4) For reproduction, extract implementation details: number of samples, decoding hyperparameters, prompt templates, and length normalization.

recommendation.zh: 点破了置信度做无验证器test-time scaling的致命缺陷，做推理缩放或自一致性研究的重点看失效分析与对比实验部分。
recommendation.en: Identifies fatal flaws in confidence-based verifier-free test-time scaling; check failure analysis and comparison experiments if working on inference-time scaling or self-consistency.

paper.title: Thought-Level Beam Search for Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time compute scaling is a primary driver of performance in large reasoning models (LRMs), but extreme inefficiency bounds current approaches, shifting the critical question from \emph{how much} compute to spend, to \emph{where} to allocate it. We formalize test-time reasoning as a constrained compute allocation problem over partial trajectories. Under a fixed hardware budget, existing paradigms fail to actively allocate the compute to the most promising partial progress: traditional paralle

summary.core_problem: 在固定硬件预算下，如何把 test-time compute 主动分配到最有希望的推理轨迹上，而不是并行采样或简单剪枝。
summary.importance: 属于 test-time scaling 与推理分配的方法创新，触及 best-of-N、tree/beam search 与 GPU 利用率之间的根本权衡，对推理模型训练与 serving 都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Gambit，做 thought-level beam search：周期性剪枝无希望轨迹，并立即从高质量前缀分叉新轨迹，动态把算力集中到 promising prefixes；通过 KV-cache 复用与调度避免剪枝导致的 GPU 饥饿。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给具体数字，但声称在固定硬件预算下相对并行采样和剪枝式方法有显著收益；作者包含 Tri Dao，系统实现可信度较高。
summary.authors_note: 作者含 Tri Dao（Stanford，FlashAttention/FlashDecoding/Mamba 等）和 Ravi Netravali（Princeton/Stanford 系统方向），系统侧实现功底强。

summary_en.core_problem: How to actively allocate a fixed hardware budget to the most promising reasoning trajectories, rather than relying on independent parallel sampling or subtractive pruning.
summary_en.importance: A test-time scaling / compute-allocation method that addresses the core trade-off between best-of-N, tree/beam search, and GPU utilization; relevant to both reasoning-model training and serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: Gambit performs thought-level beam search: it periodically prunes unpromising traces and immediately branches new ones from high-quality prefixes, concentrating compute on promising prefixes while using KV-cache reuse and scheduling to avoid GPU starvation from pruning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract gives no concrete numbers but claims substantial gains over parallel sampling and pruning baselines under a fixed hardware budget; Tri Dao's involvement lends credibility to the systems implementation.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Tri Dao (Stanford; FlashAttention, FlashDecoding, Mamba) and Ravi Netravali (systems), suggesting strong implementation quality.

recommendation.zh: 把 beam search 从 token 级抬到 thought 级并解决剪枝导致的 GPU 饥饿，是 test-time 算力分配的干净 formulation；重点看算法与 KV-cache 调度那节。
recommendation.en: Lifts beam search to the thought level and fixes GPU starvation from pruning; read the algorithm and KV-cache scheduling sections for a clean test-time compute allocation framing.

paper.title: Test-Time Augmentation for LLMs: When Input Diversity Beats Output Diversity at Matched Compute
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling improves LLM accuracy but multiplies inference cost, making the accuracy gained per unit of compute the metric that matters in deployment. Self-consistency is one of the established approaches, which spends this budget entirely on the output side by sampling repeated reasoning paths. We study Test-Time Augmentation (TTA), which extends self-consistency by also perturbing the input, aggregating predictions across transformed versions of the input, and ask whether input-side dive

summary.core_problem: 在固定推理计算预算下，研究 LLM test-time scaling 中“改输入得到多样性”是否比“重复采样输出得到多样性”更划算。
summary.importance: 贡献点是 test-time compute allocation 的经验分析。它不改模型和训练，但直接影响推理时算力如何花：更多 CoT/self-consistency 采样，还是先对输入做语义重写、词法扰动或视觉变换再聚合。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 Test-Time Augmentation 扩展到 LLM/VLM 场景，对同一个问题生成多个输入变体，再对变体的预测做聚合。比较对象包括普通 CoT prompting 和 self-consistency，并控制总推理调用次数，使输入侧多样性与输出侧多样性在 matched compute 下可比。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个数据集，包含通用与多语言知识、数学推理、多模态问答和情感分类。摘要明确指出 semantic rephrasing 在多个任务上带来稳定收益；完整提升幅度、具体模型、聚合策略和各数据集结果需看正文表格。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether spending inference-time compute on diverse inputs can yield better accuracy per compute than spending the same budget on diverse sampled outputs.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an empirical study of test-time compute allocation. It does not change pretraining, but it gives a useful deployment-side signal on whether extra calls should go to CoT/self-consistency samples or to transformed versions of the input.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method applies Test-Time Augmentation to LLM and VLM settings: generate transformed inputs through semantic rephrasing, lexical perturbation, or visual transformations, run the model on each variant, and aggregate predictions. It compares these strategies against CoT prompting and self-consistency under matched inference compute.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans six datasets covering general and multilingual knowledge, math reasoning, multimodal QA, and sentiment classification. The abstract reports consistent gains from semantic rephrasing; exact effect sizes, model choices, and aggregation details need to be checked in the paper.

recommendation.zh: 只看 matched-compute 设计和语义重写结果；它会修正“多采样就是最朴素有效 test-time scaling”的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Read the matched-compute setup and the semantic-rephrasing tables; it weakens the default habit of spending all test-time budget on repeated sampling.

paper.title: CoBa: Cost-Effective Test-Time Scaling via Compute-Balanced Routing
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling is often implemented by spending more compute along one axis: sampling more solutions, extending a chain of thought, or applying a stronger evaluator. Under a fixed inference budget, these choices compete. This paper formulates test-time reasoning as a compute-allocation problem in which a system must decide whether the next unit of compute should be spent on generation, verification, or stopping. We introduce CoBa, a compute-balanced routing policy that first obtains a small s

summary.core_problem: 测试时推理的算力分配缺乏统一框架：现有测试时缩放方法（多候选采样、长思维链、强验证器）被当作独立调节旋钮，在固定推理预算下互相挤占算力，无法在生成、验证、停止三类动作间做最优分配。
summary.importance: 分层算力路由的思路可反哺预训练阶段的生成-验证联合设计：一是为测试时算力效率导向的预训练目标设计提供参考，二是为固定总算力约束下生成大模型与验证小模型的容量配比提供量化依据。
summary.technical_approach: 将测试时推理形式化为统一的算力分配问题，动作空间包含生成候选、轻量验证、强验证、停止四类，定义总token成本、参数加权token成本两种度量（后者按模型参数量缩放token成本，反映不同规模模型的算力差异）。提出分阶段路由策略：先用少量固定预算生成少量候选保证多样性，再用轻量验证（答案频次+小模型裁判分）给所有候选打分，基于分数决定停止、继续采样、还是将高不确定性候选路由到更强的验证器。最终排序分结合答案频次、轻量验证分、可选过程验证分、强验证分，未路由到强验证的候选不会因缺失对应分数被人为惩罚或加分。设置三个变体覆盖不同成本区间：Light版（2个候选+轻量验证）、Routed版（最多4个候选+2个送强验证）、Routed-Strong版（最多8个候选+4个送强验证）。
summary.experiments: 使用Qwen3-14B、Phi-4-reasoning、Qwen3-8B作为生成器和验证器，在MATH-500、AIME 2024/2025、AMC 2023、程序符号推理共3129个示例-生成器评估对上测试。CoBa-Routed-Strong达到85.13%的宏观准确率，与best-of-16采样、自评估加权投票的准确率相当，但参数加权算力成本更低。所有对比基于离线预生成的16候选池做受控回放，保证公平性。
summary.reading_guide: 先读第2节问题形式化部分，理解统一算力分配框架的定义和两种成本度量的设计逻辑；再读第3节方法部分，重点看分阶段路由的决策流程和三个变体的配置；实验部分重点关注成本-准确率帕累托前沿的对比结果。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Test-time reasoning scaling strategies (multi-candidate sampling, extended chain-of-thought, strong verifiers) are treated as independent tuning knobs that compete for fixed inference compute, with no unified framework to optimally allocate resources across generation, verification, and stopping actions.
summary_en.importance: The tiered compute routing principle informs joint generator-verifier co-design in pretraining: it provides a reference for test-time efficiency-oriented pretraining objective design, and offers quantitative guidance for capacity splitting between large generator models and small verifier models under fixed total compute budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoBa formulates test-time reasoning as a unified compute allocation problem with four action types: candidate generation, lightweight verification, strong verification, and stopping. Two cost metrics are defined: total token cost (sum of input and output tokens across all model calls) and parameter-weighted token cost (tokens scaled by model parameter count to reflect relative compute of different model sizes). The staged routing policy first uses a small fixed warm-up budget to generate a diverse candidate pool, then scores all candidates with cheap verification (answer frequency + small model judge scores). Based on these scores, the system decides to stop, sample more candidates, or route high-uncertainty candidates to stronger verifiers. The final ranking score combines answer frequency, lightweight judge scores, optional process verifier scores, and strong verifier scores; unrouted candidates are not artificially penalized or boosted by missing strong verification signals. Three variants trace a cost-accuracy curve: CoBa-Routed-Light (2 candidates + lightweight verification), CoBa-Routed (max 4 candidates + 2 routed to strong verification), and CoBa-Routed-Strong (max 8 candidates + 4 routed to strong verification).
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 3,129 example-generator pairs across MATH-500, AIME 2024/2025, AMC 2023, and procedural symbolic reasoning, using Qwen3-14B, Phi-4-reasoning, and Qwen3-8B as generators and verifiers. CoBa-Routed-Strong reaches 85.13% macro accuracy, matching the performance of best-of-16 sampling and self-evaluation weighted voting, with lower parameter-weighted compute cost. All comparisons use controlled replay on pre-generated 16-candidate pools for fair evaluation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Section 2 (problem formulation) to understand the unified compute allocation framework and cost metric definitions. Then read Section 3 for the staged routing logic and variant configurations. For experiments, focus on the cost-accuracy Pareto frontier comparisons. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: test-time scaling的算力分配问题被干净地形式化了，路由策略值得在内部推理服务复现；重点看§3的分配公式和Table 2的token节省
recommendation.en: Clean formulation of compute allocation in test-time scaling; the routing policy is worth reproducing in internal inference serving—focus on §3 allocation and Table 2 token savings.

paper.title: From Test-Time Scaling to Reusable Memory: Measuring Crystallization in Text-to-SQL
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling can correct difficult text-to-SQL queries, but the extra computation is normally discarded after each answer. Systems increasingly retain verified repair episodes, yet evaluations still report one end-to-end score. It cannot distinguish replay on recurring questions from help on unseen questions, or identify the responsible memory choice. We call measuring this future value the crystallization problem. Our controlled evaluation holds the single-shot solver fixed and varies one

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是如何把 text-to-SQL 做得更高，而是如何衡量 test-time scaling 产生的“后续价值”。很多系统会用执行反馈、自修复、多轮采样等额外推理计算把一次失败的 SQL 修好，然后把修复轨迹存成 memory，供后续问题复用。现有评测通常只给一个端到端分数，无法区分收益到底来自重复问题的直接回放，还是来自对新问题的迁移帮助，也无法判断究竟是收集、验证、存储格式还是检索策略在起作用。作者把这个测量问题定义为 crystallization：一次性 test-time 计算，究竟有多少被“结晶”为可复用记忆，并在未来问题上兑现价值。
summary.importance: 它和狭义预训练不直接相连，但和 pretrain/post-train 接口、test-time compute 的资产化、持续学习式 memory 设计有明显关系。更具体地说，这篇工作提供了一个很干净的评测框架，用来拆开“额外推理算力”和“可复用知识沉淀”之间的关系。对做 RL、self-improvement、online adaptation、memory-augmented agent 的研究者，这种拆解很有用，因为很多方法声称把推理经验沉淀成长期能力，但常常只报一个总分，无法判断是记住了旧题，还是学到了数据库结构、schema 习惯、join 模式这类可迁移信息。论文的贡献主要是 measurement protocol 和 attribution design，而不是新的求解器。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是固定 single-shot solver，只改变 memory pipeline 的一个因素，做配对比较。作者把未来价值拆成三种使用场景。第一是 exact-query replay：同一个问题再次出现时，memory 能否直接回放已验证的正确 SQL。第二是 cross-question retention：把某个问题自己的 card 从 memory bank 中移除，再看剩余 card 是否还能帮助重新回答它，用来隔离“跨问题复用”而不是简单记忆。第三是 held-out same-database transfer：在同一数据库上留出未见问题，测 memory 对这些新问题的一次作答提升。为了把 transfer 放到可解释的尺度上，作者定义了 CR（crystallization ratio）：held-out transfer lift / 同一批 held-out 问题上的 on-demand repair headroom。这样可以回答“memory 吃掉了多少原本需要现场修复才能拿到的增益”。在具体实现上，主实验用 execution-guided repair 生成 episode，并在数据库级别建立 verified card bank。随后围绕三个研究问题做机制干预：一是价值主要出现在哪种未来使用场景；二是 transfer 到底由什么信息承载——通用示例、对齐的 question-SQL 配对，还是对目标数据库的暴露；三是收集方式、验证可靠性、card 格式、检索策略、是否必须是 repair-specific 内容，这些选择哪些真正影响结果。论文特别强调 card writer 不看 gold SQL，避免把监督信息泄漏进 memory。
summary.experiments: 主结果基于 BIRD，并使用三组 paired seeds，同时考虑数据库和问题层面的变异。最重要的数字是：在存储 verified corrected queries 的 database-scoped bank 下，held-out first-attempt accuracy 提升 4.34 个百分点；这个提升相当于同一批 held-out 问题上 on-demand repair headroom 的 44.4%。换句话说，原本需要额外修复计算才能拿到的增益里，接近一半可以通过先前积累的 memory 在首轮作答时兑现。论文还报告 memory 在 replay 和 retention 两种设置下也有明确收益，说明它不只是“记住原题答案”，也确实跨问题传递了一些数据库相关知识。机制实验给出的结论比较鲜明：transfer 主要来自“见过目标数据库”这件事，local cards 暴露的 identifiers、values、joins、query structures 即使在 question-SQL 配对被打乱时仍然有帮助；这说明迁移载体更像数据库局部模式和查询先验，而不完全依赖精确示例对齐。另一方面，可靠验证和更广的检索覆盖能带来清晰增益；更复杂的 card 格式、更 elaborate 的 retriever、以及 repair-specific 内容本身，并没有显示出统计上可靠的额外优势。这一点很重要，因为它把很多系统工程上的复杂设计压回到了几个真正有效的因素上。
summary.reading_guide: 如果只想抓住贡献，先看 Introduction 里对 replay、retention、transfer 三者的定义，再看 Figure 2 的 protocol，总体框架就清楚了。随后重点读实验设计部分，确认作者如何固定 solver、如何做 paired comparison、CR 的分母为什么选同题上的 repair headroom。主结果表需要细看，因为这篇工作的价值主要来自 measurement discipline，而不是模型结构。机制实验里最值得看的是“shuffle question-SQL pairing 仍保留不少 transfer”这一组，它直接支持“数据库暴露比示例对齐更关键”的结论。若时间有限，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以读完核心内容；若要深挖，可以继续看 verification、retrieval coverage、card formatting 的消融，判断哪些 memory 设计在别的任务上也可能成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about pushing text-to-SQL accuracy higher. It asks a cleaner question: when extra test-time computation repairs a failed query, how much of that expensive computation can be turned into reusable memory for future questions? Existing systems often store verified repair episodes, but evaluation usually collapses everything into one end-to-end score. That score cannot tell whether gains come from replaying recurring questions or from helping unseen questions over the same database, and it cannot attribute gains to specific memory choices. The paper calls this the crystallization problem: measuring how verified test-time episodes create future value.
summary_en.importance: This is adjacent to pretraining rather than directly inside it, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface, online adaptation, memory-augmented agents, and the broader question of whether test-time compute can be converted into durable capability. The main contribution is methodological. It provides a disciplined evaluation protocol that separates one-off inference gains from reusable knowledge gains. For researchers working on self-improvement, RL-style refinement, continual adaptation, or memory systems, that separation is useful because many papers report a single aggregate improvement without showing whether the system truly transfers knowledge or merely caches solved instances.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design is to hold the single-shot solver fixed and vary one memory choice at a time. The paper decomposes future value into three settings. First, exact-query replay: if the same question returns, can the system cheaply replay the stored verified SQL? Second, cross-question retention: remove a question’s own card from the bank and test whether the remaining cards still help answer it, isolating reuse across questions rather than direct memorization. Third, held-out same-database transfer: evaluate whether memory helps new questions from the same database. To make transfer interpretable, the authors define CR, the crystallization ratio, as held-out transfer lift divided by the on-demand repair headroom on those same held-out questions. This measures how much of the gain that would otherwise require fresh repair can be recovered from memory at first attempt. In the main instantiation, execution-guided repair generates episodes, which are then stored in a database-scoped verified card bank. The paper runs controlled interventions around three questions: where future value appears, what information actually carries transfer, and which choices in collection, verification, formatting, and retrieval materially affect outcomes. An important detail is that the card writer never sees gold SQL, which avoids leaking supervision into the memory bank.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments are on BIRD, with three paired seeds and analysis that accounts for variation across both databases and questions. The headline result is that storing verified corrected queries in a database-scoped bank improves held-out first-attempt accuracy by 4.34 percentage points. This gain corresponds to 44.4% of the on-demand repair headroom on the same held-out questions. In practical terms, nearly half of the benefit that would otherwise require extra repair computation can be recovered from previously accumulated memory. The paper also reports clear value in replay and retention settings, indicating that the bank is not only memorizing exact solved questions but also carrying some reusable database-specific knowledge. The mechanism studies are especially informative. Transfer is driven mainly by exposure to the target database: local cards reveal useful identifiers, values, joins, and query structures, and they still help even when question-SQL pairings are shuffled. That suggests the transferable signal is more about database-local patterns and query priors than exact aligned demonstrations. Reliable verification and broad retrieval coverage produce clear gains, while richer card formats, more elaborate retrievers, and repair-specific content do not show statistically supported advantages.
summary_en.reading_guide: If you want the main idea quickly, start with the definitions of replay, retention, and transfer, then read the protocol figure. The paper is strongest where it enforces measurement discipline, so pay close attention to how the solver is held fixed, how paired comparisons are constructed, and why CR uses repair headroom on the same held-out questions as the denominator. The most informative mechanism result is the intervention where question-SQL pairings are shuffled yet substantial transfer remains; that is the clearest evidence that database exposure matters more than exact demonstration alignment. If time is limited, 25 to 35 minutes is enough for the setup, the main result table, and the key ablations. If you want to go deeper, read the sections on verification, retrieval coverage, and card formatting to see which memory design choices are genuinely consequential.

recommendation.zh: 读实验拆分就够了；4.34pp/44.4% 这个 amortization 数字，比又报一个 Text-to-SQL 分数更有用。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental decomposition; the 4.34pp and 44.4% amortization numbers are more useful than another text-to-SQL leaderboard score.

paper.title: Stable Curves, Unstable Items: Item-Level Scaling Heterogeneity in Video LLMs
paper.abstract: Aggregate scaling curves suggest that Video LLMs improve smoothly or saturate as visual budgets grow. We show that this view can conceal large, opposing changes at the item level. We represent each frozen model--item pair by its response trajectory under controlled visual budgets and derive matched-grid measures of configuration complementarity, harmful transitions, and text overwrite. Across five open Video LLMs from three architecture families, four multiple-choice benchmark splits, open-ended

summary.core_problem: 视频 LLM 的整体 scaling 曲线掩盖了 item 层面在不同视觉 token 预算下的剧烈异质性和反向变化。
summary.importance: 原理分析类工作，指出聚合指标在多模态推理预算研究中的盲区，对 test-time visual scaling 与 token budget 调度有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 对每个冻结模型-样本对，在受控视觉预算下记录响应轨迹，构造 matched-grid 指标：配置互补性、有害迁移、文本覆盖；跨架构族和任务做对比。
summary.experiments: 5 个开源 Video LLM、3 个架构族、4 个多选 benchmark split、开放式 QA、摘要、固定历史对话；MCQA oracle 空间 8.8–18.9 点，12.5–25.5% 样本在低预算对、高预算错；MLDU Token-F1 oracle gap 2.7–3.7，AVSD 3.8–4.8。

summary_en.core_problem: Aggregate scaling curves for Video LLMs hide large item-level heterogeneity and reversals as visual token budget varies.
summary_en.importance: Analytical work exposing blind spots of aggregate metrics in multimodal compute-budget studies; relevant to test-time visual scaling and token scheduling.
summary_en.technical_approach: For each frozen model-item pair, records response trajectories under controlled visual budgets and derives matched-grid measures of configuration complementarity, harmful transitions, and text overwrite across architecture families and tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Five open Video LLMs across three architecture families, four MCQA splits, open-ended QA, summarization, fixed-history dialogue; oracle headroom 8.8–18.9 points on MCQA, 12.5–25.5% items reverse from correct to wrong; Token-F1 gaps 2.7–3.7 on MLVU and 3.8–4.8 on AVSD.

recommendation.zh: 结论本身不新，但 item-level 反向变化的量化对 visual test-time scaling 是有用警示；只看 Table 和 oracle gap 数字即可。
recommendation.en: Not a new finding, but the quantified item-level reversals are a useful caveat for visual test-time scaling; skim the tables and oracle-gap numbers.

paper.title: Refining Over Resampling: Test-Time Self-Correction for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by using additional inference compute, but wider sampling alone can suffer from diminishing returns: new rollouts often repeat existing answer patterns instead of adding useful reasoning diversity. Verifier-based selection offers an alternative, but its performance depends on the calibration of an external reward model. We propose a verifier-free breadth--depth refinement framework that uses test-time compute to both explore and improve candidate solution

summary.core_problem: Test-time scaling 下，单纯加大采样宽度(best-of-N)收益递减，外部 verifier 又依赖校准良好的奖励模型；能否在无 verifier 下用“广度+深度”自我修正更有效地利用额外推理计算？
summary.importance: 提出 verifier-free 的 breadth–depth refinement 框架，是 test-time compute 分配方向的一个实用方法组合，并在多个数学推理基准上验证。
summary.technical_approach: 先采样多条独立推理 rollout（广度），再对每条 rollout 做迭代 self-critique / self-correction（深度），最后多数投票聚合；无需外部 verifier 或 reward model。
summary.experiments: 在 AIME24、AIME25、AMC、OlympiadBench、MATH500 上对比 greedy、majority voting、verifier-based best-of-N、beam search、lookahead decoding，跨多个模型规模一致提升（具体幅度摘要截断）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 University of Oklahoma、Stanford University、UPF、Air University。

summary_en.core_problem: Under test-time scaling, pure breadth (wider sampling) hits diminishing returns because new rollouts repeat existing patterns, while verifier-based selection depends on a well-calibrated external reward model; can we use breadth + depth self-correction to spend extra inference compute more effectively without a verifier?
summary_en.importance: Proposes a verifier-free breadth–depth refinement framework for test-time reasoning, contributing a simple compute-allocation recipe evaluated across multiple math reasoning benchmarks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Samples multiple independent rollouts (breadth), iteratively refines each rollout via self-critique and self-correction (depth), then aggregates via majority voting; no external verifier or reward model required.
summary_en.experiments: On AIME24, AIME25, AMC, OlympiadBench, and MATH500, the method consistently improves over greedy decoding, majority voting, verifier-based best-of-N, beam search, and lookahead decoding across multiple model sizes (exact margins truncated in abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors from University of Oklahoma, Stanford University, Universitat Pompeu Fabra, and Air University.

recommendation.zh: test-time compute 分配的常规增量：无 verifier 时加 self-critique 深度修正比纯采样更划算；看方法段落就够，不要期待新范式。
recommendation.en: A standard incremental result on test-time compute allocation: self-critique depth beats pure breadth without a verifier; read the method section—don't expect a new paradigm.

paper.title: Relay, Don't Route: Adaptive Population Handoff for Cost-Efficient LLM-Driven Evolution
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-driven evolution has shown promise for program search and algorithm discovery, but relying on strong models throughout long evolutionary runs is costly. A natural alternative is to combine cheap and strong models under a fixed inference budget. However, existing approaches typically allocate models at the level of individual queries or mutation steps, overlooking that evolutionary search is \textit{stateful}: each generated candidate changes the population from which s

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 驱动进化搜索中，如何在固定推理预算下组合强模型与廉价模型以降低成本的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent / search 系统中的预算分配问题。价值在于把 allocation 单位从单次调用改为 population state，但对基座预训练的直接启发有限。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先分析 evolutionary trajectory，发现搜索进展前置、早期表现有信息但噪声大、廉价模型能以较低成本恢复大部分早期进展。基于此提出 training-free 的 adaptive population handoff，在不同阶段切换模型族而不是逐 query 路由。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法用于 program search 和 algorithm discovery，重点比较固定预算下强弱模型混合策略与逐步路由策略。没有预训练侧实验，主要看成本-效果曲线与 trajectory 分析。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自港大、China Mobile、城大、CMU 等，偏 LLM-driven search 与系统优化。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how to combine strong and cheap LLMs under a fixed inference budget for LLM-driven evolutionary search.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent/search budget-allocation problem. The interesting part is shifting the allocation unit from individual calls to population state, but the direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first analyzes evolutionary trajectories and finds that progress is front-loaded, early performance is informative but noisy, and cheap models can recover much of the early gains at lower cost. It then proposes a training-free adaptive population handoff strategy that switches models across search phases rather than routing each query independently.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests evaluations on program search and algorithm discovery, comparing mixed-model strategies under fixed budgets against per-query routing baselines. There is no pretraining-side experiment; the focus is on cost-performance trade-offs and trajectory analysis.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from HKU, China Mobile, CityU, and CMU, with a profile in LLM-driven search and systems optimization.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不大，但它把预算分配从 token/query 提升到 trajectory state，这个视角可迁移到 test-time scaling。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining, but the shift from token/query-level allocation to trajectory-state allocation is a reusable idea for test-time scaling.

paper.title: Argus: A General-Purpose Agentic Runtime for Long-Horizon Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long-horizon reasoning requires an agentic runtime that can persist when evidence supports its current approach and pivot when measurements reveal failure, hidden constraints, or a misspecified objective. We present Argus, a persistent, self-evolving runtime in which Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer execute bounded missions over durable project state. Argus separates stable user intent from operational objectives, constraints, and verification criteria, and admits memories, skills, proce

summary.core_problem: 长时程 agent 执行中，初始目标经常是不完备甚至错误的，agent 必须能够在不偏离用户真实意图的前提下修订操作目标；但允许修订又会引入目标漂移——失败和合理 pivot 在外部观测上不可区分。现有系统要么固定目标禁止 pivot，要么在长轨迹上丢失证据、让执行者自行验收，导致安全性与连续性同时失效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 和 agent runtime 设计有参考价值：它把“目标不是固定 supervison，而是带证据、带权限、带记录的演化合同”这个视角讲清楚了，对理解长程推理中模型需要什么样的状态表示、验证器接口、以及 self-evolution 是否可在不更新参数的情况下通过外部状态实现，提供了一个清晰的工程抽象。
summary.technical_approach: Argus 把长任务拆成 bounded missions 序列，围绕 durable project state 运行。四类角色分权：Manager 锚定意图与 campaign 状态，Planner 选下一个工作单元，Engineer 执行和评估，Reviewer 独立验收；低风险任务可走记录式 self-review。三个平面（control / execution / records）把调度、执行、记录分开。工作合同显式表示为 K_t=(ι, o_t, c_t, v_t)，其中 ι 是不变的用户意图，o_t 是当前操作目标，c_t 是约束，v_t 是验证准则。目标、约束或验证准则的更新必须由证据触发、通过对应权限角色 admission、并写入持久记录；只有能降低未来任务风险或成本的更新才被视为 compounding。论文将这一机制称为 verification-gated fixed-model runtime self-evolution：模型参数不变，但后续 mission 从演化过的搜索策略、技能、verifier、路由决策开始，而非仅从更长的 transcript 开始。
summary.experiments: 评估分为三部分：(1) 七个 benchmark arena，覆盖软件修复、GPU kernel、语言模型训练、训练速度、研究助理任务、数学数据合成；报告 SWE-Bench Pro 结果，AARRI-Bench 76.8%，数学数据合成 gap 28.0，均高于文中引用的参考值。(2) 731 个 SWE-Bench Pro 任务的长程轨迹分析，观察 Skill/Wiki 演化、verifier recovery、Reviewer 干预、成熟阶段运行成本变化。(3) 纵向部署观察，记录 41 个 research artifacts across six programs，但多数为内部系统验证案例，以定性使用反馈为主，缺少公开、对照的零干预率统计。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看第 3 节关于 K_t 合同更新规则、第 6 节关于 self-evolution 的纵向观察，以及 introduction 中对 pivot vs drift 的区分。不必细抠 benchmark 数字，因为评估以部署观察和内部案例为主，对照不严格。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-horizon agent execution, the initial objective is often underspecified or wrong, so the agent must be able to revise operational objectives without silently abandoning the user’s standing intent. But allowing revision introduces goal drift: principled pivots and outright failure are externally indistinguishable. Existing systems either fix the objective and forbid pivots, or lose evidence on long transcripts and let the executor certify its own completion, breaking both safety and continuity.
summary_en.importance: Direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but the paper is useful for post-training and agent-runtime design. It articulates a clean abstraction in which the objective is not a fixed supervision target but an evolving contract with evidence, authority, and records. That framing is helpful for thinking about what state representations, verifier interfaces, and forms of self-improvement long-horizon systems need, including fixed-model self-evolution mediated by external state rather than parameter updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: Argus structures a long campaign as a sequence of bounded missions over a durable project state. Four model-driven roles split authority: a Manager anchors intent and campaign state, a Planner selects the next unit of work, an Engineer implements and evaluates it, and a Reviewer independently inspects artifacts before issuing completion verdicts; low-risk tasks may use recorded Engineer self-review. These roles operate across three planes—control, execution, and records—so scheduling, execution, and bookkeeping stay separable. The working contract is written explicitly as K_t=(ι, o_t, c_t, v_t), where ι is the invariant user intent, o_t the current operational objective, c_t the constraints, and v_t the verification criteria. Material updates to the objective, constraints, or verifier require evidence, admission by the authorized role, and durable logging; an accepted update counts as compounding only when it reduces future task risk or cost. The mechanism is called verification-gated fixed-model runtime self-evolution: model parameters stay fixed, but later missions start from an evolved search policy with retained routes, measurements, verdicts, reusable skills, verifiers, and routing decisions rather than merely a longer transcript.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is organized in three parts. First, seven benchmark arenas cover software repair, GPU kernels, language-model training, training speed, research-assistant tasks, and mathematical data synthesis; reported numbers include SWE-Bench Pro results, 76.8% on AARRI-Bench, and a 28.0 gap on mathematical-data synthesis, all above referenced baselines. Second, a 731-task SWE-Bench Pro trajectory supports longitudinal analyses of Skill/Wiki evolution, verifier recovery, Reviewer intervention, and mature-stage operating cost. Third, deployment evidence includes 41 research artifacts across six programs, but many cases are internal system-verification episodes and are reported qualitatively; no controlled zero-touch rate is provided for the public traces.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 3 for the K_t contract-update formalism, Section 6 for the longitudinal self-evolution observations, and the introduction’s framing of pivot versus drift. Do not over-weight the benchmark numbers, since much of the evidence is observational and based on internal deployments rather than controlled comparisons. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 固定权重下仅靠运行时状态自进化就拿到SWE-Bench Pro 19点提升，token效率很高，值得关注其验证门控的设计细节
recommendation.en: A 19-point gain on SWE-Bench Pro via runtime state self-evolution without weight updates is highly token-efficient; the verification gating design is worth examining

paper.title: Test-Time Scaling in Reasoning LLMs: Inference Regimes, Evaluation, and Reproducibility
paper.abstract: Large language models can solve substantially harder reasoning problems with more inference-time compute. The term "test-time scaling," however, now covers diverse inference algorithms that extend deliberation along a single trajectory, sample completed candidates and aggregate them through voting or verification, or search over unfinished partial states. These algorithms differ in their statistical structure, compute accounting, and failure modes. Treating these procedures as interchangeable un

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 reasoning LLM 评测中的一个核心混淆：test-time scaling 已经不再是单一方法，而是一组结构不同的推理算法。延长单条思维链、多次采样后投票或 verifier 选择、在未完成前缀上做搜索，这三类方法的统计结构、计算成本、停止规则和失败模式都不同。如果只报告一个“推理预算”和最终准确率，很难判断提升来自模型能力、采样分布、聚合器、verifier，还是搜索策略。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的影响在于，它把 reasoning capability 的测量对象从“checkpoint 单点能力”推进到“模型权重 + 推理协议 + reducer/verifier + 停止规则”的完整系统。对做 base model 或 reasoning pretrain 的团队，这一点很实际：如果评测协议不固定，pretrain、SFT、RL、distillation 的增益会被 test-time controller 放大或掩盖。贡献类型主要是概念框架、评测规范和可复现实验资产，不是新的训练 recipe。量级上，它适合作为 reasoning 模型评测和训练反馈闭环的参考框架，尤其适合用于区分模型侧改进与 inference-side compute allocation 的贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 技术方案围绕一个统一形式化展开：把 autoregressive model 的生成看成隐式前缀树上的预算化推理。每个节点是一个部分序列，每条路径是一个完整 trace，test-time scaling 是在给定预算下选择如何扩展、评分、停止和聚合这些路径。工作明确区分三种 regime。第一类是 single-trajectory sequential scaling，把额外计算投入到一条不断延展的轨迹中，例如更长 deliberation 或过程中的自我修正；它的优势是实现简单、与普通 decoding 接近，但可探索性有限。第二类是 sampled inference，先生成多个完整候选，再用投票、reranking、verifier、judge 或 minimum-Bayes-risk decoding 做 reduction；这里需要区分“每条 trace 上计算了什么证据”和“最终候选池如何决策”，否则 best-of-N 与 verifier-guided selection 会被混在一起。第三类是 partial-state search，在未完成前缀上做扩展与剪枝，例如 Tree-of-Thoughts、RAP、value-guided decoding；它改变了 proposal distribution，也改变了计算账本。一个重要设计是把 causal stopping 单独建模，因为提前停止不仅影响准确率，也直接改变生成成本。评测上，工作区分 shared-bank comparison 和 end-to-end evaluation：前者用同一候选池隔离 reducer 或 verifier 的作用，后者评估完整推理系统。它还提出候选池质量诊断，特别是一组 repeated-sampling metrics，用来同时刻画 discovery 和 stability：前者关心能否采到正确解，后者关心多次运行是否稳定复现。
summary.experiments: 实验部分覆盖一批当代 open-weight reasoning models，并构建了超过 200 万条 reasoning traces，用于 trace analysis、verifier training 和可复现实验。任务范围包括 science reasoning、general reasoning 和 competition mathematics。给定内容中没有完整列出每个模型的分数表，但实验设计的重点很清楚：不是证明某个 decoding trick 单点提升，而是展示不同 test-time regimes 在相同预算描述下并不可比；shared-bank 设置可以隔离 aggregation/verifier 的贡献；end-to-end 设置则暴露 prompt、decoder、controller、judge、stopping rule 和数值超参共同造成的差异。工作也强调 proxy overoptimization：当候选数增大时，verifier 或 judge 的缺陷会被搜索过程放大，准确率提升不一定代表真实 reasoning 能力提升。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读形式化和评测协议部分。重点看三处：第一，隐式前缀树上的 budgeted inference 定义，它决定了后面对三类 regime 的划分；第二，sampled inference 中 evidence 与 decision 的分离，这是理解 best-of-N、self-consistency、reranking、verifier selection 差异的关键；第三，shared-bank comparison、end-to-end evaluation 和 repeated-sampling metrics，这些内容直接关系到 reasoning pretrain/RL 实验如何做可比评测。Figure 1 的时间线可以快速把 inference algorithm、model-side training 和 interface control 的共同演化串起来。实验部分建议关注候选池诊断、停止规则、verifier/judge 失效案例，而不是只看最终准确率。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a concrete measurement problem in reasoning LLMs: test-time scaling now refers to several different inference procedures, not a single knob. Extending one reasoning trajectory, sampling complete candidates and aggregating them, and searching over partial states have different statistical behavior, compute accounting, and failure modes. Reporting only a scalar budget and an accuracy number makes model comparisons hard to interpret.
summary_en.importance: Its main value for pretraining and reasoning-model research is methodological. It shifts evaluation from a checkpoint-only view to a system view: weights, prompt, decoder, controller, reducer, verifier or judge, stopping rule, and budget all contribute to the measured result. This matters when comparing base pretraining, reasoning SFT, RL, or distillation runs, because inference-time procedures can amplify or hide model-side differences. The contribution is an evaluation framework and reproducibility asset rather than a new training objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central formulation treats test-time scaling as budgeted inference over the implicit prefix tree of an autoregressive model. Nodes are partial prefixes, complete paths are traces, and an inference algorithm specifies how to expand, score, stop, and aggregate under a budget. The work separates three regimes. Single-trajectory sequential scaling spends extra compute on one evolving solution path. Sampled inference generates completed candidates and then applies voting, reranking, verifier selection, judge selection, or minimum-Bayes-risk style reduction. Partial-state search allocates compute before completion, expanding and pruning unfinished prefixes. A useful distinction is made between evidence computed per trace and decisions made over a completed candidate pool. Causal stopping is modeled separately because it changes generation cost, not just selection behavior. For evaluation, the work distinguishes shared-bank comparisons, which isolate reducers or verifiers on the same candidate pool, from end-to-end comparisons, which evaluate the full inference system. Candidate-bank diagnostics include repeated-sampling metrics that separate discovery from stability.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study uses a broad set of contemporary open-weight reasoning models and assembles more than 2 million reasoning traces across science, reasoning, and competition-math settings. The provided content does not expose the full score tables, but the experimental emphasis is clear: different inference regimes are not comparable under a single undifferentiated budget; shared candidate banks help isolate aggregation effects; end-to-end runs reveal the combined impact of prompting, decoding, controllers, verifiers, judges, stopping rules, and numerical settings. The study also highlights a practical failure mode: as candidate pools grow, imperfect proxy scorers can be overoptimized, so apparent gains from best-of-N or verifier-guided search may reflect scorer exploitation rather than better reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the formalization and evaluation sections carefully. The most important parts are the budgeted prefix-tree formulation, the three-regime taxonomy, the separation between per-trace evidence and pool-level decisions, and the treatment of causal stopping. The shared-bank versus end-to-end distinction is especially useful for designing reproducible reasoning-model experiments. Figure 1 is a good entry point for understanding how inference algorithms, model training, and interface controls co-evolved. In the empirical sections, focus on candidate-bank diagnostics, verifier or judge failure modes, and stopping-rule effects rather than only final accuracy.

recommendation.zh: 研究推理增强、test-time compute分配或R1类范式的人员必须读，直接修正test-time scaling的分类与评测认知，应立刻对齐内部评测规范
recommendation.en: Mandatory read for researchers working on reasoning enhancement, test-time compute allocation, or R1-style paradigms; directly corrects test-time scaling classification and evaluation priors, align internal eval protocols immediately

paper.title: Interpretable Adaptive Sampling for LLM Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling improves LLM reasoning by generating and aggregating multiple candidate answers, yet many pipelines use fixed per-query budgets that spend the same compute on easy and difficult prompts. These fixed budgets are also difficult to inspect because they do not explain why a given prompt receives a particular number of samples. We propose adaptive} test-time scaling with a lightweight fuzzy controller that maps interpretable signals, including estimated prompt complexity and model c

summary.core_problem: 为 test-time scaling 分配每题采样预算，避免简单 best-of-N 对容易题和难题使用相同推理计算。
summary.importance: 贡献是推理时计算分配方法，不是基座预训练；价值在于把 per-query compute allocation 做成可解释控制问题，可作为 test-time scaling 工程 baseline。
summary.technical_approach: 使用轻量 fuzzy controller，把估计的 prompt complexity 和 model confidence 映射到采样数量。容易或高置信题减少样本，困难或低置信题增加样本，并用 matched decoding 和受控 answer selection 做公平比较。
summary.experiments: 在问答和数学推理任务上，对比 fixed best-of-N、compute-aware scaling 和 self-certainty baseline。摘要称在不同预算下有优势，但未给出模型规模、具体数据集、绝对分数或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper allocates per-query sampling budgets for test-time scaling, rather than spending the same best-of-N compute on easy and hard prompts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is inference-time compute allocation, not base-model pretraining. Its value is in turning per-query test-time scaling into an interpretable control problem.
summary_en.technical_approach: A lightweight fuzzy controller maps prompt-complexity estimates and model confidence into a sampling budget. Easy or high-confidence prompts receive fewer samples; hard or low-confidence prompts receive more. The evaluation uses matched decoding settings and controlled answer selection.
summary_en.experiments: The paper compares against fixed best-of-N, compute-aware scaling, and self-certainty baselines on QA and math reasoning tasks. The abstract reports gains across budgets but does not provide model sizes, datasets, absolute scores, or effect sizes.

recommendation.zh: 看公平对齐协议即可；方法像工程控制器，若无大规模曲线，不足以改变 test-time scaling 规律判断。
recommendation.en: Read the fair-alignment protocol; the method is a control heuristic, and without large-scale curves it should not change test-time scaling priors.

paper.title: Shorter Reasoning, Earlier Answers? An Evaluation of Reasoning Interfaces
paper.abstract: Large language models often reason at length before answering, increasing cost and latency. Prompts and trained settings can shorten this reasoning, but a shorter trace may only show that the model stopped sooner. Here, we evaluate paired runs of the same question at matched reasoning horizons across 198 GPQA Diamond and 500 MMLU-Pro questions. We test a numeric/concision prompt that announces a token limit for Qwen3-14B and the trained effort settings of gpt-oss-20b and -120b. The Qwen prompt s

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是推理长度控制评测中的混淆问题：一个 prompt 或 effort setting 让模型更早给答案，并不等于模型在相同推理 token 预算下有更好的中间状态。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和预训练本身不直接相关，但对 post-train 与 test-time compute 的接口有参考价值。它强调评测 reasoning control 时必须区分两件事：模型何时停止并提交答案，以及在固定推理 horizon 被截断时模型当前倾向于哪个答案。这个区分对训练短推理、RL 奖励设计、推理预算标定都有用。如果只看最终完成 trace 的准确率和长度，很容易把“更早停止”误读成“更高效地思考”。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 matched-horizon paired evaluation。对同一道题、同一个模型的不同 generation condition，论文在相同 reasoning token horizon B 处比较答案，而不是只比较自然结束后的答案。它定义了多种 readout：natural-terminal readout 使用模型自然结束时的答案；standardized prefix-probe readout 在截断的 reasoning prefix 后接闭合模板，并用候选答案 logits 读出；generated-answer continuation 在截断后让模型贪心生成 final answer；common-context readout 用统一 answer context 回放不同条件的 reasoning token，以减少 answer-time prompt 差异。实现上使用 token-exact replay，避免 decode 再 tokenize 改变 prefix；候选答案评分汇总每个选项字母的有效 one-token spelling，并报告 argmax accuracy、conditional log loss、multiclass Brier score 和 valid-option probability mass。
summary.experiments: 主实验覆盖 198 道 GPQA Diamond 和 500 道 MMLU-Pro，模型包括 Qwen3-14B、gpt-oss-20b 和 gpt-oss-120b，并用 Qwen3-4B/8B 做测量校准，Omni-MATH-2 用于开放数学扩展。Qwen3-14B 的 numeric/concision prompt 可以把 reasoning trace 缩短约 12% 到 17%，但在 matched token limits 下准确率变化小且方向不稳定。另一个 concise/early-answer instruction 在 MMLU-Pro 512 token 预算下提升 3.8 个百分点；即使只看两条 run 都未完成的样本，也有 2.7 个百分点提升，但在 2048 token 时收益不确定。对 gpt-oss 的 low/medium/high effort 比较显示，低 effort 更早正确主要来自更早停止和提交，而不是在同样 horizon 下已经形成更好的答案。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。重点看 matched-horizon probe 的定义、Figure 1、Table A1，以及 readout 设计。实验结果可以优先看 Qwen3-14B 的 concision prompt、concise/early-answer instruction 的九臂 MMLU-Pro 实验，以及 gpt-oss effort setting 的对比。真正有用的部分不是某个 prompt 是否有效，而是评测协议如何把 completion timing、forced answer、common context 和 both-active subset 分开。做 reasoning SFT/RL 或评测推理预算的人可以细看候选 logit probe 的实现细节。
summary.authors_note: 从正文片段可见通讯作者为 Francesca Carlon，机构信息包含 VUB。其他作者和完整机构无法确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a confound in evaluating reasoning-length controls: shorter traces may mean that the model stops earlier, not that it has a better answer after the same amount of reasoning.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to post-training and evaluation than to pretraining recipes, but it is useful for understanding the interface between reasoning training and test-time compute. It separates answer timing from answer quality at a fixed reasoning horizon. This distinction matters for short-reasoning training, RL reward design, and benchmark protocols under token budgets. Final accuracy versus completed trace length is not enough to tell whether a control improves intermediate reasoning or merely changes the stopping policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core protocol is paired matched-horizon evaluation. For the same question and model, different generation conditions are stopped and evaluated at the same reasoning-token horizon B. The paper defines several readouts: natural-terminal readout for the answer produced by an uninterrupted run; standardized prefix-probe readout that closes a stopped reasoning block and scores answer candidates from logits; generated-answer continuation that lets the model generate an answer after interruption; and common-context readout that replays stored reasoning tokens under a shared answer context. Token-exact replay is used to avoid perturbing prefixes through decode-retokenize cycles. Candidate-logit scoring aggregates all valid one-token spellings of each answer letter and reports argmax accuracy, conditional log loss, multiclass Brier score, and valid-option probability mass.
summary_en.experiments: The main paired experiments use 198 GPQA Diamond questions and 500 MMLU-Pro questions. Models include Qwen3-14B and gpt-oss-20b/120b, with Qwen3-4B/8B used for calibration and Omni-MATH-2 used as an open-ended math extension. For Qwen3-14B, a numeric/concision prompt shortens reasoning traces by about 12-17%, but matched-horizon accuracy changes are small and mixed. A concise/early-answer instruction improves MMLU-Pro accuracy by 3.8 percentage points at a 512-token horizon, including a 2.7-point gain when both paired runs are still unfinished; the effect at 2,048 tokens is uncertain. For gpt-oss effort settings, lower effort tends to provide correct answers earlier mainly because it stops and commits earlier, not because its stopped intermediate state is clearly better at the same horizon.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25-35 minutes. Focus on the matched-horizon probe definition, Figure 1, Table A1, and the readout taxonomy. For results, prioritize the Qwen3-14B concision prompt, the nine-arm MMLU-Pro experiment for concise early answering, and the gpt-oss effort-setting comparison. The main reusable contribution is the evaluation protocol, especially the separation of completion timing, forced answers, common-context replay, and both-active subsets. Readers working on reasoning SFT, RL, or budgeted inference should inspect the candidate-logit probe implementation.
summary_en.authors_note: The provided text identifies Francesca Carlon as the corresponding author and includes VUB. Other authors and affiliations cannot be verified from the provided content.

recommendation.zh: 控制变量评测做的很干净，打破长推理必然更准的直觉，做test-time scaling的同学应复现这个对照，只看§3实验setup和核心结果即可。
recommendation.en: This well-controlled evaluation challenges the intuition that longer reasoning always yields higher accuracy; test-time scaling teams should replicate this setup, skip to §3 for the design and core results.

paper.title: Test-Time Scaling for Safe Text-Guided Image Generation via Intermediate Clean Estimates
paper.abstract: Ensuring safety and policy compliance in text-to-image diffusion models remains a critical challenge, as benign or adversarial prompts can often elicit prohibited content, e.g. nudity and protected intellectual property. While training-based unlearning methods are effective, they are computationally expensive and prone to catastrophic interference with general capabilities. Conversely, existing test-time defenses are primarily prompt-centric, relying on modifying textual descriptions only, and o

summary.core_problem: 解决文生图扩散模型在不改权重前提下，如何在推理时更可靠地拦截违规内容的问题。
summary.importance: 这是生成模型安全与 test-time intervention 工作，不直接推进 LLM 预训练，但对“推理时利用中间表征做检测与干预”这一思路有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法利用扩散生成过程中的 intermediate clean estimate 作为视觉检测信号，用 sparse margin objective 判断是否出现违规概念；一旦触发，就在文本条件空间上优化结构化低秩残差，并通过 truncated backprop 在有限预算内进行干预，保持模型权重不变。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型与数据规模；实验应围绕安全文生图场景，对比训练式 unlearning 和仅基于 prompt 的 test-time defense，关注违规拦截率、正常提示下的能力保持和额外延迟。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how to enforce safety in text-to-image diffusion models at inference time without modifying model weights.
summary_en.importance: This is a generation-safety and test-time intervention paper rather than a pretraining contribution, but the idea of using intermediate states for detection and control is still mildly relevant.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses the intermediate clean estimate during diffusion as a visual signal for prohibited-concept detection via a sparse margin objective. When a violation is detected, it optimizes a structured low-rank residual in the text-conditioning space with truncated backpropagation, leaving model weights untouched.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model or dataset scale; experiments likely compare against training-based unlearning and prompt-only test-time defenses on safety blocking, benign-prompt utility retention, and latency overhead.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不大，但“用生成中间态做检测再局部干预”这个接口设计值得记一下；正文不必细读，抓住中间 clean estimate 的用法即可。
recommendation.en: Not very relevant to pretraining, but the interface—detect from intermediate denoising states, then intervene locally—is worth noting; you do not need a full read beyond that mechanism.

paper.title: It's the Decoding Format, Not the Perturbation: Auditing Consistency-Based Selection for Vision-Language Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling lifts large language model reasoning by sampling many candidate solutions and selecting among them, yet the same recipe transfers poorly to vision-language models (VLMs): recent work shows that simple majority voting beats selection methods built on the model's own self-verification, apparently because at the selection layer an image-grounded answer and a confident guess from the language prior look the same. A natural fix is to make the selection signal one that cannot be comp

summary.core_problem: 研究 VLM test-time scaling 中，基于一致性的候选答案选择到底受益于图像扰动，还是受益于解码格式本身的改变。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是方法审计和负结果分析。它针对 VLM 上“采样多个候选再选择”的迁移失败问题，检查 perturbation-grounded selection 这类无训练选择规则是否真正提供了图像依赖信号。
summary.technical_approach: 论文考察 Perturbation Grounded Selection：对输入图像做保持标签不变的裁剪、背景遮罩、轻微光照或几何扰动，让模型在扰动图像上重新推导候选答案，并用重现一致性打分；同时控制 decoding format，区分扰动项和输出格式带来的收益。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、提升幅度。实验重点应是比较 chain-of-thought majority voting、自验证选择、空扰动退化到多数投票的 PGS，以及加入扰动后的 PGS，在不同解码格式下的表现差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether consistency-based selection for VLM test-time scaling gains from image perturbations, or merely from changes in the decoding format.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an audit-style analysis rather than a new training method. It probes why sample-and-select recipes that work for LLM reasoning transfer poorly to VLMs, especially when self-verification cannot distinguish grounded answers from confident language-prior guesses.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study evaluates Perturbation Grounded Selection, a training-free rule that perturbs the input image with label-preserving crops, masks, and mild photometric or geometric jitter, then scores candidates by whether the model re-derives them. The key control is to isolate the perturbation term from the decoding-format effect.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or numerical gains. The relevant comparisons are expected to include chain-of-thought majority voting, self-verification selection, PGS with an empty perturbation set, and PGS with actual image perturbations under controlled decoding formats.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验控制部分即可；若结论成立，VLM TTS 里不少“grounding trick”可能只是格式偏置。
recommendation.en: Read only the controlled ablations; if the claim holds, several VLM grounding tricks may just be decoding-format bias.

paper.title: Escaping Confidence Trap: Evolutionary Decoding for Mathematical Reasoning in Diffusion LLMs
paper.abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive LLMs, offering efficient generation through block-wise progressive unmasking. However, their strong general-purpose performance does not necessarily translate into reliable mathematical reasoning, where correctness depends on preserving coherent numerical-symbolic reasoning trajectories. In this work, we analyze the decoding trajectories of LLaDA 2.0 and identify a recurring diffusion confidence tra

summary.core_problem: 分析 diffusion LLM 在数学推理中为何会生成局部高置信但全局错误的推理轨迹，并提出无需训练的解码改进。
summary.importance: 这是文本 diffusion LM 生成机制和 test-time behavior 的重要分析。贡献不只是提升数学题表现，而是指出 progressive unmasking 中 token confidence 不能直接等同于 reasoning correctness，这会影响 dLLM 的解码、训练信号设计和推理评测。
summary.technical_approach: 论文以 LLaDA 2.0 的解码轨迹为对象，提出 diffusion confidence trap：局部 token 置信度与全局推理正确性错位。它区分两类失败：sampling-sensitive failures，即正确路径存在但采样不稳定；sampling-consistent failures，即多次采样仍收敛到重复的高置信错误续写。基于这一诊断，提出 Evolutionary Decoding，把 diffusion block decoding 看成可在测试时搜索和演化的过程，通过候选轨迹选择、变异或重组来逃离局部高置信错误。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确提到分析对象是 LLaDA 2.0，并面向数学推理任务；未给出具体 benchmark、模型参数、解码预算或相对 baseline 的数值提升。实验重点应关注 failure-regime 分析和 training-free test-time scaling 的增益曲线。
summary.authors_note: 作者列表中包括 Dacheng Tao。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why diffusion LLMs can produce locally high-confidence but globally wrong reasoning trajectories in math, and proposes a training-free decoding fix.
summary_en.importance: This is a relevant analysis of text diffusion LMs and their test-time behavior. The key contribution is not just math performance, but the claim that token confidence during progressive unmasking is not a reliable proxy for reasoning correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach: Using LLaDA 2.0 decoding trajectories, the paper identifies a diffusion confidence trap: local token confidence can diverge from global reasoning correctness. It separates sampling-sensitive failures, where correct paths exist but are unstable, from sampling-consistent failures, where repeated sampling converges to repetitive high-confidence wrong continuations. Evolutionary Decoding treats diffusion block decoding as a test-time search process that can select, mutate, and recombine candidate trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract names LLaDA 2.0 and mathematical reasoning as the main setup, but does not provide concrete benchmarks, parameter counts, decoding budgets, or numerical gains over baselines. The important parts to inspect are the failure-regime analysis and training-free test-time scaling curves.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Dacheng Tao.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻复现 confidence-trap 诊断；它会改变 dLLM 解码里“高置信优先 unmask”的默认安全感。
recommendation.en: Reproduce the confidence-trap probes; this directly challenges the comfort of confidence-first unmasking in diffusion LMs.

paper.title: Looped Transformers with Source-Centered State Evolution
paper.abstract: Looped Transformers create a useful train- and test-time compute axis by reusing the same Transformer block over recurrent depth, increasing effective depth at a fixed parameter count. However, that shared block must then govern an entire trajectory of varying hidden states over trained and extrapolated depths. Furthermore, in additive-injection looped Transformers, an input-conditioned signal is reintroduced at every recurrent step, so applying the shared transition at an input-conditioned refe

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理 looped Transformer 的一个具体稳定性问题：同一个 Transformer block 被反复复用时，输入相关的 source 如果在每一步都以加法方式重新注入，会让某个输入条件下的参考状态不再是固定点。即使隐藏状态已经到达作者定义的 anchor，下一次共享转移仍可能产生更新。这个“zero-deviation forcing bias”会沿循环深度传播，在训练深度内可能被模型利用，但在测试时增加循环次数后容易变成不可控的动态。论文的目标是让共享递归既保留输入条件信息，又避免 anchor 位置被重复 source 注入推着走。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在架构和训练动态层面。Looped Transformer 把深度变成一种可复用的 train/test-time compute 轴，参数量不变但有效深度可变。这和 latent reasoning、adaptive compute、长程算法泛化都有关系。贡献不在于给出一个通用的新 LM scaling recipe，而是把循环深度外推中的一个隐含自由度形式化，并用结构约束消掉。它提示了一点：当参数共享跨越深度时，常规 Transformer 中无害的 residual/source injection 会变成递归系统里的 forcing term，需要按动力系统的固定点和轨迹稳定性来设计。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Source-Centered State Evolution，简称 SCSE。作者先从输入表示 e 计算一个 learned anchor h*(e)，然后不直接在绝对 hidden state 上做循环更新，而是在相对坐标 Δ_t = h_t - h*(e) 上演化。模型实际的一步转移写成 T_t(Δ; e)，在 Δ=0 时的输出 b_t(e)=T_t(0;e) 被定义为 zero-deviation forcing bias。普通 additive-injection looped Transformer 没有约束 b_t(e)，所以 anchor 处仍可能产生 source-driven update。SCSE 则让递归 core 对零偏移保持零映射，并用 mask 使 zero-deviation 的边界精确成立，从结构上保证 T_t(0;e)=0。输入依赖没有被拿掉，而是分离到 anchor 和初始 deviation 中；真正的循环计算只在非零 deviation 上发生。和简单调参、增加容量、给 recurrent step 加条件不同，SCSE 改的是递归坐标系和固定点约束，目标是让共享 block 在训练深度和外推深度都面对一致的状态语义。
summary.experiments: 主实验在 WikiText-103 上比较 SCSE、基础 looped Transformer，以及若干控制组，包括 tuned baseline、capacity-matched control 和 recurrent-step-conditioned control。论文报告 SCSE 在所有评估循环深度上都取得最低 shared-block perplexity，覆盖训练 loop-depth 范围内和范围外。这个结果的重点不是单一深度上的 PPL，而是曲线形态：SCSE 在增加循环次数时更稳定，说明固定点约束降低了 depth extrapolation 时的动态漂移。文中还通过 anchor-response 诊断和 appendix 的 bias-subtraction counterfactual，把性能差异和 zero-deviation forcing bias 联系起来。给定材料中没有完整表格数字，因此不宜复述具体 PPL；建议以 Figure 3 和 Table 1 的深度-PPL 曲线为准。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 source、anchor、zero-deviation forcing bias 的定义，这是全文最有信息量的部分。然后看方法部分 SCSE 如何构造 anchor、deviation、zero-preserving core 和 mask。实验部分重点看 Figure 3 和 Table 1，关注不同 loop depth 下 PPL 曲线是否平滑，以及训练深度外推时各 baseline 如何退化。appendix 的 bias-subtraction counterfactual 值得快速扫一遍，它能帮助判断 SCSE 的收益是否来自固定点约束，而不只是容量或正则化差异。若关注预训练架构，可重点思考这个设计能否迁移到 MoE recurrent block、latent reasoning block 或 test-time compute 可调的解码前隐空间迭代。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a specific dynamical issue in looped Transformers. When the same Transformer block is reused across recurrent depth, additive reinjection of an input-conditioned source can make an input-conditioned reference state fail to be a fixed point. Even if the hidden state is exactly at the chosen anchor, another application of the shared transition may still produce an update. The authors call this the zero-deviation forcing bias. It can be harmless or useful within the trained loop-depth range, but it becomes a source of uncontrolled dynamics when depth is extrapolated at test time.
summary_en.importance: The relevance is architectural and dynamical rather than data-centric. Looped Transformers expose depth as a reusable compute axis: effective depth can grow without adding a separate parameter set for every layer. That connects to adaptive compute, latent reasoning, and algorithmic generalization. The useful contribution is the formulation of a hidden degree of freedom that ordinary residual/source injection creates under parameter sharing. In non-shared Transformers, different layers can absorb such effects locally. In a recurrently shared block, the same effect becomes a repeated forcing term, so fixed-point behavior and trajectory consistency matter.
summary_en.technical_approach: Source-Centered State Evolution, or SCSE, reparameterizes the recurrent computation around a learned input-conditioned anchor h*(e). Instead of evolving the absolute hidden state directly, it evolves the deviation Δ_t = h_t - h*(e). The one-step map in these coordinates is T_t(Δ; e), and its value at zero deviation, b_t(e)=T_t(0;e), measures the forcing bias at the anchor. Standard additive looped Transformers do not constrain this quantity. SCSE constructs a zero-preserving recurrent core and uses a mask so that the zero-deviation boundary is exact, giving T_t(0;e)=0 by construction. Input dependence is retained through the anchor and the initial deviation; recurrent computation is driven by off-anchor state. This differs from adding capacity, tuning the baseline, or conditioning on the recurrent step, because it changes the coordinate system and enforces a reference-preserving transition.
summary_en.experiments: The main comparison is on WikiText-103. SCSE is evaluated against a baseline looped Transformer and several controls, including tuned, capacity-matched, and recurrent-step-conditioned variants. The reported result is that SCSE obtains the lowest shared-block perplexity at every evaluated loop depth, both within and beyond the trained loop-depth range. The important experimental signal is the depth-PPL curve rather than a single number: SCSE maintains better behavior as recurrent passes increase. The paper also uses an anchor-response diagnostic and an appendix counterfactual based on bias subtraction to connect the gains to control of the zero-deviation forcing bias. Exact PPL values are not available in the provided text, so Figure 3 and Table 1 should be treated as the source of record.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction’s definitions of source, anchor, deviation, and zero-deviation forcing bias. Then read the SCSE method to see how the anchor, deviation dynamics, zero-preserving core, and mask are implemented. In the experiments, focus on Figure 3 and Table 1, especially how perplexity changes as loop depth moves outside the trained range. The appendix counterfactual is worth scanning because it helps separate the effect of fixed-point control from ordinary tuning or capacity effects. For pretraining architecture work, the main question is whether the same source-centered design applies to recurrent MoE blocks, latent reasoning modules, or other test-time-compute mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: Looped Transformer状态漂移问题的扎实改进，有明确不变性保证，做test-time scaling架构的看§3方法设计即可。
recommendation.en: A solid fix for state drift in looped Transformers with clear invariance guarantees; read §3 for the design if you work on test-time compute architectures.

paper.title: Visual prompt engineering for video models
paper.abstract: In the age of foundation models, a model is only as good as its prompt. For this reason, prompt engineering has become an essential technique for improving language model performance. Since video models are currently becoming foundation models for visual tasks (e.g., visual reasoning), we here ask whether they similarly benefit from visual prompt engineering: automatically modifying the task image to improve model performance. For example, for a visual physics reasoning task ("Where does the bal

summary.core_problem: 视频/视觉基础模型能否像文本 LLM 一样通过自动改写输入（视觉 prompt engineering）系统性提升推理性能。
summary.importance: 提出视觉侧 prompt engineering（VIPE）概念，并在视频推理任务上显示其可超过文本 prompt engineering 与 test-time scaling，对多模态推理时计算分配有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 在推理时用图像编辑模型自动修改任务图像（如将抽象草图转为写实图像等），作为视频模型的视觉 prompt，比较其与文本 prompt、test-time scaling 的效果。
summary.experiments: 在多个视频/视觉推理任务上，VIPE 带来一致提升，部分场景增益超过文本 prompt engineering 和 test-time scaling（具体模型与数值摘要未完全给出）。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Google DeepMind；Been Kim、Kevin Swersky、Priyank Jaini 等为 DeepMind 研究员。

summary_en.core_problem: Whether video/vision foundation models can systematically benefit from automatically modifying the input image, analogous to text prompt engineering for LLMs.
summary_en.importance: Introduces visual prompt engineering (VIPE) and shows it can outperform both text-based prompt engineering and test-time scaling on video reasoning, informing compute allocation at inference time for multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: At inference time, an image-editing model automatically transforms the task image (e.g., turning an abstract sketch into a photorealistic version) to serve as a visual prompt for the video model; compares against text prompts and test-time scaling.
summary_en.experiments: Across video/visual reasoning tasks, VIPE yields consistent gains, in some settings exceeding text prompt engineering and test-time scaling (exact models and numbers not fully given in the abstract).
summary_en.authors_note: Authors affiliated with Google DeepMind; includes Been Kim, Kevin Swersky, Priyank Jaini.

recommendation.zh: 视觉侧 test-time 干预的有趣现象，但与预训练关系弱，作为多模态推理时 scaling 的边角料知道即可。
recommendation.en: An interesting visual-side test-time intervention, but only loosely related to pretraining; treat as a side data point on multimodal inference-time scaling.

paper.title: Training Language Models to Cooperate with Inference-Time Controllers
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) performance increasingly depends not only on the base model, but also on the inference-time controller used to organize reasoning. Existing post-training methods, however, typically optimize for a single fixed interaction pattern, despite real deployments relying on diverse controllers such as Chain-of-Thought, self-consistency, debate, planning, and verification pipelines. This creates a training--deployment mismatch and limits transfer to new workflows. We introduce

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 post-training 与 deployment controller 之间的错配问题。现在很多推理系统并不是单轮直接回答，而是通过 CoT、self-consistency、debate、planning、verification 等多步 controller 组织多次模型调用。但常见后训练方法通常只针对一种固定交互模式优化，导致模型学到的是“适配某个 workflow 的行为”，而不是“能与一类 controller 协作的通用策略”。论文要回答的是：能否把 controller 放进训练环路，把不同 controller 视作一组相关但不相同的 MDP，让模型学习可复用的局部推理模块，从而在未见过的 controller 组合上也保持表现。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 pretrain–posttrain 接口很有启发。原因在于，越来越多系统性能来自 inference-time compute 的组织方式，而不是单次前向本身。如果后训练只对单一 controller 过拟合，那么基座模型的“可编排性”就会很差，部署时一换 workflow 就掉性能。CALM 提供了一个更贴近真实使用方式的训练视角：把 controller 当成训练分布的一部分，而不是部署时额外叠加的外壳。对基座研究员，这件事的价值在于它提示了一个新的能力维度——模型不仅要会解题，还要会在不同推理协议下稳定地产生可被上层控制器利用的中间行为。这和工具使用、验证、反思、规划等模块化能力的形成直接相关，也会反过来影响后续是否值得在预训练阶段就显式暴露更多多轮、多角色、多协议数据。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出 CALM，把 controller-aware post-training 形式化为多任务 RL。每个 controller 都是一个可执行的 Python 程序，按照 code-as-controller 范式定义多轮调用流程、角色切换、分支、聚合和验证逻辑。训练时不是固定在某一个 controller 上，而是在一个 controller 分布上采样，让同一个底座策略在多个 controller-induced MDP 上共同优化。

论文的关键建模假设是：不同 controller 虽然整体结构不同，但共享一组局部 reasoning modules，例如 CoT generation、verification、planning、critique 等。若模型能把这些模块学扎实，就有机会泛化到新的 controller 组合，而不是只记住训练时见过的完整工作流。围绕这个假设，作者研究了四种 module-level 训练策略，都是在 turn-level GRPO 目标下实现的。第一种是 flat mixing，把所有 controller 的所有 turn 混在一起训练；第二种是 uniform weighting，按模块类型做更均匀的权重分配，避免高频模块主导梯度；第三种是 adaptive gradient-norm balancing，根据不同模块产生的梯度规模做自适应平衡；第四种是 single-role-per-step，把每一步更新限制在单一角色或模块上，减少多角色混杂带来的优化干扰。

这里真正有意思的点不只是“多任务 RL”四个字，而是作者把 controller 分解成模块后，开始讨论梯度来源不平衡、turn 数差异、角色组合差异如何影响泛化。单 controller 训练时，这些问题通常被 workflow 本身掩盖；一旦目标变成跨 controller 迁移，模块级 credit assignment 和优化平衡就变成核心问题。论文也明确区分了两类泛化：一种是 held-out controller compositions，即局部原语都见过，但组合方式没见过；另一种是 broader controller shift，即角色库存或接口形式也发生变化。这种评测设计与方法假设是对齐的。
summary.experiments:
从引言给出的结果看，核心结论是多 controller 训练稳定优于单 controller 基线。单 controller 模型在自己原生 workflow 上可能表现不错，但一旦换到未见过的 controller 组合就明显退化；CALM 在 held-out compositions 和更广泛的 controller shift 上都更稳。论文的实验场景主要是数学推理任务，用来减少任务分布变化带来的干扰，把焦点放在 controller 泛化本身。

虽然当前给出的全文片段没有列出完整表格数字，但实验设计信息已经足够说明作者在测什么：一是看 familiar modules 的新组合，验证模型是否真的学到了可复用局部行为；二是看更强结构偏移，检验共享策略在角色和接口变化下是否仍然鲁棒；三是比较不同 module-level 训练策略，分析简单混合、均匀加权、梯度平衡和单角色更新哪种更有利于跨 controller 迁移。若按这篇工作的逻辑，最值得关注的不是某个单 benchmark 分数，而是“训练时 controller 多样性”与“部署时 workflow 迁移性能”之间的关系曲线，以及不同模块权重策略是否能缓解某些 controller 因 turn 更多、奖励更密而在训练中占优势的问题。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看问题设定和 controller 表示方式。Introduction 已经把动机讲得比较完整：部署依赖多种 controller，但训练通常只适配一种。接着重点看方法部分里 controller-induced MDP、module 定义、以及四种 module-level 训练策略的具体实现差异。这里决定了 CALM 到底是在学“多个 workflow”，还是在学“可复用模块”。

实验部分建议优先看两类泛化设置：held-out compositions 和 broader controller shifts。前者对应组合泛化，后者对应更强分布偏移。然后看不同训练策略的 ablation，尤其是 uniform weighting、gradient balancing、single-role-per-step 是否真的改善了跨 controller transfer，还是只是训练更稳。若论文正文提供了 controller 程序示例，也值得看一眼，因为这会帮助判断模块划分是否自然、是否容易扩展到工具调用或 agent setting。

预计 25–35 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读。若你关心 RL post-training、test-time compute、reasoning controller 或 agent workflow 搜索，这篇值得看方法和实验设计；若你更关心纯预训练，可把重点放在它对“模型可编排性”这一能力维度的启发，而不是具体 RL 细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a growing training–deployment mismatch in modern LLM systems. Real deployments increasingly rely on inference-time controllers—such as chain-of-thought, self-consistency, debate, planning, and verification pipelines—that organize multiple model calls into a structured reasoning process. Yet most post-training methods optimize the model for one fixed interaction pattern. As a result, the model often learns to fit a specific workflow rather than to cooperate with a family of controllers. CALM asks whether controller diversity can be brought into training explicitly, so that the base policy learns reusable reasoning behaviors that transfer to unseen controller compositions.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface. A larger fraction of system performance now comes from how inference-time compute is organized, not just from the base model’s one-shot capability. If post-training over-specializes to a single controller, the model’s deployability under new workflows is limited. CALM contributes a useful framing: controllers should be treated as part of the training distribution, not as an external shell added only at deployment. For foundation-model researchers, the broader implication is that model quality should include controller compatibility—whether the model can reliably produce intermediate behaviors that planners, verifiers, critics, and aggregators can use. That has consequences for how one thinks about modular reasoning skills, tool use, and possibly even what kinds of multi-turn or multi-role data should be exposed earlier in the training stack.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CALM formulates controller-aware post-training as multi-task reinforcement learning over controller-induced MDPs. Each controller is implemented as an executable Python program in a code-as-controller style. The controller specifies the sequence of model calls, active roles, branching logic, aggregation, and verification steps. Training then samples from a distribution over controllers rather than optimizing for a single fixed protocol.

The central modeling assumption is compositionality. Different controllers may have different global structures, but they share recurring local modules such as CoT generation, verification, planning, critique, and related reasoning behaviors. If the model learns these modules well, it may generalize to unseen controller compositions instead of memorizing complete workflows. To study this, the paper explores four module-level training strategies under a turn-level GRPO objective: flat mixing of all turns, uniform weighting across module types, adaptive gradient-norm balancing, and single-role-per-step training. These variants are motivated by a real optimization issue: controllers differ in turn count and role composition, so some modules naturally dominate the gradient signal unless training explicitly compensates for that imbalance.

What makes the paper interesting is not merely that it uses multi-task RL, but that it treats controller structure as a source of reusable local behaviors and then asks how optimization should respect that structure. Once the goal is cross-controller transfer, module-level credit assignment and gradient balancing become first-order concerns. The evaluation setup is aligned with this hypothesis: the paper distinguishes transfer to held-out compositions built from familiar modules from broader controller shifts that alter role inventories or interfaces.
summary_en.experiments:
From the full introduction, the main empirical conclusion is clear: multi-controller training consistently outperforms single-controller baselines on transfer. Models trained on one native controller may do well on that workflow but degrade on unseen controller compositions, whereas CALM is more robust both on held-out compositions and on broader controller shifts. The experiments are conducted on mathematical reasoning tasks, which helps isolate controller generalization from large changes in task distribution.

The excerpt provided does not include the full result tables, so exact numbers are not available here. Still, the experimental design is already informative. The paper evaluates two distinct generalization regimes. First, it tests recombination: can the model handle new workflows assembled from familiar local reasoning primitives? Second, it tests stronger structural shift: does the shared policy remain effective when the set of roles or the interaction interface changes? It also compares the four module-level training strategies to understand whether simple mixing is enough or whether explicit balancing across modules improves transfer.

The most important thing to look for in the full experiments is not a single benchmark score, but the relationship between controller diversity during training and workflow transfer at deployment. In particular, the ablations should reveal whether weighting and gradient-balancing strategies prevent controllers with more turns or denser rewards from dominating optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the problem framing in the introduction. The motivation is straightforward and well stated: deployment uses many controllers, while training usually optimizes for one. Then move to the method section and focus on three items: how controllers are represented as executable programs, how modules are defined, and how the four module-level training strategies differ in practice. Those details determine whether CALM is really learning reusable components or just jointly fitting several workflows.

In the experiments, prioritize the two transfer settings: held-out controller compositions and broader controller shifts. The first tests compositional generalization; the second tests robustness under stronger structural change. Then read the ablations comparing flat mixing, uniform weighting, adaptive gradient balancing, and single-role-per-step updates. If the paper includes controller code examples, they are worth a quick look because they help judge whether the module decomposition is natural and whether the framework could extend to tool use or agent settings.

A useful skim should take about 25–35 minutes. If your focus is RL post-training, inference-time compute, or controller search, the method and evaluation design are the main value. If your focus is core pretraining, the takeaway is more conceptual: controller compatibility may be an important capability axis for future base models.

recommendation.zh: 把 controller 分布纳入 GRPO 多任务训练的思路值得在内部 test-time scaling 实验里复现；先看 §3 框架和消融表。
recommendation.en: The idea of folding the controller distribution into multi-task GRPO is worth reproducing in internal test-time scaling ablations; start with §3 and the ablation tables.

paper.title: Teaching LLMs to Self-Evolve: Cultivating Core Meta-Skills with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling through iterative self-evolution with environment feedback, as demonstrated by AlphaEvolve, shows remarkable performance gains. We hypothesize that the success of such evolution frameworks hinges on meta-skills, such as self-reflection with environment feedback, that enable effective multi-round refinement, yet are largely neglected by traditional post-training. To bridge this gap, we present MetaEvolve, a framework designed to develop these meta-skills via a data synthesis pip

summary.core_problem: 如何把“带环境反馈的多轮自我改进”（self-evolution）从纯推理时启发式，变成模型可学习、可泛化的能力：模型不仅要解出题，还要在看到上一轮方案与反馈后，稳定地产生“更好”的下一轮方案，并能从历史尝试中提炼可操作的改进方向。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练闭环的启发在于：把“相对改进”而非“绝对正确”作为训练信号，提供了一种更接近 test-time scaling（迭代搜索/反思/修补）的对齐方式。它把可验证环境（代码执行）产生的连续奖励用于训练“改进能力”，在一定程度上缓解了传统 RLHF/PRM 更偏向单轮完成任务、难以直接优化多轮演化策略的问题。对通用预训练的直接贡献有限（主要是后训练范式），但对如何构造可规模化的过程数据、如何定义 reward 以鼓励真实进步而非模板化自省，有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三块组成：
1) 进化轨迹数据合成：基于约 25k 道编程题，先为每题采样多份候选程序（文中示例为每题 10 个），再做“两阶段多样性过滤”，优先保留解法池足够多样的题目与解答对。多样性信号不仅看语义，还用程序表面结构代理（字符长度差、行数差等）来确保历史尝试之间存在可学习的差异；核心动机是：如果历史解都很像，模型学不到“哪些改动带来性能提升”。
2) Evolution-aware RL：训练时输入显式包含“当前解 + 性能反馈 + 历史尝试”的上下文，让模型输出下一轮改进版程序。奖励来自可验证执行：既包含正确性，也包含运行时间等连续信号，从而把“能跑”与“跑得更快”之间的梯度变成可优化目标。与常见 coding RL 只优化 pass@k/AC 不同，这里优化的是相对提升（improvement）与多轮策略。
3) 推理时演化搜索：训练目标与推理时流程对齐，推理阶段继续用多轮生成-执行-反馈的循环做搜索/改进。论文强调：很多自我演化系统（如 AlphaEvolve 类）在推理时做多轮，但模型本身没在这种分布下训练；MetaEvolve 试图用数据与 RL 把这种分布内化。
差异点：不是教模型“写更长的反思”，而是把反思/诊断是否有效交给环境奖励裁决；并且把“历史轨迹”作为一等公民进入训练样本，而不是单轮 prompt engineering。
summary.experiments:
论文报告覆盖 7 个编程基准的多轮改进评测，核心指标是“绝对平均改进率”（absolute average improvement rate）。相对最强基线：
- In-distribution：绝对平均改进率 +10.01%。
- Out-of-distribution：绝对平均改进率 +24.12%。
- AlgoTune（开放式算法优化，超出训练域）：相对改进 +46.91%。
此外做了“程序新颖性/结构多样性”分析，显示生成解更结构化多样（文中对应 Table 3），并用案例展示更像“针对性诊断→策略调整→结构性重写”的多轮行为，而不是重复试错（Figure 2）。
局限：从给出的全文片段看，奖励设计与训练细节（例如如何把 runtime 归一化、如何处理噪声/超时、是否做 per-problem baseline、RL 算法与 KL 约束等）对可复现性与可迁移性很关键，但需要在方法与附录里核对；另外“元技能可迁移到非代码域”的证据主要来自跨基准/开放式优化任务，离真正跨模态/跨领域仍有距离。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1（整体训练/推理闭环）与 Figure 2（行为对比），把“训练分布对齐推理分布”的主线抓住。
- 重点看数据合成与多样性过滤的定义：它决定了模型到底学到“比较与改进”，还是学到“换皮重写”。关注两阶段过滤各自筛掉什么样的题。
- 重点看 reward 由执行信号构成的细节：正确性与性能如何组合、如何避免 reward hacking（例如投机取巧的微基准优化）。
- 实验部分优先看 OOD 与 AlgoTune（Table 2/4），再回头看消融：是否去掉历史轨迹、去掉多样性过滤、只用 correctness reward、只做 SFT 不做 RL 等，哪些组件真正贡献改进率。

summary_en.core_problem: Turning iterative self-evolution with environment feedback from a purely inference-time heuristic into a trainable capability: given prior attempts plus execution feedback, the model should reliably produce a meaningfully improved next attempt, learning how to diagnose weaknesses and exploit historical trajectories rather than just solving tasks in one shot.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model researchers is methodological rather than a new pretraining recipe: it reframes the objective from absolute task completion to relative improvement across rounds, aligning training with test-time scaling loops (generate→run→feedback→revise). Using execution-derived, continuous rewards (correctness + runtime) provides a scalable signal for learning multi-round refinement policies, which standard RLHF or single-turn verifiable RL typically does not target explicitly. Direct impact on base pretraining is limited, but it informs how to build trajectory data and rewards that incentivize real progress instead of verbose self-reflection.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MetaEvolve combines (i) trajectory-aware data synthesis, (ii) evolution-aware RL, and (iii) inference-time evolutionary search.
- Data synthesis: starting from ~25k coding problems, sample multiple candidate programs per problem (example: 10). Apply a two-stage diversity filtering to keep problems/solution pools where attempts are sufficiently different, using simple structural proxies (e.g., character length and line count differences) to ensure the history contains learnable variation.
- Evolution-aware RL: train the model on inputs that explicitly include the current solution, performance feedback, and a history of prior attempts; the target is an improved program.
