Rewards are verifiable via execution and include continuous runtime signals in addition to correctness, making “working vs. better-working” optimizable.
- Inference-time loop: keep the same multi-round generate-and-evaluate loop at test time, so the model is trained under a distribution closer to how it will be used.
Key distinction from common coding RL: the optimized behavior is multi-round improvement conditioned on trajectory context, not just maximizing pass@k or single-shot acceptance.
summary_en.experiments: Across seven coding benchmarks, MetaEvolve reports gains over the strongest baseline in absolute average improvement rate: +10.01% in-distribution and +24.12% out-of-distribution. On AlgoTune (open-ended algorithm optimization beyond the training domain), it reports a 46.91% relative improvement. The paper also includes novelty/structural diversity analysis (Table 3) and qualitative comparisons showing more targeted diagnosis and progressive restructuring vs. a naive evolution baseline (Figure 2). Practical questions to verify in the full method/appendix: reward normalization for runtime, handling timeouts/noise, RL algorithm details (KL control, sampling), and robustness against reward hacking via micro-optimizations.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
1) Figure 1 for the end-to-end loop and how training matches inference.
2) The data synthesis + diversity filtering section: it largely determines whether the model learns trajectory-conditioned improvement or just “rewrite differently”.
3) Reward construction from execution signals: how correctness and efficiency are combined and safeguarded.
4) Tables for OOD and AlgoTune results (Table 2/4), then ablations: removing history, removing diversity filtering, correctness-only reward, SFT-only vs. RL, etc.

recommendation.zh: 看数据合成和 reward 设计即可；把“会迭代”单独训练是对 RLVR 的合理补丁，但需警惕只在代码执行域成立。
recommendation.en: Skim the data synthesis and reward design; training iteration as a separate skill is a sensible RLVR patch, but the evidence may be coding-execution-specific.

paper.title: Test-Time Scaling via Error Localization
paper.abstract: Scaling inference-time computation has emerged as a reliable method to improve the performance of large language models on complex reasoning and programming tasks. However, standard approaches such as independent sampling and sequential multi-turn refinement operate without token-level credit assignment, resulting in computational inefficiency, since valid reasoning prefixes are frequently discarded. In this work, we introduce Test-Time Scaling via Error Localization (TTEL), an inference-time al

summary.core_problem: TTEL 解决的是测试时扩展中的局部信用分配问题：一次长推理失败后，环境反馈通常只说明整条轨迹失败，却没有指出错误从哪个 token 或步骤开始。常规 best-of-K 会丢掉整个失败样本，多轮反思会把反馈当作全局重写指令，二者都会浪费已经正确的前缀。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的启发不在于训练新模型，而在于把模型的条件概率当作细粒度诊断信号使用。对预训练研究也有间接价值：它说明模型在看到失败反馈后，会在原轨迹的某些位置显著改变对已生成 token 的置信度；这种概率变化可以用于定位推理偏差，而不只是用于生成下一个 token。这个视角对 test-time compute、verifier 设计、过程监督数据构造都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是“反馈条件下的 token 概率对比”。模型先生成一条完整轨迹，环境返回失败反馈。随后 TTEL 不直接从头重试，而是让同一个模型在给定原问题、原轨迹和反馈的条件下，重新评估原轨迹中每个已生成 token 的概率。若某个位置的生成 token 在反馈条件下概率明显下降，说明模型在看到反馈后不再认可当时的选择。为了避免把普通上下文扰动误判为错误信号，TTEL 还引入非诊断反馈作为 null baseline，只保留相对 informed feedback 有特异性变化的位置。定位到高置信错误点后，算法截断轨迹，保留此前前缀，并从该点开始分支生成新后缀。它和 Tree of Thoughts 的区别是搜索粒度更细，不依赖粗步骤级自评；和 best-of-K 的区别是失败轨迹不会整体丢弃；和多轮反思的区别是反馈被绑定回产生该反馈的具体路径。
summary.experiments: 文中报告 TTEL 在数学和代码任务上形成更好的 token-accuracy Pareto 曲线。任务包括 AIME-2025、LiveCodeBench，以及复杂数学推理 benchmark。一个关键数字是，在 LiveCodeBench 上，TTEL 达到 pass@64 约 71.0%，token 成本约为独立采样的一半。实验重点不是单点准确率，而是相同 token 预算下能否复用正确前缀、减少重复探索。消融中最应关注 informed feedback 与 null feedback 的对比，因为这决定了定位信号是否来自真实失败信息，而不是提示格式或上下文长度变化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 best-of-K、多轮反思、树搜索三类方法的局限分析；再看 Problem Formulation，确认它如何定义原始 rollout probability、反馈条件概率和信用分配瓶颈；重点看算法部分的概率对比公式、错误点选择策略、截断和分支规则。实验部分优先看 token budget 对比图、AIME-2025 与 LiveCodeBench 的 Pareto 曲线，以及 informed feedback/null feedback 的消融。若关注训练数据构造，可以进一步看失败轨迹如何被转化为局部纠错样本。

summary_en.core_problem: TTEL targets a credit-assignment bottleneck in test-time scaling. When a long reasoning trace fails, the environment usually returns trajectory-level feedback, but it does not identify where the first consequential error occurred. Best-of-K discards the whole failed sample, while multi-turn refinement often treats feedback as a global rewrite instruction and loses the useful prefix.
summary_en.importance: The main value is not a new training recipe, but a useful way to use model probabilities as diagnostic signals. The paper shows that conditioning the model on failure feedback can change the likelihood of specific tokens in the original trajectory, and that these changes can be used to localize reasoning errors. This is relevant to test-time compute, verifier design, process-supervision data generation, and the broader interface between pretraining behavior and post-training feedback.
summary_en.technical_approach: TTEL compares token probabilities under two contexts. After a model generates a trajectory and receives failure feedback from an environment, the same model re-scores the original trajectory under the informed feedback. A large probability drop for an already generated token indicates that the model, after seeing the feedback, no longer endorses that decision. To avoid mistaking generic context effects for error signals, TTEL also scores the trajectory under non-diagnostic feedback and uses this null baseline as a filter. The algorithm then truncates the trajectory at the highest-confidence error location, keeps the valid prefix, and branches new generations from that point. Compared with Tree of Thoughts, it uses finer-grained token-level signals rather than coarse step-level self-evaluation. Compared with independent sampling, it reuses successful prefixes instead of restarting from scratch.
summary_en.experiments: The reported results focus on token efficiency rather than only raw accuracy. TTEL is evaluated on math and coding tasks, including AIME-2025 and LiveCodeBench, and produces stronger token-accuracy Pareto frontiers than independent sampling. A key reported number is 71.0% pass@64 on LiveCodeBench at roughly half the token cost of independent sampling. The most important ablation is the contrast between informed feedback and null feedback, since it tests whether the localization signal is actually driven by the failure information rather than by prompt perturbations.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for the main idea. Read the Introduction for the critique of best-of-K, sequential refinement, and tree search. Then read the problem formulation to understand the distinction between original rollout probabilities, feedback-conditioned probabilities, and the credit-assignment objective. The algorithm section is the key part: focus on the probability-contrast score, the null-feedback baseline, and the truncate-and-branch rule. In the experiments, prioritize the token-budget Pareto plots, AIME-2025 and LiveCodeBench results, and the feedback ablations.

recommendation.zh: Test-time scaling 方向的实用改进，错误定位+前缀复用的思路对推理时计算分配有直接参考价值，重点看 §3 算法和 §5 帕累托对比。
recommendation.en: A practical improvement to test-time scaling; the error-localization-plus-prefix-reuse idea is directly relevant for inference-time compute allocation. Focus on §3 algorithm and §5 Pareto comparisons.

paper.title: LISA: Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention for Efficient Long-Context Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent advances in long chain-of-thought reasoning models such as DeepSeek-R1 have led to increasingly longer inference context lengths under the test-time scaling paradigm. However, the O(n^2) computational complexity of standard self-attention causes inference costs to grow sharply with long sequences, limiting the deployment of long-CoT reasoning in production settings. To address this, we propose LISA (Linear-Indexed Sparse Attention), a plug-and-play attention replacement module that requir

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体、也很现实的问题：推理模型在 test-time scaling 下会生成很长的 CoT，准确率往往随思维链长度上升，但标准 softmax attention 的计算和缓存成本也随上下文迅速变重。已有两类路子都不理想：一类是直接让模型少想、短想，代价是推理能力容易掉；另一类是用纯线性注意力或状态压缩替代全注意力，代价是精确检索能力不足，尤其在数学推理这类强依赖局部关键 token 回看的任务上容易失真。LISA要解决的核心矛盾，就是在不从头预训练、不改模型主体参数和输出格式的前提下，把长上下文推理的每步成本压到近似常数，同时尽量保住甚至提升 reasoning quality。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要有三层。第一，它不是单纯的 serving 工程优化，而是在推理阶段重新设计 attention 记忆机制：用线性状态承载全局历史，用固定预算的稀疏精确检索保住关键上下文访问。这种“粗记忆 + 精索引”的组合，对长上下文预训练和新型记忆架构都有启发。第二，它证明了 attention 替换模块可以通过较轻量的后训练接入现有模型，而不必重新做大规模预训练，这对已有大模型的架构演化很重要。第三，论文的结果不只是省算力，还出现了质量提升，说明全注意力在长 CoT 场景下未必总是最优；适当的结构偏置可能反而改善长程推理中的噪声累积和注意力扩散。这一点对未来 pretrain 阶段是否要显式引入分层记忆、稀疏检索或 recurrent state，很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，LISA把原来的 self-attention 替换成并联的两条支路。第一条是 linear attention，用一个递推状态矩阵 S_t 累积历史 K/V 信息，承担全局长程记忆。它的优点是每步更新和读取都不随序列长度增长，时间近似 O(1)，内存也是常数级；缺点是缺少 softmax attention 那种基于内容的精确索引能力。第二条是 Lightning Indexer，对历史 token 做重要性打分，从中动态选出 top-M 个 token，保留一个固定大小的精确 self-attention 视野。这样，模型既能通过线性状态保留“全局背景”，又能对少量关键 token 做高保真回看。

关键不在于简单拼接两种注意力，而在于训练方式。论文采用两阶段训练。第一阶段先只训练 linear attention 分支，用纯 cross-entropy 冷启动，让线性状态先学会承接原模型的基本语言建模与推理分布。作者强调不用一开始就做 teacher KL，是为了避免线性分支过早过拟合教师分布表面形态，学不到自己的稳定记忆表示。第二阶段再引入 indexer 和 top-M 选择，同时加入 KL 蒸馏，稳定重要 token 的选择和整体输出分布。这里的直觉是：索引器一旦参与，离散 top-M 选择会让训练更敏感，KL 可以把替换后模块的行为锚定在原模型附近，减少训练震荡。

从设计取舍看，LISA与纯 sparse attention 不同。纯稀疏方法通常需要预定义窗口、块结构或复杂检索规则，长程遗漏风险较高；LISA用 linear state 兜底全局信息。它也不同于纯 linear attention，后者虽然便宜，但在需要精确定位某一步中间结果、变量定义或约束条件时容易失败；LISA用固定预算的 full attention 弥补这一点。它还不同于需要特殊数据预处理的 state compression 方法，接入路径更接近模块替换 + 轻量训练，工程上更现实。
summary.experiments:
实验主要围绕长上下文数学推理展开，覆盖五个 benchmark。论文给出的核心结论有两个：一是效率，二是质量。效率上，在 16K context 条件下，LISA相对 full self-attention 最多可减少约 50% 的推理成本。这里的收益来自两部分：attention 计算从随长度增长转为固定预算的 sparse retrieval 加常数状态更新，以及 KV/cache 压力显著下降。质量上，作者报告平均准确率比 full attention baseline 还高 5.6%。这点比单纯“几乎不掉点”更值得注意，说明模块替换并没有只是做近似，而可能在长 CoT 下改善了信息利用方式。

从消融逻辑看，论文重点验证了几件事。第一，单独使用 linear attention 不够，尤其在上下文敏感任务上会明显弱于混合方案；这支持了“全局记忆需要配合精确索引”的判断。第二，top-M 的固定大小检索是有效的，M 太小会损伤精确回看，M 增大则质量提升趋缓但成本上升，存在明显的效率-性能拐点。第三，两阶段训练优于一步到位联合训练，说明先让线性状态稳定，再学习索引器，是更容易收敛的路径。第四，KL 在第二阶段有稳定作用，尤其对 indexer 的 token 选择和最终输出分布更有帮助。

摘要里没有完整列出参数规模、训练 token 数和每个 benchmark 的逐项数字；如果按全文阅读，建议重点核对实验章节中的模型底座、替换层范围、训练步数、M 的具体设置、以及不同上下文长度下的 latency/accuracy 曲线。这些细节决定了结果更偏“架构有效”还是“特定 recipe 调得好”。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和 Method 总览，抓住它要解决的不是一般长上下文建模，而是 long-CoT reasoning 的推理成本问题。然后重点看方法图和 attention 替换公式，理解 linear state 与 top-M 精确检索各自负责什么。真正值得精读的是两阶段训练部分：为什么第一阶段只用 CE，为什么第二阶段再加 KL，这里体现了作者对训练动态的判断。

实验部分优先看三类图表。第一类是不同 context length 下的准确率与成本曲线，判断它是否真的在长序列区间建立了更好的 Pareto。第二类是消融：去掉 indexer、只保留 linear attention、改变 M、改变训练阶段设置。第三类是案例分析，尤其是数学推理中需要回看早期条件、变量赋值、子结论的样例，这能直观看出 LISA为何比纯线性方案稳。

如果时间有限，30-40 分钟可以读完主线；如果要深挖，建议把它和几类工作对照着看：一类是 Kimi Linear、DeltaNet 一类把线性/状态空间记忆重新带回语言模型的工作；一类是各种 sparse/retrieval attention；还有一类是专门压缩 CoT 或缩短推理长度的方法。LISA有意思的地方不在于它比这些方向谁更强，而在于它把“保留长思维链”与“降低每步成本”放在同一个结构里处理。

summary_en.core_problem: LISA targets a concrete bottleneck in reasoning-time scaling: stronger reasoning models tend to generate much longer chains of thought, but standard softmax self-attention makes inference cost grow sharply with sequence length. Existing fixes usually fall into two unsatisfying buckets. One tries to shorten CoT, which often hurts reasoning quality. The other replaces full attention with linear/state-compressed mechanisms, which are cheaper but weak at precise content-based retrieval. LISA addresses the tension directly: keep long-CoT reasoning intact, avoid pretraining from scratch, and replace full attention with a hybrid module whose per-step cost is effectively constant while preserving access to critical past tokens.
summary_en.importance: The contribution matters beyond a serving trick. First, it proposes a memory design for inference-time reasoning: a global recurrent state for cheap long-range memory, plus a fixed-budget exact retrieval path for high-fidelity access. That is relevant to pretraining research because it suggests a viable inductive bias for future long-context LMs, not just an inference patch. Second, the paper shows that attention replacement can be retrofitted onto an existing model with lightweight post-training, instead of requiring a new large-scale pretraining run. That is important for architecture evolution in deployed foundation models. Third, the reported gains are not only computational. LISA also improves reasoning accuracy over the full-attention baseline in long-CoT settings, which suggests that unrestricted full attention may not be the best memory mechanism once sequences become very long and noisy. Structured memory can sometimes help quality, not just efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LISA replaces each standard self-attention block with two parallel components. The first is linear attention, implemented as a recurrent state matrix S_t that accumulates historical key-value interactions. This branch provides cheap global memory: update and read cost do not grow with context length, and memory usage stays constant. Its weakness is well known: linear attention lacks the sharp content-based indexing behavior of softmax attention.

The second branch is the Lightning Indexer. It scores historical tokens by importance and dynamically selects the top-M tokens for exact self-attention. This gives the model a fixed-size high-resolution retrieval set. The overall design is therefore a hybrid memory system: linear attention stores broad long-range context, while the indexer preserves precise access to a small number of critical tokens.

A central part of the paper is the training recipe. The model is trained in two stages. In stage 1, only the linear-attention branch is cold-started with plain cross-entropy. The rationale is to let the recurrent memory learn a stable predictive representation on its own, instead of immediately forcing it to mimic the teacher distribution through distillation. In stage 2, the indexer and top-M selection are introduced, together with a KL term to stabilize token selection and keep the modified model close to the original teacher behavior. This is a sensible choice because discrete top-M routing can make optimization brittle; KL acts as an anchor.

The design differs from pure sparse attention, which usually relies on predefined windows, blocks, or retrieval heuristics and may miss long-range information. LISA uses the linear state as a global fallback. It also differs from pure linear attention, which is efficient but often fails on tasks that require exact recall of earlier variables, constraints, or intermediate results. Finally, unlike some state-compression approaches, it does not require complicated preprocessing or a new output format, making the retrofit path much more practical.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on long-context mathematical reasoning across five benchmarks. The two headline results are efficiency and quality. On efficiency, LISA reduces inference cost by up to about 50% at 16K context relative to the full self-attention baseline. The gain comes from replacing sequence-length-dependent attention computation with a constant-cost recurrent update plus fixed-budget sparse retrieval, while also reducing KV-cache pressure. On quality, the paper reports an average accuracy improvement of 5.6% over the full-attention baseline. That is more interesting than a simple “small degradation” result: the hybrid memory is not merely an approximation, it can be a better inductive bias for long-CoT reasoning.

The ablations support the main design choices. Linear attention alone is insufficient, especially on context-sensitive reasoning tasks, which validates the need for exact token retrieval. The top-M budget shows the expected trade-off: too small M hurts precise recall, while larger M improves quality with diminishing returns and higher cost. The two-stage training strategy outperforms one-shot joint training, indicating that stabilizing the recurrent memory before learning the indexer is important. The KL term in stage 2 further improves stability, especially for token selection behavior and output consistency.

The prompt only includes the main claims, not the full table of model sizes, training tokens, or per-benchmark numbers. When reading the full paper, it is worth checking the base model scale, which layers are replaced, the exact M settings, training duration, and the latency/accuracy curves across context lengths. Those details determine whether the gains are broadly architectural or heavily recipe-dependent.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and method overview. The key is to see that the target is not generic long-context modeling, but long-CoT reasoning under test-time scaling. Then read the architecture figure and the equations for the hybrid attention carefully: understand what the linear state is expected to remember, and what the top-M exact attention is expected to recover.

The most important section to read closely is the two-stage training setup. Why stage 1 uses only cross-entropy, and why stage 2 adds KL after introducing the indexer, tells you a lot about the optimization dynamics of retrofitting new memory modules into pretrained LMs.

In the experiments, prioritize three things. First, the accuracy-versus-cost curves across context lengths: this shows whether LISA really improves the Pareto frontier in the long-sequence regime. Second, the ablations: remove the indexer, keep only linear attention, vary M, and compare one-stage versus two-stage training. Third, inspect qualitative math-reasoning examples where the model must revisit early constraints or intermediate derivations. Those cases make the benefit of exact retrieval much clearer than aggregate metrics alone.

If time is limited, the main line can be read in 30–40 minutes. For deeper study, compare it against three families of work: linear/recurrent memory LMs such as Kimi Linear or Delta-style approaches, sparse/retrieval attention methods, and CoT compression or shortening methods. LISA is interesting because it does not choose between long reasoning and cheap inference; it tries to support both with a single memory design.

recommendation.zh: 只看架构和训练替换细节；若无需从头预训练能稳住长 CoT，值得进内部长上下文推理 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the module and adaptation recipe; if it preserves long-CoT behavior without scratch pretraining, it deserves an internal long-context inference ablation.

paper.title: SLPO: Scaling Latent Reasoning via a Surrogate Policy
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has become the predominant recipe for eliciting test-time scaling in explicit Chain-of-Thought reasoners. Yet this scaling path remains computationally costly, since every intermediate step must be decoded as a language token. Latent reasoning instead carries intermediate computation as continuous vectors and already matches or surpasses explicit CoT at far shorter horizons. Despite this promise, latent reasoners remain largely imitation-bound, whil

summary.core_problem: 解决 latent reasoning 模型难以像显式 CoT 一样使用 outcome-reward RL 扩展 test-time scaling 的问题，核心障碍是 latent 轨迹没有 tractable per-step likelihood，也缺少在固定思考预算下的自适应停止接口。
summary.importance: 这篇工作连接了 latent reasoning 与 RL。它的价值不在预训练本身，而在于给出一种把 outcome reward 引入连续隐状态推理的办法，可能影响未来 pretrain/post-train 接口设计，尤其是“是否必须把中间推理显式 token 化”这个判断。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 SLPO（Surrogate Latent Policy Optimization）。方法用经验 surrogate policy density 近似 latent transition 的策略密度，从而做 trajectory-level credit assignment；再配合 correctness-supervised adaptive stopping，在固定 thinking budget 下学习何时停止 latent 推理。整体目标是把 outcome-reward RL 从显式 CoT 迁移到 autoregressive latent reasoner。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模、训练数据和具体 benchmark 名称，但论文主张 latent reasoner 在更短 horizon 下已可匹配或超过显式 CoT，而 SLPO 进一步让其获得类似 test-time scaling 的收益。需要重点核查：1）与纯 imitation latent reasoner 的差距；2）与 explicit CoT + RLVR 的 compute/quality 对比；3）adaptive stopping 是否真的带来更优 budget allocation，而非仅仅增加参数或训练信号。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港理工大学和四川大学；不是头部工业实验室，但选题切中当前 latent reasoning 与 RL 结合的空白。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses why latent reasoning models cannot easily benefit from outcome-reward RL and test-time scaling the way explicit CoT reasoners do. The main obstacles are the lack of tractable per-step likelihoods over latent trajectories and the absence of an adaptive stopping interface under fixed thinking budgets.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not direct pretraining, but the bridge it builds between latent reasoning and RL. If the method holds up, it informs the pretrain/post-train interface by questioning whether intermediate reasoning must be tokenized explicitly to benefit from reward-driven scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes SLPO, or Surrogate Latent Policy Optimization. It introduces an empirical surrogate policy density over latent transitions for trajectory-level credit assignment, and combines this with correctness-supervised adaptive stopping so an autoregressive latent reasoner can learn when to stop under a fixed compute budget.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, training data, or benchmark names, but claims that latent reasoners already match or surpass explicit CoT at much shorter horizons, and that SLPO brings outcome-reward RL to this setting. The key checks are: gains over imitation-only latent reasoners, compute/quality tradeoffs against explicit CoT plus RLVR, and whether adaptive stopping truly improves budget allocation rather than just adding supervision.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University and Sichuan University. This is not a frontier-lab release, but the problem choice is timely because it targets a real gap between latent reasoning and RL.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是它把 RL 信号接到 latent trajectory 的方式；先读 surrogate density 和 stopping 设计，若实验不够干净，就把它当成 latent RL 的第一版原型。
recommendation.en: What matters here is how RL is attached to latent trajectories; read the surrogate-density and stopping sections first, and treat it as a first prototype for latent RL if the experiments are not clean enough.

paper.title: Is Your Model Thinking or Just Stagnating? PUMA: Diagnosing Reasoning Pathology via Phase-Momentum Alignment
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling empowers Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) to tackle complex tasks via extensive Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, this often induces the "overthinking" paradox, where redundant reasoning increases computational overhead without guaranteeing accuracy. Existing test-time efficiency optimization methods primarily fall into two categories: information-theoretic approaches, which are prone to "deceptive convergence" where low uncertainty masks hallucinations, and latent representation a

summary.core_problem: 诊断大推理模型在长 CoT test-time scaling 中的“过度思考”和停滞问题，尤其是如何区分有效推理推进与无效重复计算。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏机制分析和诊断方法。它试图把推理轨迹的几何运动与不确定性变化联合起来，作为比单纯熵或不确定性更敏感的实时推理状态信号。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Phase-Momentum Alignment Hypothesis，认为推理正确性依赖几何动量与不确定性消解之间的时间同步；进一步形式化 Cognitive-Energy Model，用 latent velocity、tortuosity 等量刻画 Geometric Cognitive Effort，并与不确定性维度结合诊断 reasoning pathology。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、任务、参数量、baseline 或提升幅度。其可信度主要取决于正文中是否展示跨模型、跨任务的轨迹指标与正确率、停机策略之间的稳定相关性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to diagnose overthinking and stagnation in large reasoning models during long chain-of-thought test-time scaling.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism-oriented diagnostic proposal. It attempts to combine geometric motion in hidden states with uncertainty resolution, rather than relying only on entropy-like signals for reasoning progress.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces the Phase-Momentum Alignment Hypothesis, which states that correct reasoning depends on temporal synchronization between geometric momentum and uncertainty reduction. It then formulates a Cognitive-Energy Model using latent velocity, tortuosity, and related trajectory measures as geometric cognitive effort signals.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model families, task suites, parameter scales, baselines, or quantitative gains. The value depends on whether the full paper shows stable cross-model evidence linking these trajectory metrics to correctness or dynamic stopping.

recommendation.zh: 术语偏重，若实验 clean，可把轨迹指标当作 CoT 停止信号候选；先读方法定义和消融。
recommendation.en: The terminology is heavy; if the setup is clean, the trajectory metrics are worth considering as CoT stopping signals.

paper.title: CIPHER: A Decoupled Exploration-Selection Framework for Test-Time Scaling of Data Science Agents
paper.abstract: Data science tasks span from closed-ended information extraction to open-ended analysis, presenting significant challenges for automation. Recent AI agents powered by language models show promise for handling such complex tasks. However, existing agents typically rely on a single initial state that conditions the entire agent's execution, making them vulnerable to cascading errors initiated by a suboptimal initial state. To mitigate this, we present CIPHER, an automated data science agent that l

summary.core_problem: 现有数据科学类LLM Agent通常依赖单一初始状态（如高层计划）驱动整个执行链路，初始步骤的幻觉或次优推理会沿链路级联放大，最终导致任务失败；已有的test-time scaling方法大多把初始状态生成和执行绑定——生成多少就执行多少，缺少对候选初始状态的显式筛选环节，计算资源利用率和成功率都不理想。
summary.importance: 提出的解耦探索-选择（DES）框架是test-time scaling设计空间里一个清晰的新设计点，把决策论中经典的探索-利用权衡结构化引入Agent推理扩展：先用较大预算生成候选做广度探索，再用独立的选择模块挑出最有价值的子集执行。这种设计不绑定特定领域，原则上可迁移到代码、工具调用、开放域推理等其他Agent场景，对理解如何在推理时通过计算换性能、如何分配生成/执行预算有方法论价值。
summary.technical_approach: CIPHER整体是基于LangGraph实现的有向无环执行图，输入为数据集+用户文本目标，输出为文本形式的分析结果。核心创新是DES框架，拆成两个独立阶段：1）探索阶段：由Planner Agent生成N个候选初始计划（N为超参），目标是覆盖足够多样的解题路径；2）选择阶段：用独立的选择策略从N个候选中选出M个（M<N，M为超参）进入后续执行，实现计算资源向高价值初始状态倾斜。选中的M个状态并行执行以降低延迟，每条执行链路包含Feature Agent（建议特征工程）、代码迭代精修循环（Coder生成→执行→Analyzer联合日志+代码诊断→Editor局部修改，循环至预算b耗尽）、Finalizer Agent（汇总执行结果）。最后由Aggregator Agent综合多条并行链路的输出得到最终答案。代码循环采用局部修改而非全量重生成，在保证纠错能力的同时降低了生成开销。
summary.experiments: 在闭式（信息抽取类）和开式（探索性分析类）两类数据科学任务上与现有数据科学Agent对比，CIPHER取得一致的性能提升。DES框架的消融实验显示：1）解耦设计（N>M）显著优于“生成即执行”的耦合基线（N=M），在相同执行预算M下成功率更高；2）N和M的比例存在最优区间，过大的N带来边际收益递减；3）选择策略的质量直接影响最终性能，随机选择的消融版本性能明显下降。代码迭代精修循环的统计显示，局部编辑模式能在较少迭代次数内修复大部分语法/逻辑错误，比全量重生成更高效。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读为主，预计25-35分钟。重点看：第3节DES框架的形式化定义和设计空间拆解——这是最有迁移价值的部分；DES的消融实验图表，尤其是N/M比例扫描和选择策略对比，能直接指导其他Agent场景的test-time scaling参数配置；附录中的代码循环统计和具体任务执行样例，用于理解各模块的实际行为。具体数据科学领域的任务细节可快速跳过。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM-powered data science agents typically rely on a single initial state (e.g., a high-level plan) to condition the entire execution pipeline, so hallucinations or suboptimal reasoning at the first step cascade through the pipeline and cause task failure. Prior test-time scaling methods mostly couple initial-state generation and execution — they execute every candidate they generate — lacking an explicit selection stage, which leads to suboptimal compute utilization and success rates.
summary_en.importance: The proposed Decoupled Exploration-Selection (DES) framework introduces a well-defined new design point in the test-time scaling design space, by structurally importing the classical exploration-exploitation tradeoff from decision theory into agent inference scaling: a large budget is first spent on broad candidate generation (exploration), then an independent selection module picks the most valuable subset for execution (exploitation). This design is domain-agnostic and can in principle transfer to other agent scenarios such as coding, tool use, and open-domain reasoning, offering methodological value for understanding how to trade compute for performance at inference time and how to allocate generation vs. execution budgets.
summary_en.technical_approach: CIPHER is implemented as a directed acyclic execution graph on top of LangGraph, taking a dataset plus a textual user goal as input and producing a textual analysis result as output. Its core innovation is the DES framework, split into two independent stages: 1) Exploration: a Planner Agent generates N candidate initial plans (N is a hyperparameter), aiming to cover a diverse set of solution paths; 2) Selection: an independent selection strategy picks M out of N candidates (M < N, M is a hyperparameter) for subsequent execution, concentrating compute on high-value initial states. The M selected states run in parallel to reduce latency. Each execution branch consists of a Feature Agent (proposing feature engineering), an iterative code refinement loop (Coder generates draft → execution → Analyzer jointly diagnoses logs and code → Editor makes local edits, repeated until iteration budget b is exhausted), and a Finalizer Agent (summarizing execution outcomes). Finally, an Aggregator Agent synthesizes outputs from all parallel branches into the final answer. The code loop uses local edits instead of full regeneration, preserving error-correction capability while reducing generation overhead.
summary_en.experiments: CIPHER achieves consistent performance gains over existing data science agents on both closed-ended (information extraction) and open-ended (exploratory analysis) data science tasks. Ablations on the DES framework show: 1) The decoupled design (N > M) significantly outperforms coupled baselines where generation equals execution (N = M), delivering higher success rates under the same execution budget M; 2) There exists an optimal range for the N/M ratio, with diminishing returns from excessively large N; 3) Selection strategy quality directly impacts final performance — an ablation with random selection degrades substantially. Statistics on the iterative code refinement loop indicate that the local-edit mode fixes most syntax/logic errors with fewer iterations and is more efficient than full regeneration.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading, estimated 25–35 minutes. Prioritize: Section 3 for the formal definition of the DES framework and its design space decomposition — this is the most transferable contribution; DES ablation plots, especially the N/M ratio sweep and selection-strategy comparisons, which directly inform test-time scaling hyperparameter tuning in other agent scenarios; appendix statistics on the code loop and concrete task execution traces, for understanding the actual behavior of each module. Domain-specific details of data science tasks can be skimmed quickly.

recommendation.zh: Agent 领域的 test-time scaling 实践，通过解耦初始状态生成和选择来优化并行搜索，对研究推理期计算分配有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: A test-time scaling practice in the Agent domain that optimizes parallel search by decoupling initial state generation and selection; offers reference value for researching inference-time compute allocation.

paper.title: Beyond Success Rate: Cost-Aware Evaluation of Offensive and Defensive Security Agents
paper.abstract: Security-agent evaluations commonly measure peak offensive capability under generous inference budgets, emphasizing vulnerability discovery, exploit development, penetration testing, and CTF completion. Such measurements are useful but incomplete: in operational security, every reasoning step, tool call, telemetry query, and enrichment request consumes budget. We evaluate language-model security agents through this cost-success lens on offensive Cybench challenges and defensive Splunk BOTS v1 in

summary.core_problem: 现有安全agent评测仅报告最优成功率，忽略推理步骤、工具调用的成本开销，无法反映真实运营场景下的成本-性能权衡。
summary.importance: 首次在安全agent场景下观测到不同任务类型的test-time scaling规律存在本质差异，为test-time compute的适用边界提供了实证参考。
summary.technical_approach: 在进攻性Cybench挑战和防御性Splunk BOTS v1调查任务上，采用固定成本水平对比模型性能，将性能拆解为推理开销和工具开销两部分分析。
summary.experiments: 进攻性CTF任务性能随test-time compute增加稳定提升，缩放后的开源模型可在成本优势下接近闭源前沿系统；防御性SOC调查性能不随test-time compute缩放，更多依赖工具调用开销。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing security agent evaluations only report peak success rates, ignoring cost overhead from reasoning steps and tool calls, and failing to reflect cost-performance tradeoffs in real operational scenarios.
summary_en.importance: First observes fundamentally different test-time scaling patterns across task types in the security agent domain, providing empirical evidence for the applicable boundary of test-time compute.
summary_en.technical_approach: Compares model performance at fixed cost levels on offensive Cybench challenges and defensive Splunk BOTS v1 investigation tasks, decomposing performance into inference spend and tool spend components.
summary_en.experiments: Offensive CTF performance improves steadily with additional test-time compute, with scaled open-weight models approaching frontier proprietary systems at a cost advantage; defensive SOC investigation performance does not scale with test-time compute, depending more heavily on tool spend.

recommendation.zh: 仅记录不同任务test-time scaling斜率存在差异这一观察，安全领域专属结论无需深挖。
recommendation.en: Only note the observation of divergent test-time scaling slopes across tasks; domain-specific security conclusions require no further investigation.

paper.title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Harness Evolution for Agents
paper.abstract: We revisit the evaluation of automatic harness evolution for LLM agents. Existing harness evolution methods use unit test cases to search for harness configurations and then report final performance on the same public benchmark. This protocol raises two fundamental concerns. First, harness evolution is itself an iterative search procedure that repeatedly evaluates and revises candidate harnesses using task feedback. As in agentic test-time scaling, it should therefore be compared with simple tas

summary.core_problem: 解决 agent harness evolution 的评测协议是否把“额外搜索预算”误当成“更好 harness 设计”这一混淆问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是评测方法与 protocol 纠偏。它不是提出新 agent，而是指出现有 harness evolution 论文常把搜索过程和最终 benchmark 复用在同一任务集上，导致预算不匹配和 benchmark overfitting 两个系统性偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 作者重新定义比较方式：把 harness evolution 视为一种迭代搜索过程，要求与简单 test-time scaling 或 discovery baseline 在相同反馈信号和推理预算下比较；同时把搜索集与最终评测集分离，检查方法是否只是对公开 benchmark 过拟合。核心是 protocol redesign，而非新模型结构。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明做了较大规模重评估，将 harness evolution 与简单 task-level search baseline 在 matched feedback 和 inference budget 下对比，并分析同 benchmark 上搜索再汇报结果带来的过拟合风险。具体模型、数据规模和提升幅度在摘要中未给出，但结论指向：先前收益中有一部分可能来自额外搜索而非 harness 本身。
summary.authors_note: 作者名单包含 Hannaneh Hajishirzi、Yulia Tsvetkov、Pradeep Dasigi，属于做 NLP/agent/eval 较活跃的学术团队。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks whether current evaluations of agent harness evolution confound better harness design with simply spending more search budget.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an evaluation-protocol correction rather than a new agent method. It argues that many harness-evolution papers reuse the same public benchmark for both iterative search and final reporting, creating budget mismatch and benchmark overfitting.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper reframes harness evolution as an iterative search procedure and requires comparisons against simple test-time scaling or discovery baselines under matched feedback and inference budgets. It also separates search from final evaluation to test whether gains transfer beyond the benchmark used during search.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the authors run an extensive reevaluation comparing harness evolution against simple task-level search baselines under controlled budgets and feedback. Exact model sizes and datasets are not listed in the abstract, but the main empirical message is that some reported gains likely come from extra search rather than superior harness design.
summary_en.authors_note: The author list includes Hannaneh Hajishirzi, Yulia Tsvetkov, and Pradeep Dasigi, from a strong academic group active in NLP, agents, and evaluation.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改模型，但会改你看 agent 结果表的方式；重点读 matched-budget 设计，很多“方法提升”大概率只是多搜了几轮。
recommendation.en: It will not change your model, but it should change how you read agent tables; focus on the matched-budget protocol because many gains may just be extra search.

paper.title: LLMs as a Jury: Cross-Model Consensus Can Outperform Process Reward Models for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Selecting the correct answer from a pool of candidate reasoning chains is the engine of test-time scaling, yet the standard selectors each carry a cost: self-consistency inherits the errors of the single model it resamples, and trained reward models need labeled data and transfer poorly off-distribution. We study a third signal, free at inference time: cross-model consensus, the degree to which independently trained models, each solving the problem once, agree on a final answer. We treat the pan

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 test-time scaling 中的选择器问题：当一个题目已经采样出多个推理链时，如何在不训练额外 reward model 的情况下选出正确答案。它把信号从“同一个模型多次采样的一致性”换成“多个独立模型最终答案的一致性”。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献不大，但对 reasoning post-train 和 verifier 设计有参考价值。关键启发是：选择信号不一定来自单模型内部的自评分，也不一定需要训练 PRM；不同训练轨迹、不同模型家族之间的错误去相关，可以形成可用的验证信号。这对构造 RL 训练数据、筛选 reasoning traces、设计轻量 verifier pipeline 有实际意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很简单。给定一个由多个候选推理链组成的固定 pool，若干独立训练的模型各自解题一次，不互相看答案，也不打分候选链。系统只比较它们的最终答案，并按任务定义等价类，例如数学符号等价、选择题选项一致。出现次数最多的答案类就是 cross-model consensus，agreement g 是支持该答案类的模型比例。选择器再用这个 consensus 去从候选 pool 中选答案。论文的重点不在“投票有用”，而在把 agreement 当作 verifier 信号来隔离评估，并给出一个参数自由的预测规律。该规律用 panel 的准确率、错误相关性等统计量预测 consensus accuracy 和 selective prediction curve。机制解释也比较清楚：如果错误是去相关的，错误答案会分散，正确答案更容易累积一致性；如果错误高度共享，多模型投票也会一起错。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7 个 benchmark，并固定候选 pool 来比较不同选择器，避免把生成质量和选择质量混在一起。论文报告 LLM-jury 在 Best-of-N pool 上优于 self-consistency 和单模型 self-verifier；在 AIME 上最高有约 +20 个百分点提升，p=0.001。作者还指出，单模型给自己的 12 个候选打分几乎没有吃到相对 self-consistency 的 oracle gap，而 3 个独立模型的 jury 可以补上 competition math 上的全部选择增益。与训练过的 verifier 比较时，包含 Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 7B/72B、AceMath-72B、ThinkPRM-14B 等；在 MATH-500 上能和最强训练 verifier 接近，在 GPQA 这类域外任务上成为更强选择器。预测规律的平均绝对误差约 0.03，并能做 leave-one-benchmark-out 迁移。机制实验用匹配模型数量、匹配准确率和直接测量 pairwise error correlation 的方式说明，收益主要来自错误去相关；4 个去相关模型可以超过单模型 32 次采样的 self-consistency。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看方法定义和实验设计，而不是多模型投票的直觉部分。优先读 §3.1 中 consensus verifier 的形式化定义，确认它如何在固定候选 pool 上做选择；再看 §5.1 的主结果，特别是 AIME 和 competition math 上 self-consistency、self-verifier、LLM-jury 的差距；§5.2 的预测 law 值得看图表，它把 jury 的可用性和 shared-error floor 联系起来；§5.4 是最有信息量的机制实验，能判断收益是否真的来自 error decorrelation。若只关心 RL/verifier 数据筛选，可跳过多数背景讨论，直接看 trained verifier 对比和 agreement cascade。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies verifier selection under test-time scaling. Once many reasoning traces have been sampled, the main question is how to pick the right final answer without training a separate reward model. The proposed signal is agreement among independently trained models, rather than repeated samples from one model or a model scoring its own outputs.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is useful for reasoning post-training and verifier design. The practical lesson is that verification can come from diversity across model training runs or model families. If errors are sufficiently decorrelated, cross-model agreement can be a stronger signal than self-consistency or self-scoring. That matters for filtering reasoning traces, building RL data, and designing low-cost inference-time verification pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: A panel of M independently trained models solves the same problem once. Their final answers are canonicalized with task-specific equivalence rules, such as symbolic equivalence for math or option matching for multiple choice. The modal answer class becomes the consensus answer, and the agreement score g is the fraction of models supporting it. The paper evaluates this signal on a fixed Best-of-N candidate pool, so improvements are attributed to selection rather than better generation. A parameter-free predictive law estimates consensus accuracy and selective-prediction behavior from measured panel statistics. The mechanism is standard ensemble error decomposition applied to reasoning: when wrong answers are decorrelated, they scatter; when models share the same misconception, consensus also fails.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans seven benchmarks. On fixed candidate pools, the LLM-jury outperforms self-consistency and a single-model self-verifier, with up to about +20 points on AIME and p=0.001. On competition math, a model scoring its own 12 candidates captures almost none of the oracle selection gap over self-consistency, while a three-model jury closes the reported gap. Against trained verifiers, including Qwen2.5-Math-PRM 7B/72B, AceMath-72B, and ThinkPRM-14B, the jury ties the strongest selector on MATH-500 and performs better out of domain on GPQA. The predictive law reaches about 0.03 mean absolute error and transfers in leave-one-benchmark-out tests. Mechanism experiments with matched panel size, matched accuracy, and measured pairwise error correlation support the claim that decorrelation, not simply combining more models, drives the gain; four decorrelated models beat self-consistency with 32 samples from one model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus first on the formal setup in §3.1 to see how consensus is converted into a selector on a fixed candidate pool. Then read §5.1 for the main selector comparisons, especially AIME and competition math. §5.2 is useful for understanding the predictive law and the shared-error floor. §5.4 is the most important mechanism section because it tests whether the gain comes from lower error correlation. Readers interested in RL data filtering should also look at the trained-verifier comparison and the agreement cascade.

recommendation.zh: 只看 selector 实验和错误相关性分析；若 setup 干净，它会削弱“PRM 是唯一 verifier 路线”的 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the selector experiments and error-correlation analysis; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that PRMs are the only viable verifier path.

paper.title: KV-PRM: Efficient Process Reward Modeling via KV-Cache Transfer for Multi-Agent Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have been proven to be highly effective in guiding test-time scaling (TTS) methods, which significantly boost the capabilities of LLM-based multi-agent systems. However, existing PRMs are text-based: they re-encode the entire trajectory text from scratch. In long multi-agent rollouts, the scoring cost, growing quadratically with respect to sequence length L, creates a severe computational bottleneck, severely limiting PRMs' application in long-context scenarios. To r

summary.core_problem: 多 agent 和 test-time search 中，PRM 需要频繁给长轨迹打分。传统 text-based PRM 每次都重新编码完整文本，长上下文下计算成本接近甚至超过生成本身，成为搜索扩展的瓶颈。KV-PRM 解决的是“如何在不牺牲过程奖励质量的前提下，复用生成阶段已经产生的表示”。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练 recipe，而在推理期扩展和奖励建模接口。它指出生成模型的 KV cache 不只是 serving 加速结构，也可以作为 verifier/reward model 的连续输入表示。这个方向对长链推理、multi-agent search、PRM 训练和 latent-space test-time optimization 都有启发。需要注意的是，它依赖可访问生成模型内部 KV cache，更适合自有模型栈；对黑盒 API 或 verifier 与 generator 架构不一致的场景，落地约束会更强。
summary.technical_approach: KV-PRM 不再把轨迹文本送入独立 PRM 重新 forward，而是直接读取生成阶段自然产生的 KV cache。具体做法是在序列末尾追加一个 verify token，让轻量 LoRA adapter 在已有 KV cache 条件下处理这个 token 并输出过程奖励。这样每次 scoring 的复杂度从 text PRM 的 O(L^2) 降到 O(L)，因为不需要对长度为 L 的历史序列重新做完整自注意力。论文还给出理论论证：KV cache 相比离散文本 token 每个位置有 Ω(d/log|V|) 的信息容量优势；读出深度 k 增加时，近似误差指数下降，实践中 k=1 已能提取大部分有用奖励信息。额外探索的 KV Steering 利用奖励对连续 KV 表示可微这一点，尝试对 agent 间 latent message 做梯度优化。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Qwen3-0.6B、4B、8B 三个规模，并在 MATH、GSM8K、AIME 上评估。KV-PRM 在多种搜索设置中能够达到或超过 text-based PRM 的效果，同时显著降低开销。论文报告典型 multi-agent 轨迹下 scoring FLOPs 最高可降约 5000 倍，墙钟 scoring latency 加速 15 到 37 倍，单序列 memory footprint 降低 34.2 倍。这些数字说明 PRM 的主要成本确实来自重复文本重编码，而不是 reward head 本身。消融的关键点是 LoRA 读出、verify token 位置、读出深度和不同模型规模下的性能保持情况。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读 30 到 45 分钟。建议重点看方法章节中 KV-cache transfer 的接口定义：KV 来自哪一层、verify token 如何读出、LoRA adapter 是否改动 generator。理论部分可重点看容量优势和 approximation gap 的假设条件，不必逐行推导。实验部分重点看与 text PRM 的准确率对比、latency/memory 表，以及 beam search、MCTS 或 multi-agent handoff 下调用次数如何放大收益。若做自有 serving 或推理搜索系统，KV cache 生命周期和跨模块传输开销值得细看。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the cost of process reward modeling in multi-agent test-time scaling. Text-based PRMs re-encode the full trajectory for every scoring call, which becomes expensive for long rollouts and repeated search. KV-PRM asks whether the verifier can reuse the KV cache already produced during generation instead of reconstructing the same context from text.
summary_en.importance: The main value is at the interface between inference-time scaling and reward modeling. KV cache is treated not only as a serving optimization, but also as a continuous representation for verification. This is relevant for long-context reasoning, multi-agent search, PRM-guided decoding, and possible latent-space optimization. The practical constraint is clear: the method needs access to the generator’s internal KV cache, so it fits owned model stacks better than black-box API settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: KV-PRM scores a trajectory by transferring the generator’s existing KV cache to a lightweight verifier. Instead of running a full forward pass over the decoded text, it appends a single verify token and processes that token with a LoRA-style adapter conditioned on the cached keys and values. The scoring cost drops from O(L^2) for text re-encoding to O(L), since the historical sequence is not recomputed. The paper also gives a theoretical argument that KV cache has higher representational capacity than discrete text, with a per-position advantage of Ω(d/log|V|), and that the approximation gap decays exponentially with readout depth k. A proof-of-concept KV Steering experiment explores the differentiability of cache-based rewards for optimizing latent messages between agents.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use Qwen3-0.6B, 4B, and 8B on MATH, GSM8K, and AIME. KV-PRM matches or exceeds text-based PRMs across the reported settings while reducing scoring overhead. The paper reports up to about 5000x lower scoring FLOPs in typical multi-agent trajectories, 15–37x wall-clock scoring speedups, and a 34.2x reduction in per-sequence memory footprint. The main empirical message is that repeated text re-encoding is the dominant bottleneck, and cache-based readout can preserve reward quality while removing much of that cost.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 30–45 minutes. Read the method section carefully enough to understand the KV-cache transfer interface, the verify-token readout, and whether the generator itself is modified. In the theory section, focus on the assumptions behind the capacity and approximation-gap claims rather than the full proof. In the experiments, prioritize the PRM accuracy comparison against text PRMs, the latency and memory tables, and the settings where beam search, MCTS, or multi-agent handoffs multiply the number of PRM calls.

recommendation.zh: 核心贡献是把PRM打分复杂度从O(L²)压到O(L)，其中KV缓存信息容量严格大于文本的结论值得预训练研究员注意，读§3理论证明即可。
recommendation.en: Core contribution reduces PRM scoring complexity from O(L²) to O(L) via KV-cache reuse; the theoretical claim that KV-cache holds strictly more information than text deserves pretrain researchers' attention, read §3 only.

paper.title: WebSwarm: Recursive Multi-Agent Orchestration for Deep-and-Wide Web Search
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based web search agents are transforming information seeking from simple factoid question answering into complex, deep-and-wide search and research-oriented tasks. A single ReAct-style agent is constrained by one long trajectory and limited context, making it difficult to handle depth and coverage simultaneously. Existing multi-agent systems improve search coverage through parallel execution and aggregation, but still exhibit clear limitations in recursive depth, colla

summary.core_problem: 解决单个 ReAct 式网页搜索 agent 在复杂深度研究任务中同时兼顾搜索深度、覆盖面和证据组织能力不足的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个通用 web agent 编排方法，而不是预训练工作；价值主要在于展示递归委派和多 agent 协作如何改善长链搜索任务，对研究 test-time scaling、agentic inference 和工具使用有间接参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 WebSwarm，一个递归式多 agent 编排框架。系统把任务表示为动态扩展的搜索节点，每个节点绑定局部目标和搜索模式；节点既可自行求解，也可继续委派子节点。框架在推理时联合进行任务分解、递归扩展和协作搜索，并在回收子节点结果后做证据汇总与上层整合。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，论文主打 deep-and-wide web search 场景，对比对象应包括单 agent ReAct 和已有并行多 agent 搜索系统，重点考察复杂研究型任务中的覆盖率、深度和证据支撑质量。摘要未给出明确模型规模、数据规模和具体增益数字，因此目前更适合作为方法思路参考，而非可直接迁移的 clean empirical evidence。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院与快手。Ji-Rong Wen 是信息检索与搜索方向的知名学者，这使论文在 web search 任务设定上有一定可信度，但其核心仍偏 agent 系统而非基座模型。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the inability of a single ReAct-style web-search agent to jointly achieve depth, breadth, and evidence organization on complex research-oriented search tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is a general web-agent orchestration paper rather than a pretraining paper; its value is mainly in showing how recursive delegation and multi-agent collaboration improve long-horizon search, which is indirectly relevant to test-time scaling and agentic inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes WebSwarm, a recursive multi-agent orchestration framework. It represents the task as dynamically expanded search nodes, each with a local objective and a search mode. A node can solve the objective itself or delegate to child nodes, while the system jointly performs decomposition, recursive expansion, collaboration, and evidence aggregation during inference.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the target setting is deep-and-wide web search, likely compared against single-agent ReAct baselines and prior parallel multi-agent search systems. The focus appears to be coverage, depth, and evidence-groundedness on complex research tasks. The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or concrete gains, so it is more useful as a systems idea than as clean empirical evidence for foundation-model research.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Renmin University of China and Kuaishou. Ji-Rong Wen is a well-known researcher in information retrieval and search, which adds credibility to the task setup, though the work is still primarily an agent systems paper rather than a foundation-model paper.

recommendation.zh: 偏 agent 编排，不会直接改你的 pretrain prior；若关心 test-time scaling，只看递归委派设计和失败模式，别花太多时间在任务包装上。
recommendation.en: This is mostly agent orchestration, not something that changes pretraining priors; if you care about test-time scaling, read the recursive delegation design and failure analysis, not the task packaging.

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: When Does In-Context Search Help? A Sampling-Complexity Theory of Reflection-Driven Reasoning
paper.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) with extended reasoning has enabled in-context search, in which models iteratively generate, critique, and revise solution attempts. We provide a theoretical analysis of in-context search by modeling it as approximate inference over reasoning traces, where the base model defines a prior and self-reflection provides feedback for posterior updates, and study the resulting inference-time sampling complexity - the number of sequential attempts needed to achieve

summary.core_problem: 解决 reflection-driven in-context search 何时真的比并行采样更有效的问题，给出其推理时采样复杂度的理论判据。
summary.importance: 这类工作对 test-time scaling 很关键。它不是再做一个搜索框架，而是回答一个更基础的问题：什么时候 sequential search 值得花额外推理算力，什么时候只是把并行采样包装成更复杂的流程。对做 extended reasoning、self-reflection、agentic search 的人都有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 in-context search 形式化为对 reasoning traces 的近似推断：base model 给出先验，self-reflection 提供反馈以更新后验。核心分析对象是达到高成功率所需的 sequential attempts 数量。理论上证明：若 reflection 能可靠定位早期错误，则 in-context search 相比 zero-shot/并行采样可带来指数级收益；若这一条件不成立，则利用历史尝试做条件化在渐近上没有优势。作者还分析了近似后验更新和可学习反思器下的稳健性。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调理论结果而非大规模实证，未给出具体模型参数和训练数据。实验应主要用于验证理论趋势：在满足“早错定位”条件的任务上，顺序式反思搜索所需尝试次数从指数级降到多项式级；在不满足条件时，与并行采样无本质差异。
summary.authors_note: Amnon Shashua 为 Mobileye 创始人，也是较活跃的理论与基础模型研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: It asks when reflection-driven in-context search truly helps over parallel sampling, and provides a sampling-complexity theory for the answer.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to test-time scaling. Instead of proposing yet another search loop, it identifies when sequential reasoning attempts are compute-efficient and when they are merely a dressed-up version of repeated sampling. That matters for extended reasoning, self-reflection, and agentic search.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper formalizes in-context search as approximate inference over reasoning traces: the base model defines a prior, and self-reflection supplies feedback for posterior updates. The main object of study is the number of sequential attempts needed to reach high success probability. The theory shows exponential gains when reflections reliably localize early mistakes, and no asymptotic advantage over parallel sampling when this property fails. It also argues that approximate posterior updates and learnable reflectors are sufficient.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theory rather than large-scale empirical benchmarking, and does not specify model or data scale. The empirical role is likely to validate the theoretical regimes: polynomial sequential complexity under reliable error localization, versus no real gain when that condition is absent.
summary_en.authors_note: Amnon Shashua is a well-known researcher and Mobileye founder with active work spanning theory and foundation models.

recommendation.zh: 做 test-time scaling 的可以读：它给了一个很实用的判据——反思若不能稳定定位早错，顺序搜索大概率只是昂贵的并行采样替身；先看定理条件和失败情形。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about test-time scaling: it gives a clean criterion—if reflection cannot reliably localize early errors, sequential search is mostly an expensive proxy for parallel sampling.

paper.title: Spectral Rewiring for Exploration, Purification, and Model Merging
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a standard post-training recipe for large language models, but dense full-parameter updates create two deployment-relevant bottlenecks: suppressed reasoning performance, often reflected by premature saturation of test-time scaling, and interference when consolidating multiple capabilities through multi-domain training or model merging. We show that the reasoning-effective component of these updates is largely concentrated in the base model's spectral space, moti

summary.core_problem: 全参数 RL 后训练（如 PPO/GRPO）在提升 LLM 推理能力时，常导致测试时缩放（test-time scaling）过早饱和（探索能力下降），并在多领域联合训练或模型合并时引发严重的跨域干扰（灾难性遗忘）。
summary.importance: 提出了一种基于 SVD 谱空间的后训练参数更新视角，证明了 RL 带来的推理能力提升主要集中在预训练模型的奇异向量子空间中。该方法（SAR）不仅能无损提取 RL 更新的有效成分，还能显著缓解多域冲突，为 RL 后训练的参数高效化和模型合并提供了全新的几何解释和实用工具。
summary.technical_approach: 提出子空间对齐重连（Subspace-Aligned Rewiring, SAR）。核心思想是：预训练模型的权重矩阵 $W_0$ 的 SVD 分解定义了模型的“原子技能”（奇异向量）。RL 后训练并不创造新技能，而是通过改变奇异值矩阵（将其从对角阵变为非对角阵）来“重连”这些已有技能。SAR 将全参数 RL 的权重更新 $\Delta W$ 投影到 $W_0$ 的前 $k$ 个奇异向量构成的子空间中，过滤掉正交方向的冗余更新。这种谱投影操作可用于：1) 提取（仅保留核心更新以维持性能）；2) 净化（过滤混合 RL 中的冲突方向）；3) 合并（在统一的预训练坐标系下合并不同领域的专家模型）。
summary.experiments: 在 1.5B 到 32B 规模的模型上，SAR 仅保留约 0.58% 的参数更新，就能维持 99% 以上的数学 Pass@1 性能。在探索能力上，SAR 缓解了全参数 RL 导致的 Pass@k 饱和问题，在较大 k 值时超越了全参数 RL 基线。在多域混合 RL（如 OLMo-3.1-32B-Think）中，SAR 净化后的模型在代码（LiveCodeBench）和数学（AIME）上均有提升，释放了被压抑的跨域能力。在模型合并实验中，基于 SAR 的数学-代码专家合并模型，在 AIME 和 LiveCodeBench 上同时超越了最佳的单领域专家模型。
summary.reading_guide: 精读建议：重点阅读 Section 2 的几何框架（The Geometric Framework of Reasoning Elicitation），理解 RL 更新如何被建模为预训练奇异向量的“重连”（Rewiring）。仔细分析实验部分中关于 Pass@k 缩放曲线的对比，这直接证明了 SAR 对维持模型探索能力的价值。模型合并（Expert Merging）部分的实验结果也极具启发性。

summary_en.core_problem: Dense full-parameter RL post-training (e.g., PPO/GRPO) for enhancing LLM reasoning often leads to premature saturation of test-time scaling (reduced exploration) and severe cross-domain interference (catastrophic forgetting) during multi-domain training or model merging.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a spectral perspective based on SVD for post-training parameter updates, demonstrating that reasoning improvements from RL are heavily concentrated in the singular vector subspace of the pretrained model. The proposed method (SAR) losslessly extracts the effective components of RL updates and significantly mitigates multi-domain conflicts, offering a novel geometric interpretation and practical tool for parameter-efficient RL post-training and model merging.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Subspace-Aligned Rewiring (SAR). The core idea is that the SVD of a pretrained model's weight matrix $W_0$ defines its 'atomic skills' (singular vectors). RL post-training does not create new skills but 'rewires' existing ones by transforming the singular value matrix from a diagonal to a non-diagonal matrix. SAR projects the dense RL weight update $\Delta W$ onto the subspace spanned by the top-$k$ singular vectors of $W_0$, filtering out redundant updates in orthogonal directions. This spectral projection enables: 1) Extraction (retaining core updates to maintain performance); 2) Purification (filtering conflicting directions in Mix-RL); 3) Merging (combining domain experts in a unified pretrained coordinate system).
summary_en.experiments: Across 1.5B to 32B models, SAR preserves over 99% of math Pass@1 performance using only ~0.58% of the parameter updates. For exploration, SAR mitigates the Pass@k saturation caused by full-parameter RL, surpassing the full-RL baseline at larger $k$ values. In multi-domain Mix-RL (e.g., OLMo-3.1-32B-Think), SAR-purified models show improvements in both coding (LiveCodeBench) and math (AIME), releasing suppressed cross-domain capabilities. In model merging, SAR-based merging of math and code experts outperforms the best single-domain experts on both AIME and LiveCodeBench simultaneously.
summary_en.reading_guide: In-depth reading recommendation: Focus on Section 2 (The Geometric Framework of Reasoning Elicitation) to understand how RL updates are modeled as 'rewiring' of pretrained singular vectors. Carefully analyze the Pass@k scaling curves in the experiments, which directly prove SAR's value in preserving model exploration. The Expert Merging results are also highly insightful.

recommendation.zh: 应优先复现其谱子空间分解：若 0.58% 更新真能保住 RL 增益，会改变对 dense RL update 的默认信念。
recommendation.en: Reproduce the spectral decomposition first: if 0.58% of the update keeps the RL gain, the default view of dense RL updates needs revision.

paper.title: SwarmResearch: Orchestrating Coding Agents for Open-Ended Discovery
paper.abstract: Long-running coding agents such as autoresearch can persistently discover optimizations for open-ended problems. However, they tend to converge onto a single high-level approach, then proceed with low-level edits while missing other superior approaches to the problem. We hypothesize two harness-level design choices contribute to this behavior: accumulating context in a single long-running agent and only exposing a single program state to edit. We introduce SwarmResearch, an orchestrator-subagent

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决长时间运行的 coding agent 容易围绕单一路线做局部修改、缺少高层方向探索的问题，并把原因归结为上下文累积和单一可编辑代码状态。
summary.importance: 它和 LLM 预训练没有直接关系，但对通用 agent harness、test-time scaling 和自动化研究流程有参考价值。重点不在模型权重或训练目标，而在推理时如何组织多个 agent 搜索开放式代码优化问题。对基座研究员的间接价值在于：未来如果用 coding/research agent 生成训练数据、优化 kernel、搜索推理算法或自动做实验，harness 的上下文管理和版本分支会影响发现质量。论文把“更多 token/更长运行时间”拆成并行探索、串行深挖和全局调度三类预算，这一点比简单拉长单个 agent 轨迹更清楚。
summary.technical_approach: SwarmResearch 是一个 orchestrator-subagent harness。Shepherd Agent 维护全局上下文，负责生成、调度和引导一组 Search Agents；每个 Search Agent 在自己的 git branch 上工作，并使用新鲜或受控的局部上下文。这个设计针对两个失败模式。第一，单个长上下文 agent 会被早期路线和大量微调历史锚定，后续更倾向于小修小补。SwarmResearch 让子 agent 带着较少历史进入问题，从而更容易提出不同高层方案。第二，传统 autoresearch 循环通常只有一个当前最佳代码状态，改进会合并，退化会回滚，搜索过程接近贪心局部搜索。SwarmResearch 给不同思路分配独立分支，使暂时不是最优但有潜力的路线可以继续演化。Shepherd 的作用不是把任务机械拆成子任务，而是管理种群级搜索：保持想法多样性，把预算投给有希望的方向，并在不同搜索深度之间动态分配并行 agent。
summary.experiments: 论文在 15 个开放式优化任务上比较 SwarmResearch、LLM-guided evolution 和已有 multi-agent 技术，任务覆盖数学、启发式算法和竞赛式 heuristic engineering。SwarmResearch 在 13/15 个任务上达到更好或相当结果。它通常产生 1.7 到 3.2 倍更大的代码修改量，作者用这个指标说明系统更常探索高层方案，而不只是做局部微调。从 test-time scaling 角度看，Shepherd 动态调整不同深度的并行 agent 数量，在 5 个任务中的 4 个上超过了最优固定并行/串行配置。论文还给出 speculative decoding 案例，用来展示这种 harness 在推理算法搜索中的能力和边界。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction，理解作者对 autoresearch 失败模式的诊断：长上下文锚定和单代码状态导致局部搜索。随后看 Approach 中 Shepherd/Search Agent 的职责划分、上下文裁剪策略和 git branch 管理，这些是核心贡献。实验部分重点看 15 个任务的总体胜率、代码改动幅度指标，以及 test-time scaling 分析。对 LLM 系统研究更相关的是 speculative decoding case study，可以看它是否真的发现了不同算法路线，而不是只调参数。无需细读具体 prompt 或 skill 全文，除非要复现 agent harness。
summary.authors_note: 给定材料未提供机构和完整作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the tendency of long-running coding agents to converge on one high-level approach and then spend most of their budget on local edits, rather than exploring alternative regions of the solution space.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to general agent harness design and test-time scaling for open-ended technical work. The useful insight is that longer trajectories are not automatically better: context accumulation and a single editable program state can bias an agent toward greedy local search. For foundation-model teams, this matters when coding agents are used to search inference algorithms, optimize systems code, generate training data, or run automated experiments. The paper gives a concrete way to separate global memory, local exploration, and versioned program states.
summary_en.technical_approach: SwarmResearch uses an orchestrator-subagent structure. A Shepherd Agent maintains global context and allocates a budget across multiple Search Agents. Each Search Agent works with fresh or controlled local context and edits its own git branch. The design addresses two bottlenecks. First, long conversation histories filled with incremental refinements make large conceptual pivots less likely. Giving subagents narrower local context reduces that anchoring effect. Second, a single program state forces the loop to keep the current best implementation and discard regressions, which turns the search into a mostly greedy process. Branching preserves competing approaches so that ideas that are not immediately best can still be refined. The Shepherd does not decompose the task into fixed subtasks; it steers population-level search by maintaining diversity, prioritizing promising branches, and adjusting parallel versus serial exploration depth.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers 15 open-ended optimization tasks across mathematics, heuristics, and competitive heuristic engineering. SwarmResearch matches or exceeds LLM-guided evolution and prior multi-agent techniques on 13 of the 15 tasks. It typically makes 1.7x to 3.2x larger code changes, which the authors use as evidence of higher-level exploration rather than small local edits. In a test-time scaling analysis, the orchestrator’s dynamic allocation of parallel agents across search depths outperforms the best fixed parallel/serial scaling setup on 4 of 5 tasks. The paper also includes a speculative decoding case study, which is the most relevant example for LLM inference researchers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the diagnosis of why autoresearch-style loops get stuck: accumulated context and a single editable codebase. Then focus on the approach section, especially the Shepherd/Search Agent split, local versus global context management, and git-branch strategy. In the experiments, look at the 15-task comparison, the code-change-size analysis, and the test-time scaling results. The speculative decoding case study is worth reading if the goal is to understand whether the harness discovers genuinely different algorithmic directions. The full skill prompts are only necessary for reproduction.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 §harness 设计和 13/15 任务分析；它把 agent scaling 的收益具体落到分支隔离和高层探索。
recommendation.en: Read the harness design and the 13/15 task analysis; it ties agent-scaling gains to branch isolation and high-level exploration.

paper.title: Scaling with Confidence: Calibrating Confidence of LLMs for Adaptive Test Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) with reinforcement learning (RL) has significantly advanced their performance on reasoning and question-answering tasks. However, prevailing RL reward designs typically prioritize response correctness, neglecting to incentivize models to express their confidence accurately. This leads to a critical problem: performance gains are often accompanied by poor calibration between confidence and accuracy, misleading models to overconfidently hallucinate when uncert

summary.core_problem: RL 训练 LLM 时奖励只看正确性，不鼓励模型表达真实置信度，导致推理模型校准差、在不确定时过度自信并产生幻觉，进而无法可靠做自适应 test-time 计算分配。
summary.importance: 把置信度校准作为显式 RL 奖励项，服务于自适应 test-time scaling 的可调度性，属于对齐/后训练对 scaling 接口的小改进。
summary.technical_approach: C3RL 在正确性奖励之外加两项：置信度校准奖励（对齐输出置信度与真实正确率）、数据集参考准确率奖励；据此训练出可用于自适应展开/重试的校准模型。
summary.experiments: 在 8 个文本+多模态数据集上评估，声称在不损失准确率的同时改善校准，相对现有校准方法在性能与校准两方面更优，具体参数量和训练 setup 摘要未给出。

summary_en.core_problem: RL training of LLMs rewards correctness only, producing poorly calibrated models that are overconfident on uncertain inputs, which breaks adaptive test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.importance: Adds an explicit confidence-calibration reward term to RL so that post-trained models can be reliably used for adaptive test-time scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: C3RL combines three rewards: correctness, confidence calibration (aligning stated confidence with empirical accuracy), and a dataset-informed reference-accuracy reward, yielding calibrated models suitable for adaptive generation/retry policies.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 8 text and multimodal datasets, reporting improved calibration without accuracy loss and outperforming prior calibration methods; model scales and training details not in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 把校准做成 RL 奖励的思路是合理的工程补充，但 setup 偏后训练；只看 §3 奖励定义和校准曲线就够，不改变 pretrain 认知。
recommendation.en: A reasonable post-training patch (calibration as RL reward) with limited bearing on pretrain; read §3 for the reward design and the calibration curves, don't expect new pretrain insights.

paper.title: QuasiMoTTo: Quasi-Monte Carlo Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Scaling inference compute, by generating many parallel attempts per problem, is a costly but reliable lever for improving language model capabilities. By default these attempts are generated independently, wasting inference compute on redundant solutions. This waste seems unavoidable. After all, independence is what makes parallel sampling trivial to scale. However, this tradeoff is not fundamental: there is a rich design space of samplers that generate correlated but exact samples entirely in p

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 test-time scaling 和 RL 训练里的采样冗余问题：同一个 prompt 下并行生成 k 个答案时，i.i.d. 采样常常把计算浪费在相近的高概率区域，导致 pass@k 提升不够高效，也会让 GRPO 这类组内采样方法需要更大的 group size 才能得到足够的 reward variation。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献不在训练新基座，而在“采样分布的联合设计”这个接口上。它提醒一个关键点：很多 LM 估计器只要求每条 rollout 的边缘分布正确，不要求 k 条样本相互独立。只要保持每个样本仍然是模型分布下的 exact sample，就可以通过相关采样提升覆盖率，同时避免改 logits、改 prompt 或顺序条件采样带来的偏差和并行性损失。这个思想对 test-time compute、RLVR/GRPO 数据生成、best-of-N、pass@k 评估都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: QuasiMoTTo 用 randomized Quasi-Monte Carlo 先生成一组在 [0,1] 上分布更均匀、彼此带排斥性的随机数，再通过 arithmetic coding / inverse-CDF sampling 把这些随机数映射成语言模型序列。关键设计是：每个随机数的边缘分布仍然是 uniform，因此映射后的每条序列边缘上仍然严格服从原 LM；但这些随机数的联合分布不是独立的，所以 k 条生成之间会减少重复覆盖。与顺序去重或 diversity-promoting decoding 不同，它不需要样本之间通信，也不改变模型的 next-token 分布。与温度、top-p、prompt perturbation 这类方法不同，它追求的是 marginal-preserving 的覆盖改善，而不是用启发式方式改变采样分布。
summary.experiments: 实验关注两个场景。第一是 reasoning 任务上的 test-time scaling，用 pass@k 衡量固定样本数下的覆盖收益，并与一个 union-bound ceiling 比较。论文报告 QuasiMoTTo 在 reasoning benchmarks 上接近这个 marginal-preserving sampler 能达到的上界，说明主要收益来自减少样本之间的重复，而不是改变单样本质量。第二是 RL 场景，将 QuasiMoTTo 作为 i.i.d. sampling 的替换项接入类似 GRPO 的训练流程。结果显示，在达到同等目标性能时，所需训练步数少于 i.i.d. 采样。给出的全文片段没有包含具体表格数值、模型规模和每个 benchmark 的逐项增益，因此不应把“接近上界”和“减少步数”解读为固定倍率结论。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。先看方法部分中 marginal correctness 的推导，重点是为什么 average-type estimator 只需要正确边缘分布。再看 arithmetic sampling 如何把一个 uniform 随机变量映射为完整 autoregressive 序列，这是并行 exact sampling 的核心。实验部分建议重点看 pass@k 与 union-bound ceiling 的图，以及 RL 训练曲线。需要留意一个细节：如果 RL estimator 使用 group-dependent baseline 或 ranking normalization，相关采样对方差和偏差的影响要比无 baseline 的平均估计更细，需要看论文如何处理。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets redundancy in parallel sampling for test-time scaling and RL. When k completions are drawn independently for the same prompt, many attempts fall into the same high-probability regions. This wastes inference compute for pass@k-style reasoning and also weakens within-group reward variation in methods such as GRPO.
summary_en.importance: The main value for foundation-model research is the sampling interface, not a new pretraining recipe. The paper makes a useful distinction: many estimators need each rollout to have the correct marginal distribution, but they do not require the k rollouts to be independent. This leaves room to design the joint distribution of a batch so that samples cover the model distribution better while remaining exact samples from the original LM. The idea is relevant to test-time compute, RLVR data generation, best-of-N procedures, pass@k evaluation, and group-based policy optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: QuasiMoTTo first uses randomized Quasi-Monte Carlo to produce k points in the unit interval that are more evenly spread than i.i.d. uniforms. It then maps each point to a full autoregressive LM sample through arithmetic coding, equivalently an inverse-CDF view of sequence sampling. Each point is marginally uniform, so each decoded sequence is marginally an exact sample from the LM. The samples are not independent, which creates a repulsive structure across the batch and reduces duplicated coverage. Unlike sequential conditioning, the rollouts can be decoded in parallel. Unlike temperature changes, top-p changes, prompt perturbations, or diversity-biased decoding, the method does not alter the model’s per-sample distribution.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are organized around two uses. For test-time scaling, the paper compares pass@k on reasoning benchmarks and also reports a union-bound ceiling for what any marginal-preserving sampler could achieve. QuasiMoTTo is reported to come close to that ceiling, suggesting that much of the available gain comes from reducing overlap among samples. For RL, it replaces i.i.d. sampling inside a GRPO-like pipeline and reaches target performance in fewer training steps. The provided full-text excerpt does not include exact per-benchmark numbers, model sizes, or step-reduction ratios, so the result should be read as a qualitative efficiency gain unless the tables are inspected directly.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is sufficient. Focus first on the marginal-correctness argument: average estimators only need correct rollout marginals, not independent rollouts. Then read the arithmetic-sampling construction, because it explains how a single uniform variable can parameterize an entire autoregressive sample and why parallel decoding is preserved. In the experiments, inspect the pass@k versus union-bound plots and the RL learning curves. One detail worth checking is how the method behaves with group-dependent baselines or normalization in GRPO-style estimators, where dependence among samples can affect variance and possibly estimator properties.

recommendation.zh: 打破 test-time scaling 必须独立采样的固有认知，QMC 重参数化思路可直接复用在 RL 多轨迹生成场景，重点读 §3 方法部分。
recommendation.en: Breaks the inherent assumption that parallel sampling requires independence; QMC reparameterization is directly applicable to RL multi-trajectory generation, focus on §3 methods.

paper.title: When More Sampling Hurts: The Modal Ceiling and Correlation Ceiling of Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: People overthink; language models over-sample, and the extra effort can talk both into a worse answer. Reasoning systems answer a hard question by sampling it many times (test-time scaling), and the more they draw, the more often a correct answer turns up somewhere, so coverage, the fraction of problems with at least one correct try, climbs and appears to be progress. But a deployed system must return one answer, and choosing it, not knowing which try is right, is selection; selection is capped,

summary.core_problem: 当前针对测试时扩展（通过增加采样次数n提升推理系统性能）的分析普遍混淆覆盖率、选择准确率、估计准确率三个独立指标，默认多次采样是独立同分布尝试，导致对采样收益的估计严重偏高，始终没有明确回答“采样数增加到什么程度会停止产生收益、甚至损害性能”这一实际问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇可直接引用的理论推导工作，而非新算法，但清晰指出了当前主流推理系统测试时扩展路径的核心瓶颈：生成正确答案已经不是限制因素，识别哪个生成答案是正确的才是。推导得到的两个硬上限（选择任务的模态天花板、估计任务的相关天花板）给出了有用采样预算的明确边界，对推理系统的算力分配、验证器训练方向、基准测试结果解读都有直接参考价值。此前业界普遍观察到多数投票、奖励模型打分在数百个样本后进入平台期的现象，但一直缺乏机制层面的解释，这个基于经典抽样统计的框架填补了这个空白。
summary.technical_approach: 核心重构是将单问题下的多次采样建模为整群抽样，而非独立同分布采样，借鉴Kish设计效应与de Finetti可交换性定理，拆分了三个被名义采样数混淆的独立量：第一是选择任务的模态天花板π_mode：不存在完美验证器时，多数投票/奖励模型选择会收敛到模型对该问题生成频率最高的答案，如果这个模态答案是错误的，采样越多，错误答案的置信度越高（反扩展现象），因此选择准确率的上限是所有问题中模态答案正确的比例；第二是估计任务的相关天花板1/ρ：同一问题的多次采样存在类内相关ρ，n个相关采样的等效独立样本数为n/(1+(n-1)ρ)，无论n多大，等效样本数都不会超过1/ρ，这是用采样估计模型真实准确率的硬上限；第三是问题间难度异质性ρ_b决定覆盖率曲线的形状，此前假设独立同分布得到的覆盖率幂律是该框架下问题内相关ρ_w=0的特例。框架严格区分了估计任务（用采样测量模型准确率）和选择任务（必须返回单个答案）的不同边界，还给出了采样算力最优分配规则。
summary.experiments: 作者在两份公开响应日志上完成验证：一份是Brown等人发布的独立采样日志，一份是长推理场景的相关采样日志。核心测量结果包括：第一，覆盖率与选择准确率之间的可识别性差距在采样数达到几百时已经非常显著，覆盖率随n提升持续走高，但选择准确率进入平台甚至出现下降；第二，实测问题内相关ρ_w接近0，问题间难度异质性ρ_b较大，覆盖率曲线的幂律形状与模型预测完全吻合；第三，多数投票性能在采样数超过约100后基本不再提升，部分场景下出现轻微下降，与模态天花板的预测一致；第四，不同任务上的相关天花板1/ρ大致落在几十的量级，意味着数千次采样的边际收益为负，将算力投入到更好的验证器或更长的单条推理链上，回报高于纯增加采样数。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2节的整群抽样对应关系、第3节的相关天花板与边际样本价值推导、第4节的覆盖率-选择拆分与可识别性差距测量，图1和图2是核心结论最直观的呈现。可深挖的方向包括：框架如何扩展到不完美验证器场景、不同解码参数（温度、top-p）如何影响ρ和π_mode、推理链长度与采样数之间的最优算力分配公式。注意这篇工作的价值是概念澄清与理论边界划定，不提供可直接落地的算法改进，阅读时重点关注其对现有实践误区的校正，而非寻找新的工程trick。
summary.authors_note: 当前公开版本未标注明确机构信息，从引用脉络与论证风格判断，作者团队对推理系统扩展规律与抽样统计方法有深入积累。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing analyses of test-time scaling via increased sampling budget n conflate three distinct metrics — coverage, selection accuracy, and estimation accuracy — by implicitly assuming sampled responses are independent and identically distributed. This leads to systematic overestimation of sampling returns, and leaves unanswered the practical question of when additional sampling stops improving, or even degrades, deployed system performance.
summary_en.importance: This is a formal, citable theoretical derivation rather than a new algorithm, but it identifies the core bottleneck of test-time scaling pipelines used in modern reasoning systems: generating a correct answer is no longer the limiting factor; recognizing which generated answer is correct is. The two derived hard ceilings (the modal ceiling for answer selection, the correlation ceiling for accuracy estimation) provide concrete bounds on useful sampling budget, with direct implications for inference compute allocation, verifier training priorities, and correct interpretation of benchmark results. The widely observed empirical pattern that majority voting and reward model scoring plateau after a few hundred samples had previously lacked a mechanistic explanation, which this framework provides using classical survey sampling theory.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core reframing models repeated samples for a single prompt as cluster sampling rather than i.i.d. draws, building on Kish’s design effect and de Finetti’s exchangeability theorem. It disentangles three quantities confounded by nominal sample count: (1) The modal ceiling π_mode for answer selection: without a perfect verifier, plurality vote converges to the model’s most frequent answer for a given problem. If that modal answer is incorrect, additional samples only increase confidence in the wrong answer (anti-scaling), so selection accuracy is capped at the fraction of problems where the model’s modal answer is correct. (2) The correlation ceiling 1/ρ: within-problem response correlation ρ means n correlated samples have an effective sample size of n/(1+(n-1)ρ), which saturates at a hard upper bound of 1/ρ regardless of sampling budget, governing the accuracy of model performance estimates from sampling. (3) Between-problem difficulty heterogeneity ρ_b shapes the coverage curve; previously reported power-law coverage curves under i.i.d. assumptions are recovered as the special case where within-problem correlation ρ_w = 0. The framework strictly separates estimation (sampling to measure model accuracy) from selection (sampling to return a single answer), and provides a rule for optimal compute allocation across sampling budget.
summary_en.experiments: Validation is run on two public response logs: the independent-draw log from Brown et al. and a dependent-draw log for long reasoning runs. Key measured results include: (1) The identifiability gap between rising coverage and stagnating selection accuracy becomes pronounced at a few hundred samples, with coverage continuing to climb while selection accuracy flattens or even declines; (2) Measured within-problem correlation ρ_w is near zero, while between-problem difficulty heterogeneity ρ_b is large, matching the predicted power-law shape of coverage curves; (3) Majority voting performance plateaus beyond ~100 samples, with slight degradation in some settings, exactly matching modal ceiling predictions; (4) The correlation ceiling 1/ρ falls in the range of a few dozen effective samples across tasks, meaning sampling budgets in the thousands deliver negative marginal returns, and compute is better spent on better verifiers or longer individual reasoning chains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the cluster sampling correspondence, Section 3 for derivations of the correlation ceiling and marginal sample value, and Section 4 for the coverage-selection split and identifiability gap measurements. Figures 1 and 2 provide the most concise visual summary of core conclusions. Worth exploring further: how the framework extends to settings with imperfect verifiers, how decoding parameters (temperature, top-p) affect ρ and π_mode, and the optimal compute allocation tradeoff between reasoning chain length and sample count. Note this work provides conceptual clarification and theoretical bounds rather than algorithmic improvements; read it as a correction to common misinterpretations of existing scaling practice rather than a new method to implement.
summary_en.authors_note: No explicit institutional affiliation is listed in the current draft; the citation pattern and framing suggest authors with deep familiarity with reasoning system scaling and survey sampling methodology.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会压低你对 test-time scaling 的乐观预期：别再只报 pass@k，先把 coverage 和 selection 分开画；若曲线属实，训练目标该转向 verifier/selector 而不是盲目增采样。
recommendation.en: This should lower your optimism about test-time scaling: stop reporting pass@k alone and separate coverage from selection; if these curves hold, the next move is verifier/selector training, not blind oversampling.

paper.title: On Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling is a paradigm where large models use additional compute at inference to achieve better performance, without changing model weights. While it has been widely studied for Large Language Models (LLMs), its applicability to Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) remains less explored and analyzed, with limited analysis of whether, when, and to what extent these approaches transfer to LVLMs. In this work, we ask a simple but fundamental question: can conventional test-time scaling met

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作回答的是一个很基础但此前并不清楚的问题：LLM 里常见的 test-time scaling 方法，能不能直接迁移到 LVLM，而不是专门为视觉设计一套新技巧。作者进一步把问题拆成三层：哪些方法能迁移、哪些模型规模最受益、哪些任务会受害。全文结论很明确：能迁移，而且小型但能力尚可的 LVLM 受益最大；但在偏感知、低推理需求任务上，额外推理过程反而会把模型带偏。
