summary.importance: 它对预训练研究不是直接方法贡献，而是对模型能力分布和推理激活机制的实证刻画。价值主要有两点。第一，它提醒人不要把“需要更强 reasoning”与“需要更大模型”简单画等号；在视觉语言场景里，推理能力的一部分已经存在于 instruction-tuned 模型中，额外计算可以把它调出来。第二，它揭示了 LVLM 的一个结构性限制：视觉信息主要在生成早期被吸收，后续长链推理更多依赖已压缩进 hidden state 的表征，因此过长思维链容易脱离图像、转向语言先验和幻觉。这对多模态预训练、视觉 token 压缩、以及后训练中的 reasoning data 设计都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上这不是提出新 TTS 算法，而是做系统性评估与机制分析。作者聚焦 zero-shot / no-extra-training 的 test-time scaling 范式，也就是不再做额外 SFT 或 RL，而是在现有 instruction-tuned LVLM 上直接使用 LLM 社区常见的推理增强手段。评测覆盖多个模型、多个尺寸、九种 TTS 方法、六个 benchmark。文中还专门拿为 VLM 设计的方法如 Compositional CoT 做对比，检验“通用 LLM 技巧是否已经足够”。

更有意思的是分析部分。作者不是只看最终准确率，而是从 token budget、reasoning chain 质量、attention 行为三个层面解释结果。其核心观察是：LVLM 在生成初期有一个较短的视觉吸收窗口，模型会较强地 attend 到图像，把视觉证据写入 hidden state；之后随着文本继续生成，对图像的注意力逐步衰减，后续 token 更多是在已有内部表征上做语言推演。这样一来，适量推理能帮助复杂任务，但过长推理会让模型在脱离视觉锚点后“越想越偏”。这也是为什么同样的 TTS，在 reasoning-heavy benchmark 上有效，在 perception-heavy benchmark 上却可能掉点。
summary.experiments:
实验规模比较完整：多种 LVLM、不同参数规模、九种 test-time scaling 方法、六个 benchmark。主结果有几个明确结论。第一，传统 LLM TTS 方法可以直接迁移到 LVLM，并且效果通常好于专门为 VLM 设计的某些方法。第二，小模型不是天然不适合 TTS；相反，像 Qwen3-VL-4B 这类小而强的模型，在加入 TTS 后可获得最高约 40% 的相对提升，接近甚至超过未使用 TTS 的更大模型基线，例如文中提到可逼近或超过 Qwen3-VL-32B baseline。第三，TTS 对感知型任务可能有负作用，原因不是算力浪费这么简单，而是 overthinking 导致错误假设累积和 hallucination。

作者还做了 reasoning chain 质量分析，结合 LLM-as-a-judge 与人工评估，检查生成链条在全局和细粒度上的信息充分性。再配合 attention 分析，论文给出的解释链比较完整：性能变化不是偶然，而与视觉证据在生成过程中的衰减机制相关。若从研究角度看，这比单纯 leaderboard 更有价值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，先建立三个结论：小模型受益更大、感知任务会掉点、通用 LLM TTS 方法能迁移。然后看方法部分里九种 TTS 方法的定义和实验设置，确认作者比较的是同一预算下的公平结果。接着重点看 attention analysis 和 token budget 分析，这两部分解释了为什么 LVLM 会 overthink。最后再看 reasoning chain 的 judge/human evaluation，判断作者对“链条质量”的论证是否站得住。预计 35-45 分钟能完成一次高质量泛读。如果只挑最有启发的内容，优先看 Figure 1、主结果表、attention 曲线，以及讨论视觉注意力衰减的段落。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a simple but important question: can standard test-time scaling methods from the LLM literature be transferred directly to large vision-language models, rather than requiring VLM-specific reasoning tricks? It further breaks this into three practical questions: which methods transfer, which model scales benefit most, and on which task types extra inference compute becomes harmful. The central answer is yes, they transfer well; small but capable LVLMs benefit the most; and perceptual tasks can degrade when the model is pushed to reason too much.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining method, but it is useful for understanding capability allocation in multimodal models. Two points matter for foundation-model research. First, it argues against the simple view that stronger reasoning in VLMs must come from larger parameter count or additional post-training. Some reasoning capacity is already latent in instruction-tuned LVLMs and can be activated at inference time. Second, it identifies a structural limitation: visual evidence is consumed early in generation, after which long reasoning chains rely increasingly on an internal compressed representation rather than fresh image grounding. That has implications for multimodal pretraining, visual token compression, and the design of reasoning-oriented post-training data.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The contribution is a broad empirical study plus mechanism analysis rather than a new TTS algorithm. The focus is on zero-shot or no-extra-training test-time scaling: prompting, sampling, aggregation, and iterative refinement methods are applied directly to existing instruction-tuned LVLMs, without additional SFT or RL. The study spans multiple model families and sizes, nine TTS methods, and six benchmarks. It also compares against methods designed specifically for VLM reasoning, such as Compositional CoT, to test whether generic LLM techniques are already sufficient.

The stronger part of the paper is the analysis. Instead of reporting only accuracy, the authors examine token budgets, reasoning-chain quality, and attention behavior. Their main observation is that LVLMs have a short early window in which generated tokens attend strongly to the image and absorb visual evidence into the hidden state. After that, attention to the image decays, and later tokens operate more on the internal representation than on direct visual grounding. This explains the mixed effect of test-time scaling: moderate extra reasoning helps on tasks that genuinely require multi-step inference, but excessive reasoning can detach the model from the image and amplify language-prior-driven errors and hallucinations.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation is fairly extensive: multiple LVLMs, multiple parameter scales, nine test-time scaling methods, and six benchmarks. Several findings stand out. First, conventional LLM-style TTS methods transfer well to LVLMs and often outperform some approaches designed specifically for VLMs. Second, small models are not inherently bad at TTS. On the contrary, small but competent models such as Qwen3-VL-4B can gain the most, with improvements reported up to about 40%, reaching or even surpassing the baseline performance of a larger model without TTS, such as Qwen3-VL-32B in some settings. Third, TTS can hurt perceptual tasks, not merely because of wasted compute, but because overthinking introduces wrong assumptions and accumulates hallucinations.

The paper also evaluates reasoning-chain quality using both LLM-as-a-judge and human assessment, at global and fine-grained levels. Combined with the attention analysis, this gives a coherent explanation of when and why TTS helps or hurts. For research readers, that mechanism-level evidence is more useful than the headline benchmark gains alone.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick but useful read, start with the introduction and Figure 1. The three takeaways to lock in early are: small models benefit more, perceptual tasks can get worse, and generic LLM TTS methods transfer surprisingly well. Then read the section defining the nine TTS methods and the evaluation setup, mainly to verify that the comparisons are budget-aware and fair. After that, spend most of the time on the attention analysis and token-budget analysis; these sections explain the overthinking failure mode. Finally, check the judge-based and human evaluation of reasoning chains to see whether the claims about chain quality are well supported. A solid skim should take around 35–45 minutes. If you only read a subset, prioritize Figure 1, the main result tables, and the sections discussing early visual attention decay.

recommendation.zh: 读结果表和规模分组就够；小模型吃到最多 TTS 红利这个结论会影响多模态推理算力分配。
recommendation.en: Read the size-stratified results; the claim that smaller strong LVLMs gain most from TTS changes inference-compute allocation priors.

paper.title: Flow Reasoning Models: Scaling Reasoning Through Iterative Self-Refinement
paper.abstract: Discrete flow models have recently shown promising performance on few-step text generation; however, when naively applied to structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and Zebra puzzles, they converge confidently to incorrect answers (solving only $\sim$36% of Sudoku puzzles). We introduce Flow Reasoning Models (FRMs), a training and test-time-scaling framework for structured reasoning with flow models. We make the observation that, despite their poor solve rate, flow models can act as their own

summary.core_problem: 现有离散流语言模型直接应用于数独、Zebra逻辑谜题等结构化约束推理任务时，采样得到的答案置信度高但正确率极低（仅约36%的数独求解率），同时流模型缺乏推理过程的迭代修正机制，也没有适配结构化约束满足需求的专用训练目标。
summary.importance: 利用离散流模型的去噪动力学稳定性作为内部无标注自验证信号，打通了「生成-验证-修正」的端到端流建模推理范式，为非自回归建模范式在推理任务上的落地提供了完整的训练+测试时缩放框架。FlowDPO目标的提出也丰富了流模型的偏好对齐方法，为探索AR之外的通用推理基座提供了新的路径参考。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 核心观察：正确解是离散流去噪过程的稳定不动点——对正确解重新加噪再求解会返回原答案，而错误解会发生明显漂移，这种稳定性信号可作为AUROC极高的自验证器，无需外部标注或校验工具。2. 测试时缩放范式：生成多份候选解，通过「重加噪-求解-一致性检测」的稳定性流程筛选正确解，直接提升求解率。3. 推理时自条件修正：每一步去噪时输入上一轮的完整预测结果，让单次采样过程迭代向稳定不动点收敛，给流模型增加了跨修正步的记忆，无需多次独立采样即可实现自修正。4. FlowDPO训练目标：构造「金标解-模型自挖掘的高置信错误解」的配对样本，用直接偏好优化目标让模型远离错误状态、靠近正确解，比传统交叉熵最大似然目标更适配结构化推理的约束满足需求。
summary.experiments: 仅用多候选+稳定性筛选的测试时缩放策略，数独求解率达100%，Zebra谜题达95.9%，训练过程中从未见过的分布外任务数独-Extreme也达到96.1%的求解率。结合自条件修正+FlowDPO训练后，仅需7次前向传播就达到99.2%的数独求解率，比同水平的掩码扩散基线减少8倍以上的计算量；单样本pass@1从35.8%提升至80.6%（EMA参考审计配置下），Zebra任务上也获得了一致的性能提升。
summary.reading_guide: 1. 先读§2的核心观察与不动点定义，重点关注§2.3的稳定性信号计算逻辑，这是整个方法体系的根基。2. 再精读§2.2的自条件修正算法（对应Algorithm 1），理清该机制与多次独立采样的本质差异。3. §4.5的FlowDPO目标构造与消融实验需重点关注，尤其是「自挖掘高置信错误解」的配对策略，以及与交叉熵基线的对比结果。4. 附录E的离散流采样细节可按需查阅，不属于首轮精读范围。

summary_en.core_problem: Naive application of existing discrete flow language models to structured constraint reasoning tasks (Sudoku, Zebra logic puzzles) produces highly confident but incorrect answers, with only ~36% Sudoku solve rate. Discrete flow models also lack iterative refinement mechanisms for reasoning, and have no training objectives tailored to structured constraint satisfaction requirements.
summary_en.importance: Leverages denoising dynamic stability of discrete flow models as an internal label-free self-verification signal, builds an end-to-end generate-verify-refine reasoning paradigm for flow-based modeling, and provides a complete training + test-time scaling framework for non-autoregressive paradigms on reasoning tasks. The proposed FlowDPO objective also enriches preference alignment methods for flow models, offering a new path reference for exploring general-purpose reasoning backbones outside the autoregressive paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Core observation: Correct solutions are stable fixed points of the discrete flow denoising process — re-noising a correct solution and solving it returns the original answer, while incorrect solutions drift significantly. This stability signal acts as a high-AUROC self-verifier without requiring external labels or checking tools. 2. Test-time scaling paradigm: Generate multiple candidate solutions and filter correct ones via a re-noise, re-solve, consistency-check stability pipeline to directly improve solve rates. 3. Inference-time self-conditioned refinement: Feed the complete previous prediction as conditioning at each denoising step, so a single sampling run iteratively converges to a stable fixed point, adding cross-refinement-step memory to flow models without requiring multiple independent sampling runs. 4. FlowDPO training objective: Construct paired samples of (gold solution, model-mined high-confidence incorrect solution) and use direct preference optimization to push the model away from incorrect states and toward correct ones, more suited to structured constraint satisfaction than traditional cross-entropy maximum likelihood objectives.
summary_en.experiments: Test-time scaling with multi-candidate + stability filtering alone achieves 100% solve rate on Sudoku, 95.9% on Zebra puzzles, and 96.1% on out-of-distribution Sudoku-Extreme (never seen during training). Combined with self-conditioned refinement + FlowDPO training, the model reaches 99.2% Sudoku solve rate in only 7 forward passes, over 8× fewer compute steps than a comparable masked diffusion baseline; single-sample pass@1 improves from 35.8% to 80.6% under the audited EMA-reference regime, with consistent gains also observed on Zebra tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: 1. Start with the core observation and fixed point definition in Section 2, focusing on the stability signal calculation logic in §2.3 — this is the foundation of the entire method. 2. Then closely read the self-conditioned refinement algorithm (Algorithm 1) in §2.2 to understand the fundamental difference between this mechanism and independent multi-sampling. 3. Pay special attention to the FlowDPO objective construction and ablation studies in §4.5, especially the self-mined high-confidence incorrect solution pairing strategy and comparison results against cross-entropy baselines. 4. Discrete flow sampling details in Appendix E can be referenced as needed, and are not required for a first pass.

recommendation.zh: 离散flow模型自带不动点自验证性质，无需额外PRM即可做test-time scaling，修正非AR LM推理的固有认知，建议立刻在内部ablation复现。
recommendation.en: Discrete flow models natively support self-verification via denoising fixed points, enabling test-time scaling without auxiliary PRMs; this revises prior assumptions about non-AR LM reasoning and warrants immediate internal ablation.

paper.title: REAR: Test-time Preference Realignment through Reward Decomposition
paper.abstract: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with diverse user preferences is a critical yet challenging task. While post-training methods can adapt models to specific needs, they often require costly data curation and additional training. Test-time scaling (TTS) presents an efficient, training-free alternative, but its application has been largely limited to verifiable domains like mathematics and coding, where response correctness is easily judged. To extend TTS to preference alignment, we introduce

summary.core_problem: 在不做额外训练、也缺少“可验证正确性”的偏好任务里，如何用 test-time scaling（多采样/搜索）把生成结果往用户偏好方向推，而不是只提升“答题质量/流畅度”却偏好不对。
summary.importance: 把“偏好对齐”改写成一个可在推理时优化的打分问题：通过把奖励拆成“问题相关”和“偏好相关”两部分，再对偏好项做重标定，实现训练外的偏好强化。这类方法对 pretrain 的直接影响不大，但对 post-train→inference 的闭环有启发：当模型的能力在、但偏好权重不对时，可以用推理时的重加权与搜索补齐一部分对齐缺口，减少为长尾偏好做专门 RL/SFT 的成本。
summary.technical_approach:
核心做法是 Reward Decomposition + Realignment。
1）将生成视为 token 级 MDP，并沿用 RLHF/偏好优化的视角，把“一个回答的好坏”抽象为序列级 reward。
2）提出把 reward 分解为两项：与问题本身相关的项（回答是否在解决问题、信息是否充分等）和与偏好文本相关的项（是否遵守用户声明的风格/禁忌/角色设定等）。
3）REAR（REAlignment Reward）的关键是：对“偏好相关”分量乘一个可调系数，实现推理时的偏好权重重标定（realignment）。这样同一批候选回答里，原本更“会答题”但不守偏好的样本会被降分，而更守偏好的样本会上浮。
4）实现层面强调计算效率：REAR 可以写成 token 级 policy log-prob 的线性组合，从而得到序列级 score；因此可直接嵌入两类 TTS：best-of-N 采样与基于树搜索的 DVTS（论文引用 Beeching et al., 2025）。
5）与常见推理时偏好控制（例如 token-level 的固定偏置/引导）相比，作者主张 REAR 更适合“可扩展计算预算”的场景：预算越大（更多采样/更深搜索），越可能找到同时满足问题与偏好的解。
summary.experiments: 全文片段未给出完整实验表格与具体数值细节（如基座模型、N 的取值、各 benchmark 的绝对分/提升幅度、显著性等），只能从引言确认：在偏好对齐与 role-play 基准上，REAR 引导的 best-of-N 与 DVTS 优于既有偏好对齐方法；并声称通过合适的偏好文本还能迁移到更具体的数学与视觉任务。若需要可复现级结论，需要补齐：1）reward 分解的具体形式与训练/估计方式；2）与哪些 test-time alignment/偏好引导基线对比；3）不同预算下的 scaling 曲线与成本。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Figure 1（动机：同一问题下“会答题”与“守偏好”冲突的例子）与方法总览，确认 reward 分解到底如何落到可计算的序列打分。
- 重点抓“REAR 可写成 log-prob 线性组合”的推导：它决定了方法是否真能低成本嵌入采样/搜索。
- 再看与 DVTS 的结合方式：REAR 是作为叶子打分、还是作为过程中的 value/heuristic；这会影响搜索偏置与多样性。
- 最后扫实验：优先看不同 N/不同搜索预算下的曲线，以及对 reward 分解/重标定系数的消融（是否存在过度迎合偏好导致答非所问的拐点）。预计 30–45 分钟可完成有效泛读。

summary_en.core_problem: How to do preference alignment at inference time—without additional training and without verifiable correctness—so that test-time scaling (sampling/search) improves adherence to stated preferences rather than merely improving generic answer quality.
summary_en.importance: The paper reframes preference alignment as an inference-time realignment problem: decompose reward into a task/question component and a preference component, then rescale the preference term during decoding-time selection. This is not a pretraining recipe contribution, but it is relevant to the pretrain↔post-train interface: when the base model has the capability but the preference weighting is off, inference-time reweighting plus compute scaling can partially close the gap and reduce the need for bespoke RL/SFT for long-tail preferences.
summary_en.technical_approach:
REAR is essentially reward decomposition + compute-scalable selection.
- Formulate generation as a token-level MDP and view alignment as reward maximization.
- Decompose the (implicit) reward into (i) question-related reward and (ii) preference-related reward derived from the preference text.
- Define a realigned reward by multiplying the preference component with a tunable coefficient, shifting the trade-off between “answering well” and “following preferences”.
- Key engineering claim: the resulting REAR score can be computed efficiently as a linear combination of token-level policy log-probabilities, yielding a sequence-level scoring function.
- Plug this score into (a) best-of-N sampling and (b) a tree-search style test-time scaling method (DVTS), so performance can improve with larger sampling/search budgets.
Compared to fixed token-level steering, the emphasis is on budget-scalable improvement via candidate selection/search.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include the main result tables or concrete numbers (models, datasets, N/search budgets, absolute scores, deltas). From the introduction, the claimed findings are: REAR-guided best-of-N and REAR-guided DVTS outperform prior preference-alignment approaches on preference-alignment and role-play benchmarks; and the method can generalize to more specific math/vision tasks by crafting preference text. For a research-grade read, the missing essentials are: how the reward components are instantiated/estimated, what baselines are used, and the compute–performance scaling curves.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
1) Start with the motivating example (Figure 1) to understand the failure mode: good answers that ignore preferences.
2) Focus on the derivation that makes REAR a log-prob linear combination—this determines whether the method is truly cheap to integrate.
3) Check how REAR is used inside DVTS (terminal scoring vs. intermediate heuristic/value), since it affects search bias and diversity.
4) Scan ablations on the preference scaling coefficient and budget scaling; look for the point where preference over-optimization hurts task relevance.
~30–45 minutes for a useful skim.

recommendation.zh: 只看 reward 分解推导和消融；若 verifier 不干净，它更像偏好 reranker，不足以改变对 TTS 的 prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward-decomposition derivation and ablations; if the verifier is leaky, this is closer to a preference reranker than a new prior on TTS.

paper.title: VGB for Masked Diffusion Model: Efficient Test-time Scaling for Reward Satisfaction and Sample Editing
paper.abstract: Inference-time scaling is a promising paradigm to improve generative models, especially when outputs must satisfy structural constraints or optimize downstream rewards. We consider Masked Diffusion Model (MDM) and introduce MDM-VGB, a discrete diffusion sampler that augments unmasking generation with theoretically principled reward-guided remasking. Inspired by the recent success of the classical Jerrum-Sinclair backtracking Markov chain in reward-tilted generation, MDM-VGB extends the backtrack

summary.core_problem: Masked Diffusion Model 在测试时如何利用 reward 或 verifier 信号，在不靠大量 best-of-N 采样的情况下生成满足约束的离散样本。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是文本/离散 diffusion 生成范式中的采样与 test-time scaling 方法创新。它把 reward-guided backtracking 从前缀树推广到 masked-state graph，对 MDLM、LLaDA 类任意位置生成模型有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MDM-VGB，在普通 unmasking 过程中加入 reward-guided remasking。方法允许任意位置 token 被揭示或重新 mask，使用 partial configuration 的价值信号决定前进和回退方向。它借鉴 Jerrum-Sinclair backtracking Markov chain，但不局限于固定前缀树，而是在 mask 状态图上做随机游走和修复。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调该 sampler 可用于高 reward 生成和低 reward 样本修复，并给出理论性质：对 process verifier noise 鲁棒，复杂度为 quadratic；同时指出 best-of-N 等常见 test-time heuristic 在某些 reward-tilted generation 设置下可能出现 exponential cost。摘要未列出具体模型规模、数据集或数值提升。

summary_en.core_problem: How can masked diffusion models use reward or verifier signals at test time to satisfy constraints without relying on large best-of-N sampling?
summary_en.importance: This is a sampling and test-time scaling contribution for discrete diffusion generation. By moving reward-guided backtracking from prefix trees to masked-state graphs, it is directly relevant to MDLM- and LLaDA-style non-autoregressive language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: MDM-VGB augments standard unmasking with reward-guided remasking. Tokens can be unmasked or remasked at arbitrary positions, and moves are biased by the estimated value of partial configurations. The method adapts the Jerrum-Sinclair backtracking Markov chain from fixed prefix trees to the graph of masked states.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims effectiveness for high-reward generation and repair of low-reward samples. It proves robustness to noisy process verifiers and quadratic complexity, while showing that common heuristics such as best-of-N may incur exponential cost in some reward-tilted settings. The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or numeric empirical gains.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻在内部 MDLM 小模型上复现；若二次复杂度结论站得住，best-of-N prior 要下调。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing on an internal small MDLM; if the quadratic-cost claim holds, the default best-of-N prior should be weakened.

paper.title: E-TTS: A New Embodied Test-Time Scaling Framework for Robotic Manipulation
paper.abstract: Recently, a few works have made early attempts to study test-time scaling for embodied tasks. However, two major challenges remain unsolved: (1) reasoning can effectively improve the performance of the policy, but its scaling mechanism has seldom been studied; (2) historical information is essential, as embodied tasks are inherently long-horizon and sequential, making sole reliance on current observations for action scaling inadequate due to the lack of historical context utilization. To address

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 embodied 场景下 test-time scaling 的两个缺口：一是现有方法大多只在动作层做采样和重排，没有把高层 reasoning 一起纳入扩展计算；二是机器人操作是长时序决策，只看当前观测做候选评估不够，历史轨迹和在线反馈缺失会让 test-time scaling 很快失效。作者试图回答的是：在不重新训练主策略、也不额外收集专家数据的前提下，能否通过推理-动作联合采样、历史感知验证和迭代修正，把额外测试时算力稳定换成更高的操作成功率。
summary.importance: 从 LLM 基座预训练视角看，这篇文章不是核心必读。它更偏 embodied/VLA 推理时框架，而不是预训练方法本身。但它有两个可借鉴点。第一，它把“reasoning 也作为 test-time scaling 对象”明确化，而不是只对最终动作做 best-of-N，这和语言模型里从只扩展答案采样走向扩展中间推理轨迹是同一类思路。第二，它强调 verifier 必须吃到历史上下文，说明在序列决策里，测试时扩展的瓶颈不只是采样数量，而是评估器是否有足够状态信息。这对 agent、长程规划、甚至带外部工具的 LM 推理都有参考意义。贡献量级主要在系统整合和实证覆盖面，不在提出新的预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach:
E-TTS 的框架由四个核心模块组成。

第一是 Reasoning-Action Joint Sampling。给定任务指令和当前观测，系统不是只采样动作，而是同时采样中间 reasoning 候选 C_t^i 和在该 reasoning 条件下的动作候选 a_t^{i,j}，形成联合候选对。这样做的动机很直接：如果高层计划本身错了，再怎么在动作层做重排也只是局部修补；反过来，如果 reasoning 看起来合理但动作不可执行，也不能直接采用。因此作者把两者绑定成联合搜索对象。

第二是 History-aware Verification and Selection。作者维护一个 history buffer，存放过去的观测、候选和执行信息，并把这些历史上下文送入 verifier。验证器分成两类：reasoning verifier 用 VLM 做 zero-shot 打分，评估语义计划是否和任务、场景一致；action verifier 则基于构造出的 action preference dataset 训练一个单独的 VLM，用来判断候选动作在物理执行上是否更合适。最后通过 joint scoring 把 reasoning 分数和 action 分数组合起来做选择。这里的关键不是 verifier 数量，而是把“语义正确”和“物理可行”拆开建模，再在选择阶段合并。

第三是 Adaptive Online Selection。系统会根据当前最优候选的置信度决定是否直接执行。如果联合分数超过阈值，就执行该动作；否则进入下一步 refinement。这个设计让 test-time compute 不是固定展开，而是按难度自适应分配。

第四是 Feedback-Guided Iterative Refinement。当当前轮没有足够好的候选时，系统生成反馈，再把反馈连同历史一起送回 VLA 模型，促使其重新采样更对齐的 reasoning-action 对。作者强调这是闭环 refinement，而不是一次性大采样。这样做的好处是能利用 verifier 的判别信号逐轮修正，而不是把所有预算都花在盲采样上。

从方法定位看，E-TTS 是一个 plug-and-play 外挂框架。它不要求重训主 VLA policy，可以接到不同类型、不同是否显式输出 reasoning 的 VLA 模型上。和已有 embodied TTS 方法相比，它的区别主要有三点：联合扩展 reasoning 与 action；显式使用历史缓冲区；引入反馈驱动的迭代 refinement，而不是单轮候选重排。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖六个环境：SIMPLER WidowX、SIMPLER Google Robot、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、VLAbench，以及真实机器人场景；并集成到四个代表性的 vision-language-action 模型上。作者报告的总体结果是，平均成功率最高提升 33.14%，平均提升 13.52%。从摘要和正文片段看，这个提升不是单一环境偶然出现，而是在多环境、多 embodiment 下都能复现。

更有信息量的是消融方向。作者专门分析了 reasoning scaling 和 action scaling 的取舍，结论是两者都重要，只做其中一侧会留下明显短板。这和方法设计是吻合的：高层计划错误时，动作重排无法补救；低层动作不稳时，单纯扩 reasoning 也不够。另一个关键消融应当是 history buffer 与 feedback refinement 的作用。按作者的叙述，历史信息对长时序任务尤其关键，因为 verifier 若只看当前帧，很难判断候选动作是否与先前轨迹一致；而 feedback 机制则提升了采样效率，避免在低质量候选上浪费过多预算。

不过从基座研究角度，也要看到实验边界：这里的收益主要是 inference-time orchestration 带来的，不是模型参数或预训练数据层面的改进。若精读全文，建议重点找四类数字：不同 VLA backbone 上的增益是否稳定；不同环境中增益是否集中在长程任务；reasoning-only、action-only、joint 三种 scaling 的对比；以及迭代轮数/候选数增加后的收益曲线，看看 compute-performance trade-off 是否平滑。
summary.reading_guide:
如果只是判断是否值得跟进，先看 Introduction 和方法总览图，确认它解决的是 embodied TTS 而非预训练。接着看 Sec. 3 里四个模块的接口定义，尤其是 joint sampling、dual verifier、history buffer、adaptive selection 这几处。这里决定了框架是否真能作为通用外挂，而不是只对某个特定 VLA 有效。

实验部分建议先看主表，确认四个 backbone、六个环境上的平均增益和最大增益；再看消融，重点关注 reasoning scaling vs action scaling、history-aware vs current-only verifier、single-pass vs iterative refinement。若这些消融做得完整，基本就能判断方法的有效成分。

这篇不需要逐页精读。若你主要做 LLM 预训练，只需把它当作 test-time scaling 在 embodied 序列决策中的一个系统化实现，阅读 15–25 分钟足够抓住方法和边界。若你同时关注 agent/VLA 推理框架，再补看真实机器人实验和 action preference dataset 的构造细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two missing pieces in embodied test-time scaling. Existing methods mostly scale action selection only, without scaling high-level reasoning, and they often evaluate candidates from the current observation alone, ignoring trajectory history. That is a poor fit for robotic manipulation, where tasks are sequential, long-horizon, and often require iterative correction. The question the paper asks is simple: without retraining the policy or collecting more expert data, can extra inference-time compute be converted into higher manipulation success by jointly scaling reasoning and action, while making verification history-aware and refinement iterative?
summary_en.importance: For core LLM pretraining research, this is not central. It is primarily an embodied/VLA inference-time framework rather than a pretraining contribution. Still, it offers two useful ideas. First, it treats reasoning itself as a target of test-time scaling instead of only reranking final actions. That parallels the shift in language models from scaling answer sampling to scaling intermediate reasoning trajectories. Second, it argues that the verifier must consume history, not just the current state. In sequential decision problems, the bottleneck is not only how many candidates are sampled, but whether the evaluator has enough temporal context to judge them. That lesson is relevant to agents, long-horizon planning, and tool-using LM systems. The contribution is mainly in framework design and broad empirical validation, not in a new training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
E-TTS consists of four main components.

The first is Reasoning-Action Joint Sampling. Given an instruction and the current observation, the system samples not only action candidates but also intermediate reasoning candidates. Each candidate is a pair of a reasoning step C_t^i and a conditional action a_t^{i,j}. The motivation is straightforward. If the high-level plan is wrong, action-only reranking can only patch locally. If the reasoning looks plausible but the action is physically poor, the candidate still should not be executed. So the search space is defined jointly over reasoning and action.

The second is History-aware Verification and Selection. The framework maintains a history buffer containing previous observations, candidates, and execution context. This history is fed into the verifier. Verification is split into two parts: a reasoning verifier, implemented as zero-shot scoring by a VLM, and an action verifier, implemented as a separately trained VLM on an action preference dataset. The final selection uses a joint score that combines semantic consistency at the reasoning level with physical suitability at the action level. The key design choice is to model these two aspects separately and merge them only at selection time.

The third is Adaptive Online Selection. If the best joint candidate exceeds a confidence threshold, the action is executed. Otherwise, the system does not commit and instead triggers another refinement round. This makes inference-time compute adaptive rather than fixed.

The fourth is Feedback-Guided Iterative Refinement. When no candidate is good enough, the framework generates feedback and feeds it, together with history, back into the VLA model to resample better reasoning-action pairs. This is a closed-loop refinement process rather than one-shot large-N sampling. The benefit is better compute efficiency: verifier signals are used to steer later sampling rounds instead of spending the full budget on blind candidate generation.

As a system, E-TTS is designed to be plug-and-play. It does not require retraining the main VLA policy and can be attached to different VLA backbones. Relative to prior embodied TTS work, the main differences are joint scaling of reasoning and action, explicit use of trajectory history, and iterative feedback-driven refinement instead of single-pass reranking.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans six environments: SIMPLER WidowX, SIMPLER Google Robot, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, VLAbench, and real-world robotic settings. The framework is integrated with four representative vision-language-action models. The headline result is an average success-rate gain of 13.52%, with a maximum gain of 33.14%. From the description, these gains are not confined to a single benchmark but appear across multiple environments and embodiments.

The ablation direction is more informative than the headline number. The paper explicitly studies the trade-off between reasoning scaling and action scaling and concludes that both matter. That matches the design logic: if the plan is wrong, action reranking cannot rescue it; if the low-level action is poor, scaling reasoning alone is insufficient. Another important ablation concerns the history buffer and iterative feedback. The authors argue that history is critical for long-horizon tasks because a verifier that only sees the current frame cannot reliably judge consistency with prior trajectory context. Feedback-guided refinement, in turn, improves efficiency by steering later sampling rounds toward better candidates.

From a foundation-model perspective, the gains come from inference-time orchestration rather than changes in model parameters or pretraining data. When reading the full paper, the most useful numbers to extract are: whether gains are stable across all four VLA backbones, whether improvements are concentrated in long-horizon tasks, how reasoning-only, action-only, and joint scaling compare, and how performance scales with candidate count or refinement rounds.
summary_en.reading_guide:
If the goal is triage, start with the introduction and the overview figure to confirm that this is an embodied TTS paper rather than a pretraining paper. Then read Section 3 for the interfaces between the four modules: joint sampling, dual verifiers, history buffer, and adaptive selection. Those details determine whether the framework is genuinely plug-and-play or only works for a narrow class of VLA models.

In the experiments, first inspect the main tables for the four backbones and six environments to verify the average and maximum gains. Then move to the ablations, especially reasoning scaling versus action scaling, history-aware versus current-only verification, and single-pass versus iterative refinement. If those ablations are complete, they reveal where the gains actually come from.

This is not a paper that requires line-by-line reading for a pretraining researcher. If your focus is LLM pretraining, treat it as a structured example of test-time scaling in sequential embodied decision-making; 15 to 25 minutes should be enough to understand the method and its limits. If you also care about agent or VLA inference frameworks, then it is worth reading the real-robot section and the construction of the action preference dataset in more detail.

recommendation.zh: 测试时缩放到具身场景的合理扩展，重点看§3的推理-动作联合采样设计，对推理增强预训练的目标设计有弱启发。
recommendation.en: A reasonable extension of test-time scaling to embodied tasks; focus on §3 for the joint reasoning-action sampling design, which provides weak inspiration for reasoning-enhanced pretraining objectives.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences

paper.title: Granularity-Regulated Adaptive Computational Efficiency for Optimal Verification in Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs) by investing additional compute at inference time. A central component of TTS is the \emph{verifier}, which selects or scores candidate solutions to guide the search process. While prior work has explored the benefit of verification, a fundamental question remains underexplored: \emph{what is the optimal granularity of verification under a given compute budget?} Coar

summary.core_problem: 在 test-time scaling（TTS）里，verifier 既可以做 outcome-level（ORM）也可以做 step-level（PRM）。问题是：在固定推理算力预算下，验证粒度越细越准但越贵、粒度越粗越便宜但更难早期筛错。论文要回答的是：给定预算 C、题目难度 δ（单次采样出正确链的概率）以及 verifier 的准确率随粒度变化的函数 α(g)，最优验证粒度 g* 应该怎么选，是否存在可解释的“粗/细粒度切换阈值”。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“推理时扩展算力”的工程决策有明确指导意义：把 ORM vs PRM 的争论从经验选择变成可计算的 trade-off，并给出 instance-adaptive 的粒度策略。对做 RL/PRM/ORM、search+verifier、以及把 TTS 当作能力放大器的团队，价值在于：能更系统地设计 verifier 预算分配，而不是默认“越细越好”。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 GRACE 框架，把验证粒度连续化为 g∈[0,1]：g=0 代表只在最终答案上打分（ORM），g=1 代表每一步都打分（PRM），中间值表示每隔若干步验证一次。核心建模分三块：
1) 计算成本：生成一条推理链成本 C_gen；验证成本设为线性 C_ver(g)=c0+c1·g，因此在总预算 C 下，可采样候选数 N(g)=C/(C_gen+c0+c1·g)。这把“粒度越细→每条更贵→候选更少”显式化。
2) 准确率/难度：用 δ 表示题目难度（单条链正确概率），用 α(g) 表示 verifier 在粒度 g 下的判别准确率，假设 α(g) 随 g 单调上升且 Lipschitz。
3) 目标函数：定义 compute-performance F(g;C,δ,α) 为在 N(g) 个候选中，经 verifier 选择到正确解的概率。论文把 ∂F/∂g 分解为两项：precision gain（粒度更细带来的选择更准）与 sample loss（候选数减少带来的损失），并在若干假设下给出 log-concavity 等性质，从而推出存在临界预算 C*(g,δ,α)：预算低时 coarse-grained 更优，预算高时 fine-grained 更优（相变式切换）。
在理论结论基础上，给出 GRACE-Adapt：在线估计实例难度（或等价的“当前采样成功率/不确定性”信号），自适应选择 g，使其接近最优 Pareto 前沿，而不需要事先知道 δ。
summary.experiments: 全文声称在 MATH-500、GSM8K、AIME 上验证理论结论，并与 Best-of-N、固定 PRM、固定 ORM 做对比，结论是自适应粒度在不同预算区间更稳定、整体更接近 compute-optimal。当前提供的正文片段未包含关键表格与具体数值（提升幅度、预算设置、c0/c1 标定方式、α(g) 的实现与测量），因此无法在不臆测的前提下复述精确数字。建议以论文的主结果表与“不同 C 下的最优 g 曲线/相变点”图为准。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Methodology 里对 C_ver(g)、N(g)、δ、α(g)、F(g) 的定义，确认它们是否贴合你自己的 TTS 系统（尤其是验证成本是否真近似线性、以及 α(g) 如何测）。
- 重点看“Phase Transition Theorem”给出的 C* 闭式表达与推导假设：哪些假设是数学便利、哪些在工程上可校准。
- 再看 GRACE-Adapt：它用什么在线信号估计难度/不确定性，是否会引入额外开销或偏置。
- 最后对照实验部分：是否真的覆盖了“低预算 ORM 更好、高预算 PRM 更好”的区间，并检查消融（固定 g、不同 α(g) 形状、不同预算标定）是否充分。

summary_en.core_problem: In test-time scaling, a verifier can score only final answers (ORM) or intermediate steps (PRM). Finer-grained verification is typically more informative but more expensive, reducing the number of candidates you can explore under a fixed inference budget. The paper asks: given compute budget C, problem difficulty δ (probability a sampled chain is correct), and a verifier accuracy function α(g) that improves with granularity g, what granularity g* maximizes the probability of selecting a correct solution?
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining contribution per se, but it provides a principled way to allocate inference compute between sampling and verification. It turns the ORM-vs-PRM choice into an explicit compute–accuracy trade-off with a predicted regime switch, and proposes an instance-adaptive policy. This is useful for teams building PRMs/ORMs, search-with-verifier pipelines, or RL-style verifiers where inference-time compute is treated as a controllable resource.
summary_en.technical_approach:
GRACE parameterizes verification granularity continuously with g∈[0,1]: g=0 is outcome-only scoring (ORM), g=1 is step-level scoring (PRM), and intermediate g corresponds to verifying every few steps. The framework couples:
1) A compute model: per-sample generation cost C_gen and verification cost C_ver(g)=c0+c1·g, yielding the number of candidates N(g)=C/(C_gen+c0+c1·g).
2) A difficulty/accuracy model: δ for base success rate of sampled chains; α(g) for verifier accuracy, assumed monotone increasing and Lipschitz in g.
3) A performance objective F(g;C,δ,α): probability of selecting a correct answer among N(g) candidates using the verifier at granularity g.
The key analytical move is decomposing the marginal effect of increasing g into a non-negative “precision gain” term (better discrimination) and a non-positive “sample loss” term (fewer candidates). Under additional regularity assumptions (including log-concavity), they derive a critical compute threshold C* such that coarse verification is optimal below C* and fine verification is optimal above C*, i.e., a regime transition. Building on this, GRACE-Adapt estimates instance difficulty online and selects g adaptively to approach the Pareto-optimal frontier without knowing δ upfront.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports validation on MATH-500, GSM8K, and AIME, comparing against Best-of-N, fixed-ORM, and fixed-PRM baselines, and claims consistent gains and better compute-optimal behavior across budgets. The provided excerpt does not include the main tables/figures or exact numbers (budget settings, measured improvements, calibration of c0/c1, or how α(g) is instantiated), so precise quantitative results cannot be quoted reliably here.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Start with the formal definitions of C_ver(g), N(g), δ, α(g), and F(g) to check whether the modeling assumptions match your TTS pipeline.
- Read the theorem that gives the closed-form C* and note which assumptions are structural vs. convenience.
- Inspect GRACE-Adapt: what online signals are used to estimate difficulty/uncertainty, and what overhead it adds.
- Finally, verify the empirical claim of a regime switch by checking plots/tables that sweep compute budgets and show the optimal g shifting from ORM-like to PRM-like, plus ablations on fixed g and alternative α(g) shapes.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 test-time scaling，这篇值得扫；重点不是方法名，而是它把 ORM/PRM 之争写成预算分配问题，先看理论框架和预算分区图。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming if you care about test-time scaling: the useful part is not the method name but the reframing of ORM vs PRM as a compute-allocation problem.

paper.title: Think Again or Think Longer? Selective Verification for Budget-Aware Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time reasoning is increasingly used as a serving-time control knob, but extra reasoning is not uniformly valuable: it can repair failed attempts, waste compute on already-correct answers, or introduce harmful answer changes. We study this as a deployment allocation problem rather than a new-verifier problem. We introduce \sevra, Selective Verification for Reasoning Allocation, a serving-layer controller that decides whether to preserve a frozen solver's initial answer or invoke active verif

summary.core_problem: 这项工作把“是否再推理一次”定义为服务层的资源分配问题：给定冻结求解器的一次初始作答，系统应判断接受答案，还是调用主动验证来修复潜在错误。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对推理模型的部署和训练目标设计有参考意义。它强调 test-time compute 不是简单增加 token 或调用次数，而要看一次干预能否修复当前样本，以及是否会把正确答案改错。这个视角对后训练中的 verifier、process reward、self-correction 数据构造也有启发：训练信号不应只奖励“多想”，还应区分 helpful fix 和 harmful flip。
summary.technical_approach: SeVRA 使用冻结的 Qwen3-4B reasoning model 先生成基础答案，再由一个轻量 gate 决定是否触发 active verification。active verification 不是普通续写，而是要求同一个冻结模型为候选答案构造至少两个针对性检查，例如重建方程、检查单位和边界、代回候选答案、走独立解法；只有检查失败时才修改答案。gate 的训练标签来自离线执行后的结果：一次验证是否把错误答案修好，或者是否把正确答案改错。部署时 gate 只能看到题目、初始解答和运行时可见特征，不能访问 gold answer。作者比较了三类 gate：基于 completion status、token count、finalizer use、估计难度、约束密度等廉价特征的 logistic gate；Qwen3-0.6B 4-bit QLoRA sequence classifier；Qwen3-1.7B 4-bit QLoRA sequence classifier。方法的关键不在 verifier 模型更强，而在把验证看成带收益和风险的选择性动作。
summary.experiments: 主要实验使用冻结 Qwen3-4B。MATH500 上，SeVRA 达到 76.3% accuracy，高于 always verifying 的 75.5%，同时 post-generation tokens 减少 26.8%，并降低 harmful flips。GSM8K 的 frozen transfer 中，gate 只验证少量样本，相比 short-base solver 有提升，并且没有观察到 harmful flips。作者也做了预算匹配比较：接受初始答案、继续推理、主动验证、总是验证、增加初始 reasoning budget。一个重要结果是，在这些数学任务上，调大初始解题 budget 能达到相近 accuracy，而且 realized total model tokens 更少。因此 SeVRA 更适合需要显式验证、有限重试、答案修改审计的场景，而不是所有场景下的通用省算策略。CommonsenseQA 诊断显示动作选择具有任务依赖性：always-on verification 会伤害性能，self-consistency 只有在明显更高 token 成本下才有收益。廉价 feature gate 的表现接近 0.6B 和 1.7B QLoRA gate，在可接受小幅 accuracy gap 时更适合部署。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 Problem Formulation 中 helpful fix、harmful flip、realized total model tokens 的定义；看 Method 中 active verification prompt 和 gate label 的构造；看实验部分的预算匹配表，而不只看 MATH500 accuracy。最值得关注的是它如何把“验证是否有用”从样本难度中拆出来，以及为什么必须和调大初始 token budget 做公平比较。Appendix A 的 intervention screening 和 Appendix B 的 prompt 也值得扫读，因为它们决定了 selective policy 的上限。

summary_en.core_problem: This work frames extra reasoning as a serving-time allocation problem: after a frozen solver produces an initial answer, the system must decide whether to accept it or spend another call on active verification.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining paper, but it is useful for understanding the interface between reasoning models, verifiers, and test-time compute. Its main lesson is that more reasoning is not uniformly beneficial. A second pass can repair failures, waste compute on already correct answers, or flip a correct answer into an incorrect one. This distinction is relevant for post-training data design as well: useful supervision should separate helpful fixes from harmful revisions, rather than simply rewarding longer traces or more self-correction attempts.
summary_en.technical_approach: SeVRA keeps the solver and intervention prompts frozen. A Qwen3-4B reasoning model first generates a base solution and answer. A lightweight gate then predicts whether active verification is likely to help, using only the problem, the base attempt, and serving-visible metadata such as completion status, token counts, finalizer use, estimated difficulty, verification need, and constraint density. Active verification asks the same frozen model to construct and execute at least two candidate-specific checks before changing the answer. These checks can reconstruct equations, test units and bounds, substitute the candidate answer, or solve through an independent route. The gate is trained offline with labels derived from intervention outcomes: whether verification repaired an incorrect answer or damaged a correct one. The paper compares a cheap logistic feature gate with Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B 4-bit QLoRA sequence-classifier gates.
summary_en.experiments: With a frozen Qwen3-4B solver, SeVRA reaches 76.3% accuracy on MATH500, compared with 75.5% for always verifying, while reducing post-generation tokens by 26.8% and lowering harmful flips. In frozen transfer to GSM8K, it verifies only a small fraction of examples, improves over the short-base solver, and reports no observed harmful flips. The budget-matched comparisons are the most important part: accepting the base answer, continuing, active verification, always verifying, and increasing the initial reasoning budget are all compared under realized token usage. On the tested math benchmarks, a longer initial solve reaches a similar accuracy region with fewer total realized model tokens. A CommonsenseQA diagnostic shows that the best action depends on the workload: always-on verification hurts, while self-consistency helps only at much higher token cost. The cheap feature gate nearly matches the larger QLoRA gates, making it the more practical option when the small accuracy gap is acceptable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the problem formulation, especially the definitions of helpful fix, harmful flip, intervention rate, and realized total model tokens. Then read the method section for the active-verification prompt and the gate-label construction. In the experiments, prioritize the budget-matched tables over the headline accuracy numbers. Appendix A is useful for understanding why active verification was selected over continuation or critique-and-repair, and Appendix B is worth checking because the prompt defines the intervention being allocated.

recommendation.zh: test-time compute分配文章，结论很值得注意：加verifier门控不如直接把初始CoT拉长，做budgeted reasoning的人看§4与Table 3即可。
recommendation.en: A test-time compute allocation paper whose punchline is that gated verification underperforms simply lengthening the initial CoT; read §4 and Table 3 if you work on budgeted reasoning.

paper.title: REVES: REvision and VErification--Augmented Training for Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling via sequential revision has emerged as a powerful paradigm for enhancing Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning. However, standard post-training methods primarily optimize single-shot objectives, creating a fundamental misalignment with multi-step inference dynamics. While recent work treats this as multi-turn reinforcement learning (RL), conventional approaches optimize over the multi-step trajectories directly, failing to further exploit the high-quality mistakes in intermediat

summary.core_problem: test-time scaling 下的多步修订推理与现有单步后训练目标不匹配，直接做 trajectory-level RL 又浪费了中间 near-miss 步骤的学习信号。
summary.importance: 提出一种把 revision 与 verification 解耦的数据增强+策略优化框架，属于 test-time scaling 训练方法类工作；方法上为 offline/off-policy 利用中间错误提供了一个具体 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段迭代：(1) 在线 rollout 生成成功恢复轨迹，把中间 near-miss 步骤解耦为独立的 revision prompt（从错到对的改写）和 verification prompt（定位错误）；(2) 用这些增广样本做策略优化，支持离策略数据复用，降低在线采样成本。框架反复在数据增广和策略优化之间交替。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、训练 token、baseline 与数值增益，仅描述了在推理任务上相对单步目标和直接 multi-turn RL 的效率与效果提升预期，实验细节不完整。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Zhaoran Wang、Mingyi Hong、Mohammad Ghavamzadeh 等，来自优化/RL 方向，无明确机构署名在给定信息中。

summary_en.core_problem: Single-shot post-training objectives mismatch multi-step revision-based test-time scaling, while naive multi-turn RL underuses learning signal from near-miss intermediate steps.
summary_en.importance: Proposes an iterative data augmentation plus policy optimization framework that decouples revision and verification supervision, offering a concrete recipe to exploit intermediate mistakes for test-time scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-stage loop: (1) online rollouts of successful recovery trajectories; intermediate near-miss states are converted into decoupled revision prompts (error-to-correction transforms) and verification prompts (error identification); (2) policy optimization on these augmented samples enables off-policy data reuse and reduces sample cost, alternating between data augmentation and policy improvement.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits model sizes, training data, baselines, and quantitative gains; it only claims improved efficiency and performance over single-shot objectives and direct multi-turn RL on reasoning tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Zhaoran Wang, Mingyi Hong, and Mohammad Ghavamzadeh from optimization/RL backgrounds; institutional affiliations are not fully specified in the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 想法不新（revision+verification 数据增广今年已很拥挤），摘要实验不完整，扫一眼数据构造方式即可，别当方法范式读。
recommendation.en: The revision-plus-verification augmentation idea is crowded this year and the abstract lacks concrete numbers; skim the data construction, do not treat it as a new paradigm.

paper.title: How Inference Compute Shapes Frontier LLM Evaluation
paper.abstract: AI evaluations are shifting toward harder tasks that benefit from longer trajectories involving tool use and iterative problem solving. As a result, performance is increasingly sensitive to the amount and allocation of compute available at test time ("inference compute"). Yet many evaluations still report performance at a single restrictive budget, meaning that low scores may reflect the evaluation setup rather than the model's underlying capability. To test this, we evaluate up to 12 frontier l

summary.core_problem: 当前前沿大模型评测普遍使用固定的低推理算力预算（单次提交、有限token配额、无迭代空间），得到的分数无法区分是模型本身不具备对应能力，还是推理资源不足导致能力未被激发；不同模型对推理算力的利用效率差异、不同推理算力分配方式的效果差异，尚未被系统性刻画。
summary.importance: 直接动摇了当前单分数评测范式的合理性，为预训练与后训练的能力评估、模型代际对比、安全相关能力判定提供了关键观测框架：模型能力不是一个固定标量，而是推理算力投入的函数。对预训练研究的直接启示是，新模型的"推理时算力转化效率"本身就是和训练算力投入同等重要的scaling维度，未来的scaling law需要将训练-推理算力的权衡纳入统一建模。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 构建统一的可控推理缩放实验框架，在覆盖软件工程、数学、医学、网络安全的7个高难度长轨迹基准上，测试最多12个2025年5月到2026年3月发布的前沿模型；2. 使用三类通用、可复现的推理缩放干预手段：将总token预算提升到基准默认值的1-3个数量级、加入上下文压缩缓解长上下文遗忘、允许不限次数提交并可选配极简正确性反馈；3. 明确区分两类推理算力分配模式：串行缩放（加深单条轨迹的思考深度）和并行缩放（采样多条浅轨迹选最优），分别测试不同任务类型对两类分配方式的响应程度。
summary.experiments: 1. 推理缩放的收益高度依赖基准类型：FrontierMath、TerminalBench、Humanity's Last Exam这类高难度基准在远高于默认预算的区间仍然保持性能稳定上涨，部分基准边际收益较弱；2. 代际更新的新模型通常在高推理预算下优势更明显，低预算评测会系统性低估新模型将额外推理算力转化为性能的能力；3. 不存在通用最优的推理算力分配方式：重复提交在所有基准上都有稳定收益，正确性反馈在有明确对错判定、支持迭代搜索的任务（HLE、SWE-Bench Pro）上收益最大，并行缩放在无状态独立问答基准（HealthBench、HLE）上效果最好，在有持久环境状态的交互基准上效果最弱；4. 没有配套上下文管理的长轨迹会导致性能下降，仅靠堆砌token数无法获得全部缩放收益。
summary.reading_guide: 模型评估、scaling law方向的必读材料。重点关注：1. 引言部分对固定预算单分数评测缺陷的论证逻辑；2. 串行/并行推理缩放的区分，以及任务属性与最优分配方式的对应关系；3. 不同基准的性能-算力曲线形态差异，以及背后的任务属性原因；4. 结论部分给出的三条评测规范建议。建议搭配UK AISI、Epoch AI同主题推理scaling报告对照阅读，核心要理解"固定预算分数无法代表模型可达能力前沿"这一判断的实证基础。预计精读时间40分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自牛津大学人类未来研究所、OpenAI、DeepMind、UK AI Security Institute、Epoch AI等机构，包含Toby Ord、Yoshua Bengio等长期从事AI能力评估与scaling研究的资深研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Current frontier LLM evaluations almost universally report scores under a single restrictive inference compute budget (single submission, limited token allowance, no iteration budget), which cannot distinguish between cases where a model lacks a capability entirely, and cases where the model has the capability but insufficient test-time compute to elicit it. Systematic characterization of cross-model differences in inference compute conversion efficiency, and the performance impact of different compute allocation strategies, remains largely missing from standard evaluation practice.
summary_en.importance: This work directly challenges the validity of the dominant single-score evaluation paradigm. It provides a critical measurement framework for pre-training and post-training capability assessment, cross-generation model comparison, and safety-relevant capability auditing: model capability is not a fixed scalar, but a function of invested inference compute. For pre-training research, the core implication is that a model's 'inference compute conversion efficiency' is a scaling dimension as important as training compute investment, and future scaling laws will need to explicitly model tradeoffs between training and inference compute allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. The authors build a unified controlled inference scaling experimental framework, testing up to 12 frontier models released between May 2025 and March 2026 across seven hard, long-horizon benchmarks spanning software engineering, mathematics, medicine, and cybersecurity. 2. They apply three simple, general, reproducible inference scaling interventions: increasing total token budgets to 1-3 orders of magnitude above published benchmark defaults, adding context compaction to mitigate long-context forgetting, and allowing unlimited submission attempts with optional minimal correctness feedback. 3. They explicitly distinguish two inference compute allocation strategies: serial scaling (deepening reasoning on a single trajectory) and parallel scaling (sampling multiple shallow trajectories and selecting the best result), and measure task-specific response to each strategy.
summary_en.experiments: 1. Inference scaling gains are highly benchmark-dependent: hard benchmarks including FrontierMath, TerminalBench, and Humanity's Last Exam continue to show steady performance gains far above default token budgets, while other benchmarks show weaker marginal returns. 2. Newer model generations consistently achieve larger advantages at high inference budgets, meaning low-budget evaluations systematically under-measure newer models' ability to convert extra compute to performance. 3. No universal inference allocation strategy is optimal across tasks: repeated submissions deliver consistent gains across all benchmarks, correctness feedback delivers the largest gains on tasks with clear verifiers that support iterative search (HLE, SWE-Bench Pro), and parallel scaling performs best on stateless, non-interactive QA benchmarks (HealthBench, HLE) and weakest on interactive benchmarks with persistent environment state. 4. Longer trajectories without proper context management cause performance degradation, so raw token budget increases alone cannot deliver full scaling gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is required reading for researchers working on LLM evaluation and scaling laws. Focus on: 1. The core argument against fixed-budget single-score evaluation in the introduction; 2. The distinction between serial and parallel inference scaling, and how task properties predict optimal allocation strategy; 3. The shape of performance-compute curves across different benchmarks and the underlying task characteristics driving differences; 4. The three concrete recommendations for future evaluation design in the conclusion. Pair reading with related inference scaling reports from UK AISI and Epoch AI for full context, focusing on the empirical basis for the claim that fixed-budget scores cannot represent a model's reachable capability frontier. Expected close reading time: 40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: The author team includes researchers from the Future of Humanity Institute (University of Oxford), OpenAI, DeepMind, UK AI Security Institute, and Epoch AI, with contributors including Toby Ord and Yoshua Bengio, senior researchers with longstanding work on AI capability measurement and scaling.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻对内部评测复查 token budget 和重试策略；单点预算分数已经不能干净代表模型能力。
recommendation.en: Recheck internal evals for token budgets and retry policy; single-budget scores no longer cleanly measure model capability.

paper.title: Beyond Parallel Sampling: Diverse Query Initialization for Agentic Search
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling for agentic search typically increases depth (i.e., more turns and tokens per trajectory) or breadth (i.e., more parallel rollouts). Here we focus on breadth scaling, showing that standard parallel sampling yields diminishing returns, tracing this to query redundancy at the first turn. When models issue similar first queries across rollouts, the threads retrieve overlapping evidence, and subsequent turns are conditioned on this shared retrieval. We address this limitation with

summary.core_problem: Agentic搜索中广度缩放（并行采样）的收益递减问题，根源是多轨迹首轮查询冗余导致证据重叠。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出训练无关的首轮干预策略DivInit，在不增加计算量的条件下提升多跳QA性能。
summary.technical_approach: 单次调用生成n个候选查询，用多样性选择（k < n）得到差异种子后并行展开，避免独立采样导致的查询冗余。
summary.experiments: 5个开源模型，8个benchmark，多跳QA在相同计算量下平均提升5-7个百分点。
summary.authors_note: 团队包括CMU的Chenyan Xiong等研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: Diminishing returns in breadth scaling for agentic search, caused by first-turn query redundancy leading to overlapping evidence across parallel rollouts.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: proposes DivInit, a training-free first-turn intervention that improves multi-hop QA at matched compute.
summary_en.technical_approach: Generates n candidate queries in a single call, selects k diverse seeds (k < n), and runs them as parallel trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: 5 open-weight models, 8 benchmarks, average gains of 5-7 points on multi-hop QA at matched compute.
summary_en.authors_note: Team includes Chenyan Xiong (CMU) and other researchers.

recommendation.zh: Test-time scaling的具体工程insight：首轮查询多样性是并行采样收益的瓶颈，对agent serving有参考价值，pretrain研究员看abstract即可。
recommendation.en: Concrete engineering insight for test-time scaling: first-turn query diversity is the bottleneck for parallel sampling gains. Useful for agent serving; pretrain researchers can read just the abstract.

paper.title: Multi-Turn Reflective Masking Elicits Reasoning in Mask Diffusion Models
paper.abstract: While reasoning on autoregressive (AR) models is often performed by chain-of-thought reasoning and reflection, their refinement of previous outputs still relies on fully sequential generation, even when only local edits are needed. In contrast, the masking mechanism in Mask Diffusion Models (MDMs) naturally supports explicit local edits on previous outputs, allowing selective refinement without discarding previous answers and generating another from scratch. While this property more closely alig

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 mask diffusion language/model family 里一个很核心但一直没被真正打开的能力缺口：模型虽然天生支持 masked token 的并行重采样，但现有解码基本还是单轮、被动、吸收式的，一旦某个 token 被“确认”，后面很难主动回头改。这样它并没有把 diffusion 范式相对 AR 的潜在优势用出来。作者要做的不是再造一个更强的 denoiser，而是让 MDM 学会在生成过程中自己判断哪里不可靠、哪里值得重遮盖，再做多轮局部修正，把 reasoning 从“向前续写”改成“对当前状态反复修订”。
summary.importance: 对新型语言建模范式研究，这篇属于应当认真看的工作。原因有三点。第一，它抓住了 MDM 与 AR 最本质的机制差异：AR 的 test-time scaling 主要靠延长推理轨迹和重生成，MDM 则有机会把额外算力投到局部修正上。第二，它不是只在 decoding 上做启发式 remask，而是通过轻量 post-training 把 reflective masking 训练成模型内生能力，这对 diffusion LM 是否能形成独立 reasoning 路线很关键。第三，它提出的 History Reference 给了一个很实用的方向：MDM 缺少 AR 那种天然的“历史上下文串联”，于是需要显式保留去噪轨迹中的中间状态，给后续修正提供时间维度上的记忆。对 pretrain 研究员来说，这篇的意义不在于它已经给出最终答案，而在于它把“mask-based model 的 reasoning 应该如何定义和训练”讲清楚了。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上有两个主件。第一是 Reflective Masking。作者把每个位置、每个 denoising step 的动作定义成三选一：保留当前 token、把当前 token 重新 mask 掉等待重预测、或者对当前 mask 位置生成新 token。关键不是固定 remask 比例，而是根据模型当前的不确定性做逐位置决策，让模型能主动推翻先前已经 denoise 的内容。这样生成过程从单调收敛变成可逆的局部修订过程。第二是 History Reference。它不引入额外可学习参数，而是把先前若干步的中间预测状态聚合成 history-aware embedding，让模型在当前 step 不只看“现在的部分序列”，还看“这个位置之前被预测成过什么、改过几次、稳定不稳定”。这相当于给 MDM 补上一条 AR 模型天然拥有、但 diffusion 解码里通常缺失的时间记忆通道。

训练部分是全文最值得细看的地方。作者强调不能只靠推理时加规则，因为模型原本并没有学过多轮自发修订。于是他们设计了轻量 post-training，把 reflective masking 作为中心能力来训，并配套一个数据构造流程，生成与模型原生输出分布更对齐的训练样本。这里的关键取舍是：如果直接用人工构造错误或离分布 corruption，模型学到的可能只是修补特定噪声；作者更希望它学会在自身生成轨迹里识别不可靠 token 并修正，因此训练信号要贴近模型真实会犯的错。这个思路和很多 post-train reasoning 工作里“用模型自己的 rollout 造纠错数据”是同一脉络，但在 MDM 上更自然，因为 mask/re-mask 本来就是原生操作。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖图像编辑、Sudoku、文本生成三类任务，目的是证明这不是某个单一模态或强监督场景下的技巧。全文给出的主结论很稳定：Reflective Masking 在不同任务上都优于不具备多轮反思修订能力的基线 MDM；当任务需要模型自主探索、自己发现哪里错了时，History Reference 的增益更明显。图像编辑场景里，因为指令同时给了修改位置和修改目标，RM 主要体现为更稳定的局部编辑和更少的无关区域破坏；Sudoku 里，它体现为能反复定位冲突格并局部修正，而不是整盘重来；文本生成里，由于监督最弱、没有直接提示最终答案，RM 更能体现“通过迭代修订逼近正确输出”的能力。摘要和正文片段没有给出足够完整的数值表，因此不宜编造具体提升幅度；但从作者组织实验的方式看，重点不只是最终分数，而是证明 RM 带来的 test-time scaling 是一种不同于 AR CoT 的计算分配方式：额外步数主要用于 selective revision，而不是线性扩展输出长度。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇建议精读。先看 Introduction，抓住作者的核心立场：MDM 的 reasoning 优势不该理解为并行生成更快，而该理解为可以对中间状态做显式局部修订。然后直接读第 3 节 Reflective Masking，重点看三部分：逐位置 keep/re-mask/reveal 决策规则、History Reference 的构造方式、训练目标与训练样本如何生成。这里决定了方法是不是一个临时 decoding trick，还是一个可迁移的能力激活方案。接着看实验部分时，不要只盯最终指标，更要看不同任务中 RM 起作用的机制是否一致：是靠修正低置信 token，还是靠利用历史轨迹避免重复犯错。若时间有限，优先看方法图、算法描述、Sudoku 和文本任务结果，因为这两类最能体现 reasoning 与 self-correction。值得深挖的点有三个：一，反射式重遮盖是否能在更大语言模型上形成稳定 scaling；二，History Reference 能否与外部 memory 或 verifier 结合；三，这种 post-training 能力是否应前移到 pretraining，让 MDM 从一开始就学会可逆生成和局部修订。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a central limitation of mask diffusion models: although they can resample masked positions in parallel, standard decoding is still largely one-pass and absorbing. Once a token is confidently denoised, it is effectively fixed, so the model cannot actively revisit earlier commitments. This prevents MDMs from exploiting their main structural advantage over autoregressive models. The paper’s goal is to turn generation from monotonic forward completion into iterative state refinement, where the model can decide which parts of its current output are unreliable and should be re-masked and revised.
summary_en.importance: For researchers interested in alternative language-modeling paradigms, this is one of the more meaningful directions. It matters for three reasons. First, it identifies a genuine mechanism-level distinction between AR and mask-based generation: AR test-time scaling mostly spends extra compute on longer trajectories or regeneration, whereas MDMs could spend it on local revision. Second, the paper does not stop at heuristic remasking during inference; it uses lightweight post-training to make reflective masking an internalized capability. That is important if diffusion-style LMs are to develop a reasoning path that is not just an imitation of AR CoT. Third, the proposed History Reference addresses a real weakness of MDMs: unlike AR models, they do not naturally carry an explicit temporal trace of prior intermediate generations, so revision can become myopic without some form of trajectory memory.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two main components. The first is Reflective Masking (RM). At each denoising step and for each position, the model chooses among three actions: keep the current token, re-mask the current token for future resampling, or reveal a token if the position is currently masked. The key idea is that remasking is no longer a fixed heuristic based only on low confidence in still-masked positions; already denoised tokens can be actively reconsidered. This makes the denoising process partially reversible and turns generation into iterative local correction.

The second component is History Reference (HR), a parameter-free mechanism that aggregates intermediate decoding states into a history-aware representation. Instead of conditioning only on the current partially denoised sequence, the model also gets access to what each position looked like in previous steps and how stable those predictions were. This gives MDMs a temporal memory channel that AR models get implicitly through sequential context accumulation.

The training recipe is the most important part of the paper. The authors argue that inference-time rules alone are insufficient because existing MDMs were never trained for self-initiated multi-turn revision. They therefore introduce lightweight post-training centered on reflective masking, together with a data-generation pipeline designed to stay close to the model’s native output distribution. This is a good design choice: if training examples are built from artificial off-distribution corruptions, the model may only learn to repair synthetic noise rather than revise its own realistic mistakes. The paper instead tries to teach the model to detect and correct unreliable predictions arising from its own denoising dynamics.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans image editing, Sudoku, and text generation, which is a sensible way to test whether the method is tied to one modality or one supervision regime. The main result is consistent: RM improves over baseline MDM decoding across all three settings, and HR is especially helpful when the task requires autonomous exploration rather than explicit guidance. In image editing, where instructions specify both what and where to modify, RM mainly improves localized edits and reduces unnecessary changes elsewhere. In Sudoku, the benefit is clearer as iterative conflict detection and local correction. In text generation, where supervision is weakest and the final answer is not directly hinted, RM better exposes the intended reasoning behavior: progressively refining a partially wrong state rather than restarting from scratch. The provided excerpt does not include enough complete tables to quote reliable numeric gains, so the safe takeaway is qualitative but still important: the paper demonstrates a distinct form of test-time scaling for MDMs, where extra compute is spent on selective revision instead of forward token expansion.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one is worth a careful read. Start with the introduction to understand the paper’s framing: the advantage of MDMs is not merely parallel generation speed, but explicit revisability of intermediate states. Then go straight to the Reflective Masking section and read three pieces closely: the per-position keep/re-mask/reveal decision rule, the construction of History Reference, and the post-training objective plus data pipeline. Those sections determine whether the method is just a decoding trick or a transferable capability-enabling recipe. In the experiments, do not only look at final metrics; check whether the mechanism is consistent across tasks. Sudoku and text generation are especially informative because they expose self-correction more directly than image editing. The deeper questions to keep in mind are whether reflective remasking scales to larger language models, whether HR can be combined with external memory or verifiers, and whether this capability should eventually be moved earlier into pretraining rather than added only in post-training.

recommendation.zh: 应读方法和消融：它把 MDM 的“可局部改写”变成推理时计算，若成立会改变非 AR LM 的后训练设计。
recommendation.en: Read the method and ablations: it turns MDM local rewriting into inference-time compute, which would change how non-AR LMs are post-trained if it holds up.

paper.title: Are Online Skill and Memory Modules Always Worth Their Tokens? A Budget-Constrained Study of Web Agents
paper.abstract: Online web agents often augment a base actor with memory, workflow, or skill modules. These modules can improve performance, but they also consume test-time tokens, a cost rarely reported alongside the actor's inference cost. We study online augmentation, where this overhead is paid on every task, and re-evaluate its benefits under a fixed total inference budget. We compare AWM, ASI, and ReasoningBank with a token-matched vanilla baseline that uses the same budget for additional actor steps. Acr

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是如何再给 web agent 叠一个模块，而是一个更基础的问题：在固定测试时推理预算下，在线 memory / workflow / skill 模块到底值不值它们消耗的 token。很多在线 agent 方法把 actor 之外的开销当成“额外能力”而不是“预算占用”，只报告主 actor 的步数或成功率，却不把技能归纳、记忆检索、工作流注入、验证控制这些辅助调用的 token 一并计入。作者把问题重新表述为预算分配：同样的总 token，是拿去做在线技能/记忆机制，还是直接给 vanilla actor 更多 observe-act 轮次。这个问题对 agent 评测很关键，因为在线模块的收益依赖任务顺序、历史轨迹质量和模块调用频率，而这些都可能让看似更复杂的系统在真实预算约束下并不划算。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练方法论文，但有两点启发很直接。第一，它提醒人们在评估“外部脚手架是否提升模型能力”时，必须把总推理成本算清楚；否则容易把额外 token 换来的收益误判成方法优势。这个判断对 test-time scaling、tool-augmented inference、memory-augmented decoding 乃至 post-train agent scaffold 都成立。第二，它指出单次 aggregate success rate 对在线 agent 很不稳，任务级方差和运行顺序会显著影响结论。这对任何把 test-time adaptation 当作能力来源的方法都有参考意义：如果收益主要来自额外预算和顺序偶然性，而不是更好的 credit assignment 或知识复用机制，那么方法价值需要重估。贡献类型更接近 evaluation protocol correction，而不是新算法。
summary.technical_approach:
方法设计很朴素，但切中问题。作者选了三类已有在线增强方法：AWM（在线 workflow memory）、ASI（在线 skill induction）和 ReasoningBank（在线推理/经验库）。这三类方法都保留默认 actor horizon，最多 10 步，同时在每个任务或跨任务过程中额外消耗 token 去做工作流抽取、技能归纳、记忆检索、经验注入等操作。对照组 Vanilla-IB 不引入任何辅助模块，只把同等预算重新分配给更长的 actor interaction horizon。关键点不在于提出新 scaffold，而在于把 baseline 改成 budget-matched control：增强方法花在模块上的 token，vanilla baseline 则花在更多页面观察、状态推理和动作尝试上。

实验设置强调在线性。任务按顺序处理，后续任务只能利用前面任务积累的模块知识，不能离线预先构建完整技能库。这一点很重要，因为在线模块的收益上限受任务排列和可复用模式密度约束，也限制了并行化。作者因此把问题限定在 deployment-like online setting，而不是离线蒸馏好技能后再评测的 setting。

论文的核心技术贡献不是模块内部机制分析，而是评测口径的重构：
1. 统一统计 total token usage，而不是只看 actor token；
2. 用同预算 vanilla baseline 作为必要对照；
3. 报告 multi-run variance，而不是依赖单次运行的 aggregate success rate。
这三个点合起来，实际上是在挑战一类常见实验叙事：复杂 agent scaffold 的收益，可能只是预算不对齐下的表面优势。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 WebArena 和 WorkArena-L1。WebArena 部分最完整，包含 3 个站点域：Shopping（187 个任务）、Reddit（106 个任务）、Admin（182 个任务），以及 3 个底座模型：Gemini 3 Flash、GPT-5.4-mini、Qwen 3.6-27B。比较对象是 AWM、ASI、ReasoningBank 和 Vanilla-IB。文中给出的总体结论很明确：在 WebArena 上，Vanilla-IB 在三种模型上的 aggregate success rate 都达到最高，且多数情况下总 token 还低于三种在线增强方法。也就是说，把预算直接给 actor 更多交互步，整体上比把预算分给在线技能/记忆模块更划算。

WorkArena-L1 用 Qwen 3.6-27B 做同样比较，任务数 33，覆盖 ServiceNow 场景下的 dashboard、form、knowledge-base search、list filtering/sorting、menu navigation、service-catalog request 等企业知识工作流程。这里作者没有声称 Vanilla-IB 全面领先，而是说它与最优增强方法保持竞争力，说明“预算匹配后复杂模块未必占优”并不是 WebArena 特有现象。

另一个重要实验观察是方差。作者指出单次运行的 aggregate success rate 会掩盖显著的 task-level variance；在线模块因为依赖历史任务积累，任务顺序和随机性会放大波动，所以单 run 比较不足以支持稳定结论。虽然给定内容里没有完整表格数字，但从正文结论看，方差分析是论文的重要补充证据，而不是附带现象。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点不是学一个新 agent 算法，而是看作者如何把评测问题拆开。建议先看 Introduction，尤其是 Figure 1 附近关于 token allocation tradeoff 的论证，那里把问题讲得最清楚。然后看 Experimental Settings，确认四种 agent scaffold 的预算口径是否真正对齐，尤其要分清“默认 10-step actor + 辅助模块”与“无模块但更长 horizon”的差别。结果部分重点看两类内容：一是 WebArena aggregate result，二是 multi-run variance 分析。如果时间有限，优先读结论支撑 strongest claim 的图表，不必深究 AWM/ASI/ReasoningBank 的内部实现细节，因为论文的主要信息不在那里。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。读的时候要带着一个问题：如果把这套预算核算方式迁移到 tool use、test-time search、memory-augmented reasoning、甚至长 CoT 采样，哪些已有结论会改变。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a simple but under-reported question in online web agents: under a fixed inference budget, are memory / workflow / skill modules actually worth the tokens they consume? Prior agent papers often report success gains from auxiliary modules without fully accounting for the extra token cost of inducing skills, retrieving memories, injecting workflows, or running controller prompts. The authors recast the issue as a budget allocation problem: if the same total token budget were instead spent on additional observe-act steps by a plain actor, would the gains from online augmentation still hold? This matters because online modules are paid for on every task, depend on task order, and may trade away direct environment interaction for auxiliary processing.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research in two ways. First, it is a clean reminder that any claim about external scaffolding improving model capability must be normalized by total inference cost, not just actor-side cost. That lesson transfers to test-time scaling, tool-augmented reasoning, memory-augmented inference, and many post-training agent recipes. Second, the paper shows that single-run aggregate success can be misleading in online settings because task order and stochasticity materially affect outcomes. For researchers studying adaptation at inference time, the paper is useful as an evaluation correction: some apparent gains may come from extra budget and favorable sequencing rather than better reuse mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is intentionally minimal. The authors compare three existing online augmentation methods—AWM, ASI, and ReasoningBank—against a budget-matched vanilla baseline called Vanilla-IB. The augmented agents keep the default actor horizon of up to 10 steps, while spending additional tokens on workflow induction, skill extraction, memory retrieval, reasoning-bank updates, and related control logic. Vanilla-IB removes all auxiliary modules and reallocates the same overall budget to a longer actor interaction horizon.

That design choice is the core contribution. The paper does not propose a new agent architecture; it proposes a stricter control condition. Instead of comparing “augmented agent vs plain actor with a smaller budget,” it compares “augmented agent vs plain actor with the same total token budget.” The study is explicitly online: tasks are processed sequentially, and any reusable knowledge must be accumulated from earlier evaluation trajectories rather than built offline in advance. This makes the trade-off sharper, because online augmentation is sensitive to task order and cannot amortize its cost over a precompiled skill library.

The paper’s methodological contribution is therefore an evaluation protocol with three requirements: report total token usage across all modules, compare methods under matched budgets, and report multi-run variance rather than relying on a single aggregate score.
summary_en.experiments:
The main benchmark is WebArena, evaluated on three domains: Shopping (187 tasks), Reddit (106 tasks), and Admin (182 tasks). The study uses three base models: Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-5.4-mini, and Qwen 3.6-27B. Across these settings, the headline result is consistent: Vanilla-IB achieves the best aggregate success rate overall while often using fewer total tokens than AWM, ASI, and ReasoningBank. In other words, once auxiliary token overhead is counted, spending the budget on more direct interaction is usually better than spending it on online memory or skill machinery.

The authors also test the same question on WorkArena-L1, a 33-task ServiceNow benchmark covering enterprise workflows such as dashboards, forms, knowledge-base search, filtering, sorting, menu navigation, and service-catalog requests. With Qwen 3.6-27B, Vanilla-IB remains competitive with the best augmented methods, suggesting the budget-matching issue is not specific to consumer-style websites.

A second important result concerns variance. The paper argues that single-run success rates hide substantial task-level variability, especially in online settings where later performance depends on earlier trajectories. While the provided text does not include the full numeric tables, the qualitative conclusion is clear: single-run aggregate comparisons are too weak to support strong claims about online augmentation.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this as an evaluation paper, not as a new agent-method paper. Start with the introduction and the token-allocation framing around Figure 1; that is where the paper makes its strongest point. Then check the experimental setup carefully to verify what is and is not budget-matched, especially the distinction between a 10-step actor plus auxiliary modules and a longer-horizon vanilla actor. In the results, focus on two things: the aggregate WebArena comparison and the multi-run variance analysis. Those are the parts that support the paper’s main claims.

A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most readers. The useful follow-up question is broader: if the same accounting were applied to tool use, search-based inference, memory-augmented reasoning, or long-chain test-time scaling, how many published gains would shrink or disappear?

recommendation.zh: 这篇不教你造新 agent，但会提醒你别再拿“外挂模块免费”做实验；只看预算对齐设置和主表就够，很多 test-time scaling 结论会被它重算一遍。
recommendation.en: It won’t teach you a new agent, but it does kill the habit of treating auxiliary modules as free; read the budget-matching setup and main table, then revisit your test-time scaling claims.
