paper.title: Temporal Backtracking Search for Test-time Generative Video Reasoning
paper.abstract: While test-time scaling has revolutionized reasoning in large language models, generative video reasoning remains bottlenecked by a single-shot paradigm. We demonstrate that searching over denoising steps cannot rescue logically flawed rollouts because spatial trajectories commit early in the diffusion process. Root-level Best-of-N (BoN) sampling is similarly inefficient: reasoning errors cluster early in the temporal axis, and resampling blindly discards verified upstream progress. To unlock ef

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的是生成式视频模型在长程推理任务中的测试时扩展问题：如果视频 rollout 早期走错，继续在去噪步骤上加计算，或者从根节点反复 Best-of-N 采样，都很难高效修正逻辑错误。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不高，但对“视频模型作为世界模型”的推理接口有启发。论文把测试时计算从扩散去噪轴转移到时间轴，说明视频生成中的推理错误更像序列决策错误，而不是单纯的视觉质量或 prompt alignment 问题。这个观察对跨模态生成模型、world model、以及未来把视频 rollout 接入 agent planning 的系统有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Temporal Backtracking Search，简称 TBS。它不把一段视频当作不可分割的完整样本，而是维护一组已经验证过的时间前缀。模型先生成完整或部分 rollout， verifier 找到第一个逻辑失败帧，然后保留失败前的有效前缀，从该前缀重新生成后续视频。为此，模型需要 variable-K conditioning：可以从任意长度的干净前缀继续生成，并保留已有运动上下文。TBS 的三个关键组件是：前缀条件生成、过程级时间验证器、基于优先队列的前缀搜索。它和常规 BoN 的区别在于，BoN 每次失败都丢掉整个 rollout；TBS 只丢掉错误后缀，把计算集中在未解决的未来部分。
summary.experiments: 论文在三类设置中验证方法：符号 grid-world，用精确规则验证；连续导航，用学习得到的轨迹预测器做有噪声验证；机器人操作，用 simulator replay 做物理验证。主要结论是，在相同测试时预算下，TBS 相比根节点 BoN 有更好的成功率和计算效率。一个关键数字是，在严格 OOD 设置中，BoN 的 exact match 只有 0.7%，TBS 达到 22.7%，且所有成功样例都来自 restart 后的 child branch。论文还用中间 latent 解码说明，高层空间轨迹在扩散早期已经基本确定，因此沿 denoising step 搜索很难修复早期逻辑错误。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中两个 empirical bottleneck：早期轨迹承诺和错误在时间轴早段聚集。然后看 Section 3.1 的 conditional reuse gap，它解释了为什么修复后缀比从头生成更容易。Section 3.2–3.3 是方法核心，重点关注 variable-K conditioning 如何支持任意前缀续写。实验部分建议看 OOD 结果、matched-budget BoN 对比，以及不同 verifier 假设下的表现。需要留意的是，这篇工作的收益依赖可用的过程验证器；如果 verifier 很弱或无法定位 first failure frame，TBS 的优势会下降。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses test-time scaling for generative video reasoning. The key issue is that once a generated video takes a wrong early trajectory, adding compute along the denoising axis or resampling whole videos with Best-of-N is an inefficient way to repair the logical error.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core LLM pretraining contribution, but it is useful for researchers thinking about video models as world models. It reframes video test-time scaling as temporal search over partially verified rollouts, rather than refinement over diffusion steps. This matters for multimodal agents that use generated videos for planning, where trajectory correctness is more important than visual fidelity.
summary_en.technical_approach: Temporal Backtracking Search turns video generation into a generate–verify–restart loop. A rollout is checked by a process verifier, which identifies the first failing frame. The valid prefix before that frame is kept as a restart anchor, and the model regenerates only the suffix. The method relies on variable-K conditioning, a training setup that lets the diffusion model resume generation from clean prefixes of arbitrary temporal length while preserving motion context. Compared with root-level Best-of-N, TBS avoids throwing away correct early progress and reallocates inference budget to unresolved suffixes.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers symbolic grid-worlds with exact verification, continuous navigation with learned noisy trajectory verification, and robotic manipulation with simulator-replay verification. Under matched inference budgets, TBS consistently improves the success–compute tradeoff over root-level Best-of-N. The most informative result is the strict OOD case: Best-of-N reaches only 0.7% exact match, while TBS reaches 22.7%, and all solved cases come from restarted child branches. The paper also reports that high-level spatial trajectories are committed in the earliest denoising steps, which explains why denoising-step search is poorly matched to logical repair.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the empirical observations in the introduction and Figure 1, since they motivate the shift from denoising-step search to temporal search. Then read Sections 3.1–3.3 for the conditional reuse gap, the search algorithm, and variable-K conditioning. In the experiments, focus on the OOD setting, the matched-budget comparison with Best-of-N, and the sensitivity to different verifier types. The main caveat is verifier dependence: the method is strongest when failures can be localized reliably in time.

recommendation.zh: 结论对视频 test-time scaling 有启发，但和文本 LLM 距离较远；只看 Fig 中 search space 对比和重启机制即可。
recommendation.en: Useful framing for inference-time search in video diffusion, but far from text LLM pretraining; focus on the search-space comparison and restart mechanism figures.

paper.title: MaxProof: Scaling Mathematical Proof with Generative-Verifier RL and Population-Level Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: We present MaxProof, a population-level test-time scaling framework for competition-level mathematical proof in the MiniMax-M3 series. M3 first trains three proof-oriented capabilities -- proof generation, proof verification, and critique-conditioned proof repair -- using a defense-in-depth generative verifier engineered for low false-positive rate. These capabilities are merged into a single released M3 model. At test time, MaxProof treats the model as a generator, verifier, refiner, and ranker

summary.core_problem: 在竞赛级数学证明中，如何把模型的生成、验证、批改和修复能力组织成可扩展的 test-time search，而不是依赖单次证明生成。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练能力构建与 test-time scaling 系统创新；关键点不是单一 benchmark 分数，而是把低误报验证器、proof repair、候选群体搜索和 tournament selection 组合成可放大推理计算的证明框架。
summary.technical_approach: MaxProof 基于 MiniMax-M3 系列训练三个面向证明的能力：证明生成、证明验证、以及 critique-conditioned proof repair。训练中使用 defense-in-depth generative verifier，目标是压低 false positive。推理时，同一个 M3 模型被用作 generator、verifier、refiner 和 ranker，在候选证明群体上搜索、修复、比较，并通过 tournament selection 产出最终证明。
summary.experiments: 论文报告 M3 + MaxProof 在 IMO 2025 达到 35/42，在 USAMO 2026 达到 36/42，均超过对应人类金牌线。摘要未给出参数量、训练 token 数、候选规模、搜索预算和 baseline 细节，需要读正文确认 compute-normalized 增益和 verifier 误报率测量方式。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 MiniMax、香港中文大学、复旦大学、北京大学、清华大学等机构；该工作属于 MiniMax-M3 系列的数学证明能力扩展。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to scale competition-level mathematical proof by organizing generation, verification, critique, and repair at test time rather than relying on one-shot proof generation.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training and test-time scaling system for formal-style mathematical reasoning. The notable part is the composition of low-false-positive generative verification, critique-conditioned repair, population search, and tournament selection into a scalable proof pipeline.
summary_en.technical_approach: MaxProof builds on the MiniMax-M3 series and trains three proof-oriented capabilities: proof generation, proof verification, and critique-conditioned proof repair. Training uses a defense-in-depth generative verifier engineered for low false-positive rates. At inference time, the same M3 model acts as generator, verifier, refiner, and ranker over a population of candidate proofs, then selects a final proof through tournament selection.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports 35/42 on IMO 2025 and 36/42 on USAMO 2026 with M3 plus MaxProof, above the human gold-medal threshold on both contests. The abstract does not provide model size, token budget, search budget, or baseline details, so the compute-normalized gain and verifier calibration need to be checked in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with MiniMax, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Fudan University, Peking University, Tsinghua University, and others. The work is part of the MiniMax-M3 mathematical proof line.

recommendation.zh: 必须看 verifier 误报控制和 tournament search；若正文 compute 账干净，应立刻复现实验到内部数学 RL pipeline。
recommendation.en: Read the verifier false-positive controls and tournament search; if the compute accounting is clean, reproduce this in an internal math-RL pipeline.

paper.title: MARS: Margin-Adversarial Risk-controlled Stopping for Parallel LLM Test-time Scaling
paper.abstract: Parallel test-time scaling samples many reasoning traces and majority-votes their answers, improving LLM accuracy but requiring traces to run to completion, incurring substantial computational overhead. We observe that probing partial traces at intermediate checkpoints can extract current answers without disrupting generation, revealing an evolving aggregate vote. Based on this observation, we introduce MARS, a margin-adversarial stopping rule that estimates which active traces are likely to cha

summary.core_problem: 降低 parallel test-time scaling 的计算浪费：多数投票采样通常要等所有 reasoning traces 完整生成，成本很高。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 test-time scaling 的计算分配方法。它没有改变模型训练，但直接处理推理时多样本投票的停止准则，对理解 inference-time compute 如何转化为准确率有价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 MARS，即 Margin-Adversarial Risk-controlled Stopping。方法在生成中间 checkpoint 探测 partial traces 的当前答案，维护动态投票边际；同时学习 trace-level switch probability，估计每条未完成轨迹改答案的概率。对于改答案后会落到哪里，方法使用由 warmup traces 校准的 adversarial bound，从而在保守风险控制下提前停止。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型、数据集、采样数或节省比例。可确认的是：在真实 switch probability 已知时，MARS 对 early-stopped answer 提供高概率保证；实际版本用 warmup traces 校准边界，目标是在不明显损害多数投票结果的情况下降低完整生成开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reduces wasted compute in parallel test-time scaling, where many reasoning traces are sampled and majority-voted only after all traces finish.
summary_en.importance: This is a compute-allocation method for inference-time scaling. It does not change pretraining, but it is directly relevant to how extra test-time compute should be spent and when additional samples stop being worth their cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method, MARS, is a Margin-Adversarial Risk-controlled Stopping rule. It probes partial traces at intermediate checkpoints to extract current answers, tracks the evolving vote margin, learns trace-level switch probabilities, and handles the unknown destination of switched answers with an adversarial bound calibrated from warmup traces.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, sampling budgets, or exact compute savings. It states that with true switch probabilities MARS gives a high-probability guarantee for the early-stopped answer, while the practical version uses warmup traces to calibrate conservative bounds and reduce the cost of full-trace majority voting.

recommendation.zh: 读 stopping rule 和风险界即可；它把 test-time scaling 从“多采样”推进到“何时停”的干净问题。
recommendation.en: Read the stopping rule and risk bound; it reframes test-time scaling from just sampling more traces to deciding when further compute is no longer justified.

paper.title: Token Complexity Theory for AI-Augmented Computing
paper.abstract: AI-augmented computing delegates natural language queries, code generation requests, and other open-ended tasks to a cluster of AI models that processes queries and generates responses. This paradigm introduces a resource dimension that neither classical time nor space complexity captures: the cost of sending queries to and receiving responses from such a cluster. We introduce token complexity, a formal resource measure defined as the minimum expected token cost to achieve a specified level of o

summary.core_problem: 如何形式化地衡量 AI 增强计算系统中，调用 AI 模型（如 LLM）所产生的资源消耗（Token 成本）？
summary.importance: 首次提出了“Token 复杂度（Token Complexity）”理论，将 Token 消耗作为一种独立于时间和空间复杂度的全新计算资源维度进行形式化定义，为分析和优化复合 AI 系统（如 Agent 集群）的成本-质量权衡提供了理论基础。
summary.technical_approach: 在 AI-Oracle 图灵机框架下发展了 Token 复杂度理论，其中概率图灵机通过专用的查询和响应纸带与随机预言机（代表 AI 模型）交互。定义 Token 复杂度为在特定任务上达到指定输出质量水平所需的最小预期 Token 成本，并证明了其单调性和凸性等基本定理。
summary.experiments: 纯理论工作，无实证实验。通过数学证明建立了 Token 复杂度的基本属性（单调性、凸性）。
summary.authors_note: 作者 Jie Wang，关注计算复杂性理论和 AI 系统的理论基础。

summary_en.core_problem: How to formally measure the resource consumption (Token cost) incurred by calling AI models (e.g., LLMs) in AI-augmented computing systems?
summary_en.importance: First proposes the theory of 'Token Complexity', formalizing Token consumption as a new computational resource dimension independent of time and space complexity, providing a theoretical foundation for analyzing and optimizing the cost-quality trade-off in compound AI systems (e.g., Agent clusters).
summary_en.technical_approach: Develops the Token complexity theory within the framework of AI-Oracle Turing machines, where a probabilistic Turing machine interacts with a stochastic oracle (representing AI models) via dedicated query and response tapes. Defines Token complexity as the minimum expected token cost to achieve a specified level of output quality on a task, and proves basic theorems such as monotonicity and convexity.
summary_en.experiments: Purely theoretical work, no empirical experiments. Establishes the basic properties (monotonicity, convexity) of Token complexity through mathematical proofs.
summary_en.authors_note: Author Jie Wang, focusing on computational complexity theory and theoretical foundations of AI systems.

recommendation.zh: 将 Token 消耗形式化为一种新的计算复杂度维度，对于研究 Test-time Scaling 和 Agent 系统的计算最优分配有理论启发，适合做理论分析的同学扫读。
recommendation.en: Formalizes Token consumption as a new dimension of computational complexity, providing theoretical inspiration for researching Test-time Scaling and compute-optimal allocation in Agent systems. Suitable for researchers doing theoretical analysis to skim.

paper.title: Reward Modeling for Multi-Agent Orchestration
paper.abstract: Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) built on Large Language Models (LLMs) require effective orchestration to coordinate specialized agents, yet training such orchestrators is hindered by limited supervision and high computational cost. We propose Orchestration Reward Modeling (OrchRM), a self-supervised framework for evaluating orchestration quality without human annotations. OrchRM leverages intermediate artifacts from multi-agent executions to construct win-lose pairs for Bradley-Terry reward model trai

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 多智能体系统中 orchestrator 缺少监督、训练和 test-time scaling 需要大量子智能体 rollout 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 训练信号与系统方法创新。它把多智能体执行过程中的中间产物转成偏好对，用于训练 orchestration reward model，从而降低多智能体编排训练和搜索的 token 成本。对预训练研究员的价值主要在于 reward 信号构造和 test-time compute 分配，而不是模型基座训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OrchRM，自监督构造 orchestration quality 的 win-lose pair，并用 Bradley-Terry 目标训练 reward model。关键点是不在每个候选编排上重复昂贵的子智能体 rollout，而是在 orchestration level 直接评分，再用于 reward-guided orchestrator training 和 MAS test-time scaling。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 token 使用量最高降低 10 倍，同时 MAS test-time scaling accuracy 最高提升 8%。收益跨多个领域迁移，包括数学推理等；摘要未给出底座模型、具体 benchmark、训练样本量和完整 baseline 列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the lack of supervision and high rollout cost when training orchestrators for LLM-based multi-agent systems.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent training-signal and system-method contribution. It converts intermediate artifacts from multi-agent executions into preference pairs for reward modeling, reducing the token cost of orchestrator training and test-time search. For pretraining researchers, the relevant part is reward-signal construction and test-time compute allocation, not base-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: OrchRM self-supervises win-lose pairs for orchestration quality and trains a Bradley-Terry reward model. The key design is to score at the orchestration level instead of repeatedly running expensive sub-agent rollouts, then use the reward model for reward-guided orchestrator training and MAS test-time scaling.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to 10x lower token usage and up to 8% accuracy improvement in MAS test-time scaling. Gains transfer across multiple domains including mathematical reasoning, but the abstract does not specify base models, benchmarks, training size, or the full baseline set.

recommendation.zh: 可读方法和消融；真正有用的是“中间产物造 reward”这条线，别把 +8% 当成通用 agent scaling 定律。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and ablations; the useful signal is artifact-derived reward modeling, not the +8% as a general law of agent scaling.

paper.title: AVIS: Adaptive Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Modern Vision-Language Models (VLMs) benefit from chain-of-thought prompting and test-time scaling, but these gains often come with prohibitive inference cost due to large visual contexts and long decoding chains. We view this cost through two coupled axes: Visual Context Scaling (VCS), which controls how much visual evidence is passed to the language model, and Visual Reasoning Scaling (VRS), which controls how much inference-time reasoning search is performed. Existing methods typically optimi

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM测试时计算优化仅单独处理视觉上下文缩放或推理搜索缩放，未在两个耦合维度上做逐样本自适应分配，导致精度损失或计算冗余。
summary.importance: 揭示了VLM推理中“视觉上下文质量”与“推理搜索深度”的耦合trade-off，这种测试时计算分配逻辑可反向指导预训练阶段的视觉token表示设计（如强化注意力key与信息冗余的关联），为多模态模型的预训练-推理协同设计提供了新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方案为两阶段自适应策略AVIS：一是视觉上下文缩放（VCS），用训练无关、O(N)复杂度的KDV剪枝，基于注意力key的多样性判断视觉token冗余度，prefill前剪枝以降低缓存与计算成本；二是视觉推理缩放（VRS），用轻量难度预测器给中等难度可解样本分配最多的CoT rollout（自一致性聚合结果），极端难易样本分配更少；结合共享prefill机制，剪枝后的KV缓存可在所有rollout间复用，将冗余视觉计算转移到有效推理搜索上。
summary.experiments: 以Qwen2.5-VL为主干，在图像/视频的数学推理、视觉推理、通用VQA等任务上评测，相比仅VCS/仅VRS基线，可在固定计算量下提升精度，或在同精度下降低FLOPs与延迟；共享prefill大幅降低并行推理搜索成本，消融实验验证了VCS-VRS trade-off曲面及与RL后训练模型的兼容性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看Introduction中“seeing（视觉上下文）-thinking（推理搜索）”两个计算维度的定义，再看Methodology中KDV剪枝与难度预测器的实现细节，最后查看实验中的FLOPs-精度trade-off曲线与延迟数据，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing test-time compute optimization for VLMs only handles visual context scaling or reasoning search scaling independently, without sample-wise adaptive allocation across the two coupled axes, resulting in either accuracy loss or redundant computation.
summary_en.importance: It uncovers the coupled trade-off between visual context quality and reasoning search depth in VLM inference. This test-time compute allocation logic can reversely guide visual token representation design during pretraining (e.g., strengthening the correlation between attention key diversity and information redundancy), providing insights for co-design of pretraining and inference pipelines for multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach: AVIS is a two-stage adaptive policy: 1) Visual Context Scaling (VCS): training-free, O(N) Key Diversity Visual (KDV) pruning measures visual token redundancy via attention key diversity, and prunes redundant tokens before prefill to reduce KV cache footprint and compute cost; 2) Visual Reasoning Scaling (VRS): a lightweight difficulty predictor allocates the largest number of CoT rollouts (aggregated via self-consistency and majority voting) to intermediate hard-but-solvable samples, with fewer rollouts assigned to extremely easy or hard samples. Combined with shared prefill, the pruned KV cache is reused across all rollouts, reallocating compute from redundant visual processing to effective reasoning search.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations use Qwen2.5-VL as the primary backbone, covering tasks including mathematical reasoning, visual reasoning, and general VQA on both images and videos. Compared with VCS-only and VRS-only baselines, the method improves accuracy under fixed compute budgets, or reduces FLOPs and latency under matched accuracy. Shared prefill drastically cuts the cost of parallel reasoning search. Ablations characterize the VCS-VRS trade-off surface and verify compatibility with RL post-trained models.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, first review the definition of the two compute axes ("seeing" for visual context, "thinking" for reasoning search) in Introduction, then check implementation details of KDV pruning and the difficulty predictor in Methodology, finally examine FLOPs-accuracy trade-off curves and latency data in Experiments. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 把“视觉token预算”和“推理采样预算”当成同一张账来算是对的；只需看 KDV pruning 规则和难度预测器是否真的稳、是否跨数据集泛化。
recommendation.en: The right framing is joint budgeting of visual tokens and reasoning rollouts; skim the KDV pruning rule and the difficulty predictor—if they don’t generalize, it’s just another brittle heuristic.

paper.title: DIRECT: When and Where Should You Allocate Test-Time Compute in Embodied Planners?
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed as high-level planners for embodied agents, with an emerging strategy of scaling test-time compute to improve capability. However, we observe that doing so increases latency, token usage, and FLOPs while yielding uneven, often diminishing gains in downstream success, limiting where embodied agents can be deployed. We argue that choosing when and where to spend test-time compute is central to bringing frontier performance to the real world.

summary.core_problem: 具身规划中，将测试时算力（CoT 深度、模型大小、记忆历史）统一开高会显著增加延迟和 token 开销，但成功率提升并不均匀、很多场景甚至边际收益为负；问题在于每个任务应分配多少算力、沿哪条轴分配，而不是固定使用最强配置。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启示是：test-time compute 不是单维杠杆，不同 compute axis 对应不同能力维度，且收益高度依赖任务分布。这里观察到的“大模型/thinking 模型在不少任务上并不优于小模型/非 thinking 模型”，与通用 LLM 推理中关于算力路由、预算分配、以及 post-train 后能力分布非单调的问题相通；也提醒做 planner/VLM 统一建模时，静态部署成本与能力边界需要被显式建模。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Direct（Dynamic Inference Router for Embodied Compute Tradeoffs），在一个固定的 planner 候选池上做逐任务路由。候选池沿三条轴变化：是否使用 thinking/更长 CoT、不同参数规模的 VLM（如 Qwen3-VL 2B 到 235B）、不同历史记忆策略（FrameSamp、TokenDrop、SimpleSG、GroundSG、MemER）。路由器根据多模态场景图像和指令输入，推断当前任务需要的是语义约束推理、更广技能覆盖、还是长历史依赖，再选择最划算的配置，而不是统一调用最强模型。设计动机来自一组诊断实验：三条 compute axis 的收益在任务间分布极不均匀，且没有单一配置 Pareto 占优。
summary.experiments: 在 VLABench、RoboMME 和 Franka DROID 真机上评估。诊断结果显示：Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct 与 Thinking 相比，在 44% 的任务上持平或更好，但 Thinking 延迟高很多，真机上慢 3.8 倍且总体成功率未必更高；模型从 2B 扩到 235B 时，分数和延迟都不单调，32B 因生成更长甚至比 235B 慢，大模型的优势主要集中在需要更宽技能覆盖的任务；记忆策略上，短历史任务中轻量 FrameSamp 比 MemER 更优，长历史依赖任务才反过来。Direct 在匹配最强模型性能的同时，报告最多降低 65% 延迟。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看第 3 节关于三条 scaling axis 的诊断图和第 4 节 router 设计，尤其关注 Fig. 2–4 中不同 compute 配置的非单调表现。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若更关心通用 LLM 的 test-time compute 路由，可跳过机器人系统细节，重点抽取“不同 compute 轴对应不同能力、且需要按任务选择”的经验事实。

summary_en.core_problem: In embodied VLM planners, uniformly scaling test-time compute—across CoT depth, model size, and memory history—substantially increases latency and token/FLOP cost, but downstream success gains are uneven and often diminishing; the real problem is deciding when and along which axis to allocate compute per task rather than always using the strongest planner.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance to pretrain research is that test-time compute is not a single axis: different compute levers map to different capability dimensions, and their returns are strongly task-dependent. The observation that larger or thinking models do not dominate smaller non-thinking models on a large fraction of tasks mirrors broader questions in LLM inference routing, budget allocation, and the non-monotonic capability profile produced by post-training. It is also a useful data point for unified multimodal planner modeling, where static deployment of one heavy model is rarely Pareto-optimal.
summary_en.technical_approach: Direct is a routing framework over a fixed pool of VLM planners. The pool varies along three axes: CoT depth (non-thinking vs thinking), model scale (e.g., Qwen3-VL from 2B to 235B), and memory-history strategy (FrameSamp, TokenDrop, SimpleSG, GroundSG, MemER). Given multimodal scene context and instruction, a lightweight router infers whether the task requires deeper reasoning over semantic/physical/spatial constraints, broader skill coverage from a larger model, or long-horizon memory, then selects the cheapest capable configuration. The design is motivated by diagnostic analyses showing that none of the compute axes gives uniform gains and no single planner dominates across task difficulties.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on VLABench, RoboMME, and Franka DROID hardware. Diagnostics show that Qwen3-VL 8B Instruct matches or outperforms the Thinking variant on 44% of tasks, while Thinking is 3.8× slower on hardware with no uniform success gain. Scaling from 2B to 235B yields non-monotonic score and latency; the 32B model can be slower than 235B because verbosity is not tied to parameter count, and gains are concentrated on tasks requiring broader command repertoires. For memory, lightweight FrameSamp outperforms MemER on short-recall tasks at much lower FLOPs, while MemER/GroundSG are better when distant history is needed. Direct is reported to match the strongest model at up to 65% lower latency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on Section 3 for the diagnostic analyses across the three compute axes and Section 4 for the router formulation; Figures 2–4 are the most information-dense parts. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes. Readers interested mainly in general LLM test-time compute can skip robot-specific system details and extract the empirical pattern that different compute levers serve different capability needs and should be selected conditionally.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain recipe，但会改你对 test-time scaling 的先验：算力轴不是可互换的，只看固定大模型/长CoT曲线会误判，重点读三条 scaling 轴的拆分实验。
recommendation.en: It won’t change your pretraining recipe, but it should update your prior on test-time scaling: compute axes are not interchangeable, and fixed big-model/long-CoT curves can be misleading—read the axis-wise ablations.

paper.title: KCSAT-ML: Probing Reasoning Models with Nationwide-Cohort Human Difficulty
paper.abstract: Math reasoning benchmarks have proliferated, yet most lack a per-item difficulty signal grounded in actual human performance. We introduce KCSAT-ML, a decade (2014-2025) of Korean College Scholastic Ability Test (KCSAT; Suneung) mathematics: 664 problems with a 339-item core set carrying official per-item error rates from nationwide cohorts of hundreds of thousands of examinees. We pair the benchmark with Difficulty-aligned Reasoning Gain (DRG): a score-orthogonal metric that asks whether a mode

summary.core_problem: 现有数学推理评测多数只有正确率，缺少由真实人类群体表现校准的逐题难度信号，难以判断模型错题是否符合人类难度结构。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个带全国考生错误率标注的数学推理评测集，以及一个与总正确率解耦的难度对齐指标。它把“模型是否真的学会推理”从单纯 accuracy 推到“错误分布是否像人类难度曲线”这一层，对 reasoning eval 和 test-time scaling 分析都有用。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 KCSAT-ML，覆盖 2014-2025 年韩国高考数学，共 664 题，其中 339 题带官方逐题错误率，来自数十万考生的全国 cohort。提出 Difficulty-aligned Reasoning Gain，衡量模型错误是否集中在人类也认为困难的题目上，而不是只看总体分数。评测对象包括多种 VLM，以及通过 OCR 输入的 LLM。
summary.experiments: 实验横跨多个 VLM 和 OCR+LLM 设置。摘要报告三类现象：低预算推理在高人类错误率题目上普遍崩溃；test-time scaling 的 token 使用量大致随人类错误率线性增加，但正确率收益呈非单调；同一模型家族内，TTS 在最难题上可能出现 anti-scaling，在较容易题上可能出现 overthinking。摘要未给出具体模型参数量和完整提升数字。

summary_en.core_problem: Most math reasoning benchmarks report aggregate accuracy but lack item-level difficulty grounded in real human performance, making it hard to tell whether model errors follow a meaningful difficulty structure.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a benchmark with nationwide human error rates and a difficulty-aligned metric decoupled from raw accuracy. It shifts reasoning evaluation from “how many items are solved” to “whether failures track human-calibrated difficulty,” which is directly useful for reasoning eval and test-time scaling analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces KCSAT-ML, covering Korean CSAT mathematics from 2014 to 2025 with 664 problems, including a 339-item core set with official per-item error rates from hundreds of thousands of examinees. It also proposes Difficulty-aligned Reasoning Gain, which measures whether model mistakes concentrate on human-hard rather than human-easy items. The evaluation spans multiple VLMs and LLMs using OCR.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover a wide range of VLMs and OCR-mediated LLM settings. The abstract reports three patterns: low-budget inference collapses on high-human-error items across model sizes; test-time scaling increases token usage roughly linearly with cohort error rate while accuracy gains are non-monotonic; within a model family, TTS can show anti-scaling on the hardest items and overthinking on easier ones. Exact model sizes and full numerical gains are not available in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 只看指标定义和 TTS 分桶结果；它会提醒你别把 reasoning accuracy 当成干净能力信号。
recommendation.en: Read the metric and TTS-by-difficulty buckets; it is a useful guardrail against treating reasoning accuracy as a clean capability signal.

paper.title: Decentralized Multi-Agent Systems with Shared Context
paper.abstract: Multi-agent systems (MAS) can scale large language model reasoning at test time by decomposing complex problems into parallel subtasks. However, most existing MAS rely on centralized orchestration, where a main agent assigns work, collects outputs, and merges results. As the number of subtasks grows, this controller becomes a communication and integration bottleneck. We propose Decentralized Language Models (DeLM), a MAS framework that decentralizes coordination through parallel agents, a shared

summary.core_problem: 现有多智能体系统大多采用中心化编排：主智能体负责拆任务、派任务、收结果、再分发。随着子任务数量增加，主智能体会成为通信与整合瓶颈，并且在转发过程中丢失或扭曲有用细节。问题在于如何把协调从单点控制器转移到共享问题状态，让多个智能体在没有中心路由的情况下并行推进。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发有限，但对测试时计算（test-time scaling）与长上下文推理的组织方式有参考价值。DeLM 展示了一种“共享验证上下文 + 任务队列”的协调层，这与未来把推理过程本身视为可并行化工作流的研究方向相关。若把多智能体协作看作一种外部推理机制，DeLM 的设计对理解如何让多次模型调用产生可累积、可验证的中间状态是有启发的。
summary.technical_approach: DeLM 的核心是把协调从 prompt 路由改为共享状态：并行智能体、共享验证上下文、任务队列。智能体异步从队列领取子任务，读取共享上下文中已累积的进展，做本地推理，然后把经过验证的紧凑更新写回共享上下文。与点对点通信不同，所有更新一旦被接纳就成为所有智能体可见的公共状态。为避免噪声累积，DeLM 在写入时做验证，并对长上下文做层次化摘要，使共享上下文保持紧凑且可信。这样，测试时扩展不再依赖主智能体串行合并与广播，长上下文推理也不必预先静态分配证据簇。
summary.experiments: 论文在三个场景验证：SWE-bench Verified 上的软件工程测试时扩展、LongBench-v2 上的长文档多文档 QA、以及 OOLONG 上的聚合型长上下文推理。主要结果：SWE-bench Verified 上 DeLM 达到 77.4% pass@4，单任务成本约 0.12 美元，约为基线的一半；LongBench-v2 上在四个前沿模型中取得最高平均准确率，相对最佳基线提升最多 5.7 个百分点；OOLONG 上纯 DeLM 不如需要精确行级聚合的 RLM，但把 RLM 与 DeLM 结合后得到最高准确率与最低成本，说明 DeLM 可作为代码介导推理系统的协调层。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先读 Introduction 与设计原则部分，理解中心化编排为何在并行度提高时失效；然后看 SWE-bench 与 LongBench-v2 两组实验，抓住共享验证上下文如何减少重复探索与信息丢失；最后看 OOLONG 实验，理解 DeLM 与代码介导推理（RLM）的互补关系。若只关心与预训练的连接，可重点看其对“多次调用如何形成可累积中间状态”的组织方式。预计阅读时间 45–60 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者与机构信息在提供内容中未明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing multi-agent systems use centralized orchestration: a main agent decomposes tasks, dispatches subtasks, collects outputs, and rebroadcasts merged results. As the number of subtasks grows, the controller becomes a communication and integration bottleneck, and useful details can be lost or distorted during routing. The problem is how to move coordination from a single controller to a shared problem state so multiple agents can make parallel progress without central routing.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but the paper is informative for test-time scaling and long-context reasoning organization. DeLM demonstrates a coordination layer based on shared verified context plus a task queue, which is relevant to research directions that treat inference itself as a parallelizable workflow. If multi-agent collaboration is viewed as an external reasoning mechanism, DeLM's design helps understand how multiple model calls can produce cumulative, verifiable intermediate states.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeLM replaces prompt-routed coordination with shared state: parallel agents, a shared verified context, and a task queue. Agents asynchronously claim subtasks from the queue, read accumulated progress from the shared context, perform local reasoning, and write back compact verified updates. Unlike peer-to-peer messaging, admitted updates become public state visible to all agents. To prevent noise accumulation, DeLM verifies updates at admission time and uses hierarchical summarization to keep the shared context compact and trustworthy. This removes the need for a main agent to serially merge and broadcast progress, and avoids pre-assigning evidence clusters in long-context reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated in three settings: software-engineering test-time scaling on SWE-bench Verified, long-context multi-document QA on LongBench-v2, and aggregation-heavy long-context reasoning on OOLONG. Key results: on SWE-bench Verified, DeLM reaches 77.4% pass@4 at roughly $0.12 per task, about half the cost of baselines; on LongBench-v2, it achieves the highest average accuracy across four frontier models, with up to 5.7 percentage-point gains over the best baseline; on OOLONG, vanilla DeLM underperforms RLM on exact row-level aggregation, but combining RLM with DeLM yields the best accuracy and lowest cost, showing DeLM can serve as a coordination layer for code-mediated reasoning systems.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the Introduction and design-principles sections first to understand why centralized orchestration breaks down as parallelism grows. Then study the SWE-bench and LongBench-v2 experiments to see how shared verified context reduces redundant exploration and information loss. Finally, look at the OOLONG experiment to understand the complementarity between DeLM and code-mediated reasoning (RLM). If you only care about connections to pretraining, focus on how repeated model calls are organized into cumulative intermediate states. Estimated reading time: 45–60 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author and institution information is not explicitly provided in the available content.

recommendation.zh: 去中心化协作是测试时 scaling 的一条可行路径，重点看共享上下文的验证机制与任务队列设计，§4 的 SWE-bench 消融值得读。
recommendation.en: Decentralized coordination is a viable path for test-time scaling; focus on the verified shared-context mechanism and task queue design, with §4 SWE-bench ablations worth reading.

institutions: Independent / Affiliation not explicitly stated in abstract

paper.title: Item Response Scaling Laws: A Measurement Theory Approach for Efficient and Generalizable Neural Scaling Estimation
paper.abstract: Scaling laws provide a fundamental framework for understanding the performance of Language Models (LMs), yet deriving them requires prohibitively expensive evaluations across thousands of checkpoints or millions of inference samples. To address this, we introduce Item Response Scaling Laws (IRSL), a unified framework that integrates Item Response Theory (IRT) within the scaling law framework. Unlike traditional approaches that treat each model-benchmark pair in isolation, IRSL disentangles laten

summary.core_problem: 传统 scaling law 拟合需要大量 checkpoint/采样评测，成本高且难以跨模型-题目泛化；如何用更少评测更稳健地估计可泛化的 scaling 关系。
summary.importance: 把测量理论（IRT）引入 scaling law，把“模型能力”和“题目难度/区分度”等因素解耦，目标是用更少的评测点得到更稳定、可迁移的 scaling 估计；对 test-time scaling 与预训练过程监控都有潜在价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 IRSL：将 M 个模型、N 道题的观测响应用 IRT 因子分解，把参数量从 O(M×N) 降到 O(M+N)。实例化为 Beta-IRT：不只用二元对错，而用概率型响应信号（如预训练 token 概率、推理采样 pass rate）来拟合题目特性与模型潜在能力，并在两类 scaling 范式下验证（预训练/推理采样）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模与数据细节；宣称在两类常见 scaling 设置下验证：一类基于预训练概率信号（token probabilities），一类基于 test-time sampling 的通过率（pass rates），并展示在减少评测量时仍能稳定估计 scaling/能力曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: Scaling-law estimation is expensive because it requires evaluating many checkpoints or massive inference sampling; the paper asks how to estimate generalizable scaling relations with far fewer evaluations.
summary_en.importance: Introduces measurement theory (IRT) into scaling laws to disentangle latent model ability from item/question properties, aiming for cheaper yet more transferable scaling estimation—useful for both pretraining monitoring and test-time scaling analysis.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Item Response Scaling Laws (IRSL): factorize model–item observations via IRT to reduce parameters from O(M×N) to O(M+N). Instantiates with Beta-IRT that uses probabilistic responses (e.g., token probabilities during pretraining, pass rates under sampling) rather than binary correctness.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes/datasets; it reports validation on two scaling paradigms: (i) pretraining probability signals and (ii) test-time sampling pass rates, showing more sample-efficient and stable scaling estimation.

recommendation.zh: 把“题目难度/区分度”显式建模后，scaling 拟合不再被 benchmark 噪声牵着走；优先看它在少评测预算下的误差曲线与失效场景。
recommendation.en: Modeling item difficulty/discrimination explicitly can de-noise scaling fits; focus on the low-eval-budget error curves and where the factorization breaks.

paper.title: Test-Time Scaling in Multimodal Foundation Models: A Comprehensive Survey of Generation and Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time Scaling (TTS) has emerged as a pivotal research direction for enhancing model performance by dynamically allocating computational resources during inference. Recent advancements have adapted this paradigm to Multimodal Foundation Models (MFMs), unlocking their potential in multimodal reasoning and generation. Despite rapid progress, the field lacks a systematic survey and unified theoretical framework to delineate the developmental landscape of multimodal TTS. To bridge this gap, we pr

summary.core_problem: 梳理多模态基础模型中的 test-time scaling 方法，回答推理时如何动态分配额外计算以提升生成与推理能力。
summary.importance: 这是综述而非新方法，但主题与当前 inference-time compute、search、feedback、sampling 的研究主线直接相关；对预训练研究员的价值在于建立问题地图，而不是提供新证据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出一个统一分类框架，将多模态 TTS 方法分为 sampling-based、feedback-based、search-based 三类，并整理其在多模态生成与推理中的应用场景、常用 benchmark 以及开放问题。
summary.experiments: 作为 survey，不提供新的模型规模、训练数据或基准突破；实验部分主要是对已有工作和评测资产的归纳，而非原创实证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper surveys test-time scaling in multimodal foundation models, asking how extra inference compute can be allocated to improve generation and reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is a survey rather than a new method, but the topic is directly tied to current work on inference-time compute, search, feedback, and sampling. Its value to pretraining researchers is in organizing the space, not in providing new evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes a unified taxonomy that groups multimodal TTS methods into sampling-based, feedback-based, and search-based approaches, and reviews their applications, benchmarks, and open challenges in multimodal generation and reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: As a survey, it does not introduce new model scales, training data, or benchmark gains. The empirical content is a synthesis of prior methods and evaluation assets rather than original experimentation.

recommendation.zh: 综述价值大于研究价值；如果你在想 pretrain 与 inference-time compute 的接口，只看 taxonomy 和 benchmark 表即可，不必通读。
recommendation.en: More useful as a map than as research; if you're thinking about the pretrain ↔ inference-time compute interface, the taxonomy and benchmark tables are enough.

paper.title: ThinkBooster: A Unified Framework for Seamless Test-Time Scaling of LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Test-time compute (TTC) scaling has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) reasoning by allocating additional compute during inference, e.g., via multi-sample generation and verifier-based reranking. Existing TTC scaling strategies and reasoning scorers remain fragmented, evaluated under inconsistent protocols, and are rarely analyzed through the lens of quality-cost trade-offs. We introduce ThinkBooster, a unified framework for seamless test-time compute scaling

summary.core_problem: 测试时算力扩展（best-of-N、ToT、自一致、PRM/自验证打分等）方法很多，但实现分散、评测协议不统一，且常忽略质量-成本权衡，导致很难在同一预算下比较策略优劣，也不利于工程落地。论文要解决的是：把 TTC scaling 的策略、scorer、评测与部署接口统一起来，形成可复用的研究与工程框架。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的直接贡献不大，更偏推理/系统与评测资产。但它对“pretrain↔posttrain↔inference 闭环”有间接价值：
- 把 TTC scaling 的成本指标纳入基准，有助于把“推理能力提升”从纯准确率拉回到可操作的 compute 预算；这会反过来影响后续训练阶段如何设计（例如训练时对 verifier/PRM 的依赖、或训练模型更好地暴露不确定性信号）。
- 提供统一实现与 proxy 服务，降低复现实验门槛，便于做更系统的 ablation（策略×scorer×预算）。
整体更像一个工具链+基准，而不是新的建模或训练目标。
summary.technical_approach:
ThinkBooster 由三部分组成：
1）模块化 Python 库：把 TTC scaling 抽象成若干可组合组件——scaling strategy（如 BoN/ToT/自一致/动态分配等）、scorer（PRM、self-verification、不确定性分数等）、reasoning generator、step boundary detector。论文声称实现了 9 类策略，覆盖 20+ 篇相关工作，并用统一 API 组织。
2）联合质量-效率的 benchmark：不仅报准确率，也报 compute/效率指标，用来比较不同策略在不同预算下的 trade-off。
3）可部署的 OpenAI-compatible proxy：作为透明代理，在不改应用逻辑的情况下对底层模型调用施加 TTC scaling，相当于给现有 endpoint 加“Pro 推理模式”。另提供 reasoning trajectory 的可视化调试器，便于检查路径选择与错误。

取舍上，它选择“统一抽象与工程化落地”而不是提出新算法；价值主要来自可复用实现、可比评测和部署形态。
summary.experiments:
你提供的全文片段主要是动机与系统设计，未包含完整实验表格与具体数字。
从 Introduction 可确认的实验/展示点：
- 他们做了一个 pilot study，对已实现的策略与 scorer 做性能-效率权衡分析。
- 他们展示 proxy endpoint 在真实任务中的收益，例子是 CUDA kernel optimization（更像下游应用演示，用于说明可部署性）。

若要判断研究结论是否可靠，需要在正文实验部分核对：
- benchmark 任务集合与评测协议（是否区分 structured CoT vs native thinking、是否控制温度/采样等）；
- compute 指标定义（token 数、模型调用次数、wall-clock latency、并行度假设）；
- 不同策略在同预算下的 Pareto 前沿是否稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–50 分钟）：
- 先看 Table 1（策略覆盖面）和框架总览图（Figure 2 一类的系统图），确认抽象边界：strategy/scorer/generator/step detector 各自负责什么。
- 重点读 benchmark 的 protocol：预算如何定义、如何统计成本、如何保证不同方法可比。
- 如果只关心研究复现：直接跳到 pilot study 的结果图（通常是 accuracy vs cost 曲线）和实现细节（并发、缓存、批处理）。
- 如果关心工程落地：读 proxy endpoint 的 API 设计与失败模式（超时、预算耗尽、scorer 不稳定）。

summary_en.core_problem: Test-time compute scaling for LLM reasoning (best-of-N, self-consistency, tree-of-thought, verifier/PRM reranking, dynamic budgeting, etc.) is fragmented: implementations are inconsistent, evaluation protocols differ, and quality–cost trade-offs are often underreported. The paper’s goal is to unify TTC strategies, scorers, benchmarking, and deployment into a single reusable framework so methods can be compared under consistent compute budgets and adopted in practice.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining contribution per se; it sits closer to inference-time reasoning infrastructure and evaluation. The indirect relevance to foundation-model research is that it pushes the community toward budget-aware reasoning evaluation (accuracy vs compute/latency), which can feed back into training decisions (e.g., whether to train models to expose calibrated uncertainty, how much to rely on PRMs/verifiers, and how to align training objectives with inference-time selection). Its main value is reproducibility and standardized comparisons rather than a new modeling objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ThinkBooster combines:
1) A modular Python library with a consistent API that decomposes TTC into composable parts: scaling strategies, scorers (PRMs, self-verification, uncertainty/confidence scores), reasoning generators, and step-boundary detectors. The paper claims 9 implemented strategy families covering 20+ prior works.
2) A benchmark that reports both task performance and compute/efficiency metrics, enabling explicit quality–cost trade-off analysis.
3) An OpenAI-compatible proxy service that transparently applies TTC scaling on top of an underlying LLM endpoint (drop-in “reasoning mode”), plus a visual debugger for inspecting trajectories and selection decisions.

The design choice is to standardize abstractions and engineering surfaces rather than introduce a new TTC algorithm.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided excerpt focuses on motivation and system components; detailed quantitative results are not shown.
What is stated in the Introduction:
- A pilot study comparing implemented strategies/scorers under performance–efficiency trade-offs.
- A deployment-oriented demonstration where the proxy improves outcomes on a real task (CUDA kernel optimization), mainly to illustrate practicality.

To assess the empirical claims, the key is to inspect the full experimental section for: task suite and protocol controls (sampling settings, structured vs unstructured reasoning), compute accounting (tokens, calls, wall-clock latency assumptions), and whether Pareto comparisons are stable across models and budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–50 minutes):
- Start with the strategy coverage table and the system overview figure to understand the abstraction boundaries.
- Read the benchmark protocol carefully: how budgets are defined and how costs are measured to ensure comparability.
- For research use, jump to the pilot-study plots (accuracy vs cost curves) and implementation notes (batching, caching, parallelism).
- For deployment, focus on the proxy API behavior and failure modes (timeouts, budget exhaustion, scorer instability).

recommendation.zh: 如果你在看 test-time scaling，这篇的价值主要是 protocol 而不是方法；先看 benchmark 设计和 cost-quality 图，别被工程包装带偏。
recommendation.en: If you care about test-time scaling, the value here is the protocol, not the method; read the benchmark design and cost-quality plots, not the tooling gloss.

paper.title: The Tell-Tale Norm: $\ell_2$ Magnitude as a Signal for Reasoning Dynamics in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent work has sought to understand Large Language Models (LLMs) reasoning, yet a principled, model-intrinsic signal that captures its layer-wise reasoning dynamics remains underexplored. We bridge this gap by demonstrating that the l2 norm of hidden states serves as an endogenous signal of the model's reasoning intensity. Using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) as a diagnostic probe, we observe that LLMs' internal reasoning is marked by a sharp increase in reasoning feature activations concentrated i

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文想找一个不依赖额外训练探针、直接来自模型内部状态的“推理强度信号”。已有工作要么从输出侧看 CoT、熵、正确率相关性，要么用 SAE 这类外部工具去挖 reasoning feature，但后者训练成本高、依赖模型和数据。论文要回答的是：LLM 在层间是否存在稳定的推理动态，以及这种动态能否用一个内生、训练无关的量来刻画。作者给出的答案是隐藏状态的 ℓ2 范数。
summary.importance: 对预训练 recipe 的直接影响有限，但对训练动态分析、机制解释、test-time compute 分配和 reasoning control 有启发。更具体地说，它提出了一个极低成本的内部诊断量：layer-wise hidden-state norm。若这个信号在更多模型上成立，它可以成为分析“模型何时在认真算、哪些层在承担推理负荷”的通用仪表，而不必每次先训练 SAE 或做复杂探针。对基座研究员而言，价值主要在机制分析与推理时干预，而不是提升预训练本身。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三步。第一步，用 SAE 作为诊断工具而不是最终信号。作者先在多个层上训练 SAE，把隐藏表示分解成稀疏特征，识别与 reasoning 相关的 feature，并观察这些 feature 在深层尤其是后段层显著增强。这个阶段的作用是建立一个较可信的“推理活跃层”参照系。

第二步，建立 hidden-state ℓ2 norm 与 reasoning feature activation 的理论联系。论文在若干条件下给出双边界：如果 SAE 重构足够 faithful，且 reasoning feature 与 semantic feature 近似正交，则隐藏状态范数可以界定 reasoning feature 的激活强度。直觉上，推理会把表示推向更高能量、更大幅度的子空间，因此 norm 会抬升。这里的理论不是严格现实世界定理，而是一个带条件的解释框架：它说明为什么 norm 可能是 reasoning intensity 的代理，而不是仅仅经验相关。

第三步，把这个信号用于 test-time control。作者提出三种无训练、无额外数据的方法。其一是 Adaptive Layer-wise Reasoning Recursion，在高推理强度层分配额外计算，类似只对关键层做更深处理。其二是 Endogenous Reasoning State Steering，把隐藏状态朝高强度子空间引导，以增强中间计算。其三是 ℓ2-guided Response Selection，在多个候选输出中选取 reasoning intensity 更高的答案。三者共同特点是都不改模型参数，而是利用 norm 作为在线控制信号。

论文还做了相关性与因果验证。相关性上，比较 ℓ2 norm 与 SAE reasoning feature、输出熵等指标的对齐程度，并声称 norm 优于其他简单统计量。因果上，在 reasoning-heavy 层压制高范数 token，比随机压制带来更大性能下降，作为“高范数位置更关键”的证据。
summary.experiments:
实验结论有三层。第一，表征分析显示 reasoning feature 在后层集中增强，说明推理并非均匀分布在所有层，而更像在中后段进入高活跃状态。第二，相关性实验表明 layer-wise ℓ2 norm 与 SAE 识别的 reasoning feature activation、以及输出不确定性指标有较强对齐，而且优于若干替代统计量。第三，基于 norm 的 test-time 方法在多个数学和通用推理 benchmark 上平均提升 4.51%，在更难的推理任务上提升 9.13%。

更值得注意的是因果干预结果：对 reasoning-heavy 层的高范数 token 做抑制，比随机抑制更伤性能，这支持“高范数不是伴随现象，而与有效推理计算有关”。不过这类证据仍然是局部的。它说明 norm 是有用信号，但还不能证明所有高范数都对应正确推理，也不能排除它有时只是高不确定性、高冲突或高激活密度的混合指标。

从论文定位看，数字提升不是最重要部分。更关键的是它把一个简单可测的内部量和 reasoning dynamics 连接起来，并展示了这个量可以驱动实际干预。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction，明确两层问题：一是 reasoning 在层间怎么展开，二是能否找到内生信号。然后直接看 SAE 分析部分的层间激活图，确认作者观察到的“后层推理增强”现象。接着看理论部分，重点不是逐式推导，而是弄清楚结论依赖哪些假设：faithful reconstruction、feature 近似正交、reasoning/semantic 分解是否可信。

实验部分建议按顺序看：相关性比较、因果抑制实验、三种 test-time 方法的主结果。若时间有限，优先看 high-norm suppression 和 response selection，这两部分最容易判断信号是否有操作价值。

预计 25 分钟左右可以完成有效泛读。阅读时要带着保留意见：hidden-state norm 很可能是一个混合信号，既包含 reasoning，也包含不确定性、冲突、长度效应和层归一化后的几何偏置。值得继续追问的是，这个现象在不同架构、不同归一化方式、不同 CoT 风格模型上是否稳定。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper looks for a model-intrinsic, training-free signal that tracks reasoning dynamics inside LLMs. Prior work either studies reasoning from outputs such as CoT tokens and entropy, or relies on external probes like sparse autoencoders to identify reasoning features. The question here is whether reasoning has a stable layer-wise signature and whether that signature can be captured directly from the model’s own hidden states. The proposed answer is the layer-wise hidden-state l2 norm.
summary_en.importance: The direct impact on pretraining is limited, but the paper is relevant to training dynamics analysis, mechanistic interpretability, and test-time compute allocation. If the result generalizes, hidden-state norm could become a cheap diagnostic for when a model is in a high-reasoning regime and which layers carry that burden, without training SAEs or other probes. For foundation-model researchers, the value is more in analysis and intervention than in changing the core pretraining objective.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper proceeds in three stages. First, it uses SAEs as a diagnostic reference rather than as the final signal. SAE features associated with reasoning are identified across layers, and the authors observe that these features become much stronger in later layers during reasoning-heavy behavior. This establishes a layer-wise picture of where reasoning seems to intensify.

Second, the paper connects hidden-state l2 norm to reasoning-feature activation theoretically. Under assumptions such as faithful SAE reconstruction and approximate orthogonality between reasoning and semantic features, the hidden-state norm provides upper and lower bounds on the activation strength of SAE reasoning features. The intuition is that reasoning pushes representations into higher-energy subspaces, inflating activation magnitude and therefore the norm. The theory is conditional rather than universal, but it gives a principled explanation for why norm might work as a proxy.

Third, the paper turns the signal into test-time control. It proposes three data-free, training-free methods: Adaptive Layer-wise Reasoning Recursion, which allocates extra compute to layers with high reasoning intensity; Endogenous Reasoning State Steering, which nudges hidden states toward high-intensity subspaces; and l2-guided Response Selection, which chooses the candidate response with the highest inferred reasoning intensity. All three methods use norm as an online control variable without changing model weights.

The paper also includes correlation and causal analyses. Correlation experiments compare l2 norm against SAE reasoning features, output entropy, and other simple statistics. Causal interventions suppress high-norm tokens in reasoning-heavy layers and show a larger performance drop than random suppression, supporting the claim that these positions matter for successful reasoning.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical story has three parts. First, representation analysis shows that reasoning-related SAE activations rise sharply in later layers, suggesting that reasoning is not uniformly distributed across depth but becomes concentrated in the middle-to-late stack. Second, correlation experiments show that layer-wise l2 norm aligns well with SAE-derived reasoning activity and output-side uncertainty measures, and reportedly outperforms several alternative statistics. Third, the norm-based test-time methods deliver an average gain of 4.51% across benchmarks and 9.13% on harder reasoning tasks.

The causal intervention is the most informative result. Suppressing high-norm tokens in reasoning-heavy layers hurts performance more than random suppression, which supports the idea that high norm is not just an incidental byproduct. Still, the evidence does not imply that every high-norm state corresponds to correct reasoning. The signal may also mix uncertainty, conflict, activation density, or architectural geometry effects.

The main contribution is therefore not the absolute benchmark gain, but the claim that a simple measurable internal quantity can track and modulate reasoning dynamics in practice.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction to separate the two questions: how reasoning unfolds across layers, and whether there is an endogenous signal for it. Then go straight to the SAE analysis figures that show the late-layer concentration of reasoning features. After that, read the theory section selectively. The key is not every derivation, but the assumptions behind the bounds: faithful reconstruction, approximate orthogonality, and whether the reasoning-versus-semantic decomposition is plausible.

In the experiments, read the correlation study, the high-norm suppression intervention, and the three test-time methods in that order. If time is limited, prioritize the suppression experiment and the response-selection results, since they are the clearest tests of whether the signal is operationally useful.

A good reading stance is cautious. Hidden-state norm is likely a mixed signal rather than a pure reasoning meter. The natural follow-up question is whether the effect remains stable across architectures, normalization schemes, and models with different CoT styles.

recommendation.zh: 值得看，但先把它当机制线索而不是新 recipe；重点读因果干预和 norm-guided scaling，若 setup 干净，可以立刻在内部 trace/early-exit 实验里复现。
recommendation.en: Worth reading as a mechanism clue, not a new recipe yet; focus on the causal intervention and norm-guided scaling sections, then try reproducing it in your own tracing or early-exit setup.

paper.title: Small RL Controller, Large Language Model: RL-Guided Adaptive Sampling for Test-Time Scaling

summary.core_problem: 在 test-time scaling（如 self-consistency / best-of-N）里，如何在不依赖启发式规则、不读取模型内部置信度/hidden state、也不改动采样器的前提下，自动决定“还要不要继续采样、下一轮采多少”，从而在正确率、总算力与延迟（轮数）之间做可控权衡。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“推理时算力分配”这条线有现实价值：把自适应采样从手工阈值/分布假设推进到可学习策略，并且只用最终答案集合的统计量，工程侵入性低。对 pretrain 研究的启发主要在两点：1）把多目标权衡写成拉格朗日形式的 RL 目标，提供了一个可迁移的“预算约束→训练信号”的模板；2）强调只依赖输出可观测量的控制器，更贴近线上系统可落地的闭环优化。整体属于 skim：方法清晰但创新集中在问题表述与轻量控制器上，未触及训练动态/数据/优化器等核心 pretrain 议题。
summary.technical_approach:
把“逐轮采样并多数投票”的过程建模为有限时域 MDP。
- 状态（state）：只由当前已采样答案集合的可观测统计构成，不用 logits/置信度/hidden states。具体包括：top-K 最频繁答案的计数向量（排序后）、已采样总数 |D_t|、以及该计数向量的熵 Ent(V_t)（用于刻画是否收敛/分歧）。
- 动作（action）：a_t=0 表示停止并输出当前多数票；a_t=k_l>0 表示并行再采样 k_l 个候选（离散动作集合）。
- 奖励（reward）：把“最终是否正确”作为正奖励，把额外样本数（计算成本）与额外轮数（延迟）作为惩罚项；用加权和实现多目标折中。文中将其解释为“在预算约束下最大化准确率”的拉格朗日松弛：权重相当于拉格朗日乘子，控制不同预算档位的策略。
- 策略/控制器：4 层 MLP，小模型、可 CPU 训练与部署。训练用 RL（文中表述为在该 MDP 上学习最优停止/继续策略），推理时作为外部控制器包在任意 LLM sampler 外侧。
- 关键取舍：只看最终答案统计，意味着适用面广、部署简单，但也限制了上限（无法利用 token-level 置信度、过程一致性等更强信号）。
summary.experiments:
论文在 3 个 benchmark、多个 sampler 上评估“准确率-成本”曲线，并与 ASC、ESC 等自适应采样基线对比。
- 相对 ASC：采样轮数减少约 3×，总采样数减少约 30%（在相近性能/权衡档位下）。
- 相对 ESC：采样轮数减少约 10%，总采样数减少约 35%。
- 泛化：在一个数据集/模型上训练的 controller，可迁移到其他 benchmark、甚至不同 sampler，性能退化较小（文中在 Section 4.4 强调 transfer）。
（当前给定全文片段未包含更细的表格数值、具体模型规模与各任务绝对准确率；精读时需要对照 Table 1、Figure 2 与迁移实验小节补齐。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
1）先看 Figure 1 把交互流程对齐：controller 只读“答案集合统计”，不碰模型内部。
2）重点看 Method 里 state/action/reward 的定义：top-K 计数 + 熵是核心设计点，决定了它为何能跨模型迁移。
3）看 Table 1 与 Figure 2：确认在不同预算权重下的 Pareto 曲线是否稳定优于 ASC/ESC，而不是只在单点占优。
4）看 Section 4.4（transfer）：这是论文最有信息量的部分，能判断它是否只是“对某个基准调参”，还是确实学到了较通用的停止策略。
5）如果要复现/落地：关注动作集合（每轮可追加的 k_l 取值）、奖励权重如何设定/扫描，以及训练时是否需要大量带标注的正确性信号（通常需要可自动判分的任务）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to allocate test-time sampling compute for reasoning (e.g., self-consistency / best-of-N) by deciding when to stop and how many more samples to draw per round, without hand-crafted heuristics, without accessing internal confidence/hidden states, and without modifying the underlying LLM sampler—while explicitly trading off accuracy, latency (rounds), and total compute (samples).
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining contribution per se, but practically relevant for inference-time compute allocation. The main value is turning adaptive sampling into a learnable policy with minimal observability requirements (final-answer statistics only), which makes deployment easy and model-agnostic. For pretraining researchers, the transferable idea is the “budget-constrained objective → Lagrangian-weighted reward” pattern and the emphasis on controllers that rely only on externally observable signals, aligning with production constraints. Overall a skim: the novelty is mostly in formulation and a lightweight controller rather than new training dynamics/data/optimization insights.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Formulates adaptive sampling as a finite-horizon MDP over rounds of candidate generation and majority-vote aggregation.
- State: constructed purely from the current set of extracted final answers. Features include sorted top-K answer counts, total sample count |D_t|, and entropy of the count vector as a proxy for convergence/dispersion.
- Actions: discrete choices—stop (return current majority vote) or sample k_l additional candidates in parallel.
- Reward: correctness of the final aggregated answer as positive reward, with penalties for additional samples (compute) and additional rounds (latency). Implemented as a weighted sum and interpreted as a Lagrangian relaxation of maximizing accuracy under compute/latency budgets.
- Policy: a small 4-layer MLP trained with RL; runs on CPU; wraps around any black-box LLM sampler.
- Design trade-off: using only answer-level statistics improves portability and operational simplicity, but forgoes stronger internal signals (logits, token-level uncertainty, process features), which may cap achievable efficiency gains.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on three benchmarks and multiple LLM samplers, comparing accuracy–cost trade-offs against adaptive sampling baselines such as ASC and ESC.
- Versus ASC: ~3× fewer sampling rounds and ~30% fewer total samples at comparable trade-off settings.
- Versus ESC: ~10% fewer rounds and ~35% fewer samples.
- Transfer: controllers trained on one dataset/model transfer to other benchmarks and even different samplers with limited degradation (highlighted in Section 4.4).
(The provided full-text excerpt does not include absolute accuracies, model sizes, or per-task numbers; those are in Table 1 / Figure 2 and should be checked during reading.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
1) Figure 1 for the end-to-end loop and the “answers-only” observability constraint.
2) Method section for the exact state/action/reward definitions; top-K counts + entropy is the key engineering choice enabling transfer.
3) Table 1 and Figure 2 to verify consistent Pareto improvements across budget settings, not just a single operating point.
4) Section 4.4 (transfer) to judge whether the policy generalizes beyond benchmark-specific tuning.
5) For implementation: inspect the action set (allowed k_l values), how reward weights are selected/swept, and whether training requires automatically verifiable correctness signals (often necessary for RL reward).

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和预算归一化实验；若没有严格控制 token/采样次数，它只是 RL 包装的 best-of-N。
recommendation.en: Read the method and budget-normalized results only; without strict token/sample control, this is likely best-of-N with an RL wrapper.

institutions: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill

paper.title: KVarN: Variance-Normalized KV-Cache Quantization Mitigates Error Accumulation in Reasoning Tasks
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling is a powerful approach to obtain better reasoning in large language models, but it becomes memory-bottlenecked during long-horizon decoding, as the KV-cache grows. KV-cache quantization can help improve this, but current methods are evaluated under prefill-like settings and errors behave differently under autoregressive decoding. We show that in the latter regime, quantization errors accumulate across timesteps, driven primarily by incorrect token scales. We introduce KVarN, a

summary.core_problem: 现有KV缓存量化方法多在预填充类场景下评估，未覆盖推理任务常用的长序列自回归解码场景，该场景下token尺度估计错误会导致量化误差随解码步长累积，大幅降低推理质量。
summary.importance: 针对长推理场景下KV缓存量化的误差累积痛点提出无需校准的高效方案，为大模型长推理任务的部署效率优化提供了新的技术路径。
summary.technical_approach: 首先将量化误差分解为幅度误差和方向误差，识别出占比仅5%的离群token尺度误差是导致端到端性能下降的主要原因。提出KVarN量化方法：先对K/V矩阵做Hadamard旋转，实现通道维度的非相干处理，均衡通道离群值；再对K/V矩阵的两个维度做双尺度Sinkhorn风格方差归一化，修正token尺度离群误差。整个过程无需校准，可在线计算或预计算后吸收进模型权重。
summary.experiments: 在AIME24、MATH500、HumanEval、IFEval等生成式基准上，KVarN相比KIVI、TurboQuant等现有KV缓存量化方法取得更优的端到端性能，有效缓解了多步解码下的误差累积。测试基于Qwen3-4B、Llama3.1-8B等模型，KV处理分块大小为128token。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注引言部分的误差累积观测、量化误差分解的推导，以及方法部分的Hadamard旋转加双尺度归一化的组合设计，预计阅读时间20分钟，实验部分可根据关注的基准选择性浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing KV-cache quantization methods are mostly evaluated under prefill-like settings, and do not cover the long-sequence autoregressive decoding scenario commonly used for reasoning tasks. In this scenario, incorrect per-token scale estimation causes quantization error to accumulate with decoding steps, significantly degrading reasoning quality.
summary_en.importance: It proposes an efficient, calibration-free solution for the error accumulation pain point of KV-cache quantization in long reasoning scenarios, offering a new technical path for optimizing the deployment efficiency of LLM long reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: First, quantization error is decomposed into magnitude error and directional error, identifying that the top 5% outlier per-token scale errors account for most end-to-end performance degradation. The KVarN quantization method is proposed: first apply Hadamard rotation to K/V matrices to achieve incoherence processing on the channel dimension, equalizing channel outliers. Then apply dual-scaling Sinkhorn-style variance normalization across both axes of K/V matrices to correct outlier token scale errors. The entire pipeline is calibration-free, and can be computed online or precomputed and absorbed into model weights.
summary_en.experiments: On generative benchmarks including AIME24, MATH500, HumanEval, and IFEval, KVarN achieves better end-to-end performance than existing KV-cache quantization methods such as KIVI and TurboQuant, effectively mitigating error accumulation across multi-step decoding. Tests are conducted on models including Qwen3-4B and Llama3.1-8B, with 128-token KV processing chunks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the error accumulation observations in the introduction, the quantization error decomposition derivation, and the combined design of Hadamard rotation + dual-scale normalization in the methodology section. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes; experimental sections can be selectively skimmed based on benchmarks of interest.

recommendation.zh: 指出了长程 AR 解码中 token scale 错误导致误差累积的机制，Hadamard 旋转+方差归一化的解法很干净，做长上下文推理优化的值得看 §3 和实验。
recommendation.en: Identifies token scale errors as the driver of error accumulation in long AR decoding; the Hadamard + variance normalization solution is clean, worth reading §3 and experiments for long-context serving.

paper.title: Comprehensive AI governance requires addressing non-model gains
paper.abstract: Frontier AI governance often centres on the model-level governance paradigm, which assumes that a model's capability profile is primarily a function of the compute and data used during training. This position paper argues that model-level governance becomes less effective when capability progress is increasingly driven by "non-model gains"--improvements that are independent from advances in the base model. We formalise the concept of non-model gains and provide a taxonomy of three distinct vecto

summary.core_problem: 当前前沿AI治理以模型级范式为核心，默认模型能力主要由训练阶段的计算与数据决定，该范式在能力提升越来越多地来自非模型增益时逐渐失效
summary.importance: 首次形式化定义并分类非模型增益的三大类，揭示现有模型中心治理框架的盲区，属于AI治理领域的概念与视角更新贡献
summary.technical_approach: 提出非模型增益的三类划分框架：推理增益（测试时计算缩放）、系统增益（后训练增强如脚手架）、资产增益（用受限资产增强模型），定性分析其对现有预部署评估等治理策略的冲击
summary.experiments: 为立场论文，无量化实验，结合具身智能、持续学习、AI扩散等技术趋势做定性论证
summary.authors_note: 作者来自多机构AI治理研究团队，无公开的知名大模型预训练核心研究者背景

summary_en.core_problem: Current frontier AI governance relies on a model-centric paradigm that assumes model capability is mainly determined by training compute and data, which becomes less effective as capability gains increasingly come from non-model sources
summary_en.importance: First formal definition and taxonomy of non-model gains, revealing blind spots in existing model-centered governance frameworks, contributing a conceptual update to AI governance paradigms
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes a three-category taxonomy of non-model gains: inference gain (test-time compute scaling), systems gain (post-training enhancements like scaffolds), and asset gain (enhancing models with restricted assets), and qualitatively analyzes their impact on existing governance strategies such as pre-deployment evaluation
summary_en.experiments: This is a position paper with no quantitative experiments, conducting qualitative论证结合 emerging trends including embodiment, continual learning, and AI diffusion
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from multi-institutional AI governance research teams, with no publicly recognized core researchers in large model pre-training

recommendation.zh: 了解非模型增益的三类划分，用于区分基座预训练与后训练/推理侧的能力贡献，作为背景知识备查即可
recommendation.en: Understand the three categories of non-model gains to distinguish capability contributions from base pre-training vs post-training/inference side, keep as background reference

paper.title: FineVerify: Scaling Test-Time Compute with Fine-Grained Self-Verification for Agentic Search

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agentic search 里的一个老问题：增加 test-time compute 以后，候选轨迹会变多，但正确答案在候选池里往往很稀疏，而且很多错误答案看起来也相当像对的。此时，靠 majority voting 不稳，因为真答案不一定出现得最频繁；靠单个全局分数做 rerank 也不稳，因为模型需要把多个条件压成一个分数，容易受校准误差影响。论文要解决的不是“如何搜得更多”，而是“当已经搜出一批候选后，怎样更可靠地从中挑出真正满足题目所有约束的答案”。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身没有直接方法贡献，但对 post-train 阶段的 test-time scaling 和 verifier 设计有现实启发。它说明在复杂信息检索任务里，selection signal 的粒度比单纯增加 sample 数更关键。更具体地说，这篇工作把“验证比生成容易”这个思路推进了一步：不是做 candidate-level 的粗验证，而是把问题拆成共享的、可检查的子条件，再做证据约束下的逐项判断。这个设计对以后做 search agent、tool-use agent、以及需要 verifier 的长链任务都有参考价值，也能反过来提示预训练研究者：如果模型在细粒度条件核验上能力不足，单靠更强生成未必能稳定转成最终正确率。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 FINEVERIFY。流程分成 proposer 和 verifier 两部分。proposer 先用 agentic search 采样多条轨迹，得到多个候选答案。verifier 不直接给每个候选打一个总分，而是先把原问题分解成一组可核验的 sub-questions，每个 sub-question 对应题目中的一个条件、属性或约束。然后，对每个候选答案，系统结合检索到的证据，逐个判断该候选是否满足每个 sub-question，标签是 supported、not_found 或 contradicted。最后，再把这些逐项判断聚合成一个 evidence-grounded verification score，用来选最终答案。

这个设计和常见 best-of-N / confidence-based reranking 的差别有三点。第一，它把难的全局判断拆成多个局部判断，降低了 verifier 的认知负担。第二，所有候选都在同一组显式检查项上被评估，分数更可比；而单个全局分数常常隐含了不同的判断标准。第三，聚合规则是透明的，用户能看到到底是哪一项被支持、缺失或反驳，而不是只得到一个黑盒分数。

从全文描述看，作者还把“满分”作为 early stopping 信号：如果某个候选在所有 sub-questions 上都得到 supported，就可以提前停止继续采样，节省额外 compute。另一个实际价值是 verification trace 可用于数据审计，因为它把错误来源定位到具体条件，而不是停留在“答案错了”这一层。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 4 个 agentic search benchmark 和 2 个模型。论文主打的结果是：在只采样 4 条轨迹时，GPT-5-mini 的平均准确率从 Pass@1 的 59.2% 提升到 67.4%，绝对提升 8.2 个点；Gemini-3-flash 从 71.3% 提升到 76.9%，提升 5.6 个点。与 Majority Voting、Weighted Voting、Best-of-N、Solution Aggregation、Confidence Verify 等 test-time scaling 基线相比，FINEVERIFY 都更稳。

更关键的是它随 sample 数增加还能继续获益。文中图 1 给出的 BrowseComp-Plus 结果显示，GPT-5-mini 在 12 samples 时，FINEVERIFY 已经超过 GPT-5；相对 GPT-5-mini 的 Pass@1，提升达到 20.5 个点。这一点说明它不是只在小样本 rerank 上占便宜，而是确实更有效地把额外 test-time compute 转成最终准确率。

作者还做了 verification accuracy 分析：当前提是候选池里已经包含正确答案时，FINEVERIFY 比 candidate-level 的粗粒度打分方法更容易把正确答案选出来。这说明收益主要来自“选得更准”，而不只是“搜得更多”。此外，在 BrowseComp-Plus 的 200 个样本审计里，作者借助 verification traces 找到 10 个数据集问题，包括标注答案缺少证据支持，以及存在多个完全被支持的答案。这部分不是主结果，但说明细粒度验证在 benchmark 质检上有附加价值。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三件事。第一，看 Introduction 里对 agentic search 与 math/coding test-time scaling 差异的界定，作者讲清了为什么多数投票和单分数校准在这里不够用。第二，看方法部分里 question decomposition、per-check verification、score aggregation 这三步，重点理解“共享检查项”为什么能提升候选间可比性。第三，看主结果图表，尤其是 sample 数增加时各方法曲线的斜率差异，这比单点分数更说明问题。

如果时间有限，建议优先看 Figure 1、主表、verification accuracy 分析，以及 benchmark auditing 的案例。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以把方法价值和边界看清。需要带着问题去读：sub-question 的生成质量是否会成为瓶颈；当问题本身难以分解、或证据检索不全时，supported / not_found / contradicted 三分类会怎样影响最终排序；不同聚合规则对 precision-recall 的取舍是否敏感。这些点决定了方法能否迁移到更开放的 agent setting。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in agentic search: once you scale test-time compute and sample many search trajectories, the correct answer is often sparse in the candidate pool, while many wrong answers remain highly plausible. Majority voting becomes unreliable because correctness is not correlated with frequency, and candidate-level reranking with a single score is brittle because the model must compress multiple constraints into one scalar, which exposes calibration errors. The real problem here is not how to search more, but how to select the right answer more reliably once a diverse candidate set already exists.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training, verifier design, and test-time scaling. The main lesson is that in complex information-seeking tasks, the granularity of the selection signal matters as much as, or more than, the number of sampled trajectories. The paper pushes the familiar idea that verification is easier than generation one step further: instead of coarse candidate-level verification, it performs evidence-grounded checking against shared sub-questions derived from the original query. That makes it useful for search agents, tool-using agents, and long-horizon systems that need a verifier. It also suggests a useful interface back to pretraining: if a model is weak at fine-grained conditional verification, stronger generation alone may not translate into stable end-task accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, FINEVERIFY, has a proposer-verifier structure. A proposer first runs agentic search and samples multiple trajectories, producing a set of candidate answers. The verifier does not assign one global score per candidate. Instead, it first decomposes the original question into a set of checkable sub-questions, each corresponding to a requirement, attribute, or constraint in the task. Then, for every candidate answer, it verifies each sub-question against retrieved evidence and labels the result as supported, not_found, or contradicted. These per-check judgments are aggregated into an evidence-grounded verification score, and the highest-scoring candidate is selected.

Relative to best-of-N or confidence-based reranking, the design changes the problem in three ways. First, it replaces one difficult global judgment with multiple simpler local judgments. Second, all candidates are evaluated against the same explicit checklist, which makes scores more comparable across candidates. Third, the aggregation rule is explicit rather than implicit, so the final decision is inspectable.

The paper also uses a practical early-stopping rule: if a candidate receives full support on all sub-questions, sampling can stop because further compute is unlikely to change the decision. Another useful byproduct is the verification trace itself, which can be used to audit benchmark quality and diagnose why a candidate was accepted or rejected.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation covers four agentic search benchmarks and two models. With only 4 sampled trajectories, FINEVERIFY improves average accuracy for GPT-5-mini from 59.2% Pass@1 to 67.4%, an absolute gain of 8.2 points. For Gemini-3-flash, it improves from 71.3% to 76.9%, a gain of 5.6 points. It consistently beats standard test-time scaling baselines such as Majority Voting, Weighted Voting, Best-of-N, Solution Aggregation, and Confidence Verify.

The more important result is that it keeps improving as the number of samples grows. On BrowseComp-Plus, Figure 1 shows that with 12 samples, FINEVERIFY allows GPT-5-mini to surpass GPT-5, with a 20.5-point gain over GPT-5-mini Pass@1. That matters because it indicates the method is not just a small reranking trick at low sample counts; it converts additional test-time compute into accuracy more effectively than the baselines.

The paper also includes a verification-accuracy analysis: when the correct answer is present in the candidate pool, FINEVERIFY is more likely than coarse candidate-level scoring methods to actually select it. That isolates the source of improvement to better selection rather than better search coverage. Finally, on 200 sampled examples from BrowseComp-Plus, the verification traces uncover 10 dataset issues, including annotated answers with unsupported requirements and questions that admit multiple fully supported answers.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the motivation in the introduction, especially the distinction between agentic search and test-time scaling in math or coding. That section explains why majority voting and single-score reranking break down here. Second, read the method section around question decomposition, per-check verification, and score aggregation. The key idea is not just decomposition, but decomposition into a shared checklist used for all candidates. Third, inspect the scaling curves rather than only the headline numbers; the widening gap as sample count increases is central to the paper’s claim.

If time is limited, prioritize Figure 1, the main result tables, the verification-accuracy analysis, and the benchmark-auditing examples. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be enough to understand the method and its limits. The right questions to keep in mind are: how robust is the sub-question decomposition step, what happens when evidence retrieval is incomplete, and how sensitive is the final ranking to the aggregation rule over supported / not_found / contradicted labels. Those details determine whether the approach will generalize to more open-ended agent settings.

recommendation.zh: test-time scaling 里值得看的一类：别只盯 pass@k，重点看它如何把 verifier 粒度做细，以及性能-计算曲线是否真的更线性。
recommendation.en: This is worth a skim in test-time scaling: ignore headline accuracy and inspect whether finer verification truly improves the performance-vs-compute curve.

paper.title: ATLAS: Agentic Test-time Learning-to-Allocate Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling has become a major way to improve large language model reasoning, but its orchestration has remained designer-engineered: a fixed sample budget, a fixed refinement loop, a fixed scoring rule, or a fixed search policy decides how compute is spent, leaving the model in charge of solving but not of orchestration. We introduce ATLAS, an agentic test-time scaling framework in which an LLM orchestrator owns the control loop end-to-end. Through a single action, explore, which dispatch

summary.core_problem: 测试时计算扩展（Test-time scaling）通常依赖人工设计的固定策略（如固定采样预算、固定打分规则或固定搜索策略），模型仅负责求解而无法自主决定如何分配计算资源，导致在不同难度问题上效率低下或效果饱和。
summary.importance: 提出了一种完全由 LLM 自主编排测试时计算分配的 Agentic 框架，将控制权从人工规则交还给模型，证明了即使是极简的自主停止策略也能在降低成本的同时达到极具竞争力的准确率，为测试时计算扩展提供了一种更灵活、更具扩展性的新范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ATLAS（Agentic Test-time Learning-to-Allocate Scaling）框架。核心是一个 LLM 编排器（Orchestrator），它不直接求解问题，而是通过一个单一工具 `explore` 来管理候选解池。每次调用 `explore` 都会在一个独立的求解器上针对原始问题生成新的解答。编排器根据完整的 Thought/Action/Observation 历史记录（状态化证据管理）来决定是继续探索（分配更多计算）还是停止并综合最终答案。该动作空间可扩展，支持选择不同的求解器或推理策略。
summary.experiments: 在 HLE-Verified、LiveCodeBench、BabyVision 和 GPQA-Diamond 四个基准上评估（使用 Claude Sonnet 4.6）。极简版 ATLAS 在大幅减少 API 调用次数的情况下，准确率与固定工作流基线相当。多模型扩展版 ATLAS-MM（动作空间包含求解器选择）在 HLE-Verified 上达到 60.00%，在 LiveCodeBench 上达到 85.63%。消融实验表明，状态化证据管理（编排器直接综合答案而非依赖外部聚合器）是性能提升的关键。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Introduction 中对现有固定策略局限性的分析，以及 Methodology 中关于状态化证据管理（Stateful evidence management）的设计。建议仔细阅读消融实验部分，理解编排器直接综合答案为何优于分离的聚合器。

summary_en.core_problem: Test-time scaling typically relies on designer-engineered fixed strategies (e.g., fixed sample budgets, scoring rules, or search policies), leaving the model to solve but not to orchestrate compute allocation, which leads to inefficiency or saturated performance across problems of varying difficulty.
summary_en.importance: Introduces an agentic framework where an LLM orchestrator autonomously manages test-time compute allocation, shifting control from hand-specified rules to the model itself. It demonstrates that even a minimal autonomous stopping strategy can achieve competitive accuracy at a lower cost, offering a more flexible and scalable paradigm for test-time compute scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes ATLAS (Agentic Test-time Learning-to-Allocate Scaling). The core is an LLM orchestrator that does not solve the problem directly but manages a pool of candidate solutions via a single tool, `explore`. Each `explore` call dispatches a fresh, independent solver on the original problem. The orchestrator decides whether to continue exploring or to stop and synthesize the final answer based on the full Thought/Action/Observation history (stateful evidence management). The action space is extensible, allowing for solver selection or reasoning strategy specification.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on HLE-Verified, LiveCodeBench, BabyVision, and GPQA-Diamond using Claude Sonnet 4.6. The minimal ATLAS achieves competitive accuracy with significantly fewer API calls compared to fixed-workflow baselines. The multi-model extension, ATLAS-MM, reaches 60.00% on HLE-Verified and 85.63% on LiveCodeBench. Ablations highlight that stateful evidence management (direct synthesis by the orchestrator rather than a separate aggregator) is crucial for the gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the critique of fixed orchestration strategies, and the Methodology for the design of stateful evidence management. The ablation studies are highly recommended to understand why direct synthesis by the orchestrator outperforms a separate aggregator.

recommendation.zh: 将 test-time scaling 的控制权交给 LLM Agent，思路很自然，值得关注其在复杂任务上的 scaling 效率和编排策略的涌现。
recommendation.en: Handing over the control of test-time scaling to an LLM Agent is a natural progression; worth observing its scaling efficiency and the emergence of orchestration strategies on complex tasks.

paper.title: UniScale: Adaptive Unified Inference Scaling via Online Joint Optimization of Model Routing and Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: In real-world deployments of large language models (LLMs), balancing inference quality and computational cost has become a central challenge. Existing approaches tackle this trade-off along two largely independent dimensions: model routing, which switches among models of different scales to match request complexity, and test-time scaling (TTS), which adjusts inference-time compute within a fixed model for fine-grained control. However, this decoupled design introduces inherent limitations. Model

summary.core_problem: UniScale 解决的是在线推理服务中的质量—成本联合控制问题。已有方法通常把模型路由和 test-time scaling 分开做：路由可以在不同规模模型之间切换，但粒度粗；单模型 TTS 可以细调推理计算量，但受限于该模型的能力上限。论文把二者合成一个统一的推理配置空间，让系统同时决定用哪个模型、以及在该模型上采用怎样的 TTS 策略。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对基座模型研究有间接价值。它把“模型规模选择”和“推理时计算分配”放在同一个优化框架里，提供了一个更贴近真实服务的 scaling 视角。对预训练研究员有用的地方在于：能力不只由参数量和训练 token 决定，部署阶段的计算调度也会改变有效能力边界；小模型加较强 TTS 和大模型加轻量 TTS 之间存在可替代关系。这个观察会影响模型族设计、能力分层、router 训练、以及推理预算下的模型评估方式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法的核心是 Unified Inference Scaling。一个 UIS 配置同时包含 base model 和 TTS 参数。TTS 被形式化为三维参数空间：Question Parallelism 表示探索多少个推理子树，Candidate Parallelism 表示每步并行采样候选数，Beam Size 表示保留多少个经验证的节点。这样，系统不再只在模型之间做离散选择，也不只在固定模型上调解码策略，而是在组合空间里选配置。UniScale 将配置选择建模为在线 contextual bandit。它用 Transformer encoder 提取 query 表示，再用 LinUCB 学习在当前 query 和在线反馈下选择配置。为降低在线学习成本，论文加入三项工程机制：Path-Aware Early Exiting 提前终止低潜力推理路径；Dense Verification Feedback 用 TTS 中 verifier 的连续分数补充稀疏的最终正确/错误信号；UIS Cost Model 用 equivalent FLOPs 将计算和显存开销统一到一个成本度量里，避免只按 token 数或延迟近似带来的偏差。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个层次：固定模型下的 TTS 选择、不同模型之间的 routing、以及完整 UIS 配置选择。论文报告 UniScale 在这些设置下均优于分离式 baseline，并通过消融验证 early exiting、dense verifier feedback、eFLOPs cost model 对质量—成本曲线的贡献。当前给出的正文片段没有展开具体表格数字、模型池规模、benchmark 名称和绝对提升幅度，因此精读时需要核对 Section 4 和 Section 5 的完整结果，尤其是同等成本下的准确率提升、同等准确率下的 eFLOPs 降低，以及在线分布漂移场景中的恢复速度。
