summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Section 2.1–2.2，确认 UIS 配置空间和 contextual bandit 的问题定义；再看 Section 3.3–3.4，理解 early exiting、dense feedback、eFLOPs cost model 如何缓解在线推理的延迟和反馈稀疏问题。实验部分建议重点看 Section 4.3 的完整 UIS 结果和 Section 5 的消融。需要带着一个问题读：收益主要来自更大的配置空间，还是来自更好的在线学习与成本建模。若论文没有充分控制配置空间大小和搜索预算，结论会更偏系统调度，而不是推理 scaling 规律。

summary_en.core_problem: UniScale addresses the online quality–cost control problem in LLM serving. Existing systems usually treat model routing and test-time scaling as separate decisions. Routing across model sizes gives broad coverage but only coarse jumps in capability and cost. TTS provides finer control within one model, but it quickly runs into the capacity ceiling of that model. The paper combines both into a single inference-time configuration space.
summary_en.importance: The work is not about pretraining itself, but it is relevant to foundation-model research through the lens of effective scaling. It shows that deployed capability depends not only on model size and training compute, but also on how inference compute is allocated across a model family. A smaller model with stronger TTS and a larger model with lighter TTS can occupy overlapping regions on the quality–cost frontier. This has implications for model-family design, router training, evaluation under fixed inference budgets, and how pretraining teams think about serving-time compute as part of the scaling stack.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main construct is Unified Inference Scaling. A UIS configuration specifies both the base model and the TTS strategy. TTS is parameterized by Question Parallelism, Candidate Parallelism, and Beam Size, which control the number of explored reasoning subtrees, parallel candidates, and retained verified nodes. UniScale casts configuration selection as an online contextual bandit problem. A Transformer encoder produces query representations, and LinUCB learns a policy from online feedback. Three mechanisms make the setup more practical: Path-Aware Early Exiting stops low-potential inference paths early; Dense Verification Feedback uses verifier scores from TTS to provide denser quality signals than final binary correctness; and a UIS cost model uses equivalent FLOPs to put compute and memory overhead into one cost metric.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are organized around fixed-model TTS selection, model routing, and the full unified setting. UniScale is reported to outperform decoupled baselines in all three settings, with ablations isolating the effects of early exiting, dense verifier feedback, and the eFLOPs-based cost model. The provided text does not include the detailed tables, exact benchmark list, model pool, or numerical gains, so the critical results to verify are the accuracy gain at equal cost, cost reduction at equal accuracy, and behavior under online distribution drift.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Focus on Sections 2.1–2.2 for the UIS formulation and bandit setup, then Sections 3.3–3.4 for the practical mechanisms. In the experiments, prioritize the full UIS setting and the ablations. The key question is whether the gains mainly come from enlarging the action space, from the online learning algorithm, or from better cost accounting. That distinction determines whether the paper is more useful as an inference-scaling idea or as a serving-system recipe.

recommendation.zh: 将 Routing 和 TTS 联合优化的思路很自然，值得关注其在线优化的具体实现和成本-收益的帕累托前沿分析。
recommendation.en: The idea of jointly optimizing Routing and TTS is natural; worth checking the specific implementation of online optimization and the Pareto frontier analysis of cost-benefit.

paper.title: Scaling Laws for Agent Harnesses via Effective Feedback Compute
paper.abstract: Agent harnesses increasingly determine the performance of language-model systems by deciding how models call tools, receive feedback, verify intermediate states, store memory, and revise solutions. Yet current test-time scaling analyses often parameterize this process by raw expenditure -- tokens, tool calls, operations, wall time, or cost -- which does not distinguish useful feedback from redundant or unstable interaction. We introduce \emph{Effective Feedback Compute} (EFC), a trace-level scal

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 agent harness 的 test-time scaling 坐标问题：同样的 token、工具调用次数或花费，并不代表 agent 得到了同样多的有效反馈。作者希望找到一个比原始开销更能预测 closed-loop agent 成功率的标量。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的直接贡献不大，但对 posttrain、agent 评测和推理时计算分配有启发。它把 agent harness 的收益拆成两个量：原始预算转化为有效反馈的效率，以及任务本身需要多少反馈。这种拆法比单纯讨论“多采样、多工具调用、多轮反思”更接近可优化的训练信号。对预训练研究员来说，价值主要在于理解 test-time compute 为什么有时有效、有时只是增加噪声；也提示后续如果把交互轨迹用于 SFT/RL，轨迹质量不能只按长度或成功标签筛选，还要看反馈是否稳定、非冗余并被模型后续使用。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是 Effective Feedback Compute，简称 EFC。一个反馈事件只有同时满足 informative、valid、non-redundant、retained 才计入 EFC：它要提供新信息，信息要有效，不能只是重复已有观察，并且要真正进入后续决策。作者还定义了 harness efficiency η = EFC / C_raw，用来衡量 harness 把原始预算转成有效反馈的能力；以及 EFC / D_task，用任务需求归一化，避免把低反馈需求任务和高反馈需求任务放在同一尺度上比较。对于真实执行轨迹，作者使用 NRS-EFC，即 non-redundant stable EFC，强调稳定、保留的反馈，而不是短暂的交互噪声。方法上的关键区别是：它不是把 test-time compute 视为 token 或工具调用预算，而是把 agent 执行轨迹中的“可被后续利用的环境信息”作为 scaling 坐标。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三类设置：可控合成任务、可执行代码任务、真实 benchmark 轨迹，并包含 held-out 和 prospective holdout。受控 scaling 实验中，raw tokens 和 tool calls 的解释力较弱，R² 分别为 0.33 和 0.42；SAS 这个多变量 agent-system scaling baseline 达到 0.88；Oracle-EFC 和 Estimated-EFC 都达到 0.94；Oracle-EFC / D_task 达到 0.99，MAE 为 0.02。matched-budget intervention 中，在 raw cost 和 tool calls 匹配的情况下，提高反馈质量使成功率从 0.27 提升到 0.90。trace-time estimation 中，Estimated-EFC / D_task 达到 R² = 0.93，说明不用等待最终结果也能较好估计轨迹质量。模块消融显示，harness efficiency 对成功率变化的解释力为 R² = 0.97，而 raw cost 几乎不能解释。真实混合轨迹上，raw-compute baseline 的拟合接近 0 或为负，NRS-EFC 达到 R² = 0.89，NRS-EFC / D_task 达到 0.92。prospective holdout 中，NRS-EFC / D_task 的 held-out R² 为 0.85。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、Problem Formulation、EFC 定义和实验分解部分，预计 30–45 分钟。重点看三个地方：第一，EFC 的四个计分条件如何从轨迹中判定；第二，D_task 如何估计，因为任务需求归一化决定了跨任务比较是否可信；第三，matched-budget intervention 和 module ablation，这两组实验最能说明“有效反馈”不同于“花费更多”。如果关心 agent 训练数据构造，可以额外看 Estimated-EFC 和 NRS-EFC 的实现细节，它们更接近实际可用的轨迹过滤指标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what scalar should explain test-time scaling for agent harnesses. Raw tokens, tool calls, wall time, or cost do not distinguish useful environmental feedback from redundant or unstable interaction, so they often fail to predict whether an agent will actually solve the task.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a core pretraining contribution, but it is useful for understanding the interface between posttraining, agent evaluation, and inference-time compute allocation. Its main value is the decomposition of agent scaling into two factors: how efficiently a harness converts raw budget into usable feedback, and how much feedback the task demands. This is a cleaner view than treating longer traces or more tool calls as automatically better. For pretraining-oriented work, the main lesson is about trajectory quality: if interactive traces are used for SFT, RL, or verifier training, filtering by length or final success alone misses whether feedback was valid, non-redundant, stable, and retained by the policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The central construct is Effective Feedback Compute, or EFC. A feedback event receives credit only if it is informative, valid, non-redundant, and retained for later decisions. The authors then define harness efficiency, η = EFC / C_raw, to measure how much effective feedback is extracted per unit of raw budget. They also normalize by task demand, EFC / D_task, so tasks with different feedback requirements can be compared on a common scale. For real traces, they introduce NRS-EFC, non-redundant stable EFC, which discounts transient or repeated observations and emphasizes feedback that persists in the agent state. The main methodological difference from prior test-time scaling analyses is that the coordinate is not expenditure itself, but the portion of closed-loop feedback that can change future decisions.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans controllable synthetic tasks, executable code tasks, real benchmark traces, held-out splits, and a prospective holdout. In controlled scaling experiments, raw tokens and tool calls explain limited variation, with R² of 0.33 and 0.42. SAS, a stronger multivariate baseline, reaches 0.88. Oracle-EFC and Estimated-EFC both reach 0.94, while Oracle-EFC / D_task reaches 0.99 with MAE 0.02. In matched-budget interventions, improving feedback quality raises success from 0.27 to 0.90 while raw cost and tool calls are held fixed. Trace-time estimation gives R² = 0.93 for Estimated-EFC / D_task, indicating that the coordinate can be estimated before observing the final outcome. Module ablations show that harness efficiency explains success variation with R² = 0.97, whereas raw cost explains almost none. On mixed real traces, raw-compute baselines have near-zero or negative fit, while NRS-EFC reaches R² = 0.89 and NRS-EFC / D_task reaches 0.92. On a prospective holdout, NRS-EFC / D_task remains strongest with held-out R² = 0.85.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should focus on the Introduction, the formal definition of EFC, the task-demand normalization, and the ablation sections. Expected reading time is 30–45 minutes. The most useful parts are the four criteria for crediting feedback, the definition or estimation of D_task, and the matched-budget interventions showing that feedback quality can change success while raw expenditure stays fixed. Readers interested in agent training data should also inspect Estimated-EFC and NRS-EFC, since these are closer to practical trace-filtering signals than oracle EFC.

recommendation.zh: 只看 EFC 定义和 failure-rate 拟合结果；它会提醒别把 agent 的 token budget 当成干净 scaling 轴。
recommendation.en: Read the EFC definition and failure-rate fits; it is a useful warning against treating agent token budget as a clean scaling axis.

paper.title: LaneRoPE: Positional Encoding for Collaborative Parallel Reasoning and Generation
paper.abstract: Parallel LLM test-time scaling techniques (e.g., best-of-$N$) require drawing $N>1$ sequences conditioned on the same input prompt. These methods boost accuracy while exploiting the computational efficiency of batching $N$ generations. However, each sequence in the batch is traditionally generated independently and hence does not reuse intermediate generations, computations, or observations from other sequences. In this paper, we propose LaneRoPE to enable coordination and collaboration among $N

summary.core_problem: 现有批量并行生成的测试时扩展方法（如best-of-N、自一致性）中，同批次的多个生成序列相互独立，无法共享中间推理结果与计算，限制了性能提升空间与问题分解能力。
summary.importance: 提出了兼容现有Transformer架构与推理引擎的轻量级序列间协作方案，为测试时扩展提供了新的技术路径，其微调需求极低，可直接适配预训练完成的基座模型。
summary.technical_approach: 核心包含两部分设计：1）引入跨序列因果注意力掩码，允许每个序列的当前token关注所有序列的历史token，实现序列间的中间结果共享；2）对RoPE（旋转位置编码）进行扩展，在原有token维度的相对位置之外，增加序列（lane）维度的相对位置编码，使注意力机制能够区分不同序列的token，避免同位置token的位置编码冲突；该方案可兼容从独立采样到全连接注意力的多种并行推理模式，仅需不到0.5%的额外参数即可通过SFT强化协作能力。
summary.experiments: 在AIME、MATH500等数学推理数据集上对两款开源LLM进行评测，实现了稳定的准确率提升；方案可无缝集成到现有推理引擎，无需改动底层批量推理逻辑，合成的协作推理轨迹可直接用于微调。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2章的RoPE扩展与注意力掩码设计，以及第3章的微调数据合成方案；预计阅读时间20-25分钟，位置编码的数学推导部分可结合附录快速浏览，重点关注架构改动的最小化设计与兼容性实现。
summary.authors_note: UC Berkeley + Meta AI 联合团队

summary_en.core_problem: In existing batch-based parallel generation test-time scaling methods (such as best-of-N, self-consistency), multiple sequences in the same batch are generated independently, which prevents sharing of intermediate reasoning results and computation, limiting performance gains and problem decomposition capabilities.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes a lightweight inter-sequence collaboration scheme compatible with existing Transformer architectures and inference engines, providing a new technical path for test-time scaling. It requires minimal fine-tuning and can be directly adapted to pretrained base models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design includes two components: 1) A causal cross-sequence attention mask that allows the current token in each sequence to attend to historical tokens from all sequences, enabling intermediate result sharing across sequences. 2) An extension to RoPE (Rotary Positional Encoding) that adds relative positional encoding for the sequence (lane) dimension in addition to the original token-level relative positions, allowing the attention mechanism to distinguish tokens from different sequences and avoid positional encoding conflicts for tokens at the same step. The scheme supports multiple parallel reasoning modes ranging from independent sampling to fully connected attention, and can strengthen collaboration capabilities via SFT with less than 0.5% additional parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on two open-weight LLMs across mathematical reasoning datasets including AIME and MATH500, achieving consistent accuracy improvements. The scheme integrates seamlessly into existing inference engines without modifying underlying batch inference logic, and the synthesized collaborative reasoning traces can be directly used for fine-tuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 2 for RoPE extension and attention mask design, plus Chapter 3 for fine-tuning data synthesis pipeline. Estimated reading time is 20-25 minutes; the mathematical derivation of positional encoding can be skimmed with the appendix, and focus on the minimal modification design and compatibility implementation of the architecture changes.
summary_en.authors_note: UC Berkeley + Meta AI joint team

recommendation.zh: 独立 best-of-N 的 prior 被直接挑战；只看方法图和预算控制实验，若收益稳定，值得复现到内部推理解码栈。
recommendation.en: It directly challenges independent best-of-N sampling; read the method figure and budget-controlled results, then try reproducing it in an internal reasoning decoder if the gains hold.

paper.title: Automating Formal Verification with Agent-Guided Tree Search
paper.abstract: Formal verification offers a path to provably correct software, but writing verified code remains expensive enough that the technique is rarely used in production. Recent large language models can accelerate this work, and recent benchmarks measure their ability to translate specifications into code and machine-checked proofs of correctness. This thesis evaluates the state of such LLM-driven verified-code generation ("vericoding") in Lean and develops search-based methods for improving verificat

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 Lean 形式化验证里的一个很具体但常见的问题：单次采样式的 LLM 生成很难稳定写出可通过机器检查的证明或验证代码，而简单增加 sample 数 K 的收益又很快变差。作者关心的不是再训练一个更强模型，而是把现成模型放进带搜索的 agent loop 里，看看能否围绕“部分证明状态”和“上下文恢复”做更有效的探索，从而提高 vericoding 的通过率。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接贡献不大，更接近 agentic inference + formal reasoning harness 的工程研究。但它有两个启发点。第一，形式化验证这类可执行、可判定反馈的任务，很适合研究 test-time search 与外部 verifier 的闭环，这和代码、数学、proof assistant 方向的 post-train/RL 信号设计有关。第二，文中对不同模型的 think-block 发射、tool-call 行为、长上下文退化、搜索预算利用率做了较细的拆解，这些现象对理解“推理模型在可验证环境中的行为偏差”有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上分三层。第一层是基线复现：作者在 Lean 423-spec 子集上复现 vericoding benchmark 的一部分，比较多家闭源与开源模型，并单独统计 reasoning token / think block 的发射比例、多 block emission 现象，以及这些行为和通过率、token 开销的关系。第二层是 agent loop baseline：模型可以多轮调用工具，根据编译/验证反馈继续修补证明，作者记录前十轮的 tool-call 率、不同子集上的 solve rate，以及 K 扩大时的收益。第三层是搜索式 orchestrator。一个方向是 state-based search，即围绕“部分证明状态”分叉，派生 subagent 在不同中间状态上继续尝试；另一个方向是 context-based search，即不只搜索证明内容，也搜索 agent 所携带的上下文，尤其研究 empty-context resume 这类从更干净上下文重新启动的策略。最终版本把 state-based、resume、context-based 调度结合起来，目标是在相同或相近 token 预算下提高 pass rate。和普通 best-of-N 的区别在于，这里搜索节点不是完整答案，而是可继续扩展的中间验证状态或上下文配置；和单 agent 迭代修补的区别在于，它显式利用分支与恢复机制，避免错误上下文一路累积。
summary.experiments: 全文给出的实验资产主要是 Lean 423-spec 集合及其子集，评估指标是 solve/pass rate 相对 unique tokens 的曲线，以及不同 K 下的通过率。文中先做 cross-model reproduction，结论是：非 reasoning 型闭源模型相较旧基线大体持平，开源模型有小幅改善；同时不同模型在 think-block 发射比例和多段 thinking 行为上差异明显。agent baseline 部分展示了 K=10、K=50 等设置下的通过率，并按子集拆开看，说明简单堆采样能提升，但 token 成本增长很快，且不同任务子集收益不均。搜索部分的关键结果在表 4.1、4.4、4.7、4.9 与图 4.1-4.4：state-based orchestrator 相比普通 agent baseline 有稳定增益；加入 resume 后进一步改善，说明从失败轨迹中抽取可恢复状态是有用的；context-based search 也有效，尤其在上下文污染较重时；最终 orchestrator 在多种预算下都优于前述基线。由于给到的全文片段没有完整数值表格内容，无法可靠抄出每个模型和每个 K 的精确百分比，但从章节组织和图表命名可以确认，作者把 token 预算、子集差异、父代理与子代理的 tool-call 分布都做了系统消融，而不是只报一个最终分数。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看第 3.1 节和表 3.1-3.4，了解当前 Lean vericoding 的模型基线，以及 think-block 发射和验证表现之间并不简单正相关。然后看第 3.2 节，重点是图 3.2、图 3.4、表 3.6、表 3.7，理解单 agent 多轮修补的收益上限和工具使用模式。真正的方法部分在第 4 章。若时间有限，优先看 4.1.2-4.1.5 与 4.2.2-4.2.5，再对照图 4.1-4.4 和表 4.1、4.4、4.7、4.9。阅读时建议带着两个问题：一是搜索节点到底定义成“证明状态”还是“上下文快照”，会带来什么不同；二是 resume 为什么有用，它是在纠正模型推理错误，还是在清除被历史轨迹污染的上下文。预计 30-45 分钟可以抓住主要结论；若想借鉴到代码 agent 或 verifier-guided RL，值得细看 tool-call 分布和 round-2 dispatch / resume 行为。

summary_en.core_problem: The thesis studies a practical bottleneck in Lean-based formal verification: one-shot LLM generation is unreliable for producing machine-checkable proofs, while simply increasing best-of-N sampling becomes expensive and saturates quickly. The central question is whether search over partial proof states and agent contexts can improve verification success more efficiently than plain repeated sampling.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense. Its value is mostly on the inference-time orchestration side. Still, it is relevant for foundation-model researchers for two reasons. First, formal verification provides executable and binary feedback, making it a useful setting for studying verifier-in-the-loop search, post-training signals, and RL-style credit assignment. Second, the thesis carefully analyzes model behavior such as think-block emission, tool usage patterns, long-context degradation, and token-budget efficiency, which helps characterize how reasoning-oriented models behave in tightly constrained environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work has three layers. (1) Baseline reproduction: it reproduces part of the Lean vericoding benchmark on a cross-vendor model pool, measuring pass rates as well as reasoning-token emission, think-block frequency, and multi-block behavior. (2) Agent-loop baseline: instead of one-shot generation, the model iteratively calls tools, receives verifier/compiler feedback, and repairs its proof attempt over multiple turns. The study tracks solve rate by subset, per-turn tool-call rates, and scaling with K. (3) Search-based orchestration: the main contribution is to search not only over complete outputs but over intermediate proof states and context configurations. The state-based orchestrator branches from partial proof states and dispatches subagents to continue from different intermediate states. The context-based orchestrator searches over agent contexts, including resume strategies that restart from cleaner or reduced contexts. The final orchestrator combines state-based branching, resume, and context search. Compared with standard best-of-N, the search space is structured around extendable intermediate states; compared with a single iterative agent, it explicitly manages branching and recovery to avoid getting trapped in polluted trajectories.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are built around the Lean 423-spec set and its subsets. Metrics are pass/solve rate as a function of unique token budget, plus pass rate at different K values. The reproduction study reports that non-reasoning closed models are roughly flat relative to earlier baselines, while open-weight models improve modestly. It also shows substantial variation across models in think-block emission and multi-block reasoning behavior. The agent baseline demonstrates that larger K helps, but token costs rise quickly and gains vary by subset. The key results are in Chapter 4: the state-based orchestrator improves over the plain agent baseline; adding resume improves further, suggesting that recoverable intermediate states matter; context-based search also helps, especially when prior context becomes harmful; and the final orchestrator dominates earlier baselines across multiple token budgets. The provided text does not include the full numeric tables, so exact percentages cannot be quoted reliably here, but the thesis clearly includes ablations on token budget, subset difficulty, parent/subagent tool-call distributions, and resume behavior rather than only a final headline score.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick pass, start with Section 3.1 and Tables 3.1-3.4 to understand the current Lean vericoding baseline and the mismatch between visible reasoning emission and actual verification success. Then read Section 3.2, especially Figures 3.2 and 3.4 plus Tables 3.6 and 3.7, to see the limits of a single iterative agent. The main method is in Chapter 4. If time is limited, focus on Sections 4.1.2-4.1.5 and 4.2.2-4.2.5, together with Figures 4.1-4.4 and Tables 4.1, 4.4, 4.7, and 4.9. Two useful reading questions are: what changes when the search node is defined as a proof state versus a context snapshot, and why does resume help—does it repair reasoning errors or remove harmful context accumulation? About 30-45 minutes should be enough for the main ideas; a deeper read is worthwhile if you care about code agents, verifier-guided search, or RL with executable feedback.

recommendation.zh: 展示了 Agentic Search (Tree Search + Tool Use) 在形式化定理证明 (Lean) 中的强大 Scaling 能力，对理解 test-time compute 在严谨推理任务上的上限有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Demonstrates the strong scaling capability of Agentic Search (Tree Search + Tool Use) in formal theorem proving (Lean), valuable for understanding the upper bound of test-time compute on rigorous reasoning tasks.

paper.title: AgentFugue: Agent Scaling for Long-Horizon Tasks through Collective Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent progress on long-horizon agentic tasks has been driven largely by scaling up individual agents through stronger models, better tools, and more effective scaffolding. In contrast, much less is understood about scaling out: whether multiple peer agents, all targeting the same task, can become an additional source of capability without relying on explicit role specialization or workflow orchestration. We study this question and propose AgentFugue, a collective reasoning framework built aroun

summary.core_problem: 论文研究长程 Agent 能力是否可以通过“横向扩展”获得：多个同级 Agent 并行处理同一个任务，在不预设角色、不拆分子任务、不设计固定工作流的情况下，能否通过交换中间进展提升整体与单个轨迹的表现。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关系不强，但对推理时计算扩展和 Agent 训练信号有参考意义。它把多 Agent 的收益来源从“角色分工”转向“并行搜索轨迹的复用”，这和 test-time scaling、self-consistency、tree search 的问题相近：额外计算是否只是增加采样数，还是能通过中间状态共享改变搜索分布。若后续能证明 hub 的读写策略可以稳定提升样本效率，它也可能成为构造长程推理 SFT/RL 数据的一种机制。
summary.technical_approach: AgentFugue 的核心是一个共享 reasoning hub。每个 Agent 仍独立探索同一任务；当一个 Agent 完成一段相对完整的交互 episode 后，hub 将其压缩成简短 note，记录已经确认的事实、尝试过的路线、被排除的分支。其他 Agent 在后续搜索时可以选择性读取这些 note，而不是接收完整轨迹。这个设计避免两类常见问题：完全不通信时，多 Agent 只是独立采样；无限制通信时，长轨迹噪声会污染上下文，并可能让不同 Agent 过早收敛到同一条路线。hub 不是中央规划器，不负责拆任务或分配角色，而是外部通信层。论文还区分了同构团队和异构团队：同构设置用于检验收益是否来自跨轨迹信息复用；异构设置用于检验不同模型或配置的搜索偏置是否互补。实现上，hub 的 write/read 函数由一个中等规模语言模型承担，并经过监督微调和端到端强化学习，使其学会写出有用的中间摘要，并在完整 Agent loop 中返回更能帮助当前搜索的指导。
summary.experiments: 论文在长程任务上评估，包括信息搜索、开放式问题求解和多步网页推理。引言中给出的主要结论是：同构和异构团队都能从 AgentFugue 获益，收益不仅体现在团队成功率，也体现在组成团队的单个 Agent 轨迹质量和效率上。给定内容没有披露具体 benchmark 名称、模型配置、Agent 数量、成本预算和提升幅度，因此数字结论需要结合实验章节核对。需要重点看同等 compute 下与独立并行采样、简单投票、全量轨迹共享、固定多 Agent 工作流的对比，否则很难判断 hub 的收益是否来自通信机制本身。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。优先看方法部分中 hub 的 write、retrieve、read 接口定义，以及 SFT/RL 训练 hub 的数据来源和奖励设计。实验部分重点看三类对照：无通信的并行 Agent、共享完整轨迹的 Agent、以及带预设角色的多 Agent workflow。消融里最关键的是 note 长度、检索策略、hub 模型规模、Agent 数量增加时的边际收益。如果实验只报告总成功率而缺少 token 成本和 wall-clock 成本，结论要保守理解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether long-horizon agents can gain capability by scaling out: multiple peer agents work on the same task in parallel, without predefined roles, task decomposition, or a fixed orchestration workflow, and reuse each other’s intermediate progress.
summary_en.importance: The connection to foundation-model pretraining is indirect, but the paper is relevant to inference-time scaling and the construction of training signals for long-horizon reasoning. Its main framing separates multi-agent gains from role specialization and instead studies cross-trajectory reuse. This is close to questions behind self-consistency, tree search, and test-time compute: does extra compute merely add more samples, or can communication between partial searches change the effective search distribution? If the hub policy is shown to improve sample efficiency reliably, it could also become a useful mechanism for generating SFT or RL traces for agentic reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentFugue introduces a shared reasoning hub. Each agent explores the same task independently. After an agent finishes a coherent interaction episode, the hub writes a compact note describing what was established, what was attempted, and what was ruled out. Other agents can later retrieve selected notes that are relevant to their current search state. This is meant to avoid two failure modes: with no communication, the system reduces to independent sampling; with unrestricted communication, raw trajectory noise can dominate the context and collapse exploration diversity. The hub is not a central planner. It does not assign roles or decompose the task. It acts as an external communication layer. The paper studies both homogeneous teams, where all gains must come from trajectory interaction, and heterogeneous teams, where different models or configurations may contribute complementary biases. The hub’s write and read functions are instantiated with a moderate-sized language model and improved with supervised fine-tuning followed by end-to-end reinforcement learning inside the full agent loop.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates the method on long-horizon settings covering information seeking, open-ended problem solving, and multi-step web reasoning. The introduction reports gains for both homogeneous and heterogeneous teams, including improvements in team-level success and in the quality or efficiency of individual trajectories. The provided content does not include concrete benchmark names, model sizes, number of agents, compute budgets, or numerical gains. The key empirical question is whether AgentFugue beats independent parallel sampling, majority voting, full-trajectory sharing, and role-based workflows under matched compute.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on the method section that defines the hub’s write, retrieve, and read operations, and on the data and reward design used to train the hub with SFT and RL. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against no-communication parallel agents, full-context sharing, and explicitly orchestrated multi-agent baselines. The most informative ablations should cover note length, retrieval policy, hub model size, number of agents, and marginal returns under increasing compute. Interpret results cautiously if success rates are not paired with token cost and wall-clock cost.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设置和消融；如果总 token 预算没控干净，多 agent 收益只能当弱信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the setup and ablations; without a clean total-token budget, the multi-agent gain is only a weak signal.

paper.title: Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation for Adaptive Test-Time Reasoning
paper.abstract: Sampling multiple responses improves language model reasoning, but uniform compute allocation is inefficient: easy questions are over-sampled while hard questions remain under-explored. We propose Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation (UAB), a concave integer optimization framework that reallocates a fixed sampling budget based on per-question uncertainty estimated at no additional inference cost. In Phase 1, every question receives one generation; its average negative log-likelihood (ANLL), extra

summary.core_problem: 在固定测试时采样预算下，如何把更多计算分给不确定样本，而不是对所有问题平均多采样。
summary.importance: 这是 test-time compute allocation 问题。对预训练研究员的价值不在具体算法本身，而在于它把“推理时 scaling”写成了一个明确的预算分配问题，并给出几乎零额外成本的不确定性信号。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation（UAB）。第一阶段先给每个问题生成一次答案，并直接从输出 log-prob 计算平均负对数似然（ANLL）作为难度/不确定性指标；这次生成本身也参与最终投票。第二阶段把剩余预算写成一个凹整数优化问题，用 marginal-greedy 算法精确求解其 coverage-maximization surrogate，使高不确定问题获得更多采样次数。
summary.experiments: 评测覆盖 1.5B 到 27B 的 6 个开源和闭源模型，以及 5 个推理 benchmark。摘要表明该方法优于均匀预算分配，在相同预算下提升准确率或在相同效果下降低采样成本。实验广度尚可，但从预训练视角看，更关键的是看 ANLL 是否真能跨模型稳定预测 self-consistency 收益，以及在不同任务分布下是否会误配预算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to allocate a fixed test-time sampling budget adaptively, instead of spending equal compute on every question.
summary_en.importance: This is a test-time compute allocation paper. Its value for pretraining researchers is less about the specific algorithm and more about making inference-time scaling explicit as a budget allocation problem with a near-zero-cost uncertainty signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation (UAB). In phase 1, each question gets one generation, and the average negative log-likelihood (ANLL) from output log-probabilities is used as a difficulty/uncertainty signal; that generation also counts toward the final vote. In phase 2, the remaining budget is allocated through a concave integer optimization objective, solved by a marginal-greedy algorithm on a coverage-maximization surrogate, so uncertain questions receive more samples.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation covers 6 open-weight and black-box models from 1.5B to 27B parameters and 5 reasoning benchmarks. The abstract claims better accuracy than uniform allocation under the same budget, or lower cost at matched performance. For a pretraining audience, the key question is whether ANLL robustly predicts marginal gains from extra sampling across models and task distributions.

recommendation.zh: 偏 test-time engineering，不会直接改预训练 recipe；看不确定性定义和预算分配曲线就够了，若 ANLL 真能稳健预测额外采样收益，可借去做 inference-time scaling 分析。
recommendation.en: Mostly test-time engineering, not a pretraining recipe changer; read the uncertainty definition and allocation curves—if ANLL really predicts marginal gains from extra samples, it is useful for inference-time scaling analysis.

paper.title: Stabilizing Recurrent Dynamics for Test-Time Scalable Latent Reasoning in Looped Language Models
paper.abstract: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) enable efficient latent reasoning through depth recurrence, yet exhibit unreliable test-time scaling behavior: performance often peaks at a certain iteration depth and then collapses with further recurrence. Through latent dynamics analysis, we find an inherent trade-off between stability and effectiveness in existing architectures and strategies. By conceptualizing reasoning as uncertainty reduction, we propose that convergence toward stable fixed points while p

summary.core_problem: 循环语言模型（LoopLMs）在测试时通过增加循环深度（test-time scaling）进行推理时，表现出不稳定的扩展行为：性能通常在特定迭代深度达到峰值，随后随着进一步循环而急剧下降甚至崩溃。
summary.importance: 揭示了 LoopLMs 中隐藏状态的有效性（信息流动）与稳定性（有界性）之间的内在矛盾，并提出了一种通过约束雅可比矩阵谱半径来稳定循环动态的训练框架，为实现可靠的测试时扩展推理提供了新的理论视角和实用方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 STARS（STAbility-driven Recurrent Scaling）框架。核心思想是将推理视为减少不确定性的过程，要求隐藏状态收敛到既有效又稳定的不动点。方法上，利用李雅普诺夫线性化定理，通过雅可比谱半径正则化（JSRR）约束训练，迫使模型收敛到渐近稳定的不动点。为降低计算成本，采用单步幂迭代结合雅可比-向量积（JVP）进行高效估计，并结合随机循环采样进行全局优化。
summary.experiments: 在随机初始化的 Transformer 上进行基础算术任务实验，并在预训练的 LoopLM 上进行复杂数学推理任务微调。结果表明，STARS 在算术任务上实现了完全可靠的测试时扩展。在 GSM8K 上，基线模型 Ouro-1.4B 在 8 步循环后性能下降 20.47%，而 STARS 仅下降 8.26%，同时峰值性能提升了 4.01%。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对有效性与稳定性权衡的分析，以及 STARS 框架中 JSRR 的高效实现细节。关注实验部分中不同循环深度下的性能变化曲线，以直观理解方法的有效性。

summary_en.core_problem: Looped Language Models (LoopLMs) exhibit unreliable test-time scaling behavior during reasoning: performance typically peaks at a specific iteration depth and then sharply degrades or collapses with further recurrence.
summary_en.importance: Uncovers the inherent trade-off between the effectiveness (information flow) and stability (boundedness) of hidden states in LoopLMs. Proposes a training framework that stabilizes recurrent dynamics by constraining the spectral radius of the Jacobian matrix, offering a novel theoretical perspective and practical method for reliable test-time scalable reasoning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the STARS (STAbility-driven Recurrent Scaling) framework. The core idea conceptualizes reasoning as uncertainty reduction, requiring hidden states to converge to effective and stable fixed points. Methodologically, it leverages the Lyapunov Linearization Theorem to constrain training via Jacobian Spectral Radius Regularization (JSRR), forcing the model towards asymptotically stable fixed points. To mitigate computational costs, it employs an efficient estimation scheme combining single-step power iteration with Jacobian-vector products (JVP), alongside random loop sampling for global optimization.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on basic arithmetic tasks with randomly initialized Transformers and complex mathematical reasoning tasks by fine-tuning pre-trained LoopLMs. Results show STARS achieves fully reliable test-time scaling on arithmetic tasks. On GSM8K, while the baseline Ouro-1.4B drops 20.47% from its peak after 8 recurrent steps, STARS degrades by only 8.26%, while simultaneously improving peak performance by 4.01%.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of the effectiveness-stability trade-off in the Introduction and the efficient implementation details of JSRR in the STARS framework. Pay attention to the performance curves across different recurrent depths in the experiments to intuitively grasp the method's efficacy.

recommendation.zh: 针对循环推理LM的测试时深度扩展不稳定问题，提出的谱半径正则化方案可参考，重点看§3的正则化实现细节
recommendation.en: The spectral radius regularization scheme for stabilizing test-time depth scaling of recurrent reasoning LMs is worth referencing; focus on §3 for implementation details

paper.title: Share More, Search Less: Collaborative Parallel Thinking for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-Time Scaling (TTS) enhances the reasoning capabilities of large language models by allocating additional inference compute to explore the solution space. However, existing parallel TTS methods typically keep branches isolated during search: intermediate discoveries remain branch-private and cannot guide other branches in time. This information isolation causes substantial redundant exploration, as branches repeatedly rediscover information already found elsewhere and require more search ste

summary.core_problem: 解决并行 test-time scaling 中各搜索分支互不通信，导致重复探索和推理 token 浪费的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是训练无关的推理时搜索框架，目标是提高额外推理计算的利用率；它不是 scaling law，也不是预训练方法，但对推理时计算分配和 reasoning serving 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Collaborative Parallel Thinking。框架从正在运行的并行分支中抽取紧凑中间信息，维护 query 级去重信息池，再通过输入上下文广播给后续搜索步骤，让其他分支复用已经发现的线索，减少重复搜索。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、任务集合、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度。实验目标应是与分支隔离式 parallel TTS 方法对比，衡量在相同或更少搜索步数下的推理正确率和计算效率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses redundant exploration in parallel test-time scaling, where search branches do not share intermediate discoveries.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training-free inference-time search framework aimed at improving the utility of extra reasoning compute. It is not a scaling-law or pretraining result, but it is relevant to compute allocation in reasoning-time serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: Collaborative Parallel Thinking extracts compact intermediate information from active branches, stores deduplicated query-level entries in an information pool, and broadcasts them through the input context so later branch steps can reuse discoveries from other branches.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, task suites, baseline names, or numerical gains. The intended comparison is against isolated-branch parallel TTS methods, measuring accuracy and compute efficiency under comparable or reduced search budgets.

recommendation.zh: 当作推理服务技巧看，不必精读；只查信息池如何压缩和广播，容易被上下文污染反噬。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an inference-serving trick; inspect only the pool compression and broadcast mechanism, where context contamination is the obvious failure mode.

paper.title: Cast a Wider Net: Coordinated Pass@K Policy Optimization for Code Reasoning
paper.abstract: Repeated sampling with a verifier is the standard way to allocate test-time compute for code generation, with pass@$K$ as the canonical metric. Yet the standard policy class draws $K$ independent samples from a single answer distribution, so attempts often collapse onto near-duplicate reasoning paths and waste the budget on redundant rollouts. This failure is costly in competitive programming, where many problems admit multiple distinct algorithmic strategies and pass@$K$ requires only one corre

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是代码生成中 pass@K 训练和推理的冗余采样问题：固定 K 次尝试时，独立采样往往落在相近解法上，浪费了验证器预算。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于 post-training 和 test-time compute 方向，对预训练研究的间接价值在于它重新定义了“多次采样”的策略空间。它不是让同一个分布独立吐出 K 个答案，而是训练模型联合生成 K 个互补策略，再分别求解。这对推理型模型的数据合成、RL credit assignment、verifier-driven training 有参考意义，尤其适合分析 pass@K 指标下训练目标与推理策略不匹配的问题。
summary.technical_approach: CPPO 将 pass@K 从独立答案采样改成联合策略探索。模型先由 planner 自回归生成 K=4 个高层算法策略，每个策略会条件化在前面的策略上，以减少重复；随后共享 solver 针对每个策略生成一个解答。训练时使用两层奖励：solver token 接收分支级 verifier 反馈，即每个解答是否通过；planner token 接收 tuple 级奖励，即 K 个分支中是否至少一个成功。为避免 planner 生成格式不合规、重复策略或泄漏答案，作者加入窄域 plan-validity gate Jψ，并使用乘法奖励 R_plan = Jψ · R_out。优化上采用 planner 与 solver token 分区的 GRPO 更新，使策略规划和具体求解获得不同粒度的 credit。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 APPS、CodeContests 和 LiveCodeBench-v6，固定 K=4，并比较独立采样、prompt planning、inference-time plan search、pass@K-oriented RL、diversity-oriented RL、planner-only SFT 等基线。作者报告 CPPO 在 9 个模型规模与 benchmark 组合上都超过最强非 CPPO 基线，其中 6 个组合在 paired bootstrap 下达到 p<0.05。相对 Tuple Planner SFT，pass@4 提升为 +0.08 到 +0.30，说明仅做 planner SFT 不够，联合 planner-solver RL 有额外收益。最大单项增益出现在 Qwen3.5-9B 的 LiveCodeBench-v6：相对 PKPO 从 0.588 提升到 0.748，增幅 +0.16。论文还报告增益在更大尝试预算下仍然存在。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 分钟。重点看第 3 节的策略分解、planner/solver token 区域如何划分、乘法 planner reward 的定义，以及 validity gate 为什么必要。实验部分优先看 Table 1 和 Figure 2，再看 matched iid-inference ablation 与 planner SFT 对照，这两处能判断提升来自联合策略建模，而不只是 prompt 模板或更多训练。若关心 RL 训练信号质量，建议细看奖励门控是否会引入偏置，以及 planner 是否真的学到互补算法策略。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses redundancy in pass@K code generation: with a fixed budget of K attempts, iid sampling often produces near-duplicate solutions that follow the same algorithmic path.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is in post-training and test-time compute rather than base pretraining. Its relevance is that it changes the policy class for repeated sampling. Instead of drawing K answers independently from one distribution, the model is trained to produce a coordinated set of complementary strategies and then solve once per strategy. This is useful for thinking about verifier-driven training, credit assignment under pass@K objectives, and data generation for reasoning models where diversity at the strategy level matters more than surface-form variation.
summary_en.technical_approach: CPPO reframes pass@K as joint exploration over strategies. A planner autoregressively emits a tuple of K=4 high-level methods, where each method is conditioned on the previous ones. A shared solver then generates one solution for each method. Credit is assigned at two levels. Solver tokens receive branch-level verifier feedback for each generated solution. Planner tokens receive a tuple-level outcome reward that reflects whether at least one branch succeeds. Because tuple-level rewards are sparse and can be exploited by malformed, duplicated, or answer-leaking plans, the planner reward is gated by a narrow plan-validity model Jψ, giving R_plan = Jψ · R_out. The model is optimized with split-region GRPO updates over planner and solver token regions.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover APPS, CodeContests, and LiveCodeBench-v6 under a fixed K=4 budget. Baselines include iid sampling, prompt-based planning, inference-time plan search, pass@K-oriented RL, diversity-oriented RL, and planner-only SFT. CPPO improves over the strongest non-CPPO baseline in all nine reported size-benchmark cells, with six cells significant under paired bootstrap at p<0.05. Compared with Tuple Planner SFT, pass@4 gains range from +0.08 to +0.30, indicating that planner initialization alone does not explain the result. The largest reported gain is on Qwen3.5-9B for LiveCodeBench-v6, where CPPO improves over PKPO from 0.588 to 0.748, a +0.16 absolute increase. The paper also reports that gains persist at larger attempt budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: A productive skim takes about 30 minutes. Focus on Section 3: the planner-solver factorization, the separation of planner and solver token regions, the multiplicative planner reward, and the role of the validity gate. In the experiments, Table 1 and Figure 2 are the main entry points. The matched iid-inference ablation and the comparison against Tuple Planner SFT are important for checking whether the gains come from coordinated strategy modeling rather than prompt formatting or additional supervised tuning. For readers interested in RL signal quality, the key issue is whether the validity gate improves credit assignment without steering the planner toward overly narrow plan formats.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 pretrain，但对 test-time scaling 很实在：把 K 次采样从“独立抽样”改成“协调探索”，值得看 reward 设计和失败案例，别只盯平均 pass@K。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but useful for test-time scaling: it turns K samples from independent draws into coordinated exploration; read the reward design and failure cases, not just the pass@K headline.

paper.title: Beyond the Frontier: Stochastic Backtracking for Efficient Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling improves language model reasoning by spending additional compute to explore multiple solution trajectories. The key challenge is to maximize accuracy while minimizing the total number of generated tokens during reasoning. Recent PRM-guided methods score intermediate prefixes to steer this search, but most are frontier-only: they keep only the current active prefixes and irreversibly prune or resample away the rest using noisy PRM scores. This can cause premature commitment, div

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 test-time scaling 里一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：PRM 引导的搜索通常只保留当前 frontier，上一步被剪掉的 prefix 以后就再也回不来。若 PRM 对中间步骤打分有噪声，这种“只看前沿、不可回退”的机制会把局部误判放大成不可逆决策，导致过早承诺、搜索多样性塌缩，以及本来还能通向正确答案的轨迹被永久丢弃。论文的目标不是再训练一个更好的 PRM，而是在现有 PRM 不完美的前提下，重新设计搜索记忆与选择机制，让历史 prefix 仍可被重新访问，从而改善准确率与 token 开销之间的权衡。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身没有直接贡献，但对 pretrain↔posttrain 接口很有参考价值，尤其是“模型能力固定时，如何把额外推理算力花得更有效”这个问题。它的重要性主要有两点。第一，论文把很多 TTS 方法的共同脆弱点讲清楚了：问题不只是 PRM 不准，而是 frontier-only search 把 PRM 的局部误差变成永久性剪枝。这个分析对理解 PRM、value model、search policy 的耦合关系很有帮助。第二，它提出的 persistent pool + stochastic backtracking，本质上是在有限内存下给搜索加入可恢复性，和训练时讨论 exploration、credit assignment、noisy proxy signal 时的思路是相通的。贡献量级更像是对现有 PRM-guided decoding 的稳健性改造，而不是新的推理范式。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把搜索状态从“当前 frontier”改成“历史 prefix 的持久池”。每一轮仍只扩展固定预算的 N 个新 prefix，因此运行 t 轮后池子大小至多是 Nt，内存是线性增长，而不是保存整棵指数级搜索树。关键点在于：历史 prefix 不会因为某一轮没被选中就彻底失效，后续仍可重新进入扩展候选。

在这个框架上，论文给了两个具体实例。

第一是 Subpool Selection。它不是直接在全历史池上做全局 top-k，因为那样仍会被少数被高估的错误 prefix 长期垄断；也不是均匀从历史里抽，因为那会把 token 浪费在明显陈旧或低质量状态上。它的做法是先从历史池随机抽一个子池，再在子池内部按 PRM 分数选 top 候选。这样做相当于在保留 PRM 引导的同时，给被“挡住”的低估 prefix 一个重新浮出的机会。可以把它理解成对贪心 PRM 排序加了一层受控随机化，目的是打破错误高分节点的长期阻塞。

第二是 Power Backtrack SMC。论文把 SMC 风格的 sequential sampling 从 frontier 扩展到 persistent pool，允许从历史 prefix 混合采样，再用 powered PRM scores 和 mixture-corrected importance weights 做校正。这里的“power”相当于调节 PRM 分数对采样分布的尖锐程度；“mixture correction”则是因为候选来自多轮历史状态的混合分布，需要做重要性修正，避免估计偏掉。相比普通 SMC 只在当前粒子集上重采样，这个版本允许搜索在历史上回跳，因此更能从早期误剪枝中恢复。

论文还花了不少篇幅说明理论对象与实际 PRM 的错位。理想目标是 prefix 的真实可完成性，即从该 prefix 出发最终得到正确答案的边缘概率；但现实中的 PRM 通常是用二值标签或外部 rollout 监督训练出来的代理分数，既不一定校准，也不一定匹配当前部署的 base LLM continuation behavior。作者强调，真正脆弱的不是“PRM 有噪声”这件事本身，而是 frontier-only 结构把这种噪声变成不可逆决策。这是全文最值得记住的机制判断。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见，实验重点放在数学推理场景，比较的是 accuracy-token trade-off，而不是只看固定采样预算下的最终正确率。作者把方法和几类强基线比较：Best-of-N / self-consistency 这类独立完整采样方法，以及 beam / tree search / SMC 这类 PRM-guided frontier-only 方法。结论比较稳定：在相同 token 预算下，Subpool Selection 和 Power Backtrack SMC 往往能得到更高准确率；或者在达到相同准确率时，需要更少 token。

论文强调这种收益在 PRM 分数有噪声、局部排序不可靠时更明显，因为历史可回访能修复早期误判。消融部分的主要信息有三类。第一，只做 persistent pool 但仍用过于贪心的全局选择，收益有限，说明“保留历史”本身不够，还需要合适的随机化选择机制。第二，随机化太强也不行，会退化成低效探索，因此子池大小、power 温度、重采样策略都在 exploitation 和 recovery 之间做平衡。第三，方法在不同模型尺度上都能改善 token 效率，说明它不是只对某个特定 base model 或 PRM 过拟合。

给出的全文片段里没有完整表格数字，因此无法可靠复述每个 benchmark、参数量和提升幅度的精确值；但实验设计和结论方向是清楚的：作者不是追求绝对最高准确率，而是把“每个额外 token 是否花在更有恢复价值的轨迹上”作为核心指标。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Problem Setup。这里把 frontier-only failure 讲得最清楚，尤其是理想 prefix target 与实际 PRM proxy 的区别。若只想抓住论文价值，这两部分已经够用。

然后看两个方法部分：Subpool Selection 先读直觉和算法框图，再看它为什么能绕开高分错误节点的阻塞；Power Backtrack SMC 则重点看采样分布、powered score 和 mixture-corrected weights 的定义，不必一开始就陷进全部推导。

实验建议优先看 accuracy-token 曲线，而不是单点结果。因为论文真正比较的是 token efficiency。再看 ablation：persistent pool、随机子池、power 参数、历史回访频率各自带来什么变化。预计 30–45 分钟可以完成一次有效泛读；若你做 PRM-guided search 或 test-time compute allocation，值得把方法细节和附录公式再过一遍。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in PRM-guided test-time scaling: most search procedures are frontier-only. Once a prefix is pruned at an intermediate step, it is gone forever. If PRM scores on partial reasoning traces are noisy or misaligned with the deployed generator, this turns a local scoring error into an irreversible decision. The result is premature commitment, reduced diversity, and the loss of prefixes that could still lead to correct completions. The paper does not try to build a better PRM; it redesigns the search memory and selection mechanism so that previously generated prefixes remain revisitable.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface because it studies how to spend extra inference compute more effectively when model weights are fixed. Its main value is conceptual. First, it isolates a structural weakness shared by many PRM-guided decoding methods: the issue is not only PRM noise, but the fact that frontier-only search makes local PRM mistakes permanent. Second, the proposed persistent-pool backtracking gives search a recovery mechanism under a linear-memory budget. That is useful for anyone thinking about noisy proxy signals, exploration under limited compute, or the coupling between reward models and search policies. The contribution is best read as a robustness improvement to existing PRM-guided reasoning, not as a new reasoning paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The central idea is to replace the usual frontier state with a persistent pool of historical prefixes. Each round still expands only a fixed budget of N new prefixes, so after t rounds the pool size is at most Nt. This keeps memory growth linear rather than storing the full exponential tree. The key change is that a prefix that was not selected in one round is not permanently discarded; it can be reconsidered later.

The paper instantiates this idea in two ways.

The first is Subpool Selection. A naive global top-k over the full history would still be dominated by a few over-scored but ultimately wrong prefixes. Uniform sampling from history would waste tokens on stale or low-quality states. Subpool Selection instead samples a random historical subpool and then applies PRM-based ranking within that shortlist. This preserves PRM guidance while giving under-scored prefixes a chance to re-enter expansion. In effect, it adds controlled stochasticity on top of greedy PRM ranking to break long-lived blocking by falsely high-scored nodes.

The second is Power Backtrack SMC. This extends SMC-style sequential sampling from the current frontier to a persistent historical pool. Prefixes are sampled from a mixture over historical states, with powered PRM scores controlling how sharp the proposal distribution is, and mixture-corrected importance weights compensating for the fact that candidates come from multiple historical proposal sources. Compared with standard frontier-only SMC, this version can jump back to earlier states and recover from bad pruning decisions.

A strong part of the paper is its treatment of target mismatch. The ideal quantity is the true marginal probability that a prefix can still be completed into a correct final answer under the deployed generator. Real PRMs are usually trained on binary supervision or stronger rollout policies, so their scores are only proxies. They may be uncalibrated and may not match the continuation behavior of the base LLM used at inference. The paper’s main mechanism claim is that the real brittleness comes from combining this imperfect proxy with irreversible frontier-only pruning.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on mathematical reasoning and evaluate the accuracy–token trade-off rather than only final accuracy at a fixed sample count. The proposed methods are compared against strong baselines from two families: independent full-sample methods such as Best-of-N and self-consistency, and PRM-guided frontier-only methods such as beam search, tree search, and SMC variants. The qualitative result is consistent: at the same token budget, Subpool Selection and Power Backtrack SMC usually achieve higher accuracy; or, for the same target accuracy, they require fewer generated tokens.

The gains are most visible when PRM scores are noisy or only weakly correlated with eventual correctness, because historical revisiting can repair early mistakes. The ablations carry three main messages. First, persistence alone is not enough: keeping history but using overly greedy global selection gives limited benefit. Second, too much randomness also hurts, so subpool size, power temperature, and resampling policy all matter as exploration–exploitation controls. Third, the improvements appear across model scales, suggesting the effect is not tied to a single base model or PRM.

The provided full-text excerpt does not include the complete result tables, so it would be unsafe to invent exact benchmark numbers, model sizes, or deltas. Still, the experimental design is clear: the paper is optimizing token efficiency under extra test-time compute, not just chasing the highest absolute accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and the problem setup. Those sections explain the failure mode cleanly, especially the distinction between the ideal prefix target and the practical PRM proxy. If you only want the main idea, that part already carries most of the paper.

Then read the two method sections. For Subpool Selection, focus on the intuition and the algorithm sketch: why random shortlists help bypass over-scored blockers. For Power Backtrack SMC, focus on the proposal distribution, the role of powered scores, and the mixture-corrected weights. You do not need every derivation on the first pass.

In the experiments, prioritize the accuracy-versus-token curves rather than single operating points, because token efficiency is the real objective. Then read the ablations on persistent pooling, stochastic selection, and backtracking frequency. A useful skim should take about 30–45 minutes. If you work on PRM-guided search or test-time compute allocation, the method details and appendix formulas are worth a closer pass.

recommendation.zh: Test-time scaling是LLM推理时计算分配的核心方向，随机回溯挑战了前沿搜索的不可逆假设，值得看方法部分和实验对比。
recommendation.en: Test-time scaling is central to LLM inference-time compute allocation; stochastic backtracking challenges the irreversible frontier search assumption—read the method section.

paper.title: CoSPlay: Cooperative Self-Play at Test-Time with Self-Generated Code and Unit Test
paper.abstract: Recently, Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) and Test-Time Scaling (TTS) have advanced LLM code generation through executable verification. Yet Ground-Truth Unit Tests (GT UTs) remain a bottleneck: SOTA RLVR methods require them for costly training, while existing TTS methods lose competitiveness without them. This motivates GT-free TTS, where existing methods directly use self-generated UTs to refine and select code candidates. Yet such UTs are often noisy or spuriously coupl

summary.core_problem: 代码生成的 RLVR 和 test-time scaling 往往依赖真实单元测试；没有 ground-truth unit tests 时，自生成测试容易噪声大，并可能与错误代码相互强化。
summary.importance: 这是代码生成中的训练无关 test-time 方法。它对预训练研究的间接价值在于展示了可执行验证信号如何在没有人工测试的情况下自举，可能为代码 RLVR 数据构造和 verifier 设计提供弱信号。
summary.technical_approach: CoSPlay 采用 cooperative self-play，同时改进候选代码和自生成单元测试。它先探索多样化解法与潜在失败模式，生成更有区分度的测试思路；随后构造 Code-UT execution matrix，用代码通过测试和测试区分代码的双向 pass-count 信号迭代剪枝与选择。
summary.experiments: 摘要未提供具体 benchmark、模型规模或提升幅度。实验重点应是与依赖 ground-truth unit tests 的 RLVR/TTS 方法，以及直接使用自生成 UT 的 GT-free 方法比较，在无真实测试设置下评估代码候选选择质量。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)、Institute of Deep Perception Technology、JITRI 和 Wuxi。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR and test-time scaling for code generation often depend on ground-truth unit tests; without them, self-generated tests can be noisy and spuriously coupled with wrong code.
summary_en.importance: This is a training-free test-time method for code generation. Its indirect value for base-model researchers is the self-bootstrapping of executable verification signals without human-provided tests, which may inform RLVR data and verifier design.
summary_en.technical_approach: CoSPlay jointly improves code candidates and self-generated unit tests through cooperative self-play. It explores diverse solution ideas and likely failure modes to generate discriminative test ideas, then uses a Code-UT execution matrix and bidirectional pass-count signals to iteratively prune and select both code and tests.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide benchmark names, model sizes, or numerical gains. The intended comparison is against RLVR/TTS methods that use ground-truth unit tests and GT-free methods that directly rely on self-generated tests.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed affiliations include The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou), Institute of Deep Perception Technology, JITRI, and Wuxi.

recommendation.zh: 看 Code-UT execution matrix 就够了；方法像工程自举，但对无标注 verifier 信号有可借鉴细节。
recommendation.en: Skim the Code-UT execution matrix; the method is mostly engineering self-bootstrapping, but the verifier signal is reusable.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)
Institute of Deep Perception Technology, JITRI, Wuxi

paper.title: Guided Trajectory Optimization with Sparse Scaling for Test-Time Diffusion
paper.abstract: The efficient Test-Time Scaling (TTS) paradigm offers a promising perspective for enhancing the generation performance of diffusion models. However, current solutions are limited to a static, pre-defined noise pool and suffer from inflexible noise exploration across the denoising trajectory. To bridge this gap, we propose RTS, a novel Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling method to fully unlock the generative potential of diffusion models. Unlike existing methods, RTS facilitates the synthesis of ref

summary.core_problem: 提升扩散图像生成模型的 test-time scaling 效率和效果，避免固定噪声池带来的搜索僵化。
summary.importance: 贡献是图像扩散模型推理期搜索方法。它不是语言建模工作，但 reward-guided test-time compute allocation 对理解生成模型的推理期扩展有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: RTS 提出 Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling：一方面用 reward signal 优化噪声，使搜索主动朝高质量样本区域移动；另一方面用 sparse test-time scaling 只在关键 denoising step 上投入额外搜索。PCA-driven curvature analysis 用来识别轨迹中更值得扩展的中间步骤，从而压缩搜索空间。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 RTS 在 GenEval Score 上相对 baseline 提升 15.6%，ImageReward 分数提升 60.4%。未从摘要中看到模型规模、采样预算、reward model 细节和完整 baseline 设置。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Guangdong University of Technology、South China University of Technology 和 Nanyang Technological University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves test-time scaling for diffusion image generation by replacing static noise-pool exploration with guided trajectory optimization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time search method for image diffusion models. It is not language modeling, but its reward-guided compute allocation is a useful analogy for test-time scaling in generative systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: RTS introduces Reward-guided Trajectory Scaling. It optimizes noise using reward feedback to steer sampling toward promising regions, and applies sparse test-time scaling only at selected denoising steps. A PCA-driven curvature analysis identifies important intermediate steps and reduces the search space.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports a 15.6% improvement in GenEval Score and a 60.4% improvement in ImageReward over baselines. Model scale, sampling budget, reward-model setup, and full baseline details are not visible from the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Guangdong University of Technology, South China University of Technology, and Nanyang Technological University.

recommendation.zh: 作为扩散版 inference scaling 旁证即可；若采样预算未严格对齐，60% ImageReward 提升要打折看。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an image-diffusion analogue of inference scaling; if sampling budgets are not tightly controlled, the 60% ImageReward gain should be discounted.

paper.title: ExComm: Exploration-Stage Communication for Error-Resilient Agentic Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: A common failure mode in long-horizon agentic test-time scaling is error propagation, where factual errors or invalid deductions introduced at intermediate steps persist in the agent's belief state and contaminate later reasoning. Existing test-time scaling methods provide limited control over this process, as they often rely on agents to detect their own mistakes, select among flawed trajectories, or refine solutions only after errors have already shaped the reasoning path. We propose ExComm, a

summary.core_problem: ExComm 处理的是长程 agentic test-time scaling 中的错误传播问题：多个并行智能体在探索阶段一旦形成错误事实或无效推导，后续工具调用和推理会继续沿着错误信念展开，最终后处理很难修复。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 与 inference-time compute 的接口有参考价值。它把多轨迹推理中的“错误控制”前移到探索阶段，而不是只做最终投票、反思或轨迹选择。对基座研究员的启发在于：长程推理的增益不只来自采样数量，也取决于中间信念状态的质量控制；如果训练或评测只看最终答案，会漏掉大量可干预的中间错误。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是一个探索阶段通信协议。多个 agent 并行执行工具增强推理，系统在线比较它们的中间信念。作者观察到，平行轨迹中的多数中间错误会表现为跨 agent 的事实冲突，比例约为 67–71%。ExComm 利用这一点设计 Online Belief Consistency Module：检测冲突后，不要求原 agent 自我纠错，而是由独立一致性模块通过工具验证循环解决冲突，再把短反馈返回给相关 agent。agent 采用 soft belief update，即把修正追加到信念状态中，而不是覆盖原始信念，以降低 verifier 出错时的破坏性。另一个关键设计是 trajectory diversification module。它监控不同 agent 的高层策略，当轨迹过于相似时引导它们走向更正交的方向。这样做是为了避免通信带来的 diversity collapse：如果直接共享完整推理或全局摘要，多个轨迹会很快同步，削弱并行搜索的价值。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 AIME 2024、AIME 2025 和 GAIA。AIME 设置中使用 code interpreter；GAIA 中使用 code interpreter、文件管理工具和 web search。模型包括 Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite 和 Qwen3.5-4B。相较顺序修订、并行 scaling、test-time tree search 等强基线，ExComm 在两个模型上分别取得平均 5.7% 和 5.0% 的性能提升。作者还比较了改造后的 Multi-Agent Debate 和 Mixture-of-Agents，结果显示 ExComm 在准确率更高的同时保留了更高轨迹多样性。消融显示，一致性模块和轨迹多样化模块都对准确率和错误恢复有贡献。效率分析表明，在给定成本下，ExComm 的性能收益优于所比较的 test-time scaling 方法。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Section 3.2 中跨 agent factual conflict 的统计和 Online Belief Consistency Module，这是方法成立的关键假设。再看 Section 3.3 的多样性控制，因为它决定了通信协议是否只是另一种 debate 或 MoA。实验部分建议关注三类对比：与 parallel sampling/tree search 的对比、与 Multi-Agent Debate/MoA 的对比、以及两个模块的消融。对预训练研究员来说，最值得带走的是中间信念质量可以被显式建模和干预，这可能影响未来推理数据合成、过程监督和 agentic RL 的信号设计。

summary_en.core_problem: ExComm targets error propagation in long-horizon agentic test-time scaling. Once a parallel agent forms an incorrect factual belief or an invalid deduction during exploration, later tool calls and reasoning steps can keep building on that corrupted state.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a pretraining contribution, but it is relevant to the interface between post-training, agentic inference, and test-time compute. Its main value is the shift from final-answer aggregation to early control of intermediate belief states. For foundation-model research, the useful signal is that scaling inference is not only about sampling more trajectories; it also depends on keeping intermediate states verifiable, diverse, and recoverable.
summary_en.technical_approach: ExComm is an exploration-stage communication protocol for parallel agentic reasoning. The empirical premise is that many intermediate errors create factual conflicts across agents, reported as 67–71% across the evaluated benchmarks. The Online Belief Consistency Module detects such conflicts and resolves them through its own tool-based verification loop, rather than relying on the original agents to self-correct. The correction is sent back as concise targeted feedback. Agents perform a soft belief update by appending the correction instead of overwriting their previous belief, which reduces the damage if the verifier itself is wrong. The second component is a trajectory diversification module. It monitors high-level strategies and nudges overly similar agents toward more orthogonal directions. This design addresses a real failure mode of multi-agent communication: too much sharing can synchronize trajectories and remove the benefit of parallel exploration.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses tool-based reasoning setups on AIME 2024, AIME 2025, and GAIA. AIME experiments use a code interpreter; GAIA uses a code interpreter, file management tools, and web search. The reported models are Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite and Qwen3.5-4B. ExComm improves average accuracy by 5.7% and 5.0% over the best baselines for the two models, respectively. Baselines include sequential revision, parallel scaling, and test-time tree search. The paper also compares against adapted Multi-Agent Debate and Mixture-of-Agents protocols, with ExComm showing better accuracy while maintaining higher trajectory diversity. Ablations support the contribution of both the consistency module and the diversification module.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the conflict statistics and the Online Belief Consistency Module in Section 3.2, since they justify the method. Then read the diversification mechanism in Section 3.3 to understand how the protocol avoids collapsing all agents into the same trajectory. In the experiments, prioritize the comparisons against tree search, Multi-Agent Debate, and Mixture-of-Agents, plus the module ablations. The most useful takeaway is the explicit treatment of intermediate belief quality, which may inform process supervision, reasoning data generation, and agentic RL signal design.

recommendation.zh: 跨智能体冲突检测纠错的设计很扎实，可参考§3的冲突审计模块用于内部测试时推理缩放实验。
recommendation.en: Cross-agent conflict detection and correction design is robust; refer to §3 conflict audit module for internal test-time inference scaling experiments.

paper.title: CAPS: Cascaded Adaptive Pairwise Selection for Efficient Parallel Reasoning
paper.abstract: Parallel reasoning, where a generator samples many candidate solutions and an aggregator selects the best, is one of the most effective forms of test-time scaling in large language models, and pairwise self-verification has become its strongest aggregation primitive. Yet pairwise verification carries a heavy cost: each judgment reads two complete solutions in full, and existing methods perform tens of such judgments per problem regardless of whether the comparison is informative. We introduce CA

summary.core_problem: CAPS 解决的是 parallel reasoning 中 pairwise verifier 成本过高的问题。生成多个候选解以后，强聚合器通常要做成对比较，但每次比较都读取两份完整推理或代码，单次可能是 4K–8K token，验证成本很快超过生成成本。已有方法主要优化“比较哪些 pair”，很少优化“每个 pair 读多少证据”。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对 test-time scaling 和 verifier 训练有直接参考价值。它把聚合器成本拆成两个可控维度：证据粒度和比较分布。这个拆分有助于理解为什么并行采样的收益常被 verifier 可靠性和成本限制住。对基座研究员更有用的点在于：候选多样性、验证器校准、局部证据判断能力，会共同决定推理时扩展曲线。若预训练或后训练希望提升模型的自验证能力，不能只看完整 CoT 判断准确率，也要看模型在部分证据下的 pairwise discrimination 能力。
summary.technical_approach: CAPS 是 inference-only 框架，不改模型权重。方法有两条轴。第一条是 evidence axis：比较时不总是读完整解，而是先看便宜证据，例如 boxed answer、代码开头、短 reasoning window；只有需要时再升级到更完整证据。第二条是 distribution axis：比较预算不均匀分配给所有候选，而是把更贵的 full-evidence comparison 留给更可能成为 winner 的候选。具体实现是四阶段 cascade，并给出 verifier-token cost 的闭式刻画。另有可选 rescue subroutine，用来降低最便宜证据层误判导致强候选被过早淘汰的风险。与 V1-Infer 的区别是：V1-Infer 重点在 uncertainty-guided Swiss tournament，即优化 pair selection；CAPS 同时改变每次比较的证据量和比较预算分布。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 4 个 self-verifying 模型：Qwen3-14B、GPT-OSS-20B、Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507、Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507；5 个 reasoning benchmark：LiveCodeBench-v5、LiveCodeBench-v6、CodeContests、AIME 2025、HMMT February 2025。基线包括无验证 Vanilla、pointwise self-verification、V1-Infer。CAPS 在 20 个设置中全部超过 pointwise verification；相对 V1-Infer，在 14/20 个设置上更高，同时在代码任务上平均只使用 V1-Infer 25.4% 的 verifier-token budget。经验 token ratio 与闭式成本预测误差在 3 个百分点以内，说明节省主要来自结构设计，而不是单次调参。6 个落后于 V1-Infer 的结果差距不超过 3.4 Pass@1 points。作者还把失败场景归因到 partial evidence 与 full evidence 下 verifier pairwise accuracy 的差距，这给部署前判断 CAPS 是否适用提供了一个简单检查。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分对 evidence axis 和 distribution axis 的定义，以及四阶段 cascade 的成本推导；实验部分优先看 CAPS 与 V1-Infer 的 token budget/Pass@1 trade-off。若关心预训练或后训练，可以重点看 partial evidence verifier accuracy 的分析：它提示自验证能力不是单一能力，而是随证据粒度变化的条件判断能力。

summary_en.core_problem: CAPS targets the cost bottleneck in parallel reasoning with pairwise self-verification. After sampling many candidate solutions, strong aggregators often compare candidates head-to-head, but each comparison reads two full solutions, often 4K–8K tokens each. Existing methods mostly optimize which pairs to compare, while treating the evidence consumed per comparison as fixed.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to test-time scaling and verifier design. The useful abstraction is the separation between evidence granularity and comparison allocation. It clarifies why parallel sampling can become verifier-limited: candidate diversity is not enough if the aggregator is too expensive or poorly calibrated. For foundation-model training, the main signal is that self-verification should be evaluated not only on full-chain judgments, but also on partial-evidence pairwise discrimination.
summary_en.technical_approach: CAPS is an inference-only framework. It allocates verifier compute along two axes. The evidence axis controls how much of each candidate the judge reads, starting from cheap views such as boxed answers, early code lines, or short reasoning windows, and escalating when needed. The distribution axis controls where comparisons are spent, reserving expensive full-evidence comparisons for candidates that are more likely to be selected. The concrete method is a four-stage cascade with a closed-form verifier-token cost model. An optional rescue routine reduces the risk that a strong candidate is eliminated by an early low-evidence mistake. Compared with V1-Infer, which focuses on uncertainty-guided pair selection in a Swiss-style tournament, CAPS changes both the evidence used within each comparison and the allocation of comparison budget across the pool.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses four self-verifying models: Qwen3-14B, GPT-OSS-20B, Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, and Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507. Benchmarks include LiveCodeBench-v5, LiveCodeBench-v6, CodeContests, AIME 2025, and HMMT February 2025. Baselines are vanilla selection without verification, pointwise self-verification, and V1-Infer. CAPS beats pointwise verification in all 20 settings. It outperforms V1-Infer in 14 of 20 settings while using, on code tasks, 25.4% of V1-Infer’s verifier-token budget on average. The observed token ratio is within three percentage points of the closed-form prediction. In the six cases where V1-Infer is better, the gap is at most 3.4 Pass@1 points. The paper links these cases to the verifier’s accuracy gap between partial and full evidence, which is a practical pre-deployment diagnostic.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim pass of 20–30 minutes is enough. Focus on the definitions of the evidence and distribution axes, the four-stage cascade, and the verifier-token cost derivation. In the experiments, prioritize the Pass@1 versus verifier-token comparisons against V1-Infer. For training researchers, the most useful part is the analysis of partial-evidence verifier accuracy, since it exposes a finer-grained view of self-verification capability.

recommendation.zh: 推理侧并行验证的效率优化方法，仅需阅读方法部分的双轴分配设计和成本推导即可
recommendation.en: Inference-side parallel verification efficiency optimization, only read the dual-axis allocation design and cost derivation in the method section

paper.title: Agentic Systems as Boosting Weak Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Can a committee of weak reasoning-model calls reach the performance of much stronger models? We study verifier-backed committee search as inference-time boosting for reasoning language models. The mechanism is not simply that ``more agents help'': samples expose latent correct solutions, while critics and comparators must recover them without access to the hidden verifier. We formalize this view by separating proposal coverage, local identifiability, progress, and diversity. We prove that covera

summary.core_problem: 论文研究一个核心问题：在推理任务中，能否通过多个弱推理模型的采样+验证+选择系统（即推理时boosting），在推理时间将弱模型的性能提升到更强模型的水平。具体拆解为四个相互独立的因素：提案覆盖率（有用的步是否出现在采样池中）、局部可识别性（系统能否识别出有用的步）、进展性（局部选择能否链式组合成全局解）、以及多样性（多次采样能否克服不同的失败模式）。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的主要启发在于：它为推理时计算（inference-time computation）与模型能力之间的关系提供了一个正式框架。具体来说，（1）证明了仅靠增加采样次数无法修复模型的共同盲点（shared blind spots），这意味着某些能力缺陷必须在训练时解决，无法通过推理时搜索弥补；（2）区分了oracle best-of-k上限（衡量采样池的潜在能力）和实际系统性能（衡量选择机制的有效性），这种分解为评估推理系统提供了更精细的方法论；（3）局部健全性信号（如代码执行、证明检查、类型检查）的必要性，表明验证器与模型的协同设计是未来推理系统的关键方向。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将基于验证器的推理系统建模为有界深度搜索，核心创新是将推理时boosting分解为四个正交量：提案覆盖率、局部可识别性、进展深度和多样性。关键技术结果包括：（1）一个黑箱分离定理——证明即使生成正确步的概率非零，也不意味着能构造出有效的批评者或比较者，需要额外的局部可识别性信号；（2）基于秩的局部到全局误差界：Pr(failure) ≤ L(ε_orc(k) + ε_id(k,m,r))，其中ε_id随k²指数衰减；（3）在潜子群体模型下表征盲点上限：ε_orc(k) = B + o(k)，B是盲点质量，因此oracle best-of-k收敛到1-B，给出了推理时提升的理论天花板。
summary.experiments: 主要实验在SWE-bench Verified上进行。使用GPT-5.4 nano作为基础模型，其单样本Pass@1为67.0%。通过设计的reviewer-comparator系统（批评者过滤有缺陷候选 + 比较者对合理候选排序），系统性能达到76.4%，追平Gemini 3 Pro和Claude Opus 4.5 Thinking，超过GPT-5.4 mini。Oracle best-of-k上限为79.0%，表明nano的采样池中已经包含了大量正确补丁，但选择机制仍有约2.6%的gap未填补。消融实验显示：多样性暴露了潜在正确补丁，批评者过滤掉有缺陷的候选，比较者对合理选项排序；剩余失败主要源于提案覆盖率不足（即正确答案从未出现在采样池中）。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第1章（Introduction）的框架分解和running example（SWE-bench的性能拆解图），这是论文最有价值的部分。第2章的形式化模型和理论界对理解推理时boosting的极限有帮助，但可以快速浏览。实验部分（应有第3/4章）的SWE-bench结果和消融分析是实证核心。建议重点关注图1（三条曲线：one-shot、implemented system、oracle best-of-k）以及相关讨论，这直观展示了推理时提升的天花板和实际差距。阅读时间约30-40分钟。
summary.authors_note: 作者信息未在提供的全文内容中标注，无法确认

summary_en.core_problem: This paper investigates whether a committee of weak reasoning-model calls, orchestrated as verifier-backed sample-identify-advance systems at inference time, can match the performance of significantly stronger standalone models. It decomposes the problem into four separable factors: proposal coverage (whether a good move appears in the sample pool), local identifiability (whether the system can recognize it), progress (whether local choices compose into global solutions), and diversity (whether more sampling escapes distinct failure modes).
summary_en.importance: The key contribution to pretraining research is a formal framework distinguishing what inference-time computation can versus cannot fix. Specifically: (1) Shared blind spots in the proposer model cannot be overcome by any amount of inference-time sampling or selection—these are fundamental capability ceilings that must be addressed during training. (2) The three-level evaluation decomposition (Pass@1 → implemented system → oracle best-of-k) provides a principled methodology for diagnosing reasoning systems, separating generation gaps from selection gaps. (3) The necessity of local soundness signals (execution, proof checking, type checking, tests) suggests that verifier-model co-design is a critical direction for future reasoning systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper models verifier-backed agent systems as bounded-depth search over partial reasoning states. The core innovation is a four-way decomposition of inference-time boosting: proposal coverage, local identifiability, progress depth, and diversity. Key technical results include: (1) A black-box separation theorem proving that non-trivial probability of generating correct moves does not by itself yield useful critics or comparators—an additional local identifiability signal is required. (2) Local-to-global rank-bounded error bounds: Pr(failure) ≤ L(ε_orc(k) + ε_id(k,m,r)), where ε_id decays exponentially with k². (3) Blind-spot ceiling characterization under a latent subpopulation model: ε_orc(k) = B + o(k), where B is blind-spot mass, giving a theoretical upper bound of 1-B for oracle best-of-k performance.
summary_en.experiments: The primary empirical result is on SWE-bench Verified. GPT-5.4 nano achieves 67.0% one-shot Pass@1. The paper's reviewer-comparator harness (critics filtering flawed candidates + comparators ranking plausible alternatives) lifts this to 76.4%, matching Gemini 3 Pro and Claude Opus 4.5 Thinking, and exceeding GPT-5.4 mini. The oracle best-of-k ceiling reaches 79.0%, indicating the nano proposal pool already contains correct patches for many problems, with a ~2.6% gap between implemented selection and the oracle upper bound. Ablations confirm diversity exposes latent correct patches, critics filter flaws, comparators rank alternatives; remaining failures are mostly proposal-coverage failures.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Chapter 1 (Introduction) for the four-way decomposition framework and the running SWE-bench example—this is the most valuable conceptual contribution. The formal model and theoretical bounds in Chapter 2 provide rigor but can be skimmed for key takeaways. The experimental section (Chapters 3/4) with SWE-bench results and ablations is the empirical core. Pay special attention to Figure 1 showing the three performance curves (one-shot, implemented system, oracle best-of-k) as it visually conveys the inference-time boosting limits and gaps. Reading time: 30-40 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Author information not available in the provided text

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain，但会改你看 test-time scaling 的 prior：多采样只能补 coverage，补不了判别器质量；先读理论定义和 proposer ceiling 那段。
recommendation.en: It won’t change pretraining directly, but it should update your prior on test-time scaling: more samples only improve coverage, not critic quality; start with the theory and the proposer-ceiling result.

paper.title: OpenDeepThink: Parallel Reasoning via Bradley--Terry Aggregation
paper.abstract: Test-time compute scaling is a primary axis for improving LLM reasoning. Existing methods primarily scale depth by extending a single reasoning trace. Scaling breadth by sampling multiple candidates in parallel is straightforward, but introduces a selection bottleneck: choosing the best candidate without a ground-truth verifier, since pointwise LLM judging is noisy and biased. To address this, we introduce OpenDeepThink, a population-based test-time compute framework that selects via pairwise Br

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是 test-time compute 的“横向扩展”问题：并行采样多个推理候选很容易，但在没有隐藏测试、外部 verifier 或训练好的 reward model 时，如何可靠地选出更好的候选很难。作者把瓶颈从生成更多答案，转到用 pairwise judging 和 Bradley–Terry 聚合做候选排序。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 和 reasoning 数据构造有启发。它说明同一个 LLM 的点式打分噪声很大，而成对比较更稳定；这与 preference data、reward model 训练、RLAIF 数据生成中的信号质量问题是同一类问题。值得关注的是，方法不依赖任务专用 verifier，因此可作为一种通用的推理时搜索框架，也可用于构造更可靠的合成 reasoning traces。
summary.technical_approach: OpenDeepThink 维护一个候选解种群，而不是沿单条 CoT 继续加深。每一代包括三步：第一，随机抽取候选对，让同一个 LLM 做成对比较，并输出比较理由；第二，用 Bradley–Terry 模型把局部胜负关系聚合成全局排序；第三，保留高排名候选作为 elite，对中高排名候选基于比较理由做 directed mutation，低排名候选直接丢弃。最后再做一轮更密集的成对比较，用 Bradley–Terry 排名选择提交答案。与 best-of-N 的区别在于，它不只做一次性选择，而是把比较理由反馈给生成过程；与 self-refinement 的区别在于，它有种群级选择压力，可以放弃错误路线，而不是只修补单条轨迹。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 同时作为 generator 和 judge。方法在两个竞赛编程 benchmark、共 192 道题上评估，并在 HLE 的 82 个多领域问题上测试迁移性。系统每题约 285 次 API 调用，但顺序深度只有 8 次调用，适合并行执行。一个 500-pair 诊断实验显示，pairwise judging 的准确率为 86%，pointwise judging 为 59%，说明成对比较显著降低了正向偏置和打分噪声。在竞赛编程上，Gemini 3.1 Pro 的等效 Codeforces Elo 提升约 +405；同一组超参数还能迁移到 Gemini 3 Flash 和 Gemini 2.5 Pro。HLE 上的收益集中在客观可验证领域，在主观领域会反向，说明方法的上限受 judge 可靠性约束。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，建议用 20–30 分钟看 Introduction、Method 的算法流程，以及实验中 pairwise vs pointwise 的诊断和 HLE 分域结果。重点不是 Bradley–Terry 模型本身，而是三个工程取舍：用成对比较替代点式评分；用比较理由驱动 mutation；在固定 wall-clock 下把 compute 转成并行宽度。若关心 reasoning 数据合成，可重点看比较理由如何进入下一代候选生成。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets breadth scaling at test time. Sampling many reasoning candidates is easy, but selecting the best one without hidden tests, an external verifier, or a trained reward model is unreliable. The paper reframes selection as pairwise comparison followed by Bradley–Terry aggregation.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining method, but it is relevant to reasoning-time search and preference-signal construction. The main lesson is that pointwise LLM judging is noisy and positively biased, while pairwise comparison gives a cleaner signal. That connects directly to RLAIF, reward-model data generation, and synthetic reasoning trace selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: OpenDeepThink keeps a population of candidate solutions rather than extending one chain of thought. Each generation samples random candidate pairs, asks the same LLM to compare them and produce natural-language critiques, aggregates wins and losses with a Bradley–Terry model, preserves top candidates, mutates the upper and middle ranks using the critiques, and discards the bottom quarter. A denser final comparison round produces the submitted answer. Compared with best-of-N, it feeds comparison information back into generation. Compared with self-refinement, it applies population-level selection pressure and can abandon a bad approach instead of only patching it.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Gemini 3.1 Pro as both generator and judge. Evaluation covers 192 competitive-programming problems from two benchmarks and 82 HLE questions. The pipeline uses about 285 API calls per problem, with only eight sequential LLM calls because most comparisons and generations run in parallel. On a 500-pair diagnostic, pairwise judging reaches 86% accuracy versus 59% for pointwise judging. On competitive programming, the reported effective Codeforces Elo gain for Gemini 3.1 Pro is about +405. The same hyperparameters transfer to Gemini 3 Flash and Gemini 2.5 Pro. On HLE, gains are concentrated in objectively verifiable domains and can reverse in subjective domains, showing that the method is bounded by judge reliability.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough. Spend roughly 20–30 minutes on the introduction, the algorithmic description, and the pairwise-versus-pointwise diagnostic. The useful parts are the selection mechanism, the way critiques are reused for mutation, and the wall-clock-aware design. Readers interested in reasoning data generation should focus on how comparison rationales become a training or inference signal.

recommendation.zh: 只看算法 loop 和消融即可；它不会改变预训练方法，但给 test-time compute 的“宽度扩展”提供了一个相对干净的选择器设计。
recommendation.en: Skim the loop and ablations; it does not change pretraining, but gives a cleaner selector design for breadth-style test-time scaling.

paper.title: LLMs Know When They Know, but Do Not Act on It: A Metacognitive Harness for Test-time Scaling
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often expose useful signals of self-monitoring: before solving a problem, they can estimate whether they are likely to succeed, and after solving it, they can judge whether their answer is likely to be correct. However, these signals are typically measured or elicited in isolation, rather than used to control inference.
