In this work, we ask whether LLMs possess latent metacognitive ability that can be turned into effective test-time control. Inspired by the Nelson--N

summary.core_problem: 大模型在推理前后能产生反映自身确定性的元认知信号（如解题前的“知道感”和解题后的“学习判断”），但这些信号通常只被用作诊断工具，而没有被用来在推理时动态控制计算资源的分配。
summary.importance: 提出了一种将模型自我评估信号转化为推理时控制接口的新范式。这为 test-time scaling 提供了一种轻量级、无需微调的策略，证明了模型内部的元认知信号足以指导有效的计算资源分配。
summary.technical_approach: 受认知心理学启发，提出了一种分离监控与推理的元认知框架（metacognitive harness）。首先在小规模锚点集上进行“元认知诊断”，评估模型信号的区分度和校准度，并拟合出模型特定的决策规则。在测试时，模型在解题前输出“知道感”（FOK）分数，每次尝试后输出“学习判断”（JOL）分数。决策规则基于这些分数决定是提前停止（对于高置信度尝试）还是继续分配计算资源（对于不确定但有希望的尝试），最后进行结果聚合。
summary.experiments: 在固定的 Claude Sonnet-4.6 模型上，该框架在 STEM、代码和多模态推理基准测试中均取得了 SOTA 性能，且无需更新参数或针对特定基准进行微调。消融实验表明，性能提升依赖于校准的决策规则、有针对性的重试和上下文管理，而非简单的均匀采样或延长单次推理轨迹。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Method 部分中 FOK 和 JOL 信号的提取与应用机制，以及元认知诊断阶段如何拟合决策规则。实验部分可关注不同策略（如均匀采样 vs. 元认知控制）的对比，理解元认知控制在资源分配上的效率优势。

summary_en.core_problem: LLMs can generate metacognitive signals reflecting their certainty before and after reasoning (e.g., feeling-of-knowing and judgment-of-learning), but these signals are typically used only for diagnosis rather than dynamically controlling compute allocation during inference.
summary_en.importance: Introduces a novel paradigm that transforms model self-assessment signals into a control interface for inference. This provides a lightweight, tuning-free strategy for test-time scaling, demonstrating that internal metacognitive signals are sufficient to guide effective compute allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by cognitive psychology, the authors propose a metacognitive harness that separates monitoring from reasoning. First, a 'metacognitive diagnosis' is performed on a small anchor set to evaluate the discrimination and calibration of the model's signals and fit a model-specific decision rule. At test time, the model outputs a 'feeling-of-knowing' (FOK) score before solving and a 'judgment-of-learning' (JOL) score after each attempt. The decision rule uses these scores to determine whether to stop early (for high-confidence attempts) or allocate more compute (for uncertain but promising ones), followed by final aggregation.
summary_en.experiments: Using a fixed Claude Sonnet-4.6 model, the harness achieved SOTA performance across STEM, coding, and multimodal reasoning benchmarks without parameter updates or benchmark-specific fine-tuning. Ablations show that gains depend on calibrated decision rules, directed retry, and context management, rather than uniform sampling or longer single-trajectory reasoning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section detailing the extraction and application of FOK and JOL signals, and how the decision rule is fitted during the metacognitive diagnosis stage. In the experiments, compare different strategies (e.g., uniform sampling vs. metacognitive control) to understand the efficiency advantages of metacognitive control in resource allocation.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和校准实验即可；若 FOK/JOL 真能控预算，它说明预训练已学到的信号没被解码策略用好。
recommendation.en: Read the method and calibration experiments; if FOK/JOL reliably control budget, decoding is leaving pretrained self-monitoring signals unused.

paper.title: Achieving Gold-Medal-Level Olympiad Reasoning via Simple and Unified Scaling
paper.abstract: Recent progress in reasoning models has substantially advanced long-horizon mathematical and scientific problem solving, with several systems now reaching gold-medal-level performance on International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO) and International Physics Olympiad (IPhO) problems. In this paper, we introduce a simple and unified recipe for converting a post-trained reasoning backbone into a rigorous olympiad-level solver. The recipe first uses a reverse-perplexity curriculum for SFT to instill ri

summary.core_problem: 论文要解决的问题是：如何把一个已有的 post-trained reasoning backbone，用统一且相对简单的 SFT、RL 和 test-time scaling 流程，推到奥赛级长程证明与科学推理能力。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近 post-train 与 inference scaling 论文，不是基座预训练论文，但对预训练研究有两个直接启发。第一，它把“能力底座”和“推理行为塑形”分开处理：30B-A3B backbone 已经具备科学推理和指令跟随能力，SFT 主要改变长证明的搜索、检查、修复习惯，而不是从零训练能力。第二，它说明长程推理能力的瓶颈不只在数据规模，也在训练信号的结构：可验证奖励适合扩展答案正确性，证明级 reward model 和 self-refinement 更适合优化证明质量。对 pretrain ↔ posttrain 接口来说，这提供了一个清晰样例：预训练或 mid-train 应提供足够宽的科学与形式推理表示，post-train 再通过高质量轨迹、课程顺序和奖励层级把行为稳定地拉到专家任务上。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分三段。第一段是 SFT 行为塑形。作者从数学、科学、代码和通用指令来源整理长解答、自验证、自修复轨迹，过滤后得到 338K 条、每条响应短于 8K tokens 的训练样本。关键不是简单混合数据，而是用 reverse perplexity curriculum：先训练初始策略最不熟悉、perplexity 最高的轨迹，再回到更熟悉的样本做巩固。这个设计的意图是先强行注入更严格的证明搜索模式，再降低对原有能力的破坏。第二段是两级 RL。coarse RL 使用可验证题目和二值 outcome reward，类似 RLVR，目标是扩展 SFT 学到的解题行为。refined RL 转向 proof-level 训练，引入生成式证明奖励模型，对完整证明质量打分；同时使用 self-refinement prompts 训练批判与修复能力，并用 experience replay 保留困难题上的稀有成功轨迹。第三段是 test-time scaling。模型在推理时反复生成草稿、检查错误、修复候选证明，长轨迹可超过 100K tokens。和只靠采样多数投票不同，这里的推理扩展更偏向 proof search + self-verification loop。
summary.experiments: 主模型 SU-01 基于 30B-A3B backbone。SFT 数据为 338K 条长轨迹。答案可验证任务上，SU-01 在 AnswerBench、AMO-Bench、AIME 2025/2026、FrontierScience-Olympiad 上接近同尺寸强基线 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B。证明型评测上，SU-01 在 IMO-ProofBench 直接生成达到 57.6%，加入 test-time scaling 后达到 70.2%，明显强于同尺寸模型，并接近 Gemini 3.1 Pro Thinking 这类商业系统。FrontierScience-Research 上，SU-01 获得同尺寸模型中较好的整体表现，说明训练没有只过拟合奥赛题。官方竞赛题上，直接生成已经超过 2024 和 2025 IPhO 金牌线，并达到 IMO 2025 和 USAMO 2026 铜牌线；加入 test-time scaling 后，在两个数学奥赛上都得到 35 分，达到 IMO 2025 金牌线，并比 USAMO 2026 金牌线高 10 分。USAMO 2026 上，这个分数与 340 名参赛者中的最高人类总分持平。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 pipeline 的定位，重点确认它不是从 base model 训练推理能力，而是专门改造 post-trained backbone。然后看 SFT 部分的 reverse perplexity curriculum，关注样本排序为什么从“最不匹配初始策略”开始，以及它如何兼顾行为注入和能力保持。RL 部分建议看 coarse RL 与 proof-level RL 的分界：二值可验证奖励负责扩展正确性，证明奖励模型负责细粒度证明质量。实验部分优先看 IMO-ProofBench、官方 IMO/USAMO/IPhO 评分、FrontierScience-Research，以及 test-time scaling 的轨迹分析。附录若有数据过滤、reward model 训练和 replay 细节，适合进一步核查结果是否依赖隐含数据泄漏或评测特化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how far an already post-trained reasoning backbone can be pushed toward olympiad-level mathematical and scientific proof solving with a unified SFT, RL, and test-time scaling recipe.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and inference-scaling work, but it is relevant to pretraining because it cleanly separates latent capability from reasoning behavior. The backbone already has broad scientific competence; SFT is used to reshape how it searches, checks, and repairs long proofs. The RL design also gives a useful signal hierarchy: verifiable binary rewards are effective for scaling answer correctness, while proof-level reward modeling is needed when the target is a rigorous argument rather than a final value. For pretraining researchers, the lesson is practical: broad scientific and symbolic representations should be built before specialization, and later training stages can then steer the policy with much more targeted trajectory and reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The recipe has three stages. The first stage uses SFT to impose a more disciplined proof-search style. The authors curate long-form solution, self-verification, and self-refinement trajectories from math, science, coding, and instruction-following sources, ending with 338K filtered trajectories under 8K response tokens. A reverse-perplexity curriculum orders examples from those most mismatched to the initial policy to those more familiar to it. This is meant to inject unfamiliar proof behavior first, then consolidate without overly erasing existing competence. The second stage uses two levels of RL. Coarse RL uses verifiable prompts and binary outcome rewards in the RLVR style. Refined RL moves to proof quality, using a generative proof-level reward model, self-refinement prompts, and experience replay to retain rare successes on hard problems. The final stage applies test-time scaling through repeated drafting, verification, and repair, allowing very long inference traces rather than relying only on independent sampling.
summary_en.experiments: The main model, SU-01, is built on a 30B-A3B backbone. The SFT mixture contains 338K long trajectories. On answer-verifiable benchmarks, SU-01 nearly matches the strongest similar-size baseline, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, across AnswerBench, AMO-Bench, AIME 2025/2026, and FrontierScience-Olympiad. On proof-oriented evaluation, it reaches 57.6% on IMO-ProofBench with direct generation and 70.2% with test-time scaling, outperforming similar-size models and approaching systems such as Gemini 3.1 Pro Thinking. On FrontierScience-Research, it reports the best similar-size overall score among the compared models, suggesting that the recipe does not only specialize to olympiad-style prompts. On official problems, direct SU-01 exceeds the gold lines for IPhO 2024 and 2025 and clears bronze lines on IMO 2025 and USAMO 2026. With test-time scaling, it scores 35 points on both math olympiads, meeting the IMO 2025 gold line and exceeding the USAMO 2026 gold line by 10 points; on USAMO 2026, this matches the highest reported human total among 340 competitors.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Start with the pipeline description in the introduction to understand that the work specializes a post-trained model rather than training reasoning from a base checkpoint. Then read the SFT section on reverse-perplexity curriculum, since that is the most reusable training-detail idea. In the RL section, focus on the division between verifiable outcome rewards and proof-level reward modeling. For results, prioritize IMO-ProofBench, official IMO/USAMO/IPhO scoring, FrontierScience-Research, and the test-time scaling traces. If the appendix contains data filtering, reward-model training, or replay details, those are worth checking for possible benchmark-specific effects.

recommendation.zh: 读 SFT curriculum 和 RL 交接部分即可；若 200-step RL setup 干净，它支持奖励设计比 RL 预算更关键。
recommendation.en: Read the SFT curriculum and RL handoff; if the 200-step setup is clean, it argues reward design matters more than RL budget.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: EGSS: Entropy-guided Stepwise Scaling for Reliable Software Engineering
paper.abstract: Agentic Test-Time Scaling (TTS) has delivered state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on complex software engineering tasks such as code generation and bug fixing. However, its practical adoption remains limited due to significant computational overhead, primarily driven by two key challenges: (1) the high cost associated with deploying excessively large ensembles, and (2) the lack of a reliable mechanism for selecting the optimal candidate solution, ultimately constraining the performance gains tha

summary.core_problem: 现有测试时缩放（TTS）方法在软件工程Agent任务中存在计算冗余高、探索效率低、候选补丁筛选不可靠的问题：均匀采样和静态引导导致算力分配不合理，低熵常规步骤占用过多资源，高熵决策点探索不足；仅靠最终测试结果排序的筛选机制容易忽略中间调试信号，选出仅通过局部检查、未解决根本问题的脆弱补丁。
summary.importance: 为代码领域LLM的推理时算力优化提供了可落地的思路，熵引导的动态资源分配逻辑可以迁移到其他长程推理Agent的测试时缩放框架设计。
summary.technical_approach: 提出熵引导分步缩放（EGSS）框架，包含两个核心设计：1）用工具熵量化每一步的决策不确定性，仅在高熵决策点调用辅助判别器实时评估、剪枝分支轨迹，动态将推理预算分配给探索价值最高的步骤；2）融合多Agent轨迹的调试信号、仓库原有回归测试、新增边缘用例构造多维测试集，结合多模型集成投票筛选可靠候选补丁。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-Bench-Verified基准上，EGSS将所有测试模型的性能提升5-10%，在开源方法中达到最优表现，同时推理时token消耗比此前的TTS方法降低28%；实证分析显示88%的任务轨迹包含自验证步骤，但其中35.7%的自验证轨迹仍然失败，工具熵呈右偏分布，绝大多数步骤为低熵常规操作，验证了自适应算力分配的合理性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读Introduction部分的问题分析、Figure1的算力-性能 trade-off 图、Preliminary章节的工具熵分布实证分析，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing Test-Time Scaling (TTS) methods for software engineering agent tasks suffer from high computational redundancy, low exploration efficiency, and unreliable candidate patch selection. Uniform sampling and static guidance lead to suboptimal compute allocation: low-entropy routine steps consume excessive resources while high-entropy decision points get insufficient exploration. Ranking mechanisms based only on final test results tend to ignore intermediate debugging signals, and select brittle patches that pass local checks without addressing root causes.
summary_en.importance: It provides an implementable approach for inference-time compute optimization of code-domain LLMs, and the entropy-guided dynamic resource allocation logic can be migrated to TTS framework design for other long-horizon reasoning agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the Entropy-Guided Stepwise Scaling (EGSS) framework with two core designs: 1) Quantify step-level decision uncertainty with tool entropy, only invoke auxiliary judges at high-entropy decision points for real-time evaluation and trajectory pruning, dynamically allocating inference budget to steps with highest exploration value; 2) Construct a multi-dimensional test suite by integrating debugging signals from multiple agent trajectories, existing repository regression tests, and newly identified edge cases, combined with multi-model ensemble voting to select reliable candidate patches.
summary_en.experiments: On the SWE-Bench-Verified benchmark, EGSS improves performance of all evaluated models by 5-10%, achieves the best performance among open-source methods, and reduces inference token consumption by 28% compared to prior TTS approaches. Empirical analysis shows 88% of task trajectories include self-verification steps, but 35.7% of these still fail. Tool entropy follows a right-skewed distribution, with most steps being low-entropy routine operations, validating the rationality of adaptive compute allocation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the problem analysis in Introduction, Figure 1 for compute-performance trade-off, and empirical analysis of tool entropy distribution in Preliminary. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看熵控扩展和测试增强两节；这是干净的 inference-time compute 分配问题，可作为 RLVR 数据筛选的旁证。
recommendation.en: Read only the entropy-controlled scaling and test-augmentation sections; it is a clean inference-time compute allocation signal, useful as weak evidence for RLVR-style data selection.

paper.title: Primal Generation, Dual Judgment: Self-Training from Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Code generation is typically trained in the primal space of programs: a model produces a candidate solution and receives sparse execution feedback, often a single pass/fail bit. Test-time scaling enriches the inference procedure by sampling multiple candidates and judging among them, but the comparative information this process reveals is discarded after inference. We argue that this information defines a dual judgment space that provides a far richer training signal: the model learns not from a

summary.core_problem: 现有代码生成模型的训练仅使用单样本执行的稀疏二元（通过/失败）反馈，测试阶段生成多候选并排序的比较信息仅用于推理，没有被回用于训练，导致模型持续给看似合理但错误的代码分配高概率，生成能力提升受限；同时现有方法没有明确的机制将排序学习的判别能力迁移回生成能力。
summary.importance: 提出了生成-判断的原-对偶训练范式，证明仅在对偶判断空间做强化学习训练，不需要直接的生成奖励，就可以同时提升模型的判断能力和原生生成能力，为代码大模型、推理大模型的自训练提供了新的信号来源，对RL预训练、自改进范式的研究有重要参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DuST（对偶自训练）框架，分为三个步骤：1）从当前模型的分布中采样多个代码候选，通过沙箱执行获得每个候选的二元正确性标签；2）筛选同时包含正确和错误候选的分组，构造对偶判断任务；3）使用GRPO算法训练同一个模型，让模型学习按照执行正确性对候选排序，所有监督信号都来自模型自身生成的候选对的正确性对比，没有直接的生成奖励。核心假设是：模型在对偶空间学习区分正确和错误代码的过程中，会获得对正确性敏感的特征，这些特征可以迁移到原空间的生成任务中。
summary.experiments: 在LiveCodeBench v6数据集上验证，Qwen3-30B-Thinking模型经过DuST训练后，判断质量的NDCG提升6.2个点，Best-of-4测试缩放精度提升4.1个点，单样本生成的pass@1提升3.1个点，且不需要直接的生成奖励。该增益在5种不同基座模型（覆盖两个模型家族、3个参数规模4B到30B）上均可复现。消融实验显示：在相同排序数据上做监督微调只能提升判断能力，无法提升生成能力，而GRPO的在线强化学习可以将对偶空间的判断学习迁移回原空间的生成能力。
summary.reading_guide: 精读§3的原-对偶框架定义，理解对偶空间信号比原空间稀疏奖励更稠密的核心逻辑；重点看§4.2的消融实验部分，对比SFT和GRPO的效果差异，掌握迁移机制的关键变量。可深挖的点包括该范式向通用推理任务、数学推理任务的迁移，以及对偶任务设计的优化空间。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing code generation models are only trained with sparse binary (pass/fail) feedback from single-sample execution. The comparative information generated by multi-candidate sampling and ranking during test phase is only used for inference, not reused for training, leading to the model continuously assigning high probability to plausible but incorrect code, which limits the improvement of generation capability. Meanwhile, existing methods lack a clear mechanism to transfer the discriminative ability of ranking learning back to generation capability.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes a primal-dual training paradigm for generation-judgment, and proves that reinforcement learning training only in the dual judgment space, without direct generation reward, can improve both the model's judgment capability and native generation capability. It provides a new signal source for self-training of code large models and reasoning large models, and has important reference value for research on RL pretraining and self-improvement paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: The DuST (Dual Self-Training) framework is proposed, which consists of three steps: 1) Sample multiple code candidates from the current model's distribution, and obtain binary correctness labels for each candidate through sandbox execution; 2) Filter groups that contain both correct and incorrect candidates to construct dual judgment tasks; 3) Train the same model using the GRPO algorithm to rank candidates according to execution correctness. All supervision signals come from the correctness comparison of candidate pairs generated by the model itself, with no direct generation reward. The core hypothesis is that during the process of learning to distinguish correct and incorrect code in the dual space, the model will acquire correctness-sensitive features that can be transferred to the generation task in the primal space.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on the LiveCodeBench v6 dataset, the Qwen3-30B-Thinking model, after DuST training, achieves 6.2 NDCG points improvement in judgment quality, 4.1 points improvement in Best-of-4 test-time scaling accuracy, and 3.1 pass@1 points improvement in single-sample generation, without direct generation reward. This gain is reproducible across 5 different base models covering two model families and three parameter scales from 4B to 30B. Ablation experiments show that supervised fine-tuning on the same ranking data can only improve judgment capability, not generation capability, while online reinforcement learning with GRPO can transfer the dual-space judgment learning back to the primal-space generation capability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Intensively read the definition of the primal-dual framework in §3 to understand the core logic that dual-space signals are denser than sparse primal-space rewards. Focus on the ablation experiments in §4.2, compare the effect difference between SFT and GRPO, and master the key variables of the transfer mechanism. Potential directions for further exploration include the migration of this paradigm to general reasoning tasks and mathematical reasoning tasks, and the optimization space of dual task design.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法部分：它把推理时搜索转成排序监督，比只收集成功样本更干净，适合复现到内部代码 RLVR 管线。
recommendation.en: Read the method: converting inference-time search into ranking supervision is cleaner than success-only filtering and is a good candidate for internal code-RLVR ablations.

paper.title: LLMs Improving LLMs: Agentic Discovery for Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling (TTS) has become an effective approach for improving large language model performance by allocating additional computation during inference. However, existing TTS strategies are largely hand-crafted: researchers manually design reasoning patterns and tune heuristics by intuition, leaving much of the computation-allocation space unexplored. We propose an environment-driven framework, AutoTTS, that changes what researchers design: from individual TTS heuristics to environments wh

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的问题是：test-time scaling 的计算分配策略长期依赖人工设计，如何把分支、加深、探测、剪枝、停止这些决策放进一个可自动搜索的环境里。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法，但和基座模型研究的接口很近。它把推理时计算分配看成可搜索的控制策略，而不是固定 heuristic。这个视角对预训练研究有两点启发。第一，模型能力评估不应只看固定采样预算下的准确率，还要看 accuracy-cost Pareto frontier。第二，离线 replay 环境可以把昂贵的 LLM 调用变成可重复、低成本的策略搜索，这种思想也可迁移到数据配比、curriculum、verifier 使用和推理数据合成等问题。
summary.technical_approach: AutoTTS 的关键不是提出一个新的手写 TTS 规则，而是构造一个 discovery environment。作者以 width-depth test-time scaling 为实例：width 表示探索多少条 reasoning branch，depth 表示每条 branch 延展多远。系统先为每个问题离线收集 reasoning trajectories 和中间 probe signals。之后 controller 在 replay 环境中决策何时新建分支、继续生成、查询中间答案、剪枝、停止，并在预算约束下优化准确率和成本。状态包括问题、已创建分支数、活跃分支集合、各分支深度、已揭示的 probe 反馈和剩余预算。为了避免自动发现的 controller 带来过多超参数，作者提出 beta parameterization：每个 controller 只暴露一个标量 β，内部阈值由它确定。为了让搜索者知道策略为什么失败，系统记录执行轨迹，而不是只返回一个 accuracy-cost 标量。这个设计的核心取舍是牺牲一部分在线灵活性，换取确定、便宜、可重复的大量策略评估。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在数学推理 benchmark。作者报告 AutoTTS 发现的 controller 能改善 accuracy-cost Pareto frontier，相比 strong hand-crafted baselines 在相同成本下取得更高准确率，或在相近准确率下使用更少计算。发现出的策略能从搜索用 benchmark 泛化到 held-out benchmark，也能跨模型规模迁移。全文片段中没有给出具体 benchmark 名称、模型尺寸、绝对准确率和成本节省数字；这些数字需要看正文实验表和 Pareto 曲线。已有信息足以判断，主要贡献在搜索框架和环境设计，而不是某个单一 TTS heuristic。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20 分钟。优先看方法部分对 controller state/action/budget 的形式化定义，再看 beta parameterization 和 execution trace feedback。实验部分重点看 Pareto frontier 图，而不是单点准确率。若只关心预训练，可以跳过大部分具体 TTS baseline 细节，关注离线 replay 环境如何把昂贵策略搜索变成便宜评估；这对训练数据选择和推理轨迹生成也有借鉴价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to automatically discover test-time scaling policies instead of manually designing heuristics for branching, deepening, probing, pruning, and stopping reasoning trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time scaling paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research. It treats compute allocation as a policy-search problem with an accuracy-cost objective. That matters because model quality is increasingly tied to how efficiently extra inference compute is used. The offline replay setup is also a useful pattern: expensive LLM calls are amortized into a fixed environment where many candidate policies can be evaluated deterministically and cheaply.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoTTS shifts the design target from individual TTS heuristics to discovery environments. The concrete instantiation uses a width-depth space: width controls the number of reasoning branches, and depth controls how far each branch is extended. For each problem, the system pre-collects reasoning trajectories and intermediate probe outputs. A controller then operates in an offline replay environment, choosing actions such as creating branches, continuing generation, probing intermediate answers, pruning branches, and stopping. The state tracks the question, instantiated branches, active branches, branch depths, revealed probe feedback, and remaining budget. Two engineering choices are central. Beta parameterization exposes only one scalar trade-off parameter, β, while deriving internal thresholds deterministically, reducing the risk of overfitting and making search easier. Execution traces provide diagnostic feedback about how compute was allocated over time, which is more informative than a single scalar accuracy-cost score.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are on mathematical reasoning benchmarks. The reported result is that AutoTTS discovers controllers with better accuracy-cost Pareto frontiers than strong hand-crafted baselines. The discovered controllers are said to generalize from the search benchmark to held-out benchmarks and across model scales. The provided text does not include the exact benchmark list, model sizes, absolute accuracy numbers, or cost reductions, so those should be checked in the tables and Pareto plots. The main empirical claim is about the search framework producing reusable compute-allocation policies, not about a single newly hand-designed TTS rule.
summary_en.reading_guide: A practical skim takes about 20 minutes. Focus on the formal definition of the controller state, action space, and budget, then read the beta parameterization and trace-feedback design. In the experiments, prioritize Pareto-frontier plots over isolated accuracy numbers. For pretraining-oriented readers, the most useful part is the offline replay environment: the same idea could inform searches over data mixtures, curricula, verifier usage, or reasoning-trajectory generation without repeatedly paying for online model calls.

recommendation.zh: 读环境构造和离线评估部分即可；如果泛化实验干净，可作为 reasoning 数据和 TTS 策略联训的模板。
recommendation.en: Read the environment construction and offline-evaluation setup; if generalization is clean, it is a useful template for coupling reasoning data with TTS policy search.

paper.title: BitCal-TTS: Bit-Calibrated Test-Time Scaling for Quantized Reasoning Models
paper.abstract: Post-training quantization makes large reasoning models practical under tight memory and latency budgets, but it can distort the online signals that drive adaptive test-time compute allocation. Under a fixed cap on the number of newly generated tokens, miscalibrated confidence can lead to harmful early halting: the model may surface a plausible final line while the underlying reasoning is still wrong, or the controller may stop before the trace has stabilized. We study this interaction for greed

summary.core_problem: 训练后量化会扭曲推理时驱动自适应测试时计算分配的在线置信度信号，导致推理任务中出现有害的提前停止问题
summary.importance: 工程创新，针对量化推理与自适应计算的耦合痛点，提出无需微调基模型的轻量化解决方案
summary.technical_approach: 提出BitCal-TTS运行时控制器，包含三个核心模块：token级不确定性与推理轨迹稳定性的低成本在线代理、位宽条件的保守置信度重缩放、针对结构化推理输出的位感知确认窗口，通过前向钩子集成到Hugging Face 4-bit推理管线，无需微调基模型
summary.experiments: 针对贪心4-bit推理场景设计，摘要未披露具体测试模型规模、基线对比与效果提升数值

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training quantization distorts online confidence signals driving adaptive test-time compute allocation, causing harmful early halting in reasoning tasks
summary_en.importance: Engineering innovation addressing the coupling pain point between quantized inference and adaptive compute, delivering a lightweight solution without base model fine-tuning
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes BitCal-TTS runtime controller with three core components: low-cost online proxies for token-level uncertainty and reasoning trace stability, bit-conditioned conservative confidence rescaling, and bit-aware confirmation horizon for structured reasoning outputs, integrated into Hugging Face 4-bit inference via forward hooks
summary_en.experiments: Designed for greedy 4-bit inference; no specific model scale, baseline comparison, or performance metrics are disclosed in the abstract

recommendation.zh: 仅作为量化推理侧置信度校准的工程参考，预训练研究员无需深读，了解结论即可
recommendation.en: Only serves as an engineering reference for confidence calibration in quantized inference; no need for pretrain researchers to read in depth.

paper.title: ReaComp: Compiling LLM Reasoning into Symbolic Solvers for Efficient Program Synthesis
paper.abstract: LLMs can solve program synthesis tasks but remain inefficient and unreliable on hard instances requiring large combinatorial search. Given a small set of reasoning traces, we use coding agents to compile them into reusable symbolic program synthesizers over constrained DSLs. The resulting solvers require no LLM calls at test time and are strong standalone systems: symbolic solver ensembles reach 91.3% accuracy on PBEBench-Lite and 84.7% on PBEBench-Hard, outperforming LLMs with test-time scaling

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是程序归纳中的推理成本问题：LLM 在 Programming by Example 任务上可以靠 Best-of-K、迭代反馈等 test-time scaling 得到较好结果，但在长程序和组合性更强的样例上会出现大量重复搜索、循环和 token 浪费。ReaComp 的目标不是让 LLM 在测试时继续多想，而是把少量推理轨迹离线编译成可复用的符号求解器。测试时先用符号求解器做结构化搜索，必要时再回退到 LLM。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，但对“推理能力如何外化和复用”有参考价值。它给出一个清晰信号：某些看似依赖长链推理的能力，可能更适合被蒸馏成显式搜索程序，而不是继续堆测试时采样。对预训练研究的启发主要在两点。第一，LLM 的 reasoning trace 可以作为可编译的数据资产，而不只是 SFT/RL 的训练样本。第二，组合泛化失败往往不是知识不足，而是搜索结构不稳定；这会影响如何设计 reasoning data、工具使用数据和后训练目标。该工作更接近 neuro-symbolic inference 和 coding agent distillation，不应理解为新的语言建模目标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法分为离线求解器归纳和在线混合推理。任务形式是 PBE：给定输入输出样例集合，目标是在受限 DSL 中找到程序，使其匹配所有样例。LLM 基线使用两类 test-time scaling：Best-of-K 独立采样，以及 Direct Feedback 迭代修正，最后用任务级 reward 选择候选程序。ReaComp 在离线阶段收集训练任务上的 LLM 推理轨迹，再让 coding agent 从轨迹中提炼反复出现的策略、错误模式和搜索模板，生成 standalone symbolic synthesizer。测试时，符号求解器或求解器 ensemble 先尝试解决任务，不需要 LLM 调用；失败样例再交给 LLM 搜索。与常见工具增强方法的区别在于，它不在每个测试样例上调用工具和 LLM 做交互式推理，而是把一次性的 agent 构造成本摊销到大量后续样例上。
summary.experiments: 核心结果集中在 PBEBench 和 SLR-Bench。符号求解器 ensemble 在 PBEBench-Lite 达到 91.3% accuracy，在 PBEBench-Hard 达到 84.7%。在 Hard 子集上，它比 LLM test-time scaling 基线高 16.3 个百分点，同时测试时没有 LLM token 成本。混合推理在 PBEBench-Hard 上把 accuracy 从 68.4% 提高到 85.8%，报告的 token 使用量减少 78%。在 SLR-Bench hard tier 上，neuro-symbolic hybrid 把 accuracy 从 34.4% 提高到 58.0%。作者还报告了历史语言学 forward reconstruction 的零样本迁移：求解器 ensemble 达到 80.1%，并能恢复合理的音变规则。诊断部分指出，强 reasoning model 在难例上会出现单次尝试内循环、跨尝试重复探索；短程序表现较好，长组合变换退化明显。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 LLM 搜索失败模式的分析，尤其是 Figure 3 所展示的 token/attempt 随难度变化。Method 部分重点看 solver induction 的输入、输出和 reward 选择机制，以及为什么 constrained DSL 使编译可行。实验部分建议直接看 PBEBench-Hard、SLR-Bench hard tier 和 hybrid token reduction 的表格。值得进一步追问的是：求解器归纳是否依赖 benchmark DSL 的结构；coding agent 生成的 solver 有多少人工约束；当任务分布变宽时，ensemble 的覆盖率和维护成本如何变化。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses the inference-cost bottleneck in program synthesis from examples. LLMs can solve many PBE instances with Best-of-K sampling or iterative feedback, but hard compositional cases require many attempts and often show redundant exploration or looping. ReaComp shifts the burden from test-time reasoning to offline compilation: a small set of LLM reasoning traces is turned into reusable symbolic solvers, which are then used before invoking an LLM fallback.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is not a pretraining method, but it is useful for thinking about reusable reasoning. It shows that reasoning traces can be treated as compile targets, not only as supervision for SFT or RL. It also separates two failure modes that are often conflated: lack of knowledge and lack of structured search. For foundation-model work, the main relevance is in data design for reasoning traces, tool-use supervision, and the economics of test-time compute. The result argues that some reasoning behavior is better amortized into explicit procedures than repeatedly sampled from a model.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setting is Programming by Example: given input-output examples, infer a program in a constrained DSL that satisfies them. The paper compares against standard test-time scaling methods, including independent Best-of-K generation and Direct Feedback refinement, with candidates selected by a task-level verifier reward. ReaComp has two stages. Offline, training tasks and LLM traces are given to coding agents, which distill recurring strategies and failure patterns into standalone symbolic synthesizers over the DSL. Online, a solver or solver ensemble attempts the task with no LLM calls; unresolved cases fall back to LLM search. This differs from typical tool-augmented agents because the agentic cost is paid once during solver construction rather than repeatedly during test-time interaction.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluations are on PBEBench and SLR-Bench. Symbolic solver ensembles reach 91.3% accuracy on PBEBench-Lite and 84.7% on PBEBench-Hard. On the hard split, they exceed the reported LLM test-time-scaling baseline by 16.3 percentage points while using zero LLM inference tokens. In hybrid mode, PBEBench-Hard accuracy improves from 68.4% to 85.8%, with reported token usage reduced by 78%. On the hard tier of SLR-Bench, the neuro-symbolic setup improves accuracy from 34.4% to 58.0%. The paper also reports zero-shot transfer to historical-linguistics forward reconstruction, where solver ensembling reaches 80.1% and recovers plausible sound-change rules. The diagnostic analysis highlights that LLM search is strong on short programs but degrades on longer compositional transformations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the failure analysis in the introduction, especially the discussion around Figure 3 on attempts, token usage, and task difficulty. Then read the method description for solver induction: what traces are compiled, what the constrained DSL buys, and how verifier rewards are used. In the experiments, focus on PBEBench-Hard, SLR-Bench hard tier, and the hybrid token-reduction results. The main points worth checking are distribution dependence, how much human structure is embedded in the DSL, and whether the one-time solver-construction cost remains favorable as tasks become less homogeneous.

recommendation.zh: 值得看方法循环和 PBEBench-Hard 结果；它提醒 test-time scaling 不总是该留在 token 空间里做。
recommendation.en: Read the induction loop and PBEBench-Hard results; it is a useful reminder that test-time scaling need not stay in token space.

paper.title: Recursive Agent Optimization
paper.abstract: We introduce Recursive Agent Optimization (RAO), a reinforcement learning approach for training recursive agents: agents that can spawn and delegate sub-tasks to new instantiations of themselves recursively. Recursive agents implement an inference-time scaling algorithm that naturally allows agents to scale to longer contexts and generalize to more difficult problems via divide-and-conquer. RAO provides a method to train models to best take advantage of such recursive inference, teaching agents

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是：如果递归式 agent 会成为一种重要的 test-time scaling 机制，那么模型不应只在推理时被外部脚手架“包起来”，而应该在训练中学会何时拆分任务、如何委派子任务、如何在层级之间传递信息，以及如何汇总子结果。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，更偏 post-train / agent training，但有两个启发点。第一，递归 delegation 可以被看成一种结构化的 inference-time compute 分配方式，和长上下文、外部记忆、树搜索属于同一类问题。第二，论文强调“把推理时脚手架放进训练回路”，这与近来的 scaffold-aware training、tool-use training、reasoning-time optimization 是一致方向。对做基座的人来说，价值在于理解：模型能力上限不只由参数和上下文长度决定，还受是否学会使用外部计算结构影响。
summary.technical_approach: RAO 的核心是用 RL 训练 recursive agents。agent 在执行过程中可以 launch subagent，把子目标交给新的自身实例处理；子 agent 拥有 fresh context，因此递归天然扩展有效工作记忆，并支持 divide-and-conquer 与并行。训练目标不是单纯学会完成任务，而是学会使用递归：什么时候值得 delegate，子任务该如何表述，父子节点之间传什么信息，以及何时停止递归并汇总答案。论文在合成环境 TextCraft-Synth 和真实长文档环境 Oolong-Real 上训练，重点比较单 agent 与 recursive agent，以及受限上下文和非受限上下文两种设定。方法上的关键不是新模型结构，而是把递归执行树视作 policy 的一部分，用 RL 直接优化。
summary.experiments: 实验主要覆盖三个场景。TextCraft-Synth 是可控合成 benchmark，任务难度由 crafting tree depth 控制：Easy 深度 2–3，Medium 4–6，Hard 7–9。作者只在 medium 难度上训练，然后测试向 easy 和 hard 的泛化；模型使用 Qwen-3-4B-Instruct-2507。在 constrained-context 设定中，训练和推理都限制在 8K context，用来检验递归是否能弥补上下文不足；在 unconstrained 设定中，训练 40K、推理 256K，此时单 agent 在上下文上并不吃亏，因此更能看出递归是否带来结构性泛化。Oolong-Real 使用 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct，训练时上下文上限 32K，而任务文档至少 55K token，单 agent 无法完整读取输入，递归 agent 则可通过分块子代理覆盖全输入。摘要还提到 RAO 在训练效率、超上下文任务泛化、以及 wall-clock latency 上都有优势，但给出的全文片段里没有完整表格数字；阅读时需要直接看主实验表和附录超参。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction，把作者要解决的问题和递归 agent 的执行模型弄清楚；再看 TextCraft-Synth 设定，因为这是最干净的机制验证；最后看 Oolong-Real，判断这种方法在真实长上下文任务里是否只是“分块读取”，还是确实学到了更好的 delegation policy。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主线。如果只看一个点，优先看训练时是否真的学会了更好的任务分解，而不是单纯依赖更多 token 或更长 context。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to train agents that can recursively spawn sub-agents, rather than treating recursion as a purely inference-time wrapper around a pretrained model.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a post-training and agent-training contribution than a pretraining one, but it matters for anyone thinking about test-time scaling. It frames recursive delegation as a structured way to allocate inference-time compute, similar in spirit to long-context processing, external memory, and search. It also reinforces a broader lesson: if a scaffold is important at inference time, training the policy with that scaffold in the loop can materially change how well the model uses it.
summary_en.technical_approach: RAO uses reinforcement learning to train recursive agents that can launch fresh instances of themselves on subtasks. Because each sub-agent gets a fresh context, recursion increases effective working memory and supports divide-and-conquer as well as parallel execution. The optimization target is not just task success, but competent use of recursion: when to delegate, how to phrase subgoals, what information to pass across levels, and how to aggregate sub-results. The paper evaluates this on a synthetic compositional environment, TextCraft-Synth, and on a real long-context benchmark, Oolong-Real. The main idea is to treat the recursive execution tree as part of the policy and optimize it directly with RL.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover controlled and realistic settings. In TextCraft-Synth, task difficulty is controlled by crafting-tree depth: Easy is depth 2–3, Medium 4–6, and Hard 7–9. Training is done only on medium tasks, with evaluation on both easier and harder tasks to test generalization. The model there is Qwen-3-4B-Instruct-2507. In the constrained-context setup, both training and inference use an 8K context window, testing whether recursion can compensate for limited context. In the unconstrained setup, training uses 40K and inference 256K, so the single-agent baseline is not context-limited; this makes it possible to test whether recursion helps beyond raw context length. On Oolong-Real, the model is Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct, trained with a 32K limit on tasks requiring at least 55K tokens of input, where recursive chunking becomes necessary. The abstract claims gains in training efficiency, out-of-context generalization, and wall-clock time, but the excerpt here does not include the full result tables, so the exact margins need to be checked in the main experiments and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim is to read the introduction first, then the TextCraft-Synth section, and finally the Oolong-Real experiments. That is enough to understand the execution model, the training objective, and the intended benefit of recursion. Budget about 20–30 minutes. The main thing to watch for is whether the learned policy truly improves task decomposition and communication, rather than merely exploiting more total tokens or a chunking heuristic.

recommendation.zh: 想看 test-time compute 如何被训练成策略可以扫一眼；但它更像 agentic decomposition，不会直接改你的 pretrain recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming if you care about learning test-time compute policies, but this is agentic decomposition rather than something that will directly change your pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Scaling Test-Time Compute for Agentic Coding
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling has become a powerful way to improve large language models. However, existing methods are best suited to short, bounded outputs that can be directly compared, ranked or refined. Long-horizon coding agents violate this premise: each attempt produces an extended trajectory of actions, observations, errors, and partial progress taken by the agent. In this setting, the main challenge is no longer generating more attempts, but representing prior experience in a form that can be effe

summary.core_problem: 论文研究长程 agentic coding 的测试时计算扩展：当一个 coding agent 产生的是多步环境交互轨迹，而不是短答案时，如何有效复用多次尝试中的信息。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不属于预训练方法，但对通用 agent 训练和后训练有参考价值。它指出长程 agent 的关键瓶颈不是简单增加采样次数，而是如何表示、选择和复用历史轨迹。这个结论会影响 agent SFT/RL 数据格式设计：训练数据不一定只保留完整轨迹，也可以显式训练模型生成结构化失败摘要、诊断、部分修复和后续计划。
summary.technical_approach: 方法围绕 compact structured rollout summaries 展开。每次 agent rollout 包含思考、bash 命令、环境观察、错误日志和中间修改，直接比较或塞回上下文都很低效。作者先用模型把轨迹压缩成结构化摘要，保留假设、关键决策、进展和失败模式，丢掉重复终端输出等低价值细节。随后在两个方向扩展测试时计算：并行方向提出 Recursive Tournament Voting，在多个 rollout 摘要之间做递归小组选择，而不是一次性比较大量完整轨迹；顺序方向改造 Parallel-Distill-Refine，让后续 rollout 条件化于多个先前摘要，从而复用已有诊断和失败经验。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 SWE-Bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench v2.0，并在多个前沿闭源模型上测试，包括 Claude-4.5-Opus、Gemini-3.1-Pro、Claude-4.5-Sonnet、Gemini-3-Flash、GPT-5-0825。关键数字包括：在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，Claude-4.5-Opus 从 70.9% 提升到 77.6%，Gemini-3.1-Pro 从 72.3% 提升到 76.6%；在 Terminal-Bench v2.0 上，Claude-4.5-Opus 从 46.9% 提升到 59.1%，Gemini-3.1-Pro 从 52.5% 提升到 64.8%。消融观察包括：结构化摘要比原始轨迹更适合做 rollout 比较；递归小组选择优于一次性大组选择；顺序 refinement 使用多个先前摘要通常好于使用单个先前尝试；后续 rollout 的质量和 refinement context 的质量强相关。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Methodology 和实验消融部分，预计 25–35 分钟。重点看 Section 2.2 的 rollout summary 设计、Section 2.3 的 Recursive Tournament Voting、Section 2.4 的 agentic PDR，以及 Section 3.2 的表示消融。对预训练研究员而言，值得关注的不是具体 benchmark 分数，而是轨迹压缩格式能否转化为 agent 训练数据规范，例如把失败模式、环境观察摘要、可复用假设作为显式监督目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses test-time compute scaling for long-horizon agentic coding. Unlike single-turn code generation, an agentic coding attempt produces a long interaction trajectory with file reads, edits, command execution, logs, and failures. The question is how to reuse information from many such attempts without comparing or replaying raw trajectories.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant for agent post-training and data design. The central lesson is that scaling long-horizon agents requires a good representation of prior attempts, not just more samples. For training research, this points toward supervision formats that teach models to summarize failures, preserve useful diagnoses, and condition future attempts on compact reusable artifacts rather than full logs.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses compact structured rollout summaries as the interface for test-time scaling. Each rollout is compressed into a summary that records key hypotheses, decisions, progress, and failure modes while removing low-value details such as repeated terminal output. The summaries are then used in two ways. For parallel scaling, Recursive Tournament Voting selects stronger attempts through recursive small-group comparisons over summaries. For sequential scaling, the authors adapt Parallel-Distill-Refine so that new rollouts are conditioned on multiple distilled summaries from previous attempts, rather than on one raw trajectory.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on SWE-Bench Verified and Terminal-Bench v2.0 across Claude-4.5-Opus, Gemini-3.1-Pro, Claude-4.5-Sonnet, Gemini-3-Flash, and GPT-5-0825. Reported gains include Claude-4.5-Opus improving from 70.9% to 77.6% on SWE-Bench Verified and Gemini-3.1-Pro from 72.3% to 76.6%. On Terminal-Bench v2.0, Claude-4.5-Opus improves from 46.9% to 59.1%, and Gemini-3.1-Pro from 52.5% to 64.8%. The ablations support four claims: structured summaries are better comparison objects than raw trajectories; recursive small-group selection works better than flatter large-group selection; conditioning refinement on multiple prior summaries is better than using a single prior attempt; and the quality of the refinement context strongly predicts the quality of later rollouts.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the methodology and ablation sections. The most relevant parts are Section 2.2 on rollout summaries, Section 2.3 on Recursive Tournament Voting, Section 2.4 on agentic Parallel-Distill-Refine, and Section 3.2 on representation ablations. Expected reading time is 25–35 minutes. For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful question is whether these trajectory summaries can become a training target for agent models: failure-mode summaries, reusable diagnoses, and environment-state abstractions may be better supervision units than full interaction traces.

recommendation.zh: 和 pretrain 关系不深，知道它把长轨迹问题重写成“摘要表示 + 选择复用”就够了；若你做 agent rollout 数据回流训练，可重点看摘要格式与投票消融。
recommendation.en: Not very close to pretraining; it is worth knowing mainly for the reframing of long trajectories into summary representations plus reuse. If you recycle agent rollouts for training, inspect the summary format and voting ablations.

commentary.article_excerpt: 大模型任我行 关注 Meta：长程智能体测试时扩展新范式 📖标题：Scaling Test-Time Compute for Agentic Coding 🌐来源：arXiv, 2604.16529v1 🛎️文章简介 🔸研究问题：如何有效利用额外的推理计算资源来提升长周期代码智能体（Agentic Coding）的性能，解决传统方法难以直接比较和复用冗长交互轨迹的难题？ 🔸主要贡献：提出了一种基于紧凑结构化摘要表示的统一测试时扩展框架，结合递归锦标赛投票与并行蒸馏优化，显著提升了前沿模型在复杂代码基准上的表现。 📝重点思路 🔸将冗长且充满噪声的智能体交互轨迹转化为紧凑的结构化摘要，保留关键假设、进展和失败模式，作为后续选择与复用的核心接口。 🔸引入递归锦标赛投票机制，通过将候选摘要分组进行多轮小规模比较和投票聚合，在无真实标签情况下从并行生成的多个尝试中筛选出最优解。 🔸适配并行蒸馏优化方法至智能体场景，利用前一轮精选出的高质量摘要作为上下文条件，指导新一轮智能体在初始化环境中进行更高效的探索与修复。 🔸构建统一流水线，先通过并行生成与投票筛选出高质量经验子集，再基于此进行顺序迭代优化，最后再次投票选出最终结果，平衡了探索与利用。 🔎分析总结 🔸实验表明，使用紧凑结构化摘要作为比较对象比直接使用完整轨迹能显著提升选择准确率，证明了表示形式是扩展性能的关键瓶颈。 🔸递归式的小组两两比较配合多次投票聚合，优于一次性对所有候选者进行全局排序，能有效处理长周期任务中的细微差别。 🔸顺序优化的效果高度依赖于复用上下文的质量，基于投票筛选出的高质量摘要进行微调，比随机采样或单条轨迹复用能带来更大的性能提升。 🔸该方法在 SWE-Bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench v2.0 等多个基准上，使 Claude-4.5-Opus 等前沿模型的通过率提升了 6% 至 12% 不等，并减少了约一半的解题步骤。 💡个人观点 论文洞察到长周期智能体测试时扩展的核心并非单纯增加计算量，而是如何高效地“表示、选择和复用”过往经验，要将非结构化的漫长交互压缩为高信噪比的摘要。 #LLM #大模型 #agent #论文分享 #Meta 5天前

paper.title: Adaptive Consensus in LLM Ensembles via Sequential Evidence Accumulation: Automatic Budget Identification and Calibrated Commit Signals
paper.abstract: Large Language Model ensembles improve reasoning accuracy up to a performance boundary; beyond it, additional deliberation degrades accuracy. Static-budget methods cannot detect this boundary. Extended-thinking architectures compound the problem: a wrong answer after 120k tokens is indistinguishable from a correct one. We introduce DASE (Deliberative Adaptive Stopping Ensemble), a stopping heuristic for iterative ensemble deliberation that commits early on genuine consensus and applies a global-

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM ensemble/extended-thinking 在多轮 deliberation 中何时停止、何时提交答案的问题，避免继续思考反而降准确率和浪费预算。
summary.importance: 贡献属于推理时控制与集成策略，而不是预训练。价值在于给出一个可操作的 stopping heuristic，并指出“更多 token/更多轮讨论不一定更好”的预算边界现象。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DASE（Deliberative Adaptive Stopping Ensemble），基于顺序证据累积来判断是否形成真实共识；当证据碎片化时使用全局频率回退。文中还比较 persistence heuristic 与 DASE-Spatial（arena half-width W）两种配置，并把 commit-type routing 与单次 verbalized confidence 做互补分析。
summary.experiments: 在 contamination-controlled 的 AIME 2010-2023 数据上评估，N=254，3 个随机种子；使用 120B ensemble。摘要报告其 commit routing 可形成 24.8 个百分点的区分间隔（right-wall 97.1% vs left-wall 73.6%），并称在覆盖率匹配下与 Opus 4.6 Standard 的 verbalized confidence 统计上相当。实验规模不大，主要是推理预算控制信号的现象验证。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles when an LLM ensemble or extended-thinking system should stop deliberating and commit, to avoid both accuracy degradation and wasted inference budget.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-time control paper rather than a pretraining one. Its value is in offering a practical stopping heuristic and highlighting a useful boundary phenomenon: more tokens or more deliberation can hurt accuracy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes DASE (Deliberative Adaptive Stopping Ensemble), a sequential evidence-accumulation heuristic that commits early on genuine consensus and falls back to global frequency when evidence remains fragmented. It compares a persistence heuristic and DASE-Spatial (arena half-width W), and studies commit-type routing as complementary to single-call verbalized confidence.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluation is on a contamination-controlled AIME 2010-2023 set with N=254 and 3 seeds, using a 120B ensemble. The abstract reports a 24.8-point routing gap (97.1% vs. 73.6%) and statistical parity with Opus 4.6 Standard verbalized confidence at matched coverage. The setup is modest in scale and mainly supports an inference-budget control observation.

recommendation.zh: 结论对 test-time scaling 有点用，但更像小样本启发式；只看摘要和路由结果，别把它当稳健方法论。
recommendation.en: Potentially useful for test-time scaling, but this looks more like a small-sample heuristic than a durable method; read the routing result and move on.

paper.title: When to Vote, When to Rewrite: Disagreement-Guided Strategy Routing for Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on mathematical reasoning tasks but remain unreliable on challenging instances. Existing test-time scaling methods, such as repeated sampling, self-correction, and tree search, improve performance at the cost of increased computation, yet often exhibit diminishing returns on hard problems. We observe that output disagreement is strongly correlated with instance difficulty and prediction correctness, providing a useful signal for guiding in

summary.core_problem: 在不改模型、不加训练的前提下，如何把“test-time scaling”的额外算力用在刀刃上：对不同难度/不确定性的题目，动态选择更合适的推理增强策略（投票 vs 重写再推理），避免在简单题上浪费采样、在难题上陷入投票的边际收益递减。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对“推理能力评测与训练信号设计”有间接价值：它把输出分歧（disagreement）当作可操作的不确定性指标，展示了同一基座在不同实例上存在明显的策略最优解差异。这类现象会反过来影响两件事：1）做 scaling law/训练动态分析时，不能只看平均指标，实例难度分布会改变最优推理预算；2）若未来把 test-time routing 的信号蒸馏回训练（例如作为 curriculum 或 sample reweighting），disagreement 可作为一种“无需标注的难度/噪声代理”。整体更偏 post-train / inference-time 方法论，适合泛读了解其信号与路由框架。
summary.technical_approach:
方法是一个三段式、training-free 的实例级路由框架，把“算力分配”从单策略内的自适应（多采样/树搜索深度）扩展为“策略选择”。核心信号是输出分歧：
1）Minimal Disagreement Detector (MDD)：对同一题做两次随机采样生成答案a1、a2，用归一化等价判断（数值/符号/结构匹配）判定是否一致。用极低成本把样本分成无分歧/有分歧。
2）Disagreement Filter：若两次一致，直接输出，认为是 easy/高置信实例，避免继续采样。
3）Vote Resolve：对“轻微分歧”实例增加采样次数，做多数投票（majority voting）得到最终答案。直觉是：分布有主峰时投票有效。
4）Rewrite & Rethink：对“严重分歧”实例，先对题目进行重写（reformulation），再重新采样/投票。动机是：难题上模型对表述敏感，重写能把模型从不稳定推理轨道拉出来；同时作者也强调重写对简单题可能有害（引入语义漂移或错误假设），因此只在高分歧时触发。
整体上，贡献点不在某个新推理算子，而在“用分歧做门控，把投票与重写的 trade-off 显式化”，并用两次采样的廉价检测器把路由做成可落地流程。
summary.experiments: 论文在 7 个数学推理基准与 3 个 LRM 上评估，并报告相对基线 test-time scaling 的绝对提升约 3%–7%，且在更难的基准上增益更明显；同时由于对无分歧样本早停，整体采样次数更少（更省算力）。作者还做了代码生成任务的泛化验证，说明“分歧→路由”的信号不局限于数学。消融重点围绕三阶段各自贡献、以及重写在不同难度分桶上的正负效应：简单题重写可能降分，难题重写更稳定增益；投票在轻微分歧区间更有效，但在严重分歧时边际收益差。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看引言里关于“重写 vs 投票在 easy/hard 上相反趋势”的现象图（通常是 Figure 1）来建立动机。
- 重点看方法图（Figure 2）与 Algorithm 1，理解三段式路由与 MDD 的判定逻辑，以及“轻微/严重分歧”的划分规则。
- 实验部分优先看：按难度或按分歧程度分桶的结果、以及计算量（采样次数）对比；这些比单一平均准确率更能说明路由是否真的把算力用对地方。
预计阅读时间：20–30 分钟可抓住主线；若要复现，额外花时间在答案等价归一化与重写提示词细节。

summary_en.core_problem: How to allocate test-time compute more effectively without any training: route each instance to the right inference-time scaling strategy (majority voting vs. rewrite-then-reason) based on an uncertainty signal, instead of blindly increasing samples within a single strategy and suffering diminishing returns on hard problems.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining contribution per se, but it is relevant to foundation-model research in two ways. First, it operationalizes output disagreement as a cheap uncertainty/difficulty proxy, which matters when interpreting scaling behaviors under different evaluation budgets. Second, the routing signal is a plausible candidate for distillation back into training (curriculum, reweighting, or synthetic data targeting), since it does not require labels. Overall, it sits closer to post-train / inference methodology than to core pretrain objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach:
A training-free, instance-level routing pipeline with three stages driven by disagreement:
- Minimal Disagreement Detector (MDD): sample twice; if the two answers match under a normalized equivalence check (numeric/symbolic/structural), treat the instance as consistent.
- Disagreement Filter: for no-disagreement cases, early-exit and return the answer (avoid wasted sampling).
- Vote Resolve: for minor disagreement, increase sampling and apply majority voting, assuming the answer distribution has a dominant mode.
- Rewrite & Rethink: for severe disagreement (flat/unstable answer distribution), rewrite the problem statement and resample to escape brittle reasoning trajectories. The key design choice is gating rewriting only when disagreement is high, because rewriting can hurt easy instances via semantic drift or injected assumptions.
The novelty is the explicit compute/strategy trade-off: voting is favored when consensus is strong; rewriting is reserved for high-uncertainty cases.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on seven math reasoning benchmarks with three LRMs, reporting ~3–7 absolute accuracy gains over baselines, with larger improvements on harder benchmarks where base accuracy is low. The method also reduces average sampling cost via early exits on consistent instances. A generalization check on code generation suggests the disagreement-based routing signal is not math-specific. Ablations emphasize per-stage contributions and show rewriting is beneficial mainly in the high-disagreement regime while potentially degrading easy cases.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Start with the motivating result showing opposite behaviors of voting vs rewriting across easy/hard buckets (typically Figure 1).
- Read the method schematic and Algorithm 1 to understand the three-stage router and how MDD defines minor vs severe disagreement.
- In experiments, prioritize bucketed analyses by difficulty/disagreement and the compute (number of samples) comparison; these validate that routing, not just extra sampling, drives gains.
Time: ~20–30 minutes for the main idea; more if you care about answer-equivalence normalization and rewriting prompt details for reproduction.

recommendation.zh: 利用 disagreement 作为 test-time scaling 路由信号的思路很实用，对设计推理阶段的 compute allocation 策略有启发，值得看其路由机制的设计。
recommendation.en: Using disagreement as a routing signal for test-time scaling is practical and insightful for designing compute allocation strategies during inference; worth checking the routing mechanism design.

paper.title: Entropy Centroids as Intrinsic Rewards for Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: An effective way to scale up test-time compute of large language models is to sample multiple responses and then select the best one, as in Grok Heavy and Gemini Deep Think. Existing selection methods often rely on external reward models, which requires training a strong reward model and introduces additional computation overhead. As an alternative, previous approaches have explored intrinsic signals, such as confidence and entropy, but these signals are noisy with naive aggregation. In this wor

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 test-time scaling 里的一个老问题：当同一个问题采样出多条推理轨迹后，如何不用外部 reward model、也不依赖多数投票，单靠模型自身生成过程中的内在信号，稳定地区分“早期探索但最终收敛”的好轨迹和“后期持续混乱”的坏轨迹。作者认为，问题不在于熵这个信号本身无效，而在于 token 级熵太噪，简单平均又会抹掉时间结构，因此需要一个更粗粒度、带位置信息的 uncertainty 表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain objective，但对“模型内部不确定性是否可作为可用训练/推理信号”这个问题给了一个很具体的答案。它的启发主要有三点。第一，token-level entropy 不是只能做 calibration 指标，也可以经过结构化建模后变成 trajectory-level reward。第二，推理质量和不确定性的关系不是单调的：早期高熵可能对应有效探索，后期高熵更像局部崩塌，这一点对 RL、self-training、process reward 设计都有参考意义。第三，它提示了一个方向：如果预训练或后训练改变了熵随时间的分布形态，那么这些动态统计量可能比静态平均置信度更能反映模型能力边界。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心很简单，但设计上有两层。第一层是把连续高熵 token 段定义成 High Entropy Phase, HEP。作者不是直接对全序列做滑窗平均，而是用双阈值和结束条件把“高熵爆发段”切出来：当 token entropy 超过高阈值时进入 HEP，之后直到连续若干 token 低于低阈值才结束。这样做的目的，是把单 token 的局部抖动压平，得到更接近“一个推理单元处于不确定状态”的片段。第二层是在 HEP 之上构造 Entropy Centroid。每个 HEP 的长度被当作质量，HEP 中点被当作位置，再对整条轨迹做加权平均，得到一个标量，表示高熵探索主要集中在前段还是后段。选择策略非常直接：在 N 条候选轨迹里选 centroid 最低的那条。作者的判断是，正确轨迹往往在前期经历探索，后面进入低熵收敛；错误轨迹则更容易在后段仍然出现高熵混乱。和已有 intrinsic reward 方法相比，它不依赖平均熵、平均置信度或固定窗口统计，而是显式编码了 uncertainty 的时间位置。和 reward model 路线相比，它没有额外训练成本，也不需要任务特定标注。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 14B 到 480B 的模型规模，任务包括数学、代码生成、逻辑推理和 agentic task，重点不是单一 benchmark 冲分，而是看 Lowest Centroid 作为统一选择准则是否稳定。全文给出的主结论是：在不同模型尺度和任务类型上，Lowest Centroid 都比已有 intrinsic baselines 更稳，且随着模型变大，收益没有明显消失。作者还做了几类关键分析。其一，HEP 可视化显示高熵 token 确实不是独立噪点，而是成段出现，这为从 token 升到 phase 提供了经验依据。其二，正确与错误轨迹的 centroid 分布有明显分离，正确轨迹的高熵更偏前部。其三，和 token-level entropy、confidence、KL 或固定窗口平均相比，centroid 更能区分“有用探索”和“后期迷失”。从你给出的全文片段看，具体 benchmark 数字没有完整展开，但论文主打的是跨任务一致性和尺度稳定性，而不是某一个数据集上的极端提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1、Figure 2，先确认作者到底在建模什么现象：不是“低熵一定好”，而是“高熵出现在什么位置”更重要。然后看 HEP 的正式定义，重点留意高阈值、低阈值、结束条件这几个超参是怎么设的，因为方法是否稳健很大程度取决于 phase 切分是否合理。实验部分建议优先看三类内容：一是不同任务上的主表，判断它是不是只在数学题上有效；二是和 token 平均熵、局部窗口统计的对比；三是可视化分析，尤其是正确/错误轨迹的 centroid 分布。如果只想快速判断是否值得深入，预计 20–30 分钟足够。若进一步深挖，值得想两个问题：这种 temporal uncertainty pattern 是否能反哺 RL 训练；以及 HEP/centroid 是否会受到 tokenizer、长度归一化和 SFT 后 logit sharpening 的系统性影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a selection problem in test-time scaling: given multiple sampled reasoning trajectories, how can we pick the best one without an external reward model and without relying on majority voting? The key claim is that entropy itself is not the issue; the issue is that token-level entropy is too noisy, while simple averaging destroys temporal structure. What matters is not only how uncertain a trajectory is, but when that uncertainty appears along the trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it turns internal uncertainty dynamics into a usable trajectory-level signal. The main value is conceptual. First, predictive entropy can become a practical intrinsic reward once it is structured properly. Second, the relationship between uncertainty and quality is non-monotonic: early high entropy may reflect productive exploration, while late high entropy often signals failure. That observation matters for RL, process supervision, and self-improvement pipelines. Third, it suggests that temporal statistics of uncertainty may be more informative than static confidence averages when diagnosing how pretraining or post-training changes model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has two layers. The first is High Entropy Phase (HEP), a variable-length segment of consecutive high-entropy tokens. Instead of averaging entropy over fixed windows, the paper detects bursts: a phase starts when token entropy crosses a high threshold and ends only after a specified number of consecutive tokens fall below a low threshold. This is meant to smooth token-level noise and better align the signal with a coherent reasoning unit under uncertainty. The second layer is the Entropy Centroid. Each HEP is assigned a mass equal to its token length and a position equal to its midpoint in the trajectory. The centroid is then the weighted average position of all HEPs in the trajectory. At selection time, among N sampled trajectories, the method simply chooses the one with the lowest centroid. The intuition is that good trajectories tend to explore early and settle later, whereas bad trajectories remain uncertain late into generation. Compared with prior intrinsic signals such as mean entropy, confidence, KL, or fixed-window aggregation, this method explicitly encodes temporal placement of uncertainty. Compared with reward-model-based selection, it adds no extra training cost.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans models from 14B to 480B parameters and covers mathematics, code generation, logical reasoning, and agentic tasks. The main empirical claim is consistency: Lowest Centroid outperforms existing intrinsic baselines across settings, and the gains remain stable as model size increases. The analysis section appears to be more important than any single benchmark number. The paper shows that high-entropy tokens indeed occur in bursts rather than as isolated spikes, which justifies moving from tokens to phases. It also shows a separation between correct and incorrect trajectories in centroid space: correct trajectories concentrate uncertainty earlier, while incorrect ones exhibit more late-stage confusion. Relative to token-level entropy, confidence, KL-based signals, and fixed-window averages, the centroid better distinguishes useful exploration from unresolved uncertainty. From the provided full-text excerpt, the exact benchmark tables are not fully visible, so the main takeaway is robustness across tasks and scales rather than one standout numeric gain.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the first two figures. They establish the central point: low entropy is not uniformly good; the temporal pattern matters. Then read the formal HEP definition carefully, especially the high threshold, low threshold, and stopping rule, because the method depends on whether phase segmentation is stable. In the experiments, focus on three parts: the main cross-task results, the comparison against token-average and window-based baselines, and the visualizations of centroid distributions for correct vs. incorrect trajectories. For a quick pass, 20 to 30 minutes is enough. If reading more deeply, two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether this temporal uncertainty signal can be fed back into RL training, and how sensitive HEP/centroid is to tokenizer choice, sequence length normalization, and post-training-induced logit sharpening.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §方法和主表；若 HEP 消融干净，它会改变只看平均熵做 self-selection 的默认做法。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and main table; if the HEP ablations are clean, this weakens the default practice of using averaged entropy for self-selection.

paper.title: Doing More With Less: Revisiting the Effectiveness of LLM Pruning for Test-Time Scaling
paper.abstract: While current Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit remarkable reasoning capabilities through test-time compute scaling (TTS), their massive parameter counts and high inference costs have motivated the development of pruning methods that can reduce model size without sacrificing performance. However, specific to reasoning LLMs, prior work has shown that structured pruning (methods which removes entire set of layer blocks), significantly degrades TTS reasoning performance. In this work, we revisit

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的是：面向 test-time scaling 的推理型 LLM，剪枝是否一定会伤害长链推理能力。已有结论主要来自结构化剪枝，也就是直接删整层或整块网络，因此观察到随着推理 token 预算增加，模型在数学和复杂推理任务上的收益明显变差。作者重新检查这个结论，问题被收紧为：如果不改网络拓扑，只做非结构化剪枝，把单个权重置零，是否仍然会破坏 TTS 带来的性能增益，以及不同层的稀疏率分配会怎样影响这种关系。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，这不是新的建模目标或训练范式，但它对“参数冗余、推理深度、可用容量”之间的关系给了一个有用的反例。更具体地说，先前一些讨论容易把“剪枝伤害长推理”泛化成普遍规律，这篇工作说明问题更可能出在删掉了关键层级结构，而不是单纯减少参数量。这个区分很重要，因为它影响后续对稀疏预训练、稀疏后训练、以及推理期算力分配的判断：如果 TTS 依赖的是网络中的某些功能路径而非致密参数本身，那么保留结构、只去掉冗余权重，可能仍能保住长链推理收益。贡献量级偏经验性和纠偏性，不是范式级推进，但对做稀疏化、压缩和推理效率的人有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上很直接，重点在实验设计而不是提出新剪枝算法。作者把结构化剪枝和非结构化剪枝放到同一 TTS 评测框架下比较。结构化侧使用 ShortGPT 一类按 block influence 删除整层的方法；非结构化侧主要考察经典 magnitude pruning 和 Wanda。前者按权重绝对值裁剪，后者利用权重与激活统计的组合来决定保留哪些连接。非结构化剪枝保持原有层数、残差路径和注意力/MLP 的宏观结构不变，只在层内形成稀疏掩码。论文还专门研究 layer-wise sparsity allocation，也就是总稀疏率固定时，稀疏度如何在不同层分配。这个点有意义，因为如果 TTS 依赖中后层的迭代推理能力，那么均匀稀疏和按层敏感度分配，结果可能差很多。作者的核心论点不是“所有非结构化剪枝都安全”，而是“结构保持”比“参数总量保持”更关键；在 reasoning LLM 上，删层会破坏深层计算路径，而细粒度删权重在相当范围内不会。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个推理模型：s1.1-7B 和 Qwen3-8B；四个基准：MATH500、AIME24、AMC23、GPQA-Diamond。评测重点不是单点精度，而是随着 test-time token budget 增加，性能是否还能继续上升。全文给出的主结论是：结构化剪枝会复现已有工作中的现象，即在短推理或浅层任务上还能维持，但一旦任务需要更长 reasoning trace，TTS 曲线明显变平甚至掉队；而非结构化剪枝在多数设置下能接近未剪枝模型，有些 benchmark 上还会略好。作者还比较了不同稀疏率分配策略，发现并不是任意分配都一样，某些层更敏感，合理分配能减少 TTS 损失。就证据类型看，这篇文章的价值主要来自多基准、一致的 TTS 曲线对比，以及把“剪枝类型”作为关键变量单独拎出来。摘要截断后没有完整数字表，但从正文描述看，结论依赖的是跨模型、跨任务的一致趋势，而不是单个数据点上的偶然提升。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，确认它要纠正的是哪一个已有结论。然后直接看实验主表和 TTS 曲线图，重点不是绝对分数，而是不同 token budget 下曲线斜率是否保留。接着看 layer-wise sparsity allocation 的消融，这部分最接近机制线索：哪些层被稀疏化后，长链推理更容易受伤。若时间有限，优先看结构化 vs 非结构化的对照图、不同稀疏率下的结果，以及作者对 Wanda 与 magnitude pruning 差异的讨论。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要信息；若你关心稀疏预训练或 sparse scaling，再花时间看附录里的实现细节和稀疏配置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a narrow but important question: does pruning necessarily break test-time scaling in reasoning LLMs, or was that conclusion specific to structured pruning that removes whole layers/blocks? Prior evidence mostly came from structured pruning, where longer reasoning traces degrade sharply after pruning. This work revisits the claim by isolating unstructured pruning, which preserves the architecture and only zeros individual weights, and studies whether TTS gains survive under sparsity and how layer-wise sparsity allocation changes the outcome.
summary_en.importance: This is not a new pretraining paradigm, but it matters for how people reason about capacity, redundancy, and long-horizon inference. A common takeaway from earlier work was that pruning is fundamentally hostile to deep reasoning under TTS. This paper argues that the failure mode is more specific: removing structural depth is much more damaging than removing fine-grained redundant weights. That distinction is useful for sparse pretraining, post-training sparsification, and inference-time efficiency work. If TTS depends on preserving functional computation paths across layers rather than keeping every dense parameter, then architecture-preserving sparsity may be compatible with long-chain reasoning. The contribution is mainly empirical and corrective rather than foundational, but it is relevant to anyone working on sparsity or reasoning-efficient deployment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper is centered on experimental comparison rather than a new pruning algorithm. It evaluates structured pruning and unstructured pruning under the same TTS setup. On the structured side, it uses layer/block removal methods such as ShortGPT based on block influence. On the unstructured side, it studies magnitude pruning and Wanda. Magnitude pruning removes weights by absolute value; Wanda uses weight-activation statistics to decide which connections to keep. The key property is that unstructured pruning preserves the original depth, residual pathways, and macro-architecture, while inducing sparsity within layers. A notable part of the study is layer-wise sparsity allocation: under a fixed global sparsity budget, how should sparsity be distributed across layers? This matters because TTS may rely disproportionately on certain layers, especially if later layers are more important for iterative reasoning. The central claim is not that all unstructured pruning is harmless, but that preserving architectural structure is more important than preserving dense parameter count.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on two reasoning models, s1.1-7B and Qwen3-8B, and four benchmarks: MATH500, AIME24, AMC23, and GPQA-Diamond. The main evaluation lens is not just final accuracy, but whether performance continues to improve as the test-time token budget increases. The reported pattern is consistent: structured pruning reproduces the known failure mode, where shallow tasks may remain intact but longer reasoning tasks lose much of the TTS benefit; unstructured pruning, in contrast, usually tracks the dense model closely and sometimes slightly exceeds it on some benchmarks. The paper also compares different layer-wise sparsity allocation strategies and shows that allocation matters: some layers are more sensitive, and better allocation reduces TTS degradation. The value of the evidence comes from consistent TTS-curve comparisons across models and tasks, rather than a single isolated gain. The abstract snippet does not include the full numeric tables, but the full text frames the result as a robust trend across settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction to see exactly which prior claim is being challenged. Then jump to the main result tables and TTS scaling curves. The key signal is not the absolute score at one compute budget, but whether the slope of improvement with more tokens is preserved after pruning. After that, read the ablations on layer-wise sparsity allocation; that section is the closest the paper gets to a mechanism story. If time is limited, focus on the structured-vs-unstructured comparison, the results at different sparsity levels, and the discussion of Wanda versus magnitude pruning. Around 20–30 minutes is enough to extract the main message. If you care about sparse pretraining or sparse scaling, spend extra time on the appendix for implementation details and sparsity configurations.

recommendation.zh: 只看剪枝率×TTS budget 的曲线；若 setup 干净，应把“剪枝必伤 reasoning scaling”的 prior 下调一档。
recommendation.en: Look at the sparsity-by-TTS-budget curves; if the setup is clean, it weakens the prior that pruning necessarily hurts reasoning-time scaling.

paper.title: Large Language Models Explore by Latent Distilling
paper.abstract: Generating diverse responses is crucial for test-time scaling of large language models (LLMs), yet standard stochastic sampling mostly yields surface-level lexical variation, limiting semantic exploration. In this paper, we propose Exploratory Sampling (ESamp), a decoding approach that explicitly encourages semantic diversity during generation. ESamp is motivated by the well-known observation that neural networks tend to make lower-error predictions on inputs similar to those encountered before,

summary.core_problem: 标准随机采样常只带来词面变化，难以在测试时扩展中产生语义上真正不同的候选解。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个推理时探索机制：用模型内部表示的预测误差作为 novelty signal，尝试把多样性从词级扰动推进到语义级探索。它不改变预训练目标，但对理解解码、多样性和 test-time scaling 有一定参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the limitation that ordinary stochastic decoding often produces lexical variation without much semantic exploration.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an inference-time exploration mechanism that turns internal representation prediction error into a novelty signal. It does not change pretraining, but it is relevant to decoding behavior, diversity, and test-time scaling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Exploratory Sampling method trains a lightweight Distiller at test time to predict deep-layer LLM representations from shallow-layer representations. During generation, the Distiller adapts to the current context, and its prediction error on candidate continuations is used to reweight token choices toward semantically novel regions.
