recommendation.en: Read only the novelty-score definition and ablations; this looks like a decoding heuristic, not a prior shift for pretraining.

paper.title: Efficient Test-Time Inference via Deterministic Exploration of Truncated Decoding Trees
paper.abstract: Self-consistency boosts inference-time performance by sampling multiple reasoning traces in parallel and voting. However, in constrained domains like math and code, this strategy is compute-inefficient because it samples with replacement, repeatedly revisiting the same high-probability prefixes and duplicate completions. We propose Distinct Leaf Enumeration (DLE), a deterministic decoding method that treats truncated sampling as traversal of a pruned decoding tree and systematically enumerates d

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 test-time scaling 里一个很具体但常被忽略的问题：self-consistency 通过并行采样多条推理链来换准确率，但在数学、代码这类可行解空间很窄的任务上，采样会反复落到相同高概率前缀和重复完成，导致算力花在“重复探索”上，而不是“扩大有效覆盖”。作者要解决的不是如何做更强的搜索，也不是训练一个额外的 verifier，而是在给定截断采样规则和固定 token 预算下，怎样系统地枚举更多互不重复、且仍然位于高概率区域的候选解。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在预训练目标，而在推理时 compute allocation 的设计。它给出一个清楚的判断：当后训练模型分布变尖、top-p/min-p 截断后有效分支数很小，随机采样并不是高效的 test-time compute 使用方式。DLE 把“多采样”改成“确定性覆盖截断树中的不同叶子”，说明在 constrained reasoning 场景里，覆盖率比采样独立性更关键。这个结论对后续做 inference-time scaling、reasoning search、prefix reuse、以及训练时是否要鼓励更平滑或更可探索的分布，都有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把截断采样后的生成过程显式看成一棵被剪枝的解码树。每个前缀节点只保留满足截断规则的 active set，例如 top-p、min-p、epsilon-sampling 下留下的 token；整条序列在这个截断分布下有一个路径概率。传统 self-consistency 是在这棵树上“有放回”采样，所以会重复访问同一前缀甚至同一叶子。DLE 改成确定性地枚举 distinct leaves：每次选择尚未访问的高优先级分支，保证不会生成重复完整轨迹。

从机制上看，它和 beam search 不一样。beam search 在每一步维护多个部分序列，目标是局部保留高分前缀，容易出现低多样性和大 beam 退化；DLE 不追求逐步保留一组 beam，而是直接在截断树上做叶子级枚举。它也不同于 without-replacement sampling，因为目标不是逼近某个采样分布，而是提高固定预算下的搜索空间覆盖。和 tree-of-thought 类方法相比，它不引入额外评估器、反思步骤或额外 LM 调用，仍然是单模型解码，只是改变了分支遍历顺序。

论文里另一个重要点是 prefix reuse。因为 DLE 在树上扩展而不是独立重采样，它不会重复生成已经出现过的共享前缀。系统实现上可以缓存前缀状态，只为新分支生成新增 token。这样带来两层收益：算法层面，更多预算用于未探索分支；系统层面，减少重复 token 生成，尤其在 memory-bound 推理环境下更容易转成实际延迟收益。作者还把 coverage 作为中间分析指标，强调更高的截断树概率质量覆盖与更好的最终任务表现相关，这比只报 pass@k 或 accuracy 更能解释方法为何有效。
summary.experiments:
实验重点围绕三件事：覆盖率、任务表现、以及 token/时间效率。文中先用代码生成前缀统计说明重复问题确实存在：多条采样轨迹中约 20% 的 prefix tokens 是重复的，且示例里 5 条生成有 3 条完全相同、4 条共享前缀，说明 self-consistency 的预算有相当部分浪费在重复路径上。

在算法分析上，作者比较了 DLE 与随机 self-consistency 在相同 token 预算下对截断搜索空间的覆盖。结论是 DLE 能覆盖更多未访问的高概率叶子，因此在相同预算下拿到更高的 probability mass coverage。论文把这件事和下游性能联系起来：覆盖越高，数学与代码任务上的最终正确率越好。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整表格数字，但主结论很明确：DLE 在 equal token budget 下优于随机多采样；如果按相同候选数比较，它还能用更少新生成 token 达到相近或更好的效果。

系统层面，作者强调 DLE 的优势在 memory-constrained 条件下更明显。原因不是单步算子更快，而是共享前缀减少了重复 decode，能在同样预算下完成更多完整序列，或者在相同性能下减少总生成 token。这个点对大模型 serving 很实际：当瓶颈在 KV cache 和带宽而不是纯算力时，prefix reuse 的收益会比理论 FLOPs 节省更容易兑现。

从实验设计看，论文不是在证明 DLE 绝对优于所有搜索方法，而是在一个更窄但常见的设定里证明：若你本来就会用 top-p/min-p 之类截断采样做 self-consistency，那么把“随机有放回采样”换成“确定性无重复叶子枚举”通常更划算。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三部分。第一，看 Introduction 和前两张图，理解作者为什么把问题表述成“重复访问截断树的高概率前缀”，这是整篇文章最关键的建模视角。第二，看方法部分里 truncated distribution、coverage 定义和 DLE 枚举策略，重点想清楚它为何不等同于 beam search，也不等同于 without-replacement sampling。第三，看实验中 coverage 与任务准确率的关系，以及 token efficiency / latency 的结果，这决定了方法是否只是一个搜索技巧，还是确实改变了 test-time compute 的利用方式。

预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。若只想判断是否值得复现，优先看算法伪代码、prefix reuse 的实现说明，以及 math/code 两类任务上的主表。若想深一点，可以追问两个问题：一是 DLE 的收益是否依赖后训练模型分布过尖；二是当模型温度更高、有效分支更多时，确定性枚举是否仍优于随机采样。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific inefficiency in test-time scaling: self-consistency improves reasoning by sampling multiple traces, but in narrow-solution domains such as math and code, many samples collapse onto the same high-probability prefixes and even identical completions. The real problem is not lack of search depth, but wasted budget from sampling with replacement. The paper asks how to explore more useful candidates under a fixed token budget when decoding already uses a truncated distribution such as top-p or min-p.
summary_en.importance: Its value is not in pretraining per se, but in how it reframes inference-time compute allocation. The main takeaway is that once post-trained models become sharp and truncation leaves only a small active set at each step, random multi-sampling is often a poor use of extra compute. Deterministic coverage of distinct leaves can be better than stochastic independence. That matters for reasoning-time scaling, search over model outputs, prefix-sharing systems, and even for thinking about whether post-training is making distributions too peaky for efficient exploration.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, Distinct Leaf Enumeration (DLE), treats truncated decoding as traversal of a pruned generation tree. At each prefix, only tokens surviving a truncation rule remain in the active set. A full completion corresponds to a leaf with probability given by the product of truncated conditional probabilities along the path. Standard self-consistency samples from this tree with replacement, so it repeatedly revisits the same prefixes and leaves. DLE instead deterministically enumerates distinct leaves, prioritizing unexplored high-probability branches and guaranteeing no duplicate full traces.

This is importantly different from several nearby ideas. It is not beam search: beam search keeps multiple partial hypotheses at every step and is known to suffer from degeneration and low diversity as beam width grows. DLE does not optimize a beam frontier; it enumerates leaf-level completions in the truncated tree. It is also not sampling without replacement in the probabilistic sense, because it does not aim to preserve a target sampling distribution. And unlike tree-of-thought style methods, it does not add verifier calls, reflection steps, or extra model evaluations. It remains a single-model decoding procedure with a different traversal policy.

A second key contribution is prefix reuse. Because DLE expands a shared tree rather than independently resampling complete traces, it never regenerates an already explored prefix. This gives both an algorithmic gain and a systems gain: more of the budget goes to novel branches, and fewer new tokens need to be decoded for the same number of candidate completions. The paper also introduces coverage of the truncated search space as an analysis metric, arguing that better probability-mass coverage explains downstream gains more directly than raw sample count.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around three claims: DLE increases coverage, improves downstream performance under equal budget, and reduces redundant generation. The paper first establishes that redundancy is real. In code generation, around 20% of prefix tokens are repeated across sampled traces, and qualitative examples show multiple identical completions among only a handful of samples.

On the algorithmic side, DLE is compared against stochastic self-consistency under matched token budgets. The central result is that DLE covers more of the truncated search space, especially previously unvisited high-probability branches. That increased coverage is then linked to better task outcomes on constrained reasoning tasks such as math and code. The excerpt provided does not include the full result tables, but the paper’s main empirical claim is clear: at equal token budgets, deterministic distinct-leaf exploration outperforms repeated stochastic sampling.

On the systems side, DLE generates fewer new tokens because shared prefixes are reused rather than regenerated. This matters most in memory-bound settings, where avoiding repeated decode over common prefixes can translate into lower latency or more completed candidates under the same serving budget. The paper is careful not to claim universal superiority over all search methods; the claim is narrower and more practical: if one already uses truncated sampling for self-consistency, replacing random sampling-with-replacement by deterministic distinct-leaf enumeration is often a better use of inference compute.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, focus on three parts. First, read the introduction and the motivating figures carefully; the paper’s main contribution is the reframing of repeated sampling as redundant traversal of a truncated decoding tree. Second, read the method section around the truncated distribution, the definition of coverage, and the DLE procedure. The important question is why this is neither beam search nor standard without-replacement sampling. Third, inspect the experiments that connect coverage to task accuracy and the ones reporting token efficiency or latency.

Estimated reading time is 20 to 30 minutes. If deciding whether to reproduce it, prioritize the algorithm description, the implementation details for prefix reuse, and the main math/code result tables. Two useful follow-up questions while reading are: how much the gains depend on post-trained models being overconfident, and whether deterministic enumeration still helps when temperature is higher and the effective branching factor grows.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改一点你对 self-consistency 的默认做法：别再把重复采样当成天然基线，先看树遍历 formulation 和 prefix reuse 的系统收益，再决定要不要内化到推理栈里。
recommendation.en: This should update your default on self-consistency: repeated sampling is a weak baseline once you view decoding as tree traversal; read the formulation and the prefix-reuse results before locking in your inference stack.

institutions: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

paper.title: Cut Your Losses! Learning to Prune Paths Early for Efficient Parallel Reasoning
paper.abstract: Parallel reasoning enhances Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) but incurs prohibitive costs due to futile paths caused by early errors. To mitigate this, path pruning at the prefix level is essential, yet existing research remains fragmented without a standardized framework. In this work, we propose the first systematic taxonomy of path pruning, categorizing methods by their signal source (internal vs. external) and learnability (learnable vs. non-learnable). This classification reveals the unexplore

summary.core_problem: 解决并行推理中大量错误分支在早期就已注定失败、却仍持续消耗算力的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率工作，不是预训练方法论文；价值在于把 path pruning 做了较系统的分类，并提出可学习的内部剪枝信号。对做 reasoning serving 或 test-time scaling 的团队有参考，但对基座预训练本身较间接。
summary.technical_approach: 作者先给出 path pruning taxonomy，按信号来源（internal/external）和是否可学习（learnable/non-learnable）分类，指出“可学习的内部方法”被低估。基于此提出 STOP（Super TOken for Pruning），用专门的 token/信号在前缀阶段预测并提前剪掉低价值推理路径。还讨论了将发现蒸馏到模型中的可能性。
summary.experiments: 在 1.5B 到 20B 的多种 LRM 上评测，与现有 pruning baseline 比较效率和准确率。摘要给出的代表结果是，在固定算力预算下，GPT-OSS-20B 在 AIME25 上可从 84% 提升到接近 90%。实验重点是预算变化下的可扩展性，而非训练数据或预训练配方。
summary.authors_note: 来自中大深圳相关团队。更像 reasoning inference optimization 方向的系统化工作。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets wasted compute in parallel reasoning, where many branches are already doomed early but continue consuming budget.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its value lies in systematizing path pruning and proposing a learnable internal pruning signal. Useful for reasoning serving and test-time scaling, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper first introduces a taxonomy of path pruning by signal source (internal vs. external) and learnability (learnable vs. non-learnable), arguing that learnable internal methods are underexplored. It then proposes STOP (Super TOken for Pruning), which uses a dedicated token/signal to predict low-value reasoning paths at the prefix stage and prune them early. The paper also mentions distilling these findings back into the model.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LRMs from 1.5B to 20B, comparing against existing pruning baselines on both effectiveness and efficiency. The abstract highlights a fixed-budget result on AIME25 where GPT-OSS-20B improves from 84% to nearly 90%. The emphasis is scalability under compute budgets, not pretraining recipe or data.
summary_en.authors_note: From CUHK-Shenzhen-related institutions. Best viewed as a reasoning inference optimization paper.

recommendation.zh: 如果你管推理预算，这篇看 taxonomy 和固定预算曲线就够了；对预训练本体帮助有限，别被“可蒸馏回模型”这句带偏。
recommendation.en: If you own inference budget, read the taxonomy and fixed-budget curves; for pretraining proper the value is limited, and the ‘can be distilled back’ angle is not yet enough to upgrade it.

paper.title: A Tale of Two Temperatures: Simple, Efficient, and Diverse Sampling from Diffusion Language Models

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（dLLM）采样研究长期聚焦“单样本速度-质量”权衡，但在需要多样本的场景（pass@k、test-time compute、A/B、后训练rollout）中，现有高置信度/低置信度优先的贪心remasking会系统性压制跨样本多样性：它倾向于延后不确定位置，从而绕开真正的“分叉点”（forks），导致探索不足、pass@k扩展性差。
summary.importance: dLLM的核心优势是并行生成与双向上下文，但如果多样性被remasking策略“贪心化”抹平，则在后训练（如GRPO）、推理时多次采样、以及需要候选集覆盖的任务上会显著落后于AR。本文给出一个几乎不增加实现复杂度、仍保留并行优势的修复：把“位置选择”从确定性贪心改为可控随机，从而恢复探索与多样性。
summary.technical_approach:
关键思想是引入第二个温度：位置温度T_pos，用来控制“先确定哪些位置”的随机性；与常规token温度T_token（控制每个位置采样哪个token的熵）正交互补。

方法上提出两类“温和化/温度化”的remasking：
1) TLC（Tempered Low-Confidence）：对经典Low-Confidence remasking做随机松弛。传统做法每步选最低置信度的一批位置重采样/延后；TLC改为按(温度化后的)低置信度分布对位置进行采样/选择，使得不确定位置更可能被处理，但不会被贪心地“永远拖到最后”。
2) TCT（Tempered Confidence Thresholding）：对置信度阈值策略做温度化随机化。传统阈值法自适应决定每步提交多少token以加速；TCT在保留“自适应步长/速度”的同时，用T_pos对“哪些位置达标/被提交”进行软化抽样，从而在速度与多样性间提供连续可调的旋钮。

理论动机：提出fork tokens的操作性定义（高熵、决定分支的关键位置），并在理想化fork模型下分析remasking对fork处期望熵的影响；证明对TLC而言，提高T_pos会提高fork处的期望熵（直观上：更随机的提交顺序更可能在分叉处保留不确定性并探索不同分支），从机制层面解释pass@k多样性恢复。

实现层面：改动集中在“位置选择/提交规则”，不需要复杂的全局MCMC或昂贵的重打分；因此保持了原有置信度启发式的计算优势。
summary.experiments:
实验主线围绕“探索差距（exploration gap）”展开：
- 多样性/扩展性：在多个基准与模型上，TLC显著缩小现有置信度贪心remasking与AR rollout之间的pass@k差距；图2展示其pass@k随k增长的曲线更接近AR，说明多样性被恢复。
- 计算成本校正：在把每次rollout成本纳入后，TCT由于保留阈值法的自适应加速，常在单位计算预算下比未温度化启发式或AR更好的pass@k扩展（图3强调“质量-多样性-成本”三者综合）。
- 下游后训练：用于dLLM的GRPO rollout生成，在匹配计算预算时，TCT产生的更强多样性候选带来更强策略（优于AR生成）。
- 测试时选择策略：更高多样性可能让简单majority voting被“分散”而受损，但使用outcome reward model进行答案选择后差距大幅缩小，说明多样性需要与更强选择器配套才能兑现收益。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：
  1) Section 3.2：TLC/TCT的具体定义与实现细节（这是可复现与可落地的核心）。
  2) Section 3.1：fork tokens理想化模型与“提高T_pos提升fork熵”的推导（理解为何贪心顺序会抑制探索）。
  3) Section 4.1：pass@k与成本校正对比（尤其图2、图3），把“多样性恢复”与“效率不崩”同时看清。
  4) Section 4.3：GRPO rollout实验，理解该方法对后训练的实际价值链。
- 重点图表：Figure 2（pass@k曲线对齐AR）、Figure 3（考虑rollout成本后的综合扩展）。
- 创新点抓手：
  (i) 把remasking的贪心性识别为多样性瓶颈而非并行生成本身；
  (ii) 引入位置温度T_pos作为与T_token正交的控制旋钮；
  (iii) 用fork熵的形式化分析连接“位置顺序随机化”与“探索/多样性”。

skim（泛读）：
- 先读Introduction把问题与贡献对齐；
- 快速扫Section 3.2掌握TLC/TCT一句话实现；
- 直接看Section 4.1的主结果与图2/图3；
- 若关心训练收益再看Section 4.3；若关心推理集成策略看Section 4.2。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：dLLM多样性不足主要来自remasking启发式的“贪心提交顺序”，而不是扩散并行范式的原罪。通过对位置选择做温度化随机松弛（T_pos），可以在几乎不牺牲速度与实现简洁性的前提下恢复探索，从而让dLLM在pass@k、后训练rollout与test-time compute场景中重新具备竞争力。

summary_en.core_problem: Diffusion LMs (dLLMs) have seen extensive work on fast, high-quality sampling, but most remasking heuristics optimize single-sample quality and inadvertently hurt cross-sample diversity. Greedy confidence-based remasking delays uncertain positions, systematically skipping true branching points (“forks”), leading to poor exploration and weaker pass@k scaling than autoregressive (AR) rollouts.
summary_en.importance: Many practical workflows—post-training rollouts, test-time compute scaling, A/B testing—depend on diverse candidate sets, not just one good sample. If dLLMs lose diversity due to greedy remasking, they forfeit key advantages despite parallel decoding. This paper shows diversity can be recovered with a minimal change: make the position-commitment order stochastic in a controlled way, preserving parallelism and simplicity.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper introduces a second temperature, position temperature T_pos, which controls stochasticity in *which positions* get committed next, orthogonal to token temperature T_token that controls entropy over *which token* is sampled at a position.

Two tempered remasking heuristics are proposed:
1) TLC (Tempered Low-Confidence): a stochastic relaxation of low-confidence remasking. Instead of greedily selecting the lowest-confidence positions, positions are sampled according to a tempered low-confidence distribution, preventing perpetual deferral of uncertain (often fork) tokens.
2) TCT (Tempered Confidence Thresholding): a tempered version of confidence-threshold decoding. It retains adaptive speed (variable number of tokens committed per step) while softening the commit/selection decision via T_pos to improve exploration.

Theory: the authors define fork tokens operationally (high-entropy, branch-determining positions) and analyze an idealized fork model. For TLC, increasing T_pos is shown to provably increase expected entropy at forks, explaining why tempering the position order restores diversity.

Practically, changes are localized to the position-selection rule, keeping computational benefits and implementation simplicity of existing heuristics.
summary_en.experiments:
Empirical results focus on closing the “exploration gap”:
- Diversity / pass@k scaling: TLC substantially narrows the gap between greedy confidence-based remasking and AR rollouts across benchmarks/models; Figure 2 shows pass@k curves approaching AR-like scaling.
- Cost-aware scaling: accounting for rollout cost, TCT often scales better than both untempered heuristics and AR due to retaining adaptive thresholding speed; Figure 3 highlights the compute-normalized advantage.
- Downstream post-training: using TCT to generate GRPO rollouts at matched compute budgets yields stronger policies than AR generation.
- Test-time selection: higher diversity can hurt naive majority voting, but outcome reward models largely close the gap, indicating diversity benefits require stronger selection mechanisms.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ thesis is that dLLM diversity issues stem primarily from *greedy* remasking order. By tempering the position-selection/commitment process with a position temperature T_pos, one can restore exploration and pass@k scaling while keeping decoding parallel, efficient, and easy to implement—often improving compute-normalized performance and downstream rollout quality.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法段里“两个温度/随机位置选择”的采样规则和对应pass@k曲线即可；它是低成本补丁，适合直接塞进你现有remasking解码器试试多样性。
recommendation.en: Skim just the sampling rule (two temperatures + stochastic position choice) and the pass@k plots; it’s a low-friction patch you can drop into an existing remasking decoder to recover diversity.

paper.title: Your Model Diversity, Not Method, Determines Reasoning Strategy

summary.core_problem: 论文研究推理计算扩展中“广度（并行探索多条解法）vs 深度（对少数候选进行迭代精炼/树搜索）”的预算分配问题，并提出核心观点：决定最优推理策略的不是你用的具体方法名（并行采样、树搜索、MCTS式 refinement 等），而是目标模型自身的“多样性画像（diversity profile）”——概率质量在不同高层解法路径上的分布形态。
summary.importance: 该观点直接挑战当前常见研究范式：提出一个探索/搜索策略→只在1-2个模型上验证→宣称方法更好。作者指出这会把“模型差异”误当成“方法优势”。若不先刻画模型的多样性画像，就无法原则性地选择 breadth 或 depth，导致策略迁移失败、复现实验不稳定、以及训练/推理算力分配不合理。
summary.technical_approach: 论文给出一个分解推理不确定性的理论框架，并在抽象MCTS预算分配下推导“何时深度精炼优于纯并行采样”的条件。1）轨迹与‘解法簇’建模：对问题q，模型p_ϕ生成推理轨迹τ；将所有轨迹集合𝒯划分为m个不交集合𝒜_i，每个𝒜_i代表一种高层解法/思路（approach）。定义可行解法集合𝒱（包含至少一条正确轨迹的approach）。2）引入理想模型ϕ*及其在approach上的最优分布π(ϕ*)，用以刻画“正确解法应被分配的概率质量”。3）不确定性三分解： (i) Aleatoric不确定性U_alea(q)=H[A|ϕ*]：问题本身导致的不可约难度；(ii) Epistemic breadth U_epi^breadth(ϕ)=DKL(π(ϕ*)||π(ϕ))：模型在‘选哪种思路’上的分布与理想分布的偏差，需通过更广的探索与重加权选择来降低；(iii) Epistemic depth U_epi^depth(ϕ,B)=∑_{i∈𝒱} π_i(ϕ*) DKL(Bern(θ_i(ϕ*,B))||Bern(θ_i(ϕ,B)))：在给定思路内把解做对的能力差距，强调通过反馈/迭代精炼降低。4）MCTS式预算分配：总预算N条轨迹，分αN用于探索（发现不同approach），(1-α)N用于对最优approach i*做深度精炼。定义每个approach的单次精炼价值c_i=-log(1-θ_i)，随机采样的价值c_rand=-log(1-θ̄)，以及最优approach相对随机的质量比R=c_{i*}/c_rand。推导： (a) 在“能识别最优approach”的理想条件下，MCTS分配优于纯随机并行采样当且仅当α ≤ 1-1/R；(b) 为了以≥1-η概率在探索阶段发现i*，需要α ≥ α_min(η)（与N及π_{i*}相关，π_{i*}越小则需要更大探索比例）。5）核心解释：模型多样性画像决定π_{i*}（最优思路的先验质量）与R（精炼收益），从而决定最优α区间；因此“同一策略”在不同模型上会跨越不同的制度区间（regime）而表现相反。
summary.experiments: 论文在两个模型家族上验证理论边界：Qwen-3 4B 与 Olmo-3 7B。实验目标不是证明某个搜索算法普适更强，而是展示：当模型处于不同多样性制度（例如概率质量更集中/更分散、最优思路先验更大/更小）时，理论预测的“并行采样更合适”或“深度精炼更合适”的分界能被观察到；并且把某类方法搬到‘不匹配的制度’会显著变差，从而支持“先刻画多样性画像再选策略”的主张。（注：你提供的全文片段在实验细节处截断，具体任务/指标/图表编号未完整出现；但论文意图与验证对象在摘要与引言中已明确。）
summary.reading_guide: must_read（精读）：(1) Framework（§2）是全文核心：先精读轨迹分区𝒜_i/可行集合𝒱/理想分布π(ϕ*)的建模假设；(2) 三类不确定性分解：理解U_epi^breadth与U_epi^depth分别对应‘找对思路’与‘把思路做对’，以及它们如何映射到breadth vs depth；(3) MCTS Allocation推导：重点看α ≤ 1-1/R与α ≥ α_min(η)这两个不等式如何共同夹出可行区间，并理解π_{i*}与R如何由模型多样性画像决定；(4) 实证部分：按作者主张去读——不要只看总体平均提升，而要看“跨模型家族时策略排序是否翻转/是否符合理论制度边界”。skim（泛读）：(1) 读Introduction抓住主张：方法效果由模型多样性决定；(2) 快速浏览Framework里对breadth/depth的形式化与两个关键条件（α上界/下界）；(3) 直接看实验结论段落：作者如何用Qwen-3与Olmo-3展示制度差异与策略迁移失败案例。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调：在推理计算扩展中，‘先验多样性’是第一性变量。任何探索/搜索策略都应先测量并报告目标模型的多样性画像与所处制度区间，再谈breadth-depth分配与方法优劣；否则容易把模型特性误归因于方法创新。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to allocate a fixed reasoning compute budget between breadth (sampling diverse solution approaches) and depth (iteratively refining a promising approach, e.g., tree/MCTS-style). Its central claim is that the best reasoning strategy is determined primarily by the target model’s diversity profile—the distribution of probability mass across distinct high-level solution approaches—rather than by the named method itself.
summary_en.importance: This challenges a common evaluation pattern: propose a search/exploration method, test on 1–2 models, and attribute gains to the method. The authors argue that such results often confound method effects with model-specific diversity regimes, causing poor transfer, unstable reproduction, and suboptimal compute allocation if diversity is not characterized first.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces a theory that decomposes reasoning uncertainty and derives conditions under which depth refinement beats pure parallel sampling. (1) Trajectories and approach partition: for a query q, a model p_ϕ generates trajectories τ; the trajectory space 𝒯 is partitioned into disjoint sets 𝒜_i, each representing a high-level approach. Viable approaches 𝒱 are those containing at least one correct trajectory. (2) An ideal model ϕ* induces an optimal approach distribution π(ϕ*). (3) Uncertainty decomposition: (i) Aleatoric uncertainty U_alea(q)=H[A|ϕ*], irreducible problem difficulty; (ii) Epistemic breadth U_epi^breadth(ϕ)=DKL(π(ϕ*)||π(ϕ)), mismatch in selecting approaches, reducible via broader exploration and reweighting/selection; (iii) Epistemic depth U_epi^depth(ϕ,B)=∑_{i∈𝒱} π_i(ϕ*) DKL(Bern(θ_i(ϕ*,B))||Bern(θ_i(ϕ,B))), within-approach execution gap, reducible via feedback and iterative refinement. (4) MCTS-style allocation: with N trajectories, allocate N_e=αN to exploration and N_f=(1-α)N to refining the best discovered approach i*. Define per-sample refinement value c_i=-log(1-θ_i), random sampling value c_rand=-log(1-θ̄), and quality ratio R=c_{i*}/c_rand. Under oracle identification of i*: (a) MCTS allocation outperforms i.i.d. sampling iff α ≤ 1-1/R; (b) to discover i* with probability ≥1-η during exploration, α must satisfy α ≥ α_min(η) (depends on N and π_{i*}; smaller π_{i*} requires more exploration). (5) Key implication: the diversity profile determines π_{i*} and R, hence the feasible/optimal α regime; the same method can succeed or fail depending on the model’s regime.
summary_en.experiments: The theory is validated across two model families: Qwen-3 4B and Olmo-3 7B. The goal is to show regime dependence rather than universal superiority: when models exhibit different diversity profiles (e.g., more/less concentrated mass on the best approach), the empirically optimal breadth–depth trade-off shifts in line with the derived boundaries, and strategies degrade when applied outside their matching regime. (Note: the provided full-text excerpt is truncated before complete experimental details/figures; the validation targets and intent are clearly stated in the abstract/introduction.)
summary_en.reading_guide: must_read (deep): (1) Framework (§2) is the core—carefully parse the approach partition 𝒜_i, viable set 𝒱, and ideal distribution π(ϕ*); (2) Understand how U_epi^breadth vs U_epi^depth map to ‘finding the right approach’ vs ‘executing it correctly’; (3) Focus on the two key inequalities α ≤ 1-1/R and α ≥ α_min(η) and how π_{i*} and R (driven by diversity) determine the regime; (4) In experiments, look specifically for cross-model reversals and regime boundary consistency rather than average gains. skim (quick): (1) Read the Introduction for the main claim about diversity; (2) Skim the framework to capture the breadth–depth formalization and the two conditions; (3) Jump to the experimental conclusions showing regime shifts across Qwen-3 vs Olmo-3.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors argue that diversity is the first-order variable in compute-scaled reasoning. Any exploration/search strategy should first measure and report the target model’s diversity profile and regime, then choose breadth–depth allocation; otherwise, method claims risk misattributing model properties to algorithmic novelty.

paper.title: Test-time Scaling over Perception: Resolving the Grounding Paradox in Thinking with Images

summary.core_problem: 论文聚焦“Thinking with Images”范式中的细粒度视觉推理不可靠问题：模型必须先决定“看哪里/怎么裁剪缩放”，但正确决策又依赖尚未获取的局部证据，形成循环依赖。作者将其形式化为 Grounding Paradox（落地悖论）：感知证据不足→工具调用位置/策略猜测化→进一步错过关键证据→推理失败。
summary.importance: 该悖论解释了工具增强型 MLLM 的系统性失败模式（误缩放、冗余检查、漏检、该用工具却不用），指出瓶颈不在“有没有工具/分辨率”，而在“在不确定性下如何进行有根据的感知搜索”。这为多模态 test-time scaling 提供了清晰的研究切入点：不仅要扩展推理计算，还要扩展感知获取证据的计算。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 TTSP（Test-Time Scaling over Perception），把“感知”本身当作可扩展的推断过程，而非一次性工具轨迹。

must_read（详细技术分析）：
1) 多轨迹探索（exploratory perception traces）：在推理时并行/多次采样不同的工具调用与观察路径（如不同裁剪、缩放、区域检查），让模型在“看哪里”上产生多样性，而不是押注单一路径。
2) 置信过滤（entropy-based confidence estimation）：对每条感知轨迹或其中的观察结果进行基于熵的置信度估计，过滤不可靠/高不确定的观察，避免把噪声通过投票或自洽放大（作者强调多模态下轨迹差异不仅是“逻辑链”，更是“看到的证据不同”，因此必须显式建模证据可靠性与冲突）。
3) 结构化蒸馏（distill into structured knowledge）：将通过过滤的稳定观察压缩为结构化中间知识（可理解为“已确认的视觉事实/约束/候选集合/冲突点”的摘要），作为后续探索与最终回答的共享依据，降低长上下文与重复查看成本。
4) 迭代精化（iteratively refine exploration）：用结构化知识驱动下一轮工具探索，把计算集中到“尚未解决的不确定性/冲突证据”上，实现从猜测式 probing 到“感知假设检验”的闭环。

skim（方法概述）：TTSP = 多次看（多轨迹）→挑可信（熵过滤）→记成共识（结构化知识）→再去补看（迭代），最终答案来自逐步收敛的感知共识，而非单次工具调用。
summary.experiments: 作者声称在多种视觉推理基准上 TTSP 相比现有基线稳定提升，覆盖细粒度场景（小文本、细微属性、密集符号、杂乱场景等）并更鲁棒。由于你提供的“全文内容”目前仅包含引言级别信息，具体实验设置（数据集/指标/对比方法/消融：轨迹数、熵阈值、蒸馏形式、迭代轮数等）与定量结果无法从现有文本中复原；若补充论文方法与实验章节，我可以进一步给出可复现级别的实验解读与消融结论。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读建议）：
- 重点读：提出 Grounding Paradox 的动机与失败模式归因（通常在 Introduction + 相关失败案例/图1）。
- 重点读：TTSP 的完整流程定义（多轨迹生成、熵置信、结构化蒸馏、迭代策略）以及“为何多模态不能直接用 self-consistency/majority vote”的论证。
- 重点看图表：Figure 1（TTSP 总览/流程图）——理解“探索-过滤-蒸馏-再探索”的闭环与信息流。
- 重点抓创新点：把 test-time scaling 从“语言推理轨迹”扩展到“感知证据获取轨迹”；用熵做证据级可靠性筛选；用结构化中间知识做跨轨迹共识与后续探索的控制信号。

skim（泛读建议）：
- 只看：Introduction（悖论定义与动机）+ Figure 1（方法直觉）+ 实验主表（总体提升）+ 1-2 个关键消融（轨迹数/迭代轮数/是否熵过滤）。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：工具增强并不等于真正的视觉推理；真正的能力在于当初始落地不充分/有歧义/出错时，模型能通过可扩展的感知搜索恢复证据。TTSP 试图把“看哪里”从一次性决策变成可迭代、可验证、可收敛的推断过程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets brittleness in fine-grained visual reasoning under the “Thinking with Images” paradigm. Tool-augmented MLLMs must decide where/how to look (zoom/crop) before they have the local evidence needed to make that decision correctly, creating a circular dependency. The authors formalize this as the Grounding Paradox: insufficient grounding → speculative tool use → missed/incorrect evidence → reasoning failure.
summary_en.importance: The Grounding Paradox explains systematic failure modes (mislocalized zooms, redundant inspections, missed evidence, or not using tools when needed) and argues the bottleneck is not tool availability or resolution, but grounded perceptual search under uncertainty. This reframes multimodal test-time scaling: scaling should apply not only to reasoning trajectories but also to perception/evidence acquisition.
summary_en.technical_approach:
They propose TTSP (Test-Time Scaling over Perception), treating perception itself as a scalable inference process rather than a single tool-use trajectory.

must_read (technical deep dive):
1) Multiple exploratory perception traces: sample/execute diverse tool-use and observation paths (different crops/zooms/regions) to diversify “where to look”.
2) Confidence-aware filtering via entropy: estimate uncertainty (entropy-based) for traces/observations and discard unreliable evidence, preventing naive aggregation from amplifying perceptual noise (a key multimodal issue since trajectories differ in what they observe, not just in logic).
3) Distillation into structured knowledge: compress validated observations into structured intermediate knowledge (confirmed visual facts/constraints/candidates/conflicts) shared across trajectories, reducing redundancy and stabilizing downstream reasoning.
4) Iterative refinement: use the distilled knowledge to steer subsequent exploration toward unresolved uncertainty/conflicts, turning tool use into iterative hypothesis testing and consensus-building.

skim (high-level): TTSP = look multiple ways → keep confident evidence → distill into a shared structured state → look again to resolve remaining uncertainty; final answers come from progressively refined perceptual consensus.
summary_en.experiments: The paper claims consistent improvements over baselines across diverse visual reasoning benchmarks, especially in fine-grained settings (small text, subtle attributes, dense symbols, clutter). However, the provided “full content” here only includes introduction-level material; concrete experimental details (benchmarks, metrics, baselines, ablations on #traces/entropy thresholds/distillation format/iterations) and quantitative results cannot be reconstructed from the current text. If you share the method+experiments sections, I can produce a reproducibility-oriented analysis.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (close reading):
- Focus on: the formalization and diagnosis of the Grounding Paradox and its characteristic failure modes (typically Introduction + motivating examples/Fig. 1).
- Focus on: the full TTSP pipeline (trace generation, entropy confidence, structured distillation, iterative control) and the argument for why text-only self-consistency/majority vote is insufficient in multimodal settings.
- Key figure: Figure 1 (TTSP overview) to understand the explore–filter–distill–refine loop and information flow.
- Key contributions to extract: scaling perception (not just reasoning), entropy-based evidence reliability filtering, and structured intermediate knowledge as a control signal for iterative exploration.

skim (fast reading):
- Read: Introduction + Figure 1 + main results table + 1–2 critical ablations (e.g., #traces, #iterations, with/without entropy filtering).
summary_en.authors_note: The authors’ thesis is that tool access is not equivalent to genuine visual reasoning; the real capability is recovering from incomplete/ambiguous/misgrounded initial perception via deliberate, scalable perceptual exploration. TTSP operationalizes this by making “where to look” an iterative, verifiable, convergent inference process.

paper.title: Agentic Aggregation for Parallel Scaling of Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks

summary.core_problem: 如何在长时程、工具增强、开放式输出的 agentic 任务中实现“并行 test-time scaling”，并有效聚合多条并行轨迹的信息以提升最终答案质量。
summary.importance: 方法与系统层面的创新：把“并行采样+聚合”从 CoT 推理扩展到长轨迹 Agent 场景，指出仅聚合最终答案/拼接全轨迹都不适用，并提出可在轨迹空间中按需检索与综合的聚合代理范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AggAgent：将多条并行生成的 agent 轨迹视作一个可交互的“环境”，由一个聚合 agent 使用轻量工具对候选解进行检查、在轨迹间搜索与按需读取关键信息；避免全量拼接导致的上下文溢出，同时避免只看最终答案丢失过程信息。
summary.experiments: 在6个基准、3个模型家族（GLM-4.7、Qwen3.5、MiniMax-M2.5）上评测；相对既有聚合方法平均最高提升约5.3个百分点，单项最高约10.3个百分点（摘要所述）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to perform parallel test-time scaling for long-horizon, tool-augmented agentic tasks with open-ended outputs, and how to aggregate information across multiple parallel trajectories to improve final answer quality.
summary_en.importance: Extends the idea of parallel sampling plus aggregation from chain-of-thought to long-horizon agent trajectories, arguing that aggregating only final answers or concatenating full traces is ineffective, and proposing an aggregation-agent paradigm that can selectively retrieve and synthesize trajectory evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes AggAgent, which treats multiple parallel agent rollouts as an interactive environment; an aggregator agent uses lightweight tools to inspect candidates, search across trajectories, and read only relevant segments on demand, avoiding context overflow while retaining crucial process information beyond final outputs.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 6 benchmarks and 3 model families (GLM-4.7, Qwen3.5, MiniMax-M2.5); compared to prior aggregation methods, it achieves up to ~5.3 percentage points average improvement and up to ~10.3 points on the best single case (as reported in the summary).

recommendation.zh: 只看聚合代理的检索/综合策略与消融：它把“并行采样=拼答案”这个 prior 推翻了，但收益高度依赖轨迹表征与检索噪声。
recommendation.en: Skim the aggregation-agent policy + ablations: it breaks the “parallel sampling = merge final answers” prior, but gains look tightly coupled to trajectory representation and retrieval noise.

paper.title: RecaLLM: Addressing the Lost-in-Thought Phenomenon with Explicit In-Context Retrieval

summary.core_problem: 长上下文LLM并不等于“会用长上下文”。论文指出在推理模型中存在更尖锐的失效模式：随着链式思维变长，模型在后续从上下文中检索关键信息的能力会显著下降，即 lost-in-thought——推理步骤本应提升效果，却反过来让后续in-context retrieval更困难（推理产生的语义相关但干扰性token增多、注意力被中间推理占据等）。现有方法多假设“推理前一次性检索足够证据”，无法覆盖推理过程中动态出现的新检索需求。
summary.importance: lost-in-thought直接限制test-time scaling与长上下文应用：越推理越“找不到”上下文证据，会导致引用错误、遗漏关键条件、以及在长文档/多证据任务中性能崩塌。更关键的是，这一问题不仅影响简单查找，也影响基于证据的推理与重排序等复杂能力，因此需要把“检索”作为推理过程中的显式可训练技能，而非隐式注意力副产物。
summary.technical_approach:
RecaLLM通过“推理-显式召回交错（interleave）”来解决：
1) 显式Recall Span：模型在需要时输出专门的召回片段（recall spans），用于从给定长上下文中逐字抽取相关证据；把检索从隐式注意力变成可监督、可验证的行为。
2) 上下文感知的约束解码（context-aware constrained decoding）：对recall span施加约束，确保其必须是上下文中的原文片段（faithful verbatim recall），从而让“是否检索成功”可自动判定并用于奖励。
3) 训练数据与任务覆盖：构造从“无需检索”到“多步检索”的多样任务；对检索密集样本系统控制上下文长度、证据位置、检索类型（词法/语义）、以及干扰项难度（随机/硬词法/硬语义负例），逼迫模型学会在推理过程中定位证据。
4) 两阶段后训练：先用教师标注rollouts做SFT冷启动，再用GRPO进行强化式优化。
5) 细粒度可验证奖励：奖励不仅看最终答案，还显式奖励recall span是否成功召回已知相关证据（比只做outcome reward更强的训练信号），从机制上对抗“推理越长越检索不到”的退化。
summary.experiments:
论文在合成与真实长上下文基准上验证：
- RULER：RecaLLM-Qwen2.5-7B在7–8B档取得92.8的最佳平均表现，并在128K仍保持强势，超过更大或专门长上下文训练的基线（如LoongRL-14B）。相对基座模型，增益随长度增加而变大（Qwen从4K +6.8到128K +16.1；Llama在128K也出现最大增益 +24.2）。
- HELMET：平均提升16.1–17.7分，在Recall/ICL/Re-rank/citation等检索密集类别优势明显；并非只提升KV查找，ICL从3.0→64.1、Re-rank从21.3→53.2显示“显式召回”也增强了基于证据的推理。
- 训练长度外推：训练上下文最长仅10K，但评测可泛化到128K，提示提升in-context retrieval本身比“用超长序列训练”更具性价比。
- 消融：强调显式可验证的召回信号与约束解码的重要性。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：Lost-in-Thought现象的定义与诊断实验（合成基准如何隔离“推理前/后检索能力”）；方法部分关于recall spans与约束解码如何保证逐字召回；训练流程（SFT冷启动→GRPO）与奖励设计（答案+检索双目标）。
- 重点图表：Figure 1（lost-in-thought示意/现象展示）；RULER与HELMET主结果表；关于“10K训练→128K评测”外推的对比图/表；检索负例难度与多步检索设置的消融表。
- 重点创新点核对：① 推理与检索交错而非一次性检索；② 召回片段可验证；③ 上下文约束解码保证忠实引用；④ 细粒度奖励显式优化检索成功率。

skim（泛读）：
- 推荐先看：Introduction（为何长CoT会伤害检索、与既有LoongRL/ALR2假设的差异）、方法概览（recall span + constrained decoding）、两大基准RULER/HELMET的主结果与长度外推结论、以及一两个关键消融（去掉约束解码/去掉检索奖励）。
summary.authors_note: 作者强调“检索与推理是耦合的闭环”：推理会产生新的检索需求，而推理本身也会让后续检索更难。解决之道不是单纯扩大上下文或在推理前检索一次，而是把检索变成推理过程中的显式动作，并通过可验证的召回与奖励把它训练到位；同时证明无需用超长序列训练也能显著提升超长上下文的有效使用。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-context LLMs still often fail to use long-context information effectively. The paper identifies a sharper failure mode in reasoning models: as Chain-of-Thought grows, the model’s subsequent ability to retrieve relevant evidence from the given context degrades substantially—lost-in-thought. Reasoning tokens become semantically related distractors and make later in-context retrieval harder. Prior approaches typically assume retrieval can be done once before reasoning, which breaks when retrieval needs emerge dynamically during multi-step reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Lost-in-thought limits test-time scaling and real long-document applications: more reasoning can cause worse evidence access, leading to missed constraints, incorrect citations, and performance collapse on multi-evidence tasks. The issue affects not only key-value lookup but also evidence-based reasoning and re-ranking, so retrieval must be treated as an explicit, trainable skill rather than an implicit byproduct of attention.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RecaLLM addresses this by interleaving reasoning with explicit in-context retrieval:
1) Explicit recall spans: the model emits dedicated recall spans when needed, extracting relevant evidence verbatim from the provided context; retrieval becomes an observable action.
2) Context-aware constrained decoding: recall spans are constrained to be exact substrings from the context, ensuring faithful verbatim recall and making retrieval success automatically verifiable.
3) Task and data design: training covers cases from no-retrieval to multi-step retrieval; retrieval-intensive instances vary context length, evidence position, retrieval type (lexical/semantic), and distractor difficulty (random, hard lexical, hard semantic negatives).
4) Two-stage post-training: supervised cold start on teacher-annotated rollouts, followed by GRPO.
5) Fine-grained verifiable rewards: optimize not only final answer quality but also successful retrieval of known relevant evidence, providing stronger signals than outcome-only RL and directly countering retrieval degradation during long reasoning.
summary_en.experiments:
Validated on synthetic and realistic long-context benchmarks:
- RULER: RecaLLM-Qwen2.5-7B achieves the best average among 7–8B models (92.8) and remains strong at 128K, outperforming larger long-context baselines (e.g., LoongRL-14B). Gains over base models increase with context length (Qwen: +6.8 at 4K to +16.1 at 128K; Llama: largest gain +24.2 at 128K).
- HELMET: improves base models by 16.1–17.7 points on average; strongest in retrieval-heavy categories (Recall, ICL, Re-rank, citation). Improvements go beyond KV lookup (e.g., ICL 3.0→64.1; Re-rank 21.3→53.2), indicating better reasoning over retrieved evidence.
- Length generalization: trained on contexts up to 10K yet improves evaluations up to 128K, suggesting improving retrieval can be a cost-effective path versus ultra-long training.
- Ablations highlight the importance of verifiable recall signals and constrained decoding.
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Key sections: the definition and diagnostic of lost-in-thought (how the synthetic benchmark isolates retrieval before vs after reasoning); recall spans + constrained decoding details; training pipeline (SFT → GRPO) and reward design (answer + retrieval).
- Key figures/tables: Fig. 1 (lost-in-thought illustration), main RULER/HELMET results, plots/tables on 10K-train → 128K-eval generalization, and ablations on constrained decoding and retrieval rewards.
- Innovations to verify: (i) interleaved retrieval during reasoning, (ii) verifiable recall spans, (iii) context-constrained decoding for faithful citation, (iv) fine-grained rewards for retrieval success.

skim (high-level):
- Read first: Introduction (why long CoT hurts retrieval; contrast to one-shot retrieval assumptions), method overview (recall spans + constrained decoding), main RULER/HELMET tables plus the length-generalization takeaway, and one or two core ablations (remove constrained decoding / remove retrieval reward).
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s key message is that retrieval and reasoning form a coupled loop: reasoning creates new retrieval needs, yet also makes retrieval harder. The solution is not merely longer contexts or one-shot pre-retrieval, but making retrieval an explicit action inside reasoning and training it with verifiable recall and rewards—showing strong long-context gains even without ultra-long training sequences.

recommendation.zh: 只看失效曲线与方法对照：它把“越想越找不到证据”的现象钉死为可复现问题，提醒你做长CoT/长上下文时必须把检索做成显式步骤而非指望注意力自发完成。
recommendation.en: Skim the failure curves + key comparisons: it makes “longer CoT hurts in-context retrieval” a reproducible pathology, implying retrieval must be an explicit step in long-context reasoning rather than an attention side-effect.
